data.title: Run into the CEO's Secret Playroom
data.intro: When intern Mila accidentally stumbles into CEO Leo's secret playroom, she is drawn into a dangerous and seductive game of forbidden desire. As power, lust, and family ethics collide, their hidden office affair threatens to unravel into public scandal. Can they break free from the shadows and confront their true feelings when everything is exposed?

data.title: No Escape From The Mafia King's Embrace
data.intro: On Valentine's night, nurse Lydia Hale saves a dying stranger—then learns he's Soren Moretti, a feared mafia king. He offers a brutal ultimatum: marry him or die. Trapped in his dangerous world, desire clashes with defiance. As a 30-day love contract ends, Lydia must choose freedom—or life beside a ruthless mafia king.

data.title: The Bride They Feared, The Queen They Crowned
data.intro: Bella Elmer's half-sister, Lisa Elmer, steals her wedding gift and marriage. Her fiancé wants to take Lisa as his main wife and Bella as his concubine. To change her fate, Bella volunteers to marry the 80-year-old King of Bexar. On her wedding night, she defends herself with a knife, only to realize that the bridegroom is Marcus Keagan, the god of war. From then on, Princess Bella and Prince Marcus join hands to quash their enemies and rule over their dominion.

data.title: Kissing the Wrong Brother
data.intro: To win the heart of her crush before graduation, nerd Aria enlists the help of his dangerously charming older brother for a crash course in intimacy—only to discover she might be learning how to love the wrong guy. She asks him for lessons in sex and intimacy. And her crush's brother becomes her love coach.

data.title: Falling for the Janitor Everyone Looked Down On
data.intro: Once the founder of Tae Sung Bio and now hiding as a cleaner, Park Chang-wook is pushed out by his son under pressure from his wife and mother-in-law. His life takes a turn when he saves Jia and later marries her mother, Se-yeon. Framed for a fake painting, Se-yeon faces bankruptcy. Chang-wook steps in with a genuine artwork but is branded a thief. As Se-yeon defends him, his true identity emerges.

data.title: Wild Ride with the Dangerous Kian
data.intro:
Lydia Gray, a sheltered daughter of a cop, meets Kian Wilder, the dangerously magnetic leader of the Dark Hawks, on her eighteenth birthday. One night of adrenaline and escape changes everything. When Lydia learns that the man she's fallen for is the criminal her father has been hunting, desire and danger collide. 
The line between love and ruin blurs—can she survive this wild ride?

data.title: A Life That Shines Again
data.intro: For seven years, Yun Seo-rin has given everything to her billionaire husband and their daughter. On her birthday, she discovers they are celebrating her husband's half-sister instead of her. Realizing she has been abandoned, Seo-rin quietly prepares for divorce and withdraws from both the family and the company. Only then do they understand the depth of what they've lost. Cast aside by both her love and her family, Seo-rin is determined to reclaim her dignity and her life.

data.title: It's Too Late to Apologize
data.intro:
Her husband accused her of trapping him. Her daughter wished for a different mom. Now she's gone.
After one last betrayal, Zoey signs the divorce papers and disappears.What will they do when they realize she's never coming back?

data.title: If Only You Loved Me More
data.intro: Five years ago, Alex nearly died saving Beth, who donated her kidney to him, causing her blood cancer. While she sought treatment abroad, Alex's secretary Stella lied that Beth had left him and claimed she was his donor. Betrayed, Alex married Beth out of spite, torturing her until her illness returned. After losing everything, Alex learned Beth was his true savior and the heiress of the wealthiest Duncan family.

data.title: The Bedmate Game Sharehouse
data.intro: Ju-yeon subs in on <The Bedmate Game Sharehouse>, R-rated dating reality show. Intimate contact is mandatory and bedmate swaps every night! Ex-boyfirend Inho, nice Jae-hee, and sexy Se-heon is waiting for her in the sharehouse. And their exes start moving in... Participants approach her through a moral-bending rule. Romance vs Money, Instinct vs Reason. Ju-yeon's shaky decision-making begins.

data.title: Plus Size Plus Love
data.intro: Amber, a plus-size girl in the fashion world, is dealing with heartbreak and workplace bullying—until one accidental knock on the head changes everything. After getting literally struck by her true love, she wakes up believing she's miraculously transformed into the most stunning beauty on the planet! With unshakable confidence, she snags her dream "supermodel" gig and a steamy night with fashion director Nathan—kickstarting a hilarious will-they-won't-they office romance.

data.title: Your Husband is The Tech King
data.intro: A humble repairman secretly saves a tech empire—revealed as the vanished Tech King. Betrayed by his girlfriend's greed, he reclaims power and dignity, while a brilliant CEO sees his true worth and becomes his new ally and love.

data.title: Alpha King's Silent Cinderella
data.intro: Saved by a girl who lost her voice for him, Alpha King Evan reunites with Claudia 20 years later—now mute and abused. Bound by fate and lies, he must choose between power, vows, and true love.

data.title: Your Billionaire Bride Is My Cheating Wife
data.intro: On his birthday, low-profile billionaire Anthony discovers his wife is marrying another man—using his identity, money, and status. Crashing the wedding as a “nobody,” he endures public humiliation until the truth erupts: he is the real CEO and Mafia King. As lies unravel, Anthony reclaims his power, exposing betrayal and delivering ruthless revenge.

data.title: Divorced, Now a Lycan Princess
data.intro: After being cast aside by her powerful Alpha husband and forced to conceal her miraculous pregnancy, a seemingly ordinary human woman discovers she is actually the long-lost Lycan Princess. As her secret identity awakens, she reclaims her power, exposes betrayal, and challenges the ruthless werewolf hierarchy—not just to protect her unborn child, but to decide her own fate.

data.title: Till Death and Forever After
data.intro: Deceived by her fiancé and betrayed by her family, Nina Sand loses everything—her fortune and even her life. Her death is staged as a suicide, and her soul lingers at her funeral, seething with rage yet powerless. Then, the obsessed military governor Jensen Stewart storms in, kills her betrayers, and takes his own life. Only then does Nina realize his love, vowing to marry no one but him in her next life.

data.title: Boss, She Said No Again!
data.intro: Abandoned for sixteen years, Rowena returns to New York to reclaim her mother's inheritance. Posing as the Kingsley second son's fiancée, she plans a breakup as cover. But she saves Damien Kingsley, the Kingsley's elder son, from a mafia attack. Intrigued, Damien forces into her life. As Rowena navigates traps from her scheming family and ruthless Mrs. Kingsley, her bond with Damien shifts from enemies to allies as they uncover the truth behind a mysterious murder.

data.title: The Alpha King's True Luna
data.intro: Her dad's life on the line, the piteous Omega agrees to pose as her pack's princess and enter the brutal contest to marry the feared Alpha King. Everyone says he's a monster. She spends one night with him and realizes he's not hideous or cruel... He's actually super sweet.

data.title: Daddy Dominant's Good Girl
data.intro: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Olivia finds herself drawn to his powerful, dominant father. What starts as revenge spirals into a dangerous game of desire, secrets, and control—where she might lose more than just her heart.

data.title: Watch Out, I'm The Lady Boss
data.intro: After being cast aside by the man she helped rise to power, Eleanor—secret CEO of the powerful Thunder Circle—is thrust back into the spotlight when a mysterious billionaire proposes marriage, shaking high society to its core.

data.title: Step Back! Nothing Escapes the Eagle
data.intro: After three years of secretly safeguarding his wife, James Wilson is stunned when she returns from war carrying another man's child, and the truth he reveals at her ceremony leaves Julia with a regret she can never undo.

data.title: Daddy Don't Go, Please Save Mommy
data.intro: Seven years ago, Grace sacrificed everything to save the man she loved, and vanished in a car crash while eight months pregnant.  Now, her secret little daughter unknowingly draws her back into a world of danger and revenge. This time, their story will end differently.

data.title: His Love Was A Lie
data.intro: After two years in a passionless marriage, Charlotte discovers her emotionally distant husband has secretly been in love with his stepsister all along — and she’s just been his cover. So she tells the truth to his stepsister and leaves him, but he ends up regretting it.

data.title: The Mafia's Obsession
data.intro: Augusto Castro can't stand the thought of his only sister Alice getting hitched to some monster man due to an old-school marriage pact from 15 years back. He decides to pull a fast one on the agreement and steps in to marry the notorious mob boss, Pietro, in her place. Little did he know, it was all a love trap set by Pietro.

data.title: A Deal With My Billionaire Donor
data.intro: Claire Miller, desperate to have a child after being diagnosed with premature ovarian failure, vows to get pregnant before her ex’s new girlfriend gives birth. Enter Ethan Reed—a billionaire forced to marry or lose his inheritance. They strike a “sperm contract” for mutual benefit, but when Ethan becomes her new boss, sparks ignite and emotions blur. Can a fake marriage born of pride turn into real love?

data.title: Almost Lover
data.intro: Evelyn returns from her prenatal checkup to find her husband massaging oil onto his first love's belly. When Evelyn suffers a severe allergic reaction, he locks her in a room and ignores her pain—she loses the baby. Shattered, she walks away and rebuilds at her friend's architecture firm. Months later, Edward finds her at the love-lock bridge where they vowed forever, threatening to jump unless she forgives him. Will Evelyn save the man who destroyed her, or let him fall?

data.title: The Rival I'm Falling For
data.intro: To salvage his reputation after a scandalous accidental kiss with scholarship student Xavier Miller, popular quarterback Alex Watson proposes a fake dating scheme. Bound by a contract, they must convincingly perform as the campus "it" couple until the student election is over. Alex seeks to repair his image, while the financially struggling Xavier needs the money.

data.title: His to Claim, His to Love(DUBBED)
data.intro: Village doctor Carol Xavier supports her fiancé Preston Leigh through college, only to learn he's married another woman in the city. Heartbroken, she cuts all ties. By chance, she saves mafia leader Mateo Steele, who falls for her at first sight. Touched by his warmth and honesty, Carol finds herself falling too. But just as happiness nears, Preston's jealous wife plots to destroy their love.

data.title: Bound by Blood:The Mafia King's Sweetheart
data.intro: Lily, a young bakery worker, saves Mafia boss Salvatore with her rare blood, sparking a dangerous connection. After being sold by her stepmother, she’s rescued by him and thrown into a world of luxury and violence. As they grow closer, they face betrayal, jealousy, and violence from those around them, including his delusional 'fiancée' Bianca. Despite everything, their bond strengthens, culminating in their marriage and the birth of twins, marking a happy end.

data.title: Legally Sexy and Mr. Ice Cold
data.intro: A one-night stand with billionaire Leo Whitney leaves law student Summer Ellis unexpectedly pregnant. Her toxic sister, Angie, steals Summer's identity and becomes Leo's fiancée. Six years later, Summer crosses paths with Leo again—this time with her five-year-old daughter, Melody. As Summer represents Leo in a custody case, the buried truth resurfaces, and love ignites.

data.title: Hot Gardener's Seduction
data.intro: Carol, having endured years of neglect and humiliating rejections from her husband William, finds her spirit withered. Her life changes when the young gardener—Arthur—intrudes upon her solitude. His intense gaze and unabashed allure leave her emotionally torn.Just as she succumbs to Arthur's ardent pursuit, rediscovering a passion long absent, Carol makes a devastating discovery: Arthur was planted by William.

data.title: My World Ends with You
data.intro: To avenge his father's death due to medical malpractice, Luca retaliates against Scarlett, the daughter of the attending doctor, by throwing her into a mental hospital for torture and humiliation. But what his heart keeps telling him is...

data.title: A Mother's Triumph: I Have Three Powerful Sons
data.intro: On Christmas, Tessa Preston gets an unexpected call from her estranged father inviting her home for dinner. She arrives alone with gifts, while her three powerful sons plan to join later. The moment she steps inside, her stepmother and step-siblings mock her "poverty" and try to humiliate her—unaware of the strength and influence her sons truly hold.

data.title: Fake Dating The Quarterback on Christmas
data.intro: With Christmas right around the corner, a sharp-tongued writer and an egotistical NFL star become reluctant roommates, clashing at every turn—unaware they’re actually each other's beloved online pen pals. Already head-over-heels in digital love, the pair attempt to navigate family, friends, and rivals whilst driving each other crazy in real life this holiday season.

data.title: My Crush Thinks I'm A Boy
data.intro: Ari fakes her identity to get into an all-boys elite fencing school—but when her new roommate is the school's golden boy and ex-hookup, staying hidden might be harder than winning.

data.title: Pucked by My Brother's Rival
data.intro:
Good girl Jenny's first rule? Never sleep with the enemy -especially not Xavier, her brother Samuel's rival and the league's most insatiable player. But when he catches her mid-fantasy with his nude photo between her thighs, rules shatter faster than the headboard in his bedroom. Facing Xavier's relentless pursuit, the closet, the bathroom, and her exclusive lingerie...
Now they're playing a dangerous game of ‘pretend we’re not fucking’—and Samuel is about to find out.

data.title: Unwanted True Mate
data.intro:
A human girl, whose fated mate was stolen from her, overcomes countless obstacles to reclaim
her destined mate and discover her werewolf heritage.

data.title: The One I was Meant to Marry
data.intro: After being cruelly abandoned, kind-hearted artist Troy impulsively marries a mysterious woman, Gabriella, at the courthouse. As his manipulative ex-fiancée and her family try to humiliate and reclaim him, Troy discovers Gabriella is the very girl he once saved in childhood—and a powerful heiress. Choosing self-worth and true love, Troy finally breaks free from betrayal to claim a future he deserves.

data.title: The Legal Queen's Comeback
data.intro: Six years ago, after "the Legal Queen" Nora won the rape and murder case, she stepped away from the legal profession for her marriage. However, she returned to the legal world due to her husband Darren's involvement in a major case, exposed Darren's crimes and betrayal, and sent him to prison. With the support of her assistant Ethan, Nora reclaimed the nickname of "the Legal Queen" and took back control of her life, achieving a happy ending in both her career and love life.

data.title: They Love Me Too Late
data.intro: After her family's bankruptcy, Joy was lovingly taken in by the Reynolds brothers until Megan, the maid's daughter, arrived. Megan's scheming framed Joy, turning the brothers against her. Tired of years of mistreatment, Joy left to marry Nathan, a powerful heir, and start a new life.  Will the brothers realize the truth before it's too late?

data.title: Through Ashes Their Sorrow Awakens
data.intro: Ashley, the Langstons' biological daughter, spends years in prison after Lilith, the adopted daughter, frames her. When she gets out, her whole family—including her fiancé Ethan—still believes Lilith's lies and keeps hurting her. To make Lilith happy, Ethan even agrees to a fake wedding with her. On the day of their wedding, Ashley stages her own death in a fire and leaves for good. That's when they're shocked, panicked, and burning with regret.

data.title: Time To Cut Off My Shameless Family
data.intro: After discovering that her "perfect" foster sister Nancy uses a secret power to turn their family against her, Peggy is murdered. But she wakes up ten years in the past—the year her family first adopted Nancy. Now, she must expose the truth and finally break free from her toxic family.

data.title: If I Never Loved You
data.intro: Five years ago, Elena sacrificed her heart to mysterious billionaire Victor for a 30 billion investment, saving Nolan's bankrupt family and his life, then lied about being money-driven to break up with him. Five years later, Nolan becomes a tycoon, engaged to Sophia, who actually plotted his family's downfall.

data.title: Engraved On Your Heart
data.intro: To save Damien's life, Scarlett broke up with him and raised their daughter alone. Now, because of her terminally ill, she pretends to be the villain again, just to send their daughter back to Damien—until the truth comes out and the family is finally reunited.

data.title: The Fae King is My Shadow Daddy
data.intro: In order to keep peace among the fae and humans, a young human woman must marry the deadly, immortal fae High King and produce an heir before all-out war erupts between the two species. Will the Fae King help the human survive the ruthless fae court?

data.title: Miss You After Goodbye
data.intro: To repay a debt of kindness, Neil signs a secret contract with Keira's father stating that he will marry Keira for five years and help her recover from a painful breakup with her first love, Simon. During their contract marriage, Neil is attentive and caring towards Keira, but she never treats him as anything more than Simon's substitute. When the contract comes to an end, Neil discovers Keira's persistent infatuation with Simon and finally decides to divorce her.

data.title: Love on a Mission: Capture His Heart
data.intro: International secret agent Rhea Keller poses as a tutor for spoiled heir Owen Kane. She sees past his defiance to the trauma beneath and, learning he's the son of the woman who saved her, becomes his protector. They grow close through conflict but are torn apart. Three years later, Owen is a CEO, Rhea lives quietly, and their reunion sparks the redemption they both need.

data.title: Reverse Harem Chaos: Healing Beasts, Capturing Hearts
data.intro: Veterinary intern June Stone awakens in a beastman world as the notorious Peacock Princess and gains a rare, touch-based healing ability. Using modern medical knowledge, she heals the merman Silas Selve, a fierce warrior, and other powerful beastmen. Once despised, she rises with their support, stepping into a sweet tangle of love and becoming a formidable force, achieving both success and romance.

data.title: I Loved Until It Hurt (DUBBED)
data.intro: On their 20th anniversary, Colin Clark's wife took their son abroad to celebrate her first love's birthday—but was kidnapped instead. With no enough money for ransom, Colin was forced to take Evan's place as the hostage. She promised to return for him, but he waited in vain for three years. When he finally comes home, everything has changed. Just as he resolves to leave for good, his wife refuses to let him go.

data.title: After Prison, She is No One's Daughter
data.intro: After serving six years in prison for a crime she didn't commit, Linda returns to the Dalink family only to face further betrayal and abuse. As she uncovers the truth behind the incident that ruined her life, she fights back with the help of Leaf, her childhood protector. Together, they expose the family's dark secrets and bring justice to those who wronged her.

data.title: Adieu, My Almost Forever (DUBBED)
data.intro: Ignored by her father in favor of her stepsister, Whitney Lovell turns to Hector Elwood for protection and slowly falls for him—only to be met with cold indifference and even cruelty, for his heart belongs to her stepsister. Shattered, Whitney marries the paralyzed heir Carson Monroe, who offers her stability. But when regret consumes Hector, he fights desperately to win her back, begging for the love he once cast aside.

data.title: Master of All Arts, Conqueror of Love
data.intro: Disciple of Berge Sanctum, Frank Cole, descends the mountain and goes to Toxra. He asks for Linda Todd's hand in marriage, but the Todds go back on their word because of his shabby appearance. Right after Frank breaks off their engagement, the grandfather of Toxra's most beautiful woman wants him as his grandson-in-law. Armed with superb medical skills and great abilities, Frank wins over powerful allies. At the same time, he becomes entangled with four remarkable women.

data.title: Divorce, My Happily Ever After (DUBBED)
data.intro: Betrayed by her husband and his mistress while five months pregnant, Rosie Turner is cast out in humiliation despite having sacrificed everything for him. After the divorce, she finds new strength in Andrew Jaffe, a young and charismatic CEO who not only helps her seek revenge but also supports her rise to success. With him by her side, Rosie discovers both triumph in her career and lasting happiness in love.

data.title: Divorced, Then Find My Mr. Right
data.intro: After a brutal betrayal, Hazel loses her marriage, child, and dignity. Rising from despair, she reunites with Evan, a powerful man who helps her reclaim her career, self-worth, and take control of her fate.

data.title: Forever, If Only (DUBBED)
data.intro: Mike Abbot has loved Elsa Parker for fifteen years—devoting himself to her, even giving up his passion for art. But everything shatters when he watches her fall for someone else. Heartbroken, Mike changes his name and leaves the country, never expecting that Elsa will one day search the world for the man she let slip away.

data.title: Boss, Your Executive Secretary has Resigned
data.intro: Anne deeply in love with the Jackson, gives up her position as chief jewelry designer to become his personal secretary and secret lover, until she witnesses the Jackson and his first love Melissa being carried naked into an ambulance after carbon monoxide poisoning. After handling the situation, she decides to resign and return to her career.

data.title: You'll Be a Memory, Nothing More
data.intro: To repay the Bentons' kindness, Heidi Stroud gives up studying abroad and marries Clive Benton, hoping to heal the wounds left by his first love, Serena Alcott. For five years, she endures his indifference and humiliation, only to be divorced upon Serena's return. Heartbroken, Heidi pursues her art and rebuilds her life with childhood sweetheart Seth Fuller—while Clive's regret comes far too late.

data.title: Fake Dating My Rich Nemesis
data.intro: When a sassy high school girl returns to North Lake High, she doesn't expect to have a one-night mistake with the Beaumont heir, her childhood nemesis, and later team up with him to piss off their exes. Will they eventually fall in love?

data.title: 3.2.1, Farewell Forever
data.intro: Joy, completely disillusioned with her seven-year marriage to Wyatt, wants to leave with their son, Caleb, who has never known his father's love. However, Caleb decides to give his dad three final chances. Will Wyatt be able to seize these opportunities?

data.title: When Distance Became His Answer  (DUBBED)
data.intro: For the sake of his childhood friends, Winona Shaw and Naomi Zabel, Frank Lovell gives up a prestigious opportunity to study abroad and chooses to attend the same university as them. But after they meet Calvin Gibbs, Winona and Naomi begin to misunderstand and neglect Frank, leaving him increasingly sidelined. Disheartened and disillusioned, Frank finally decides to walk away—choosing to chase his dreams overseas.

data.title: I Thought You Were Him
data.intro: After losing her fiancé, Silas, in a brutal gang war, Mafia princess Stella Moretti is shattered—until she crosses paths with Milo who looks exactly like him. He has no ties to her world, but Stella doesn't care. Desperate to fill the void Silas left behind, she snatches Milo from his life and brings him into hers, determined to keep him by any means necessary.

data.title: Oath of Rebirth, Debt of Blood
data.intro: Nina Spur, the prime minister's wife, was slain at a palace banquet by her own sister, Jane Spur—the emperor's forsaken concubine. Yet fate rewinds. Both sisters are reborn at the moment the Levy family's proposal arrives. Jane seizes it, vowing to marry Luke Levy, the future Prime Minister, while "gifting" Nina the chance to enter the imperial selection instead.

data.title: Queen's Fury: Fall Before Her Wrath (DUBBED)
data.intro: Sadie Firth is the daughter of the city's most notorious crime boss. After she gets married, she hides her true identity. Her daughter, Becky, suffers a heart attack on her birthday. Sadie rushes her to the hospital. As she is in a hurry, she overtakes her dad's girlfriend, Lyla Seyfried, who is offended and blocks her way. Backed by her dad and three brothers, Sadie deals with Lyla and exposes her cheating husband. She walks away with dignity for herself and Becky.

data.title: Love The Way You Lie
data.intro: Molly’s sister didn’t just swipe her boyfriend Connor—she also snatched her inheritance, leaving Molly high and dry. Fueled by alcohol and vengeance, Molly hatches a wild plan: seduce Connor’s attractive uncle, Adrian. Little does she know, her half-baked scheme works a little too well, because Adrian soon finds himself head over heels for Molly.

data.title: A Dangerous Engagement: The Bride He Mustn't Touch
data.intro:
I ran from the mob at 18. My dad, the mafia king, couldn't find me. And neither could Angelo, my stepbrother, my father's legally adopted son. When my father suddenly died, Angelo found me and brought me back. Though we were never raised together, Angelo saw me as his innocent responsibility. He insisted I marry for my safety and the empire's stability, and took charge of selecting my future husband.
But I wanted Angelo to marry me.

data.title: Knocked Up by the Silver Fox Alpha
data.intro: Clara, a humble she-wolf born without a wolf, is cast aside by her fiancé Drake and shunned by the pack. But everything changes when she's rescued—and claimed—by Theo Sterling, the powerful Alpha and Drake's father. As secrets unravel and enemies close in, Clara must fight for her place, her love, and the future of her unborn heirs.

data.title: Betrayal Was Your Choice, Reckoning Is Mine
data.intro: While on vacation with her mother-in-law, Anna Jensen, Wendy Smith discovers her husband Shane Holt's affair—and a conspiracy he and his father have hatched to seize control of the company. When Anna collapses from a heart attack, Wendy takes matters into her own hands, exposing them at the company's annual meeting. With the shares Anna entrusts to her, Wendy seizes full control, punishes the perpetrators, and protects those who truly deserve justice.

data.title: Carrying His Babies, Stealing His Heart
data.intro:
Ella Reed is a struggling college student who’s barely making ends meet. Desperate
to cover her tuition, she accepts a one-night arrangement with Sebastian Harrington,
a billionaire heir from an affluent family grappling with a legacy of infertility. When
Ella discovers she’s pregnant with twins, Sebastian, eager to secure his family’s
long-awaited heir, brings her into his luxurious world to ensure a safe and peaceful
pregnancy.

data.title: Too Late to Leave You
data.intro: Desperate to save her comatose brother, a struggling grad student Alice accepts a humiliating offer from the cold-hearted billionaire Mr. Keane, only to discover he is the high school crush she fell for eight years ago. Love kindles from their transactional relationship; but beneath, a deadly family conspiracy is smoldering.

data.title: Ruling Over All I See II: Path to Dominion(DUBBED)
data.intro: Judah Shaw transmigrates into the ancient world, married to three wealthy wives. But before he gets to enjoy life, his second wife Willa Zorath gets abducted by Lotia Sect, who aims to have Judah surrender to them. Unwilling to yield, he defeats the sect leader and saves Willa, only to then be hunted by Ian Walton. But now bound with the sect leader's power, he easily reclaims safety—and starts a rebellion for justice.

data.title: Move to Countryside, Marry a Billionaire!
data.intro: Forced into a marriage to save her adoptive father, Louise Mitchell leaves the city for the countryside, only to discover her "farmer" husband, Troy Scott, is actually a hidden billionaire. Bound by a three-month contract, their rocky start slowly transforms into trust and passion, as schemes, family conflicts, and secrets test their love.

data.title: The Longlost Heiress's Return
data.intro: Nova Park is lost due to an accident, and her mother Zoe Park, determined to find her, establishes the world’s largest conglomerate and offers a huge reward. Finally, she receives news of her daughter at a medical laboratory. However, when she arrives, she witnesses her daughter's dignity being crushed by opportunists. Determined, Zoe vows to teach them a harsh lesson.

data.title: Oops! Mr. Lawson Got the Wrong Girl(DUBBED)
data.intro: After a round of drinks, Sara Joy, an intern at Lawson Corp, acts under the influence of alcohol and has a one-night stand with her boss, Ted Lawson. Upon waking up, she leaves immediately unnoticed but fails to cut ties cleanly as she accidentally leaves her best friend’s resume in the room. Taking advantage of this, Mandy Fox impersonates Sara and moves into Pine View, living under the same roof as Ted.Meanwhile, Sara hopes to maintain a low profile as an ordinary intern.

data.title: Ruling Over All I See (DUBBED)
data.intro: Soon after unemployed graduate Judah Shaw finds himself a penniless scholar in Qirelia, he is forced by the system to win his wives' affection, despite their marriages being purely convenient. To his surprise, among them are a princess, a general's daughter, and a merchant heiress, who bring him not only fortune but also a future brighter than he ever imagined.

data.title: Queen Mom Rules
data.intro: At her parents' anniversary party, a successful CEO is dismissed as a low-class nobody, her diamond gift is called fake, and she's even banned from the table!

data.title: I Kissed A CEO And He Liked It
data.intro: Gabrielle Taylor, a bold young model, is publicly humiliated and fired after discovering her ex is marrying her best friend. A spontaneous kiss with powerful CEO Kyle Wright sets off a chain of events that pulls her into his world. Hired as his assistant, Gabrielle must navigate ambition, romance, and betrayal in a glamorous, high-stakes world.

data.title: House Husband? Try Supreme Immortal (DUBBED)
data.intro: Logan Bale, an immortal who has walked the earth for a thousand years, fulfills a dying promise to his disciple—to protect his family for three years. To honor that vow, he marries his disciple's granddaughter, only to be met with her family's scorn and cruelty. Yet undeterred, he endures their contempt with quiet resolve, holding fast to one promise of his own: to walk away the moment those three years come to an end.

data.title: The Bad Boy Who Ruined Me
data.intro: Hazel Smith, a math prodigy with a quiet life, arrives at LA Tech, determined to succeed. But when she accidentally breaks a luxury watch belonging to Zach Lloyd—the school‘s infamous bad boy and billionaire heir—her life takes a sharp turn. Zach gives her an ultimatum: spend time with him or pay up.

data.title: Divorced at the Wedding Day
data.intro: Alessia DeLuca returns home after years abroad, widowed and pregnant, to attend her brother Enzo's engagement party. A misunderstanding occurs when Caroline, the bride-to-be's mother, mistakes Alessia for Enzo's mistress. Sophie, the bride, storms into Enzo's mansion and physically confronts Alessia. She drags Alessia to the engagement party, humiliating her in front of the guests. The situation escalates until Enzo arrives to reveal the truth.

data.title: Keep the Ring, I'll Take My Crown (DUBBED)
data.intro: More than a decade after wealthy Jake Carr marries the stunning but ordinary Sara Stokes, he throws it all away with an affair he doesn't even take seriously. Humiliated and heartbroken, Sara files for divorce—and over the next year, reinvents herself as a popular streamer. Now, Jake is drowning in regret, but it's too late. Sara has already found happiness in the arms of tycoon Bryan Searle, who can't wait to make her his wife.

data.title: A Promise Weathered to Nothing (DUBBED)
data.intro: In love with Irene Thayer since their school days, Oscar Eaton gave up a promising future to become her secretary, finally earning a place by her side after a one-night stand. But everything changes four years later when her first love, Aaron Paxton, returns. Heartbroken, Oscar walks away to build a life of his own—while the echo of regret begins to stir in Irene's heart.

data.title: Eight Wings of Destruction: The World Trembles at My Summon
data.intro: Harry Jobson transmigrates into a world of beast summoning and calls forth a top-tier succubus—only for her to defect to a wealthy man. What she doesn't know is that Harry has a system. He activates it and summons a Fallen Angel, drawing widespread mockery. But when the Eight-Winged Angel descends to Earth, the entire world trembles at her arrival!

data.title: Not His Choice, Not His Ending(DUBBED)
data.intro: Countryside girl Elise Jensen marries Cyrus Fenton in place of her twin, Sylvia, to secure an alliance between the two families. In the next three years, she endures neglect, misunderstandings, and harm, all for the promised pay. But when Sylvia reclaims her place, conflicts and complications arise, eventually bringing the truth to light. When Cyrus finally realizes his love for Elise, she has already started a new life with someone else.

data.title: Love Moves On Without You (DUBBED)
data.intro: Despite being in love with Nina Lane, Gavin Bowen marries Ava Green under family pressure, vowing to divorce after three years. Over the years, he neglects her, and the situation worsens when Nina returns from abroad. Heartbroken, Ava eventually leaves, and only then does Gavin realize what he's lost. As he faces bankruptcy and Nina reveals her true colors, Ava flourishes in her career and finds happiness with someone who truly loves her.

data.title: Escape With Boss's Baby
data.intro: Hermione Garcia is a famous computer genius and the heiress to the Garcia family,the wealthiest family in the South. She falls in love with Chris Evans, the President of LM Corporation, after he saves her at a banquet three years ago. To seek a genuine connection, Hermione conceals her identity and takes on the role of Chris's chief secretary, secretly dating him for three years.

data.title: The Lost Heir: A Christmas Reckoning
data.intro: On Christmas Eve, a lowly maintenance worker is dumped by his fiancée after she steals his revolutionary patent. At the company’s holiday party, she and her new fiancé publicly mock and humiliate him. But when a powerful stranger crashes the event and reveals he’s the worker’s long-lost father, the two join forces to turn the tables — delivering a Christmas revenge no one will forget.

data.title: The Father She Called Useless (DUBBED)
data.intro: For five years, William Zimmer fought through bloodbaths, clinging to life for the chance to return to his beloved daughter. When he finally comes back as the hero of Tereon, revered by millions, he discovers she is no longer the girl he once knew.

data.title: Kidnapped By The Gangster
data.intro: Nurse Chloe saves gang leader Liam while he is being hunted, only to be forcibly dragged into his dark world. To protect her family, she agrees to marry this dominant and dangerous man, but amid lies, betrayal, and revenge, she gradually discovers the tenderness and truth behind him. When the shadows of the past return, the two choose each other at the edge of life and death, and ultimately find rebirth through love and redemption.

data.title: What Remains After Love Burns Out(DUBBED)
data.intro: After a car accident, Earl Pearce loses all memory of Rowena Ortega—the woman he has loved for seven years. Daniel Ortega, Earl's best friend who has stayed by his side during his recovery, soon realizes Earl truly does not remember Rowena. This marks a turning point for Earl, who had been quietly courting her all this time, unaware that Rowena's heart still belongs to her ex-boyfriend.

data.title: The Little Healer Who Restored Love (DUBBED)
data.intro: Bea Ford, a young doctor born into poverty, rescues an elderly woman on her way to the city after being cast out by her mentor. In gratitude, the woman adopts Bea as her granddaughter. This leads Bea to meet her new adoptive father, Jim Hark, the city's wealthiest man, who is confined to a wheelchair by a mysterious ailment.

data.title: Daddy, Mommy Married a Better Man!
data.intro: A top pediatrician is despised by her husband, his ex, and even her own son. After saving her child with a blood transfusion, the credit is stolen. Despite endless sacrifices, she's publicly humiliated and forced to take the blame for her husband's ex. Broken, she divorces him—only to marry the richest man in the city and reunite with her biological son, switched at birth. In the end, they can only kneel and beg for her forgiveness.

data.title: Rescued by the Rugged Mountain Man
data.intro: Mia, a city girl who was hurt by her ex, was beaten and banished to a deep mountain covered in ice and snow. In the midst of hunger and cold, she was even attacked by a wild wolf. At this moment, a powerful man saved her. The two started off disliking each other but gradually developed feelings for one another. Mia also discovered the man's true identity and punished her evil ex. Eventually, they lived happily together.

data.title: The Stormbringer (DUBBED)
data.intro: Craig Bush, the master of martial arts and medical techniques, returns to the city. And that unfolds the story fraught with challenges as he navigates his way through them.

data.title: Hunter in the Ring: Gloves Off, Blood On (DUBBED)
data.intro: Once a ten-time boxing champion, Flynn Pierson hides his identity after serving time in prison and works as a janitor at a boxing club. But when the organization responsible for his father's murder resurfaces, Flynn is forced back into the ring of vengeance. Protecting his friends while unraveling the truth, he sets a deadly trap to draw out the mastermind—and make them pay the ultimate price.

data.title: The Choices of Fate (DUBBED)
data.intro: After their mother’s death, Kate and Amelia Morse face a cruel choice—only one can leave with their grieving grandmother. Believing wealth awaits, Amelia departs, only to find an ordinary life. Years later, envy consumes her when Kate marries into the wealthy Warren family. In a fit of rage, she kills her sister before taking her own life.

data.title: Back to Tomorrow: A Second Chance for Love(DUBBED)
data.intro: Cory Judd has had a crush on Zoe Stone for as long as he can remember. Just before graduating from college, he finally confesses—and she accepts him. While celebrating, he gets drunk. But when he wakes up, he finds himself seven years in the future. Not only is he married to Zoe, but he's also ruined their marriage. Zoe is disappointed in him, and their child suffers from psychological trauma that leaves them unable to speak.

data.title: My DA Daddy, Save My Mommy!
data.intro: Six years ago, a fire forced pregnant Audrey to fake her death and leave Alex. She raised their daughter Ivy struggling alone—six years later, a work-related injury dispute reunites them. When will Alex realize the child he’s treating so coldly is his daughter?

data.title: Roses & Riches: Secrets Behind the Name (DUBBED)
data.intro: Growing up together, Laura Depp and Jake Carter promised to marry after college. But on the day of their wedding, as Laura stands outside City Hall in her gown and holding a bouquet, she realizes she is nothing more than a joke Jake used to amuse Vivian Lown. Heartbroken and humiliated, she hands the bouquet to a scorned laborer and impulsively proposes marriage—unaware that he is, in fact, the wealthiest heir in Osted.

data.title: Love After Death: The One Who Never Left My Side(DUBBED)
data.intro: Zach Gould, heir to a prestigious family, must choose a fiancée from five women—Laura Stone, Tasha Litt, Celine Quinn, Yael Trent, and Mona Upton—on his 22nd birthday. In his previous life, he devoted himself to the aloof Laura, only to be betrayed by her, Tasha, Celine, and Yael. Broken, he died in a car accident; only Mona, the rival he had always dismissed, came to mourn him. Reborn with every painful memory, Zach chooses Mona this time.

data.title: The General's Secret Armory
data.intro: In a heart-stopping saga of destiny and survival, Mona Yates inherits more than just grief after her parents' death—she uncovers a mystical family heirloom that shatters the boundaries of time itself. Thrust into the chaos of ancient Norwell, she meets Cedric Zahn, a fierce young general fighting to protect his people from annihilation.

data.title: When Time Unlocks Love
data.intro: Abandoned by her first love, Im Eun-ju impulsively accepts Kim Woo-jin's proposal. Woo-jin gives up his dream of becoming a doctor and becomes a stay-at-home husband to develop a cure for Eun-ju's allergy. Despite his devotion, Eun-ju remains indifferent toward him. When her first love returns, Woo-jin voluntarily divorces her so she can reunite with him. By the time Eun-ju realizes her mistake in letting him go, he has long since left her world to pursue his dream.

data.title: When She Stole My Lover
data.intro: Lim Min-young, has been living in pain, having everything taken away from her half-sister. Choi Shi-hyuk, mistakenly mistook the girl he passed by as a child for Lim Hye-ri, leaving a deep wound for Min-young. After abandoning everything and leaving, Min-young meets Hyun-woo. Shi-hyuk finally realized the truth and belatedly tried to catch her.

data.title: Badass Heiress Returns
data.intro: After a harsh upbringing, Evelyn Vincent returns to her wealthy family, only to find her place taken by Isabella, the adopted daughter she was swapped with at birth. Armed with resilience and a sharp mind, Evelyn navigates a hostile household, confronting her biased mother, hostile brother, and manipulative rival. She fights for her rightful place, from school conflicts to corporate battles.

data.title: She Was Never a Good Girl
data.intro: Orphaned young, Na Danbi is raised under the iron rule of her strict uncle, who molds her life to his desires. Outwardly obedient but fiercely independent inside, she spends a night with Moon Seowon at her cousin's wedding, hoping his influence can free her from her uncle's control. But when he unexpectedly falls for her, they are both drawn into a perilous web of love, power, and secrets.

data.title: BellyFullofPower:Mama'sMiniMastermind (DUBBED)
data.intro: Honest, simple country girl Sophia Snyder interns at a hotel when she unexpectedly spends the night with wealthy Shawn Granger. She becomes pregnant and, hearing her baby's thoughts, realizes her past mistakes left them both to suffer. Determined to change their fate, Sophia vows to protect herself and her child. Guided by her unborn child, she rises to wealth, finds true love, and embraces a happy life.

data.title: Spoiled by My Billionaire Baby Daddy
data.intro: Broke and desperate, college student Yuna Lee agrees to a one-night deal with Sejun Han, the cold and powerful heir of a wealthy chaebol family plagued by generations of infertility. When Yuna unexpectedly ends up pregnant—with twins—Sejun is shocked but determined. He brings her into his world, offering protection, luxury, and everything she’s ever been denied.

data.title: The Invincible Bodyguard: One Punch to the Heart (DUBBED)
data.intro: Top bodyguard, Fred York, is hired to protect Scarlet Gould. Not only does he need to fend off assassins and dismantle dark schemes, but he also has to resolve the misunderstandings between himself and Scarlet. As enemies close in, Fred never abandons his duty. He strikes back with force and clears all obstacles. With each clash, he slowly reveals long-buried past secrets that have something to do with him.

data.title: From Trouble to Triumph: When All Turns Around	 (DUBBED)
data.intro: When a PhD graduate in mechanical and materials engineering accidentally transmigrates into the body of the notorious wastrel Ralph Wright, he faces the threat of losing his family's wealth and his wife. Armed with modern knowledge, he leads the village to prosperity. Though his actions appear reckless, Ralph reshapes his destiny, saves his family from disaster, and gradually earns Silvia Lowe's respect across time.

data.title: Married by Fate, Feared by All
data.intro: Pierre Young, a rare genius, is forced into divorce after a three-year marriage he agreed to under his mentor's orders. But what seems to be a fall turns into a path towards success when a stunning CEO pulls him into a flash marriage—his life as a respected doctor and feared hero begins, bringing his name to glory and leaving his ex-wife in never-ending regret.

data.title: From Simp to Sigma: Rich, Single, and Desired
data.intro: Cody Lawson has pursued Selene Zeller for three years, but to no avail—until, in the depths of his despair, he unexpectedly activates the "Simp System." Frustrated by constant rejection, he exploits the system's glitches to buy himself a life of luxury. Just as he resigns himself to being rich but alone, women suddenly begin flocking to him.

data.title: Love Frequency at 30,000 Feet
data.intro: Air traffic controller Grace has secretly loved elite pilot Liam for a decade, her admiration hidden behind the radar screens of the control tower. A fateful blind date unexpectedly reunites them, igniting an impulsive decision to marry. Their whirlwind union begins as a marriage of convenience but soon navigates turbulent skies.

data.title: I Played the Game, He Claimed My Heart
data.intro: Jane Elkins, the illegitimate daughter scorned by the Elkins family, has endured endless humiliation from her stepmother and sister. Determined to take revenge, she wins over Jeremy Voss—the powerful heir and her sister's secret crush. But as fate intertwines their paths, Jane and Jeremy find themselves falling hopelessly in love.

data.title: In Other Words, I Love You
data.intro: When Alice scores a scholarship to London's elite Ashford Institute, she clashes with the school's royal pain, Charles "King" Kenward. But one wild twist lands them under the same roof... And their rivalry? About to turn dangerously romantic.

data.title: Hero Should Never Stay Low
data.intro: A retired war hero hiding as a humble mechanic is dragged back into conflict when he defends a woman from injustice. As his secret past unfolds, he becomes entangled in love, corruption, and revenge—proving that a true hero can never stay low.

data.title: Cheer Up Baby!
data.intro: Jane, the mascot of the  High School cheerleading team, is bullied by the school tyrant. Additionally, her house is destroyed by a tornado, forcing her to move in with her childhood nemesis, whom she hasn't seen in years, affectionately nicknamed "Tubby." Unexpectedly, Tubby turns out to be the new, tall, and handsome captain of the school's basketball team.

data.title: Never Come Back
data.intro: Orphaned, Nam Yujin grows up with the three Nam brothers, with the promise that one of them will marry her on her coming-of-age. But upon the return of their true sister Nam Sua, Nam Yujin loses their love and sinks into desperation. Even when she marries her suitor Ha Jihoon, they deem her as attention-seeking and only regret after unveiling Nam Sua's true colors—but Nam Yujin is never coming back.

data.title: FYI: My Love Ship's Sailed Without You
data.intro: After five years trapped in a loveless marriage, Kayla discovers her husband still loves his ex. Heartbroken but determined, she files for divorce, reignites her career as a fashion designer, and rises again to reclaim her life and dignity.

data.title: Wife on the Run, Again! (DUBBED)
data.intro: While Jay Glover tells others not to bully his wife, Riley Keller, just because she is a country girl, the socialites fall silent. After all, Riley outshines them effortlessly, without even trying. Jay paints her as kind-hearted and innocent, but he seems to have forgotten the patients she has treated and the enemies she has killed. Even he himself is under her control, yet he claims she never opposes him.

data.title: Too Wild to Love
data.intro: After returning as an illegitimate daughter, Cara is caught in emotional turmoil between her adoptive brother Brian and wealthy heir Leo. Targeted by Moona’s schemes, she strikes a deal with Leo to save her adoptive father. Despite family opposition and public scandals, their forced proximity ignites mutual feelings. Ultimately, they confess years of hidden longing and defy societal barriers to be together.

data.title: Married to the Secret Lycan King
data.intro: A young, wolfless she-wolf's world shatters when she catches her fiancé cheating the night before their wedding. In a twist of fate, she marries a mysterious stranger—unaware he's the powerful Lycan King hiding his identity. As they navigate a marriage of convenience, sizzling chemistry and dangerous pack politics threaten to expose secrets, ignite passions, and change both their lives forever.

data.title: From Nothing to Everything: Forever in Our Hands
data.intro: Walter Peele stumbles upon Naomi Dryer, the heiress of Dyer Corp, after she is drugged by one of her clients. When Walter steps in to save her, Naomi sleeps with him and takes half of his pendant. Six years later, Walter works as a laborer to pay for his adoptive mother's medical treatment, while his coworkers mock him for being single. Naomi arrives to inspect the site with Tanya Peele, who immediately notices Walter wearing the other half of her pendant and calls him "Dad."

data.title: How to Conquer the Celibate Lawyer
data.intro: To save her wrongfully imprisoned mother, Sonja works at a strip club—until a one-night stand with powerful lawyer Bruce Cross leaves her pregnant with twins, and he becomes the man who fiercely protects her from anyone who dares to shame her.

data.title: Divorce? No Big Deal (DUBBED)
data.intro: After saving Emily Lawson from taking her own life, Logan Bennett falls out with his father just to marry her, only to later be met with betrayal and distrust—even a divorce never seems to bother her. But things only come to an end after her lover sets up a trap for Logan's new partner, Natalie Quinn, infuriating Logan, who secretly holds power they would never believe he had.

data.title: Boxer Boss Can't Get Enough
data.intro: UFC champ Leo saves a shy florist from danger—and ends up spending one unforgettable night with her. She vanishes, only to return as his maid… and his contract lover. Cold, rich, and used to control, Leo never expected to fall. But as jealousy flares and a rival socialite schemes, Sela walks away—pregnant and heartbroken. Now Leo must chase the woman who changed everything.

data.title: The Return of My Superhero Mom
data.intro: Decorated General Caroline West returns home to find her life stolen. Replaced by her husband's new family, her daughter, Sheryl, is tormented at home and at school. Mocked as a "female general," Caroline stays quiet until Sheryl is beaten and falsely accused. With the general's strength and a mother's fury uniting, she fights back—defending justice, exposing lies, and reclaiming dignity for both herself and her child.

data.title: Stuck with the Spoiled Heiress
data.intro: After her mother dies, the rich party girl, Maya, finds out that her inheritance will be split  between her and Peter, a poor kid whose education her parents sponsored, but only if they spend one week living together. With millions of dollars at risk, they agree to play  along and are surprised to find their mutual hatred turning into mutual attraction.

data.title: My Poor Husband is the Real Boss
data.intro: At a lavish wedding, the bride’s ex drops a bombshell: her billionaire groom is bankrupt, and her family turns on him overnight. What they don’t know—his ruin is a ruse. As a secret hostile takeover ignites, the “penniless” husband strikes back, shattering everyone who mocked him.

data.title: Mafia's Good Girl
data.intro: Abducted by the mafia king, innocent Bella was forced to sign a contract with him in order to pay for her mother’s surgery. However, this contract that’s worthy of half a million dollars requires much more from Bella than she has ever imagined… The mafia king’s hardcore outer shell is slowly getting softened by Bella, while Bella gradually discovers her true self as well. But is it love, or just Stockholm syndrome?

data.title: Fortune's Favorite, Family's Castoff
data.intro: Born with extraordinary luck, Emily Duffer is left disabled after saving her brother because her parents refuse treatment. Four years later, overwhelmed by debt, they abandon her. She is later found by debt collector Benson Boyd, who takes her in after witnessing her strange good luck. Nearly dragged into hell by Benson's wicked family, Emily becomes the reason he cuts ties with them—and the family he chooses instead.

data.title: He Who Shaped the Empire(DUBBED)
data.intro: After years of devoted service to the late emperor, Cedric Zeller is worn out, having sacrificed his health for the good of the nation. But when the new female emperor, Xaviera Spencer, ascends the throne, she replaces him with Lucas Quinton, a scheming official unworthy of such a crucial post. Cedric has sworn to the late emperor that he will endure Xaviera a hundred times—but after that, he intends to leave without ever looking back.

data.title: Taming of a Billionaire
data.intro: She married him for survival. He vowed never to love her. But in a world built on lies and blood, love became the most dangerous truth of all.

data.title: From Fat to Fab: Ex-Wife's Revenge
data.intro: Beauty queen Jessica gained 250 pounds for love, only to have her husband Oliver call it “insane.” While she was drowning in new-mom hormones, his relentless groupie Sophie sabotaged her—cost Jessica her baby and nearly her life. After clawing her way back from the brink, Jessica teams up with Oliver’s uncle Albert to reclaim everything. Now she’s back at the top of her game, and Oliver and Sophie are about to learn what payback looks like.

data.title: Warning! Handle Him at Your Risk (DUBBED)
data.intro: Three years ago, Cedric York went to prison in his brother's place, enduring relentless torment until he was rescued by the Elixir Sage. Armed with supreme medical skills, he marries into the Kent family. Later, he uncovers the truth about his dragon lineage and the Dragon's Bone. Cedric overcomes every obstacle, earns the respect of all, and finally lives the life he was destined for.

data.title: Flames of Rebirth: Queen of Her Destiny
data.intro: Winona Steele gets a second chance at life. In her past life, she married Prince Harold, only to be betrayed and meet a tragic end. She discovers that her cousin is a transmigrator who conspired with him. Reborn on the day the marriage decree is issued, Winona firmly refuses to marry Prince Harold and instead chooses the infamous wastrel, Prince Joshua.

data.title: Dumped by a Cheater, Spoiled by a Billionaire
data.intro: At 8, Nina goes missing and is raised by Bruce's family. After regaining her memories, she learns her real mother died heartbroken. Her mother's will forces her to marry Mark, or her father loses the inheritance. Forced into marriage with a cheating man, Nina seeks proof to escape. Meanwhile, Bruce, who once confessed to her, finds her just before the wedding.

data.title: Ballerina Reborn For Revenge
data.intro: Amelia murders Katherine out of jealousy on her engagement day, then kills herself. The act dooms the sisters to relive their lives from the moment they chose between living with Grandmother or their father Jay—this time forced to remember the tragic fate their past decisions created.

data.title: The Wrong Twin Got Me Pregnant
data.intro: After countless fertility treatments, Chanel is finally pregnant --- but the baby daddy is her husband's twin, not her husband. With a billion-dollar empire on the line, Chanel's husband and the family matriarch are willing to go to any length to claim the heir as his own child.

data.title: From Dumped Wife to Christmas Billionaire
data.intro: After being publicly humiliated, dumped by her cheating husband, and fired on Christmas Eve, a kindhearted mechanic-waitress wins a life-changing lottery and rises from rock bottom—facing revenge, reclaiming power, and discovering unexpected love with the doctor who saved her.

data.title: Shock Points Activated II: Rise and Dominate
data.intro: After being electrocuted and sent into the past, Arnold Zane becomes a notorious gambler, facing threats from his mother. He gains the Shock System and uses his powers to save his family, defeat bandits, and assist the defense team in rescuing disaster victims. A year later, with Lardell safe, Arnold—now a top member of the defense team—continues protecting the land as its hero.

data.title: Absolute Power: The Day He Returned
data.intro: Five years after Soria's Champion Quincy Quade retreated from battle, a shadowy group begins systematically murdering warriors' families to draw him out of hiding. Rising to the challenge, Quincy hunts down each perpetrator, delivering brutal justice before joining forces with his successor to eliminate the mastermind and restore order to the martial world.

data.title: Hit Me Hard, Make Me Mighty (DUBBED)
data.intro: Max Clark transmigrates into a cultivation world as a worthless playboy—but awakens a system that makes him stronger every time he's beaten. If ten minutes pass without a hit, the system will erase him. Desperate, he must find ways to get beaten while the female lead, carrying grudges from her past life, is reborn.

data.title: Back to Tomorrow: A Second Chance for Love
data.intro: Cory Judd has had a crush on Zoe Stone for as long as he can remember. Just before graduating from college, he finally confesses—and she accepts him. While celebrating, he gets drunk. But when he wakes up, he finds himself seven years in the future. Not only is he married to Zoe, but he's also ruined their marriage. Zoe is disappointed in him, and their child suffers from psychological trauma that leaves them unable to speak. Determined to fix his disastrous life, Cory vows t

data.title: Serve Me! Ball Girl Heiress
data.intro: Ingrid Voss must finish her summer internship at the country club without anyone finding out that she's the heiress to the Voss Empire. However, she meets Jordan Temple, the second son of the powerful Temple Holdings.

data.title: A Deal With The Hockey Captain
data.intro: Nerdy college girl Dora joins the hockey team as an assistant, secretly in love with Leo. After a humiliating rejection, she makes a deal with team captain Troy to help her win Leo's heart. As Dora transforms and gains confidence, sparks fly with Troy. But secrets, sabotage, and shifting feelings complicate everything.

data.title: Cheers to Me: Self-Made, Self-Loved
data.intro: After being reborn, Gigi Lane buys a private island and vows to leave her tragic past behind—a life of humiliation by her family and fiancé, who used her as a "bloodbank" for her sister. This time, she exposes every scheme and fights back. No longer the pushover framed by her pretentious sister, she finally claims a life of her own.

data.title: All I Want For Christmas Is My Quarterback Husband
data.intro:
After being betrayed by her stepsister, who steals her wealthy fiancé, Mia impulsively marries Andy — a humble street cleaner who’s secretly a football superstar and billionaire CEO.
Six years later, when Mia returns home for Christmas, her family’s cruel judgment turns to shock as Andy’s true identity shatters their arrogance.

data.title: Veil of Eternity: Awakened to Her Power (DUBBED)
data.intro: At Jim York's funeral, a mysterious veiled woman appears, claiming she made a pact with him a century ago—and demanding that the York family offer their finest descendant as her servant. Outraged, the Yorks dismiss her as a fraud, even accusing her of being Jim's mistress. But when her veil is lifted, long-buried secrets and century-old feuds come to light, revealing her true identity—and forcing the family to choose between honor and desire.

data.title: Softly Ruined By You
data.intro: In a world ruled by power, desire, and betrayal, runaway bride Hailee Raine flees her wedding night from her ruthless guardian, Papa Sylvester, only to crash into the life of Leo Hardy, the dangerously charismatic heir to a mafia empire.When she begs him to hide her, one desperate kiss sparks a chain of memories—revealing she once saved him from death years ago. Now, Leo will risk everything to return the favor.

data.title: Between Lies and Love(DUBBED)
data.intro: Determined to tear apart Emma Boyer's marriage, Penny Chandler orchestrates a meeting between Emma and a stranger, hoping to drive the couple to divorce. However, Emma is unexpectedly rescued by Steve Chandler, who becomes her savior. As their bond deepens, Emma discovers she is pregnant with Steve’s only child.

data.title: After I Died He Went Mad
data.intro: On their wedding day, Lillian's father killed Sebastian's parents in a drunk-driving crash, turning lovers into enemies. Sebastian had her parents jailed and tortured until they committed suicide, then imprisoned Lillian to make her suffer the same loss. Five years later, she learned she had a week left to live. Unaware, Sebastian kept tormenting her while she treated death as freedom, choosing kindness before ending her life.

data.title: Not His Choice, Not His Ending
data.intro: Countryside girl Elise Jensen marries Cyrus Fenton in place of her twin, Sylvia, to secure an alliance between the two families. In the next three years, she endures neglect, misunderstandings, and harm, all for the promised pay. But when Sylvia reclaims her place, conflicts and complications arise, eventually bringing the truth to light. When Cyrus finally realizes his love for Elise, she has already started a new life with someone else.

data.title: Just a Driver, Until You Cross the Line
data.intro: Sawyer Vance was born into a poor family, and his classmates looked down on him because of it. Later, he builds an apparel company and rises to become the county's top entrepreneur. Outshining all his peers, he even captures the attention of his first love, Vivian Nelson. But this success is just the beginning of his climb to even greater heights.

data.title: Taming the Football Bad Boy
data.intro: All-pro tight end Tucker Newsome gets a last-chance contract with a strict morality clause—one misstep and it's over. To keep him in line, he’s paired with ambitious PR intern Samira Rivers, who's hiding a secret of her own. Forced to spend every moment together, their chemistry grows undeniable. They can't hook up. They shouldn't fall in love. And everyone is watching.

data.title: Doormat No More: The Toxic Ex Licks My Feet
data.intro: Charlotte signed a life-or-death contract to save her sister, agreeing to marry and work for Leo, the arrogant CEO of Carter Group. For three years, Leo has treated her like a doormat—belittling her, trampling her dignity, and taking credit for her success, convinced she’ll never leave. Now, as the contract nears its end, her old flame Harper returns. Will Charlotte leave Leo, reclaim her life, and reignite the spark with Harper? And will Leo realize what he’s lost?

data.title: His to Claim, His to Love
data.intro: Village doctor Carol Xavier supports her fiancé Preston Leigh through college, only to learn he's married another woman in the city. Heartbroken, she cuts all ties. By chance, she saves mafia leader Mateo Steele, who falls for her at first sight. Touched by his warmth and honesty, Carol finds herself falling too. But just as happiness nears, Preston's jealous wife plots to destroy their love.

data.title: Judgment Strike: All That Opposes Shatters (DUBBED)
data.intro: Elite mercenary Ray Geyser returns to repay a debt of gratitude. He becomes both the personal bodyguard and fiancé of Paige Logan, CEO of Logan Group. To keep him out of sight, Paige makes him her driver. When she becomes entangled in fierce corporate schemes, Ray repeatedly saves her. What begins as suspicion gradually turns into trust and affection. Together, they uncover the ultimate conspiracy and destroy it—finding love along the way.

data.title: Crowned in Plain Sight: From Shadows to Supreme Power
data.intro: To repay a debt of gratitude, Carl Turner hides his true identity and willingly marries into the Lowe family. Behind the scenes, he helps Riley Lowe rise to the position of CEO. Unaware of the truth, Riley believes her success is entirely her own. Encouraged by her best friend and a scion, she cruelly abandons Carl. On the day of the Turner banquet, she witnesses her ex-husband ascend to the very top in front of all the prominent families.

data.title: Adieu, My Almost Forever
data.intro: Ignored by her father in favor of her stepsister, Whitney Lovell turns to Hector Elwood for protection and slowly falls for him—only to be met with cold indifference and even cruelty, for his heart belongs to her stepsister. Shattered, Whitney marries the paralyzed heir Carson Monroe, who offers her stability. But when regret consumes Hector, he fights desperately to win her back, begging for the love he once cast aside.

data.title: Surprise! Baby Daddy Is The CEO
data.intro: Kind and resilient Cristy quickly marries 'impotent' Leo after his secret millionaire mother, Lisa, arranges the match. Little does she know, Leo is the CEO of a large company and the father of her children, setting her on a path to unexpected luxuries and life-altering revelations.

data.title: Fabulous & Unstoppable: Through Time, She Conquers
data.intro: Raina Quinn, a feared general in ancient times, finds herself the heiress of the wealthy Quinns after time-travelling to the modern day. Despite being threatened by a scheming imposter and her biased family, she wins the battle with wit and bravery. Here, she thrives in a legend of her very own.

data.title: Not Here for Love, Too Busy Making Money
data.intro: Alexa Bayne has always known that money isn't everything—but without it, life can be miserable. Using her skills and insight, she seizes every opportunity to level up, both in school and in business. Just as campus life settles into a predictable routine, a newly funded student arrives and shakes things up. As events unfold, Alexa realizes that those she considered mere partners of convenience are playing a game. And, unexpectedly, she seems to be their target!

data.title: From Fired to Feared: Beyond Your Reach, Forever	 (DUBBED)
data.intro: To honor a childhood engagement, Ian Lake joins Olson Corp, secretly helping his fiancée Winona Olson rise to power. But she repays him with humiliation, sparking his rage and breaking their marriage pact. When Olson Corp collapses—and Ian's secret as Lake Corp's heir is revealed—Winona can never hope for forgiveness from the man who once vowed to love and protect her.

data.title: Spiritbound: Shadows of Revenge
data.intro: Nadia Raven meets her demise at the hands of the ruthless Princess Cecilia. Unable to rest in peace due to her untimely death, she becomes a ghost. While urging her husband, Cillian Moore, to bury her corpse, she secretly plots revenge. She asks him to protect her parents through a dream.As the dead and the living mingle, diabolical schemes and dark secrets slowly come to light one by one. With the revelation of the truth, every blood debt will be repaid.

data.title: Glory on the Line: The Taste of Triumph (DUBBED)
data.intro: Born and raised in isolation, Fiona Smith carries more than just her grandfather's extraordinary culinary techniques—she harbors a burning desire to escape the mountain that has been her silent prison. When a twist of fate brings her into the orbit of Ethan Parker, the cutthroat restaurateur of River Dine, she sees an opportunity for more than just a job—she sees a chance at redemption.

data.title: Don't Mess with the Billionaire's Daughter
data.intro: After American billionaire James Ward divorced his French ex-wife, their daughter Camille lived with her mother in France. James spent time with her on European business trips, and Camille, bilingual in English and French, accompanied him to high-end events as an interpreter, shining brightly.

data.title: Honey, Don't Worry: My Family Is Legendary
data.intro: Gary York is a wealthy heir. To avoid his family pressuring him to marry, he has been away from home, working as an Uber driver. Still, two of his sisters manage to find him. By coincidence, he runs into Rosie Voss, who is facing the same problem. They immediately get married to deal with their families. The Voss family, however, does not approve of the marriage. Under pressure, Gary reveals his true identity—but no one believes him until his family members......

data.title: Billionaire Overnight: Inheritance of Glory
data.intro: Ethan Hill lives in a rundown house with his mother for 22 years and is dumped by his girlfriend for being too poor. One night, his billionaire grandfather appears and reveals that his mother is his only daughter, making Ethan the sole heir to his fortune. Gaining wealth and power overnight, he crushes those who once humiliated him and stands up against injustice for his classmates. In the end, he finds both love and success.

data.title: Back to the Heiress, Back to Slay
data.intro: Misdiagnosed with an intellectual disability at six, Avery Vinton is replaced and abandoned—only to be taken back fifteen years later. Facing her arrogant family, Avery proves she is powerful and far beyond their league. Even her ex-boyfriend, the heir to Eagan's wealthiest family, bows before her. As her secret identities are gradually unveiled, the truth behind her abandonment surfaces—and it is far more sinister than she was ever told.

data.title: The Age of Titans: Awakening the Ten Fiends
data.intro: This is the Age of Titans. Rifts tear open beneath the earth, unleashing monstrous beasts that devastate the human world. Cities fall, lives are lost, and humanity survives only by awakening Titans to fight back. Elias Fox transmigrates into this brutal era, but during his awakening, he gains no Titan—instead, he awakens the Ten Fiends Tower, sealing ten god-level ferocious beasts. Watch as Elias rises and dominates the Age of Titans.

data.title: Love After Death: The One Who Never Left My Side
data.intro: Zach Gould, heir to a prestigious family, must choose a fiancée from five women—Laura Stone, Tasha Litt, Celine Quinn, Yael Trent, and Mona Upton—on his 22nd birthday. In his previous life, he devoted himself to the aloof Laura, only to be betrayed by her, Tasha, Celine, and Yael. Broken, he died in a car accident; only Mona, the rival he had always dismissed, came to mourn him. Reborn with every painful memory, Zach chooses Mona this time.

data.title: Who Needs a Plot When You Have Me?
data.intro: Waking up as a bullied side character in a novel, Lola Merrin refuses to stay powerless. She strikes back, letting her bullies taste the full force of her fury. But revenge is just the beginning—she captures the heart of Theodore Crowe, the patriarch of her ex-husband's family, and blossoms into a sweet, unforgettable love. Meanwhile, her ex-husband is left powerless, forced to watch as Lola finds happiness with someone far beyond his reach.

data.title: Mafia Boss & His White Rose
data.intro: Evelyn Harrington's sister Lily is critically ill, with the life-saving experimental treatment controlled exclusively by mafia boss Victor Volkov. Evelyn seeks him out to purchase the medication, but unable to afford the exorbitant price, Evelyn offers herself as payment, and Victor accepts with harsh conditions that she endures for her sister's sake.

data.title: He Betrayed My Heart, I Won the World
data.intro: Sandra Gould completes her studies with the support of the Klein family. To repay their kindness, she sacrifices her dream of attending an elite university and stays to support Joe Klein, who repeatedly favors Vivian Shelby over her. Joe assumes Sandra will never leave him—but he doesn't know about the secret agreement she made with his mother. When Joe finally wastes all one hundred chances he has, Sandra marries another man and rises to the top, while he spirals into ruin.

data.title: Ex-Wife 2.0: Richer, Colder, Untouchable (DUBBED)
data.intro: Riley Lester, the stunning CEO of Lester Corp in the city of Horrun, has always cherished her husband, Derek Harmon, above all else. She gifts him a Porsche, the luxurious Skyle Villa, and even a Centurion Black Card with a hundred-million-dollar credit limit—while also covering the living expenses of his parents and sister.

data.title: If Only I Had Loved Her More (DUBBED)
data.intro: On New Year's Eve, Bella Joslin is hospitalized due to a cancer relapse, while her husband, Hugo Pitt, spends the night at an amusement park with his secretary, Gwen Lowe. Denying Bella's illness, Hugo cuts off her financial support and showers Gwen with expensive gifts. Even as Bella faces a critical surgery, Hugo refuses to sign the consent form, leaving her alone. Yet, when Gwen has an allergic reaction, Hugo rushes her to the hospital in a panic.

data.title: Vengeance Awaits His Return(DUBBED)
data.intro: Felix Hill is a devoted husband who showers Rosa Snow with endless love. He buys her a billion-dollar villa, a luxury car worth tens of millions, grants her a VIP bank card, dines with her at Micolin’s finest restaurants, and even supports her family—along with her first love, Jay Hunt. Yet, despite indulging in Felix’s wealth and generosity, Rosa keeps an ambiguous relationship with Jay, ultimately betraying Felix by giving him both his company and even his kidney.

data.title: I Designed My Revenge, You'll Wear the Regret
data.intro: Jewelry designer Julia Holt hides her heiress identity while dating Jared Knox. When Julia, now pregnant, discovers his affair with his former crush, Hailey Moore, she breaks up with him, terminates her pregnancy, and marries Theo Mercer. Later, when Hailey enters a competition, Julia exposes her theft. Hailey pays the price for her dishonesty, and Jared regrets his choices. Julia, meanwhile, finds true love with Theo.

data.title: Off Your Hands, Off My Heart
data.intro: Justin Owen, heir to the Owens, has been hopelessly in love with his aloof commanding officer, Andrea Hartman. For three years, he tries to win her heart, but she never gives him so much as a glance. Heartbroken, he agrees to his father's demand to marry in the countryside, seeking a way out—only for Andrea to realize she has already fallen for him after he's gone.

data.title: I Walked Away, I Stay Away
data.intro: For three years, Celine Stafford has poured her heart into her marriage with Simon Porter. Yet instead of cherishing her, Simon has lavished all his attention on her adoptive sister, Wendy. Then, an unexpected accident erases Celine's memories. Free from the pain of unrequited love, she decides to leave Simon. Only now does he realize he cannot live without her—and will stop at nothing to win her heart again.

data.title: When Forever Only Means Five Years (DUBBED)
data.intro: When Helen Leonard went blind, Sheldon Hurst stayed by her side for five whole years—until his identity and credit were stolen by his brother. Betrayed and framed, he died full of resentment. Reborn, he tries to walk away from the pain, but the past won't let go. When a watch sparks false accusations, he's cast aside again. Only when Helen uncovers the truth does she realize her mistake—but by then, he already belongs to someone else.

data.title: Trash the Past, Own Myself
data.intro: Simon Mort devoted his life to his family, only to die alone and unloved. Reborn, he abandons his wife, Sue Hart, and their two sons to live for himself, never imagining the depth of regret his absence would bring. Yet no matter how they repent, he is resolute—he will neither forgive nor return.

data.title: Your Lies Won't Win Again
data.intro: On his deathbed, Leo Wyatt discovers his late wife, Phoebe Shaw, faked her death and spent his fortune on her lover, Jason Dean. Reborn on the day she "died," he reclaims his assets, erases her identity, and announces a new marriage—enraging the Shaw sisters. Phoebe returns with Jason to manipulate him again, but Claire Aster arrives just in time to save Leo.

data.title: May This Farewell Be Forever
data.intro: Olivia Renner is an orphan who, with the sponsorship of Hugh Pearce, earned her PhD. To repay him, she signs a contract to marry Hugh's grandson, Aaron Pearce, for six years. She gives birth to their son, but Aaron's heart belongs to his adopted sister, Julie Boyd. The moment Julie returns, Aaron neglects Olivia and their child. After a car accident opens her eyes, Olivia signs the divorce papers and leaves the loveless marriage behind, determined to start a new life.

data.title: I'm Nothing but a Mortal (DUBBED)
data.intro: Ian Colt, a genius Jade Sect apprentice, ascends to the Sky Realm after just 20 years of cultivation. Believing there's nothing more to teach him, his mentor, Sean Judd, tricks Ian into leaving for the mortal realm.There, Ian encounters Jim Cole, whose life is on the line. Despite the efforts of three skilled doctors, none can save him, leaving his daughter, Sue Cole, desperate. Ian successfully saves Jim.

data.title: Up From the Ashes, Up to the Sky
data.intro: After discovering that her husband, Harvey Schol, is legally married to his assistant, Zoe Marsh, Tracy Nott decides to leave him. Later, Harvey falls into Zoe's trap, inflicting even more pain on Tracy. She eventually meets Joel Xavier, who mends her broken heart with love and care, and they marry. Five years later, Zoe returns from abroad, intent on reclaiming everything that once belonged to her.

data.title: When Love Runs Out (DUBBED)
data.intro: Wanting to make the most of his life before marriage, Nick Frye pretends to have lost only his memories of Ruby Wright in a car accident. Desperate to help him, Ruby spends all her savings on a rumored cure—only to uncover the truth just as she is about to give it to him. Shattered by the betrayal, she changes her name and moves abroad to escape the unbearable heartbreak.

data.title: The Day Fate Found Us
