data.intro: Nathan Ford, CEO of Ford Corp, is obsessed with his childhood sweetheart and refuses to marry. Desperate for a grandchild, his mother drugs him, leading to an unexpected night with the young nanny, Yelena Shaw, and the misconception of her being a gold digger. Pregnant, Yelena faces the jealous Lydia Zane's plots and falls victim to danger—until he saves her upon finding out she is his long-lost first love.

data.title: Where Love Was Tested, Regret Remains
data.intro: Evan Lowe and his wife, Lila Snow, have spent five years saving every cent for their son Colin's life-saving surgery. But in the name of "testing their love and trust," Lila—who is secretly a wealthy heiress—carelessly spends all of their savings on luxuries. Her reckless decision delays the procedure, ultimately leading to their son’s death. In the end, she not only exposes her ignorance, but also proves how cruel and absurd such so-called "tests of love" truly are.

data.title: Game Flipped, Crown Slipped
data.intro: When Renata Jennings can't stand losing to brilliant Juniper Keaton, she makes her charming childhood friend, Neil, seduce Juniper and ruin her focus. But Juniper is three steps ahead, playing the perfect mark. As Renata gets ready to expose Juniper's downfall on results day, she has no idea the real trap has already been set for her. What was meant to be revenge may become her ultimate humiliation.

data.title: Knocked Down, Not Out
data.intro: Once an undefeated kickboxing champion, Hunter Ruse is drugged and loses a crucial match. A clash with his opponent after the fight leads to his daughter's death, setting off a series of events that ruin his life. Cast out and broken, he works as a delivery driver. Light returns when landlady Esme Ross and her daughter Mary enter his life. As Hunter finds fragile redemption with Esme and Mary, danger closes in on them.

data.title: Legend of the Warrior Lord
data.intro: Born in Naria—a land riddled with injustice—Jon Shaw endures relentless harassment from gangs, forced to swallow his pride under the weight of their power. Though forbidden from learning martial arts, he secretly trains in combat, honing his skills in the shadows. Defying his mother’s wishes, Jon enters the Warrior Tournament to pursue his dreams—unaware that each step draws him closer to the truth of his hidden identity.

data.title: Too Glorious to Step Down: Crown On, Clowns Gone
data.intro: Despite her unwavering devotion to Trevor Latham, Lauren Sloane is treated with contempt, mocked as if she were nothing more than a tool for his success. Enraged, she reclaims her true identity as a wealthy heiress and seizes control of her family business, dismantling everything she once gave him and ensuring he spends the rest of his life in regret. In both love and power, she stands untouchable—a fierce, flawless force of vengeance.

data.title: Proof of Love, Proof of Nothing
data.intro: Chelsea Sandler and Sean Barnes are childhood sweethearts, but in college, he sets his sights on someone else. He later pretends to return to their marriage, yet their three years together are a lie—he never cuts ties with the other woman, and even their marriage certificate is fake. Fifteen days later, Chelsea boards a plane abroad, leaving him behind for good.

data.title: Our Unscripted Love After Split
data.intro: Charlotte and Arthur enter a contractual marriage, but misunderstandings and Arthur's ex, Stella, lead to three years of pain. As they approach divorce, arguments and flashbacks reveal his true feelings and her past depression. They eventually reconcile, rekindling their love.

data.title: Spoiled by My CEO Husband
data.intro: I'm treated coldly at home, but the strange man is gentle with me.In a twist of fate, Belle, struggling to make ends meet, has a one-night stand with William, a celibate CEO with fertility issues, and ends up pregnant with twins. From thereon, she finds herself lavishly pampered by the CEO's family.

data.title: Love Left to Bleed
data.intro: Sean Floyd warns his wife, Grace Hall, that Survey Point No. 1 is dangerous, yet she chooses to trust her first love, Eric Klein, and ends up in an accident. When Sean risks his life to save her, he ends up hanging from a cliff—along with Eric. As he desperately hopes for Grace to rescue him, she saves Eric instead and lets Sean fall into the abyss. Miraculously, he survives the fall and later comes across a social media post of Grace and Eric flaunting their relationship.

data.title: Loving Me Was His Game, Losing Me Was Mine
data.intro: Sienna Reyes finally marries Adrian Clark after years of admiration, but just as she thinks she's living her dream, she discovers his darker side. Though he loves her, Adrian enjoys tormenting her. Determined to break free, Sienna leaves for her dreams abroad. As Adrian scrambles to win her back, she finds happiness with someone new.

data.title: Regret in the Shape of Her Name(DUBBED)
data.intro: Rose Baker and Nathan Shaw built their success from nothing, standing by each other through every hardship. As husband and wife, they were once inseparable. But after achieving everything they had dreamed of, Nathan betrays the woman who helped him rise. When Rose confronts him, he refuses to take responsibility. Instead, he suggests they live separate lives, convinced she would never leave him—never love anyone else. But he underestimates her.

data.title: Love That Hurts, I Let Go
data.intro: Jillian McCray has loved Harry Stroud, the wealthy heir, for ten years. When he loses his memory, the scheming Tina Latham saves him—and after regaining it, he brings her home. Jillian tolerates her, unaware of his betrayal, until she sees him escort his pregnant mistress to a prenatal check-up. Heartbroken, she sells her assets, secures a remote island escape, and leaves the evidence of his affair as a "wedding gift" before vanishing.

data.title: From Red Carpet to Dirt Road (DUBBED)
data.intro: Yvonne Shaw was a popular celebrity before she accidentally travels back in time and becomes a villager in the 1980s, where she gets caught red-handed in an affair by her fiancé. However, this is all part of her fiancé’s scheme to call off their marriage! To preserve her reputation, Yvonne decides to marry the man she was found in bed with, unaware that her seemingly ordinary husband is the director of the Steelworks Factory!

data.title: Sleeping Beauty, Sneaked Into My Life
data.intro: Burdened by his parents' illness, Axel Taber seeks quick money and meets 60-year-old Piper Bevan, who needs someone to keep her comatose friend, Elise Cantor, company. Expecting another elder, Axel is stunned to discover Elise is a beautiful young woman. After a simple wedding, he devotes himself to her care, offering hope and kindness. As Elise slowly recovers, she secretly tests his sincerity before finally revealing her true self.

data.title: My Miracle Luna
data.intro: The wolfless orphan female lead Rylee has had enough of the toxic love she’s endured for years with the scumbag Ash (her first mate). Completely disillusioned, she leaves him behind and chooses to be with Wyatt (her second-chance mate). Along the way, she awakens her wolf spirit, grows into her true self, stands up against the villains who wronged her, and eventually becomes an Alpha Queen.

data.title: Size Doesn't Matter, Power Does(DUBBED)
data.intro: After giving birth, Empress Sophie Shaw gains weight and faces her husband's scorn, while her son grows distant under Tara Cox's influence. Tara, scheming for the throne, humiliates and murders Sophie at the Rain Ceremony. But as Tara celebrates, a modern medical graduate transmigrates into Sophie's body and seeks revenge. Using modern knowledge, Sophie defeats enemy princes and corrupt officials, winning the people's admiration and the emperor's heart.

data.title: Married by Fate, Feared by All (DUBBED)
data.intro: Pierre Young, a rare genius, is forced into divorce after a three-year marriage he agreed to under his mentor's orders. But what seems to be a fall turns into a path towards success when a stunning CEO pulls him into a flash marriage—his life as a respected doctor and feared hero begins, bringing his name to glory and leaving his ex-wife in never-ending regret.

data.title: I Married Him for Survival, But Fate Had Other Plans
data.intro: Upon rebirth, Elena Moore marries the disabled Prince Lucian Vale to protect her unborn child—a child she secretly despises. In exchange, she offers to heal his legs. As they join forces against Lucian's treacherous brother, their partnership deepens into a bond far stronger than mere allies—yet Elena remains unaware that the child she carries is truly his.

data.title: Dean: My Mafia Protector
data.intro: When tailor Megan Shill accidentally kills a mafia heir in self-defense, she seeks protection from Dean Russo—the powerful mafia boss who once promised to keep her safe. As danger closes in, their bond deepens into a fierce romance. But loving Dean means entering a deadly war... and Megan may be the spark that ignites it.

data.title: House Husband? Try Supreme Immortal
data.intro: Logan Bale, an immortal who has walked the earth for a thousand years, fulfills a dying promise to his disciple—to protect his family for three years. To honor that vow, he marries his disciple's granddaughter, only to be met with her family's scorn and cruelty. Yet undeterred, he endures their contempt with quiet resolve, holding fast to one promise of his own: to walk away the moment those three years come to an end.

data.title: Ruling Over All I See
data.intro: Soon after unemployed graduate Judah Shaw finds himself a penniless scholar in Qirelia, he is forced by the system to win his wives' affection, despite their marriages being purely convenient. To his surprise, among them are a princess, a general's daughter, and a merchant heiress, who bring him not only fortune but also a future brighter than he ever imagined.

data.title: The One I Never Forget
data.intro: Sofia and Justin, torn apart by a tragic misunderstanding five years ago, reunite in Los Angeles. She is now a renowned journalist, he a baseball star. Past lies and new dangers test their reunion, but uncovered truths and forgiveness allow them to heal old wounds, triumph in their careers, and rebuild their love.

data.title: Emergency Marriage To My Secret Billionaire
data.intro: Emily, a café worker who caught the groom cheating with the bridesmaid, decides to marry James, the paramedic who saved her life, in a flash marriage to complete her dream wedding. However, she doesn't know that James is the former billionaire CEO and the sole heir to a wealthy family. Emily, who had sworn never to get involved with rich people again, unknowingly falls in love with James, who is pretending to be an ordinary paramedic.

data.title: Where Our Love Couldn't Live(DUBBED)
data.intro: Princess Zoe Cork and General Sean Bard despise each other, yet on the day the empire falls, Sean sacrifices himself for her, wishing to sever their bond forever. Grief-stricken, Zoe follows him in death. Reborn with memories intact, she fulfills his wish by matching him with her sister and marrying an Arvan. But when Sean learns the truth, it's too late to undo the pain that binds them.

data.title: The Hockey Star's Remorse
data.intro: Six years ago, nerdy Evie spent a magical night with her crush,  hockey star Timothy—only to learn it was all a bet. Now a successful producer, she crosses paths with him again. In front of reporters, Timothy publicly apologizes and reveals he's been waiting for Evie ever since. Within an hour, #FindEvie is trending at number one.

data.title: Mated to My Savage Alpha
data.intro: Elena, a maid desperate to save her sick son, unknowingly reunites with the Alpha who fathered her child years ago. As love rekindles, old enemies, power struggles, and shocking truths threaten their fate.

data.title: Ruling Over All I See II: Path to Dominion
data.intro: Judah Shaw transmigrates into the ancient world, married to three wealthy wives. But before he gets to enjoy life, his second wife Willa Zorath gets abducted by Lotia Sect, who aims to have Judah surrender to them. Unwilling to yield, he defeats the sect leader and saves Willa, only to then be hunted by Ian Walton. But now bound with the sect leader's power, he easily reclaims safety—and starts a rebellion for justice.

data.title: Ice in His Veins, Death in His Hands
data.intro: Shaun Kane, Ruinvale's most gifted assassin, is "rewarded" with five deadly beauties who plan to kill him the moment he lets his guard down. But he has perfected ruthlessness, earning his master's recognition as the top assassin. Later, descending the mountain, he encounters the poisoned Penny Lore, hunted by killers. One cold glance, and his murderous aura freezes the scene.

data.title: Where Love Once Was, Too Late
data.intro: Cassidy Zabel, the general's daughter, falls for her bodyguard, Edmund Spencer, unaware that he is the crown prince who's in love with her half-sister, Marilyn Zabel. Heartbroken after he throws her into a bandit camp just because of Marilyn's complaint, Cassidy asks the emperor to marry her off to Bellaros. By the time Edmund realizes his love for her, she has already become someone else's wife, so he seeks her mother's sword to bring her back.

data.title: The Unwanted Wife Strikes Back
data.intro: When a housewife discovers her fashion mogul husband is cheating, and stealing her designs, she files for divorce and wages a scorched-earth revenge campaign to reclaim the empire she secretly helped build. But exposing his lies means going to war with his scheming mistress, his icy sister - and allying herself with Cyrus Voss, her husband's biggest rival.

data.title: The Scent of  My Fated Luna
data.intro: A half-witch, half-werewolf teen forced to hide her true identity struggles to survive a high school divided by magic and fangs—while resisting her fated mate, the future Alpha who doesn't remember their childhood bond, and battling the jealous rival willing to destroy her to claim him.

data.title: Fated Mate with My Enemy Stepbrother
data.intro: Selene is forced to become the stepdaughter of her enemies' Alpha and live under the same roof as her arrogant new stepbrother, her mortal enemy—only to discover he might be her fated mate. As she hides the shameful secret that she's lost her wolf, deadly enemies within the pack close in, and forbidden desire turns to loyalty, love, and war.

data.title: Abstinent CEO's Pregnant Sweetheart
data.intro: A struggling university student, Bella, unexpectedly has a one-night stand with Ian, a cold and restrained CEO with fertility issues, and ends up pregnant with triplets. From then on, she is showered with endless love and care from Ian's family.

data.title: From Contract Lover to the Billionaire's Bride
data.intro: After being betrayed by her boyfriend, Mason, Chloe meets a handsome man at the bar and tries to seduce him. Just before they get to the point, Chloe recognizes the man she kissed—Ethan Foster, the well-known lawyer in the city, a billionaire, and her ex-boyfriend's brother-in-law. Chloe flees the bar and gets a phone call: her father has been framed by Mason and taken into custody. Mason tells Chloe that no one would dare to take this case except Ethan.

data.title: Blood and Promises: Mated to the Alpha
data.intro: After the massacre of the Fierce Wind Clan, the lone survivor, Monica, infiltrates the Blood Night Fortress to seek revenge by seducing its Alpha, Victor. But when she becomes pregnant with his child, Victor’s fiancée Nora—daughter of the Shadow Clan’s Alpha—discovers the truth and tries to kill her. Victor intervenes upon realizing Monica is his fated mate, bound by the Moon Goddess.

data.title: The Invincible Bodyguard: One Punch to the Heart
data.intro: Top bodyguard, Fred York, is hired to protect Scarlet Gould. Not only does he need to fend off assassins and dismantle dark schemes, but he also has to resolve the misunderstandings between himself and Scarlet. As enemies close in, Fred never abandons his duty. He strikes back with force and clears all obstacles. With each clash, he slowly reveals long-buried past secrets that have something to do with him.

data.title: Fired, Framed, and Fierce
data.intro: Jessica is the star quantitative trader at TB Securities, but she is unjustly fired by the new male-dominated CEO, Jackson. Meanwhile, her achievements and identity are falsely claimed by her scheming colleague, Jessie. Jessie takes advantage of Jackson's misjudgment and steals Jessica's trading model, using it to frame Jessica. At the same time, William, the CEO of Charles Securities, steps in to support Jessica and hires her for his company.

data.title: Punished by His Love
data.intro: She was a destitute woman whose life was dependent on others. She was forced to be a scapegoat and traded herself, which resulted in her pregnancy. He considered that she was the ultimate embodiment of evil as she was greedy and deceitful. She tried all her efforts to win his heart but failed. Her departure made him so furious that he searched through the ends of the world and managed to recapture her. The whole city knew that she would be shredded into a million pieces.

data.title: My Poor Husband is A Billionaire
data.intro:
Stella had a one-night stand with a stranger and mistook the man as someone who had
plunged her into a prostitution scandal and ruined her life. Three years later, Stella
married a man named Ethan in a flash and the two soon fell in love. However,
gradually Stella found Ethan similar to the man three years ago. Even worse, Ethan
had been hiding his CEO identity from Stella. Unable to accept the truth, Stella
divorced Ethan.

data.title: From Fifty to Fearless: Rising to Rule All(DUBBED)
data.intro: Neo Baar, a man in his fifties, regains his youth through the System amid chaos and wins the hearts of several women. To survive, he strikes a deal with the wounded General Ava Jagger and sneaks into the military camp with her, where she disguises herself as a man—searching for a way to rise.

data.title: Done with Lies, Done with You
data.intro: During a food delivery, Claudia Barker finds out that her supposedly poor husband of seven years has gifted his childhood sweetheart jewelry worth hundreds of millions. He brushes it off, claiming the gift is befitting of an heiress. He tells her not to be petty and expects her to take the initiative to reconcile. Contrary to his expectations, Claudia serves him the divorce papers.

data.title: Cheat on Me? Enjoy Your Collapse
data.intro: Sebastian Grants hides his identity and spends three years as a house husband to support his wife, Vivian White. On their third anniversary, Vivian's assistant—who is also her lover—assaults Sebastian. To make matters worse, Vivian blindly takes her assistant's side. Sebastian finally reveals himself, freezes her assets, ends all her deals, and watches her downfall. He finds true love with someone who truly deserves him, while Vivian gets the ending she deserves.

data.title: Betrayed to Brilliance: Her Life, Her Rules(DUBBED)
data.intro: Jade Kemp stays dutiful in marriage, running the household flawlessly while tolerating her husband's blurred boundaries with his "female best friend". But when they eventually go too far, she decisively puts an end to their marriage and rises from being a housewife to a powerful CEO, thriving in success while beginning a new life with someone new.

data.title: Divorce is Mercy, Revenge is Justice.
data.intro: As the CEO of a trillion-dollar conglomerate, Wade Bowen has given his wife and their three daughters the finest life possible. But when they frame him for a crime connected to his wife's childhood friend, Joel Zahn, Wade sees their true colors. Determined to reclaim everything, he secretly swaps the asset transfer agreement for a divorce and severance deal. Those who betrayed him will pay—every last one.

data.title: A Promise Weathered to Nothing
data.intro: In love with Irene Thayer since their school days, Oscar Eaton gave up a promising future to become her secretary, finally earning a place by her side after a one-night stand. But everything changes four years later when her first love, Aaron Paxton, returns. Heartbroken, Oscar walks away to build a life of his own—while the echo of regret begins to stir in Irene's heart.

data.title: May We Never Meet Again
data.intro: For three long years, Esme Quinn has endured her husband's cold indifference while he openly cherished another woman. Her desperate attempts to win his heart prove futile when he abandons her to face a family crisis alone, choosing instead to stay by his mistress' side. Just as she finally gathers the strength to leave him, the last thing she expects happens—he comes begging for her to stay.

data.title: After Divorce, I Built a Fabulous Life
data.intro: Once a talented designer, Mia married Tyler for love and became a housewife post-graduation. However, a three-year marriage ended with a divorce decree. Tyler's heartlessness makes Mia give up hope, leading her to reclaim her beloved career. Eventually, Mia shines in her passion, and Tyler realizes his true feelings, allowing them to rediscover love...

data.title: No More Family, No More Forgiveness
data.intro: Jude Stone is sent to prison after being framed by his adoptive brother, Richie Stone. Though he is eventually released, the Stone family continues to treat him with prejudice. Cutting ties with them, Jude finds support in Hailey Zeller. When he is later appointed to a prestigious position, Jude invites the Stones to his induction banquet. Mistaking Richie for the newly appointed official, they publicly humiliate Jude—until the shocking truth is finally revealed.

data.title: The Mistaken First Love
data.intro: When a proud heiress is forced to marry in her stepsister’s place, she discovers shocking betrayals and vows revenge. But as her bodyguard’s secret identity and their twisted past unravel, love, lies, and fate collide in a storm of passion and deception.

data.title: Don't Miss Me When I'm Among the Stars
data.intro:
Forced to serve as her sister‘s blood donor since
childhood, Lydia endures cruelty from her family and
betrayal from Ethan, the boy she trusted most. Rising as the youngest astronaut in U.S. history, she reclaims her dignity among the stars, leaving her family and Ethan to a too-late regret and bitter loss.

data.title: The Returns of Billionaire Mom
data.intro: Harley Carson, the heiress of the Carson family, was betrayed by her stepsister Ivy Carson and fiancé Gavin Gray. She nearly lost her life, but survived by faking her death. Five years later, as the chairwoman of HyperNova Association, she returns with her son to take revenge on Ivy and Gavin. Unexpectedly, Nolan Hamilton, her one-night stand, reappears. For their son's sake, Harley decides to sign a marriage contract with Nolan.

data.title: Love You To Death
data.intro: Rebelling against her perfect life, high school senior cheerleader Brooke falls into a hot and heavy romance with transfer student and new QB Nate. Everything seems perfect. Until she discovers that Nate has a very dark side.

data.title: My Boss Is A Cyber-Daddy
data.intro: Workplace nobody, Brooke, secretly thrives as a steamy webcomic artist. When she meets her perfect online boyfriend in person, he turns out to be her icy CEO boss! To avoid exposure and getting fired, Brooke frantically hides her identity, sparking a chaotic cat-and-mouse romance—only to discover his "player" persona is an elaborate scheme to win her heart.

data.title: After She Left: Two Sweethearts Drowning in Regret
data.intro: Orphaned, Lee Na Gyeom spent 20 years at Seowon Group with heirs Seo Do Hyun and Seo Ian. Everything changed when Han Yoo Ra arrived. Her schemes destroyed Lee Na Gyeom; the deceived brothers drifted apart. Heartbroken, like the moon that lost its light, she left with CHA IHYUN. Too late, the brothers learned the truth and regretted it. She married him, reclaimed herself, and started a peaceful new life.

data.title: My Secret With Country Boys
data.intro: Sofia, an uptown girl thrust into the heard of countryside after a tragic accident. With her parents gone, she seeks solace with Aunt Celine. But it's not just cows and fields she encounters—three charming boys turn her world upside down. As she delves into her newfound rural life, secrets of her witchcraft lineage unravel. Will she find love amidst the hay and magic?

data.title: I'm the Rule
data.intro: In a world where power reigns supreme, a mysterious Emperor of the mafias must navigate betrayal, love, and loyalty as he fights to maintain his iron grip on the criminal underworld, all while keeping his true identity hidden from those closest to him.

data.title: Sleeping Tycoon's Magic Bride Pregnant with Twins
data.intro: Desperate college student Isabelle enters a contractual marriage with comatose tycoon Andrew to save her grandfather, resulting in a secret pregnancy. Eight months later, the now-awake Andrew repeatedly encounters but fails to recognize her, leading to tension, hidden identity revelations, and familial conflict. The story culminates in their reunion, the birth of twins, and genuine love.

data.title: The Gangster Queen Returns: I Am The Power
data.intro: To protect her terminally ill daughter, Mildred, the legendary gangster boss, hides her true identity and works as a janitor in a hospital. But when the very hospital and insurance empire she bankrolled conspires to auction off her daughter's life-saving medicine to the wealthy, Mildred has no choice but to reclaim her underworld throne. Now, she must take back her daughter's last hope and make the corrupt medical system pay.

data.title: Don't Mess With The XXL Heiress
data.intro: XXL Claire is about to become Lucas's bride, filled with anticipation. However, on her wedding day, she suffers multiple betrayals and humiliations from her fiancé Lucas and her best friend Stella. Devastated by these blows, Claire is finally found by her biological father, Victor, the billionaire, and becomes the heiress. Determined to completely change herself, she undergoes a thorough metamorphosis. Six months later, a radiantly new Claire appears at a banquet.

data.title: You Turned Our Love to Dust
data.intro: When Jared Atkin still loved Claire Valen, he took three knife wounds for her—one to his brow, one to his ankle, and one to his back. But now, a pregnant woman arrives at their doorstep, demanding that Claire leave him. The marriage that was once sweet and whole shatters into fragmented pieces. Resolutely, Claire ends it all and walks away. Jared chases after her—but is it already too late?

data.title: Payback's Coming, Mr. Ex (DUBBED)
data.intro: After a whole night spent on a project, Stella Clark steps away for just ten minutes—and suddenly, she's accused of slacking off. Secretary Wendy Kurt insists Stella is at fault and persuades their superior—Stella's own fiancé—to fire her. Shockingly, he sides with Wendy. Sensing a deeper betrayal, Stella uncovers their secret affair and strikes back, ensuring they pay dearly while she reclaims the future she truly deserves.

data.title: Forever After, Never Again (DUBBED)
data.intro: Neglected by her father and stepmother since childhood, Elara Rhode hires Ethan Walden as her personal bodyguard—only to fall in love with him and begin pursuing his affection. But Ethan remains distant. Unbeknownst to Elara, he is secretly the heir to the powerful Walden family—and harbors feelings for her stepsister instead. Devastated and furious, Elara impulsively marries Charlie Shaw, a man trapped in a vegetative state.

data.title: You Were My Only, Once
data.intro: Aiden York spent ten years loving Xena Boyd, juggling three jobs to support her academic ambitions until she became Baymere's youngest professor. Yet she never loved him in return. Only when he finally lets go—stepping aside for the dean's son and returning home to start anew—does Xena realize she has lost the one person she truly needed.

data.title: House of Cards: All In or Nothing (DUBBED)
data.intro: While the festive season closes in, Claudia Roman loses 200 thousand dollars in a gambling scheme plotted by her best friend Jane White. The money was meant for her daughter's tuition, her father's medical bills, and the living expenses of her family of three, so to win the money back, Matt Swain joins the game. Initially, he intended to leave after winning the same amount back, but Jane and Kelvin Grant kidnap Claudia, forcing him back into the gamble.

data.title: Mr. Delaney: Tempted by My Sugar Daddy
data.intro: When Bella chooses to go stripping to save her bedridden brother and is humiliated by her peers, she meets her hero, the gentlemanly and handsome tycoon Mr. Delaney, who offers her the chance to become his sugar baby in her most desperate moment of helplessness and despair. But will this be a salvation, or will it lead her to desire and danger?

data.title: Level Up, Rule All: From Chains to Absolute Dominion
data.intro: Luke Vaughn transmigrates and becomes the Emperor of Dareth—a ruler in name only, as real power rests with the empress dowager. In the original timeline, he is deposed, imprisoned, starved, and ultimately killed. Determined to change his fate, Luke rises from the prison and methodically seizes power, step by step. Amid a crumbling dynasty, he stands his ground and turns the tide at the brink of ruin.

data.title: A Sweet Contract with the Mafia Boss
data.intro: By chance, Tessa, an emergency room nurse, saved Victor, a dangerous and charming gang boss, but was strongly targeted by him. He was closing in on her, and she was running for her life—until fate tore away her last hope. Her brother was dying, and the sky-high medical bills were crushing her. Victor narrowed his cold eyes and said, "Be my woman, and I'll save him."

data.title: Three Chances, I'm Gone Forever
data.intro: After sacrificing everything—her fortune, her health, even a kidney—for her childhood love Erwin, Kama is betrayed and replaced by the manipulative Circe. Vowing to give Erwin just three chances, she rises from heartbreak to reclaim her power, wealth, and dignity—with billionaire Landon by her side. When the final chance is gone, so is Kama's mercy.

data.title: 33 Times, I Survived You
data.intro: Astrid Poole grows up believing her engagement to Sebastian Warren is fate. But their wedding has been postponed 33 times after a string of accidents that leave her injured and exhausted. When Astrid finally learns the truth—that all 33 "accidents" were arranged by Sebastian to delay the marriage—she chooses to walk away, ending the engagement and leaving him behind forever.

data.title: Divorce Is My Best Christmas Gift
data.intro: Five years ago, law school's brightest star, Hannah, dropped out for love, becoming the perfect wife to Congressman Ethan. This Christmas Eve, her dream wedding turns into a nightmare - Ethan sweeps his first love into his arms and runs. Heartbroken, Hannah returns to campus under Professor Daniel's guidance... Ethan finally realizes Hannah is the one he loves.

data.title: Divorce? No Big Deal
data.intro: After saving Emily Lawson from taking her own life, Logan Bennett falls out with his father just to marry her, only to later be met with betrayal and distrust—even a divorce never seems to bother her. But things only come to an end after her lover sets up a trap for Logan's new partner, Natalie Quinn, infuriating Logan, who secretly holds power they would never believe he had.

data.title: His Unexpected Forever
data.intro: Nineteen years lost to time, Leah York is plucked from obscurity by the family she never knew, only to face a chilling fate: marrying a man believed to be dead in her adoptive sister's stead. Just when her world threatens to collapse, a twist shatters every expectation. Her fiancé, the notorious and cold-hearted Chad Ford, isn't only alive—he's enamored with her. As he showers her with tenderness no one thought him capable of, whispers swirl.

data.title: Emergency Reckoning: Brother's Fury
data.intro: Annie is mistaken for a mistress and is insulted and beaten by her future sister-in-law, Camilla, and her family. Her brother Nolan arrives, calls off his engagement to Camilla, and rescues Annie, leaving Camilla's family full of regret.

data.title: Our Love, Once Perfect, Shattered (DUBBED)
data.intro: Emma Shaw and Joe Lowe have been lovers since school days. Emma Shaw is left infertile after saving Joe Lowe, a secret she hides to spare him guilt. When she enrolls their adopted daughter in school, she discovers their marriage is a lie—the child belongs to his mistress. As the truth unravels, Emma is abducted and brutally beaten—by Joe himself, unaware the woman in the bag is her.

data.title: Love Me All You Like
data.intro: When an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, Sara finds herself pulled into Elliot’s world of luxury and privilege. As he repeatedly steps in to help her—saving her from an ex, offering her a place to stay, and supporting her during family conflicts—their connection deepens. Despite their differences, Sara and Elliot decide to marry, confronting the realities of their contrasting worlds and discovering love where they least expected it.

data.title: The Price for One Sweet Night
data.intro: To save her dying brother, Chloe makes a one-night deal with a mysterious stranger—Ethan, a ruthless billionaire who later becomes her boss. He uses power, contracts, and emotional pressure to keep her close, while she fights for her independence. When her gentle protector James steps in, Chloe is torn between toxic obsession and safe devotion, forcing her and Ethan into a brutal emotional war where love is the battlefield.

data.title: Healing My Pain, Stealing My Heart
data.intro: The cool and composed CEO, Jacob Ford, has suffered from a chronic headache that no expert has ever been able to cure. Cheryl Keller, an apprentice of a legendary healer, possesses extraordinary medical skills. By chance, she finally relieves Jacob's pain. Just as he prepares to thank her in person, they both receive a shocking call: they are to honor a family promise and marry someone chosen for them.

data.title: Mafia's 90-Day Bride
data.intro: Gigi, seeking revenge on the insurance CEO who caused her father's death, offers her only $10,000 to mafia boss Vito to buy his life. Amused by her persistence, Vito proposes she become his bride for 90 days instead. Though he protects her, Vito's cynical nature leads him to refuse life-saving cancer surgery. Disheartened, Gigi believes she's just a pawn. When Gigi nearly miscarries, Vito realizes his love and chooses to fight for life to protect her and their child.

data.title: Loving Me Was His Game, Losing Me Was Mine (DUBBED)
data.intro: Sienna Reyes finally marries Adrian Clark after years of admiration, but just as she thinks she's living her dream, she discovers his darker side. Though he loves her, Adrian enjoys tormenting her. Determined to break free, Sienna leaves for her dreams abroad. As Adrian scrambles to win her back, she finds happiness with someone new.

data.title: Judgment Strike: All That Opposes Shatters
data.intro: Elite mercenary Ray Geyser returns to repay a debt of gratitude. He becomes both the personal bodyguard and fiancé of Paige Logan, CEO of Logan Group. To keep him out of sight, Paige makes him her driver. When she becomes entangled in fierce corporate schemes, Ray repeatedly saves her. What begins as suspicion gradually turns into trust and affection. Together, they uncover the ultimate conspiracy and destroy it—finding love along the way.

data.title: When Love Is a Losing Bet	 (DUBBED)
data.intro: Five years after Alfred Gill marries Iris Logan for money, her first crush, Owen Kane, returns from abroad. It is then that Alfred realizes he has never truly captured her heart. Despite the pain, he decides to let her go, knowing she deserves a love with Owen. To make a clean break and ensure Iris fully belongs to Owen, Alfred stages his own death and disappears overseas. However, when Iris learns of his death, she is consumed by remorse, realizing too late what she’s lost.

data.title: Spoiled by My Vampire Uncle
data.intro: Damon, a vampire, has been secretly protecting Nancy for ten years to fulfill a promise to his fallen comrade, Paz. Nancy is about to get engaged to her seemingly gentle fiancé, Wayne, who is actually colluding with designer Fiona to steal her designs and manipulate her mentally.At the engagement party, Nancy is harassed by a client, and Damon intervenes to save her. As they grow closer, Nancy discovers Wayne's infidelity and theft.

data.title: I Wish It Were You
data.intro: Bound by a family alliance, Isabel found herself reluctantly married to a stranger named Jared. Despite being wed for a year, their encounters were so scarce they could barely recall each other's faces. As Isabel navigated her new life at work, she unexpectedly fell deeply for her boss—the billionaire Lorenzo Bellini. Through a series of jaw-dropping twists, Isabel was stunned to discover that the captivating Lorenzo was, in fact, her husband Jared in name...

data.title: Reset The Game: Where Her Empire Begins
data.intro: In Evelyn Reid's past life, Michael Hart blamed her for the death of his childhood sweetheart, Ava Baker, unleashing all his anger on her. Given a second chance at life, Evelyn allows Ava to sabotage Michael's business deal—but soon, she turns the tables, securing the deal herself and ousting Michael from the company. Though Michael continues to stir up trouble, Evelyn handles him with ease. Along the way, she meets the man truly meant for her and flourishes in both her caree

data.title: Seize What's Mine: All In for Revenge
data.intro: Swapped at birth, Loey Zeller grows up in a gambler's household, spending 18 years in misery. When she finally returns, she is met with her parents' blatant favoritism toward the fake heiress, Grace Zeller. Jealous of Loey, Grace sows discord and has her sent to a brutal training camp. Six years of torment forge Loey into a cold, calculating woman. On her first day back, Grace frames her once more—but this time, Loey fights back and vows to repay them tenfold.

data.title: Love at the End of Lies
data.intro: On her engagement day, Ava discovers that her fiancé́ Dylan has secretly misused her savings. Instead of feeling guilty, Dylan and his mother insulted her, prompting her to call off the engagement in anger. In a desperate attempt to raise funds to save her grandmother's house, Ava agrees to marry Noah, the grandson of her elderly neighbor. Unknown to Ava, Noah is a billionaire who mistakenly believes Ava is a gold digger.

data.title: Beware, I'm Back and Dangerous
data.intro: Framed by her adopted sister, Heidi Raven, Lindsay Raven is betrayed by her fiancé and family, confined to a mental hospital. Her sister even stole her life as a writer.  A year later, she is finally released—but only to take Heidi's place in an arranged marriage. Little does Heidi know, the man she refuses to marry is none other than the heir of Oakley's wealthiest family, the Dugans.

data.title: Casting You Out of My Love
data.intro: Sophia Hooper has been in a secret relationship with Aiden Fuller for five years. But when his first love, Bella Parry, returns from overseas—pregnant—he breaks things off, offering Sophia his company shares instead. On her wedding day, Sophia joins Glenn Corp and severs all ties with him for good. Aiden soon realizes his mistake, while the wicked face their comeuppance, and Sophia finally finds true love.

data.title: You Call It Love, I Call It Pain
data.intro: Lana Stewart, deaf and mute, falls for her bodyguard, Steven Payne, and agrees to be with him after surviving a hundred assassination attempts. But when she regains her hearing, she learns the harsh truth: she has only been a tool to satisfy her adopted sister. Heartbroken, Lana leaves in search of her own happiness, unshaken even when Steven desperately tries to win her back after realizing who he truly loves.

data.title: Accidentally Pregnant, Forever Spoiled
data.intro: Since childhood, Ella has lived with her remarried mother and stepfather after her parents divorced. She endured indifference and abuse in her stepfather's household. After her mother passed away, her stepfather and stepbrother treated Ella as nothing more than a tool to make money. Her stepfather even spent all of her college tuition, forcing her to work part-time to pay for her education.

data.title: Divorce, My Happily Ever After
data.intro: Betrayed by her husband and his mistress while five months pregnant, Rosie Turner is cast out in humiliation despite having sacrificed everything for him. After the divorce, she finds new strength in Andrew Jaffe, a young and charismatic CEO who not only helps her seek revenge but also supports her rise to success. With him by her side, Rosie discovers both triumph in her career and lasting happiness in love.

data.title: Glowing With You: Lit by Your Love
data.intro: Sandy Swift has harbored a secret crush on Henry Roche ever since he saved her when they were students. Years later, a one-night stand between them leads to pregnancy and marriage. Sandy and Henry marry first and gradually come to know each other better. Under Henry's devotion and protection, the gentle yet resilient Sandy matures and discovers her own strength.

data.title: I Loved Until It Hurt
data.intro: On their 20th anniversary, Colin Clark's wife took their son abroad to celebrate her first love's birthday—but was kidnapped instead. With no enough money for ransom, Colin was forced to take Evan's place as the hostage. She promised to return for him, but he waited in vain for three years. When he finally comes home, everything has changed. Just as he resolves to leave for good, his wife refuses to let him go.

data.title: My Billion Dollar Waiter
data.intro: So casual! He casually had an affair with my stepsister, and I casually found a waiter to marry him.An untoward heiress found out her fiancé is cheating with her stepsister at her wedding day. Provoked by her father and stepsister, she proceeds with the wedding and marries the waiter of the hotel on site. She couldn’t possible imagine, the waiter is actually the CEO of a top global corporation…

data.title: Forever, Gone With Her
data.intro: To repay Tim Holt for saving his life, Hugo Keller marries Elise Holt, who has secretly loved him for years. But after three loveless years of marriage, Elise realizes that his heart belongs to Piper Upton. To free him without forcing him to break his promise, she fakes her death and pursues her dreams—only for Hugo to discover that he cannot bear a life without her.

data.title: Out of Control: Fake Love with My Enemy
data.intro: Vivian and Alex are fierce rivals at work. An unexpected incident leads to a night of entanglement. Their parents secretly plot to set them up on a blind date. Vivian wants to promote her adult product business and find investors, but Alex constantly tries to stop her. As they argue, they begin to develop unexpected feelings for each other. A calculated move by an ex-boyfriend, an unexpected pregnancy, and a product crisis bind their fates together...

data.title: Fabulous & Unstoppable: Through Time, She Conquers(DUBBED)
data.intro: Raina Quinn, a feared general in ancient times, finds herself the heiress of the wealthy Quinns after time-travelling to the modern day. Despite being threatened by a scheming imposter and her biased family, she wins the battle with wit and bravery. Here, she thrives in a legend of her very own.

data.title: Postscript of Love (DUBBED)
data.intro: A mismatched marriage binds Ruth Shaw and Ivan Green for three years, until Ruth is diagnosed with liver cancer and discovers Ivan's ninety-ninth affair. She demands a divorce with five promises and reinvents herself as the artist "Rina" to exact revenge. Later, she exposes the truth behind a car crash and a deadly scheme, unmasking Summer Ford's true colors. Ivan repents, but Ruth leaves a final, tearful farewell.

data.title: Betrayal Was Your Choice, Reckoning Is Mine (DUBBED)
data.intro: While on vacation with her mother-in-law, Anna Jensen, Wendy Smith discovers her husband Shane Holt's affair—and a conspiracy he and his father have hatched to seize control of the company. When Anna collapses from a heart attack, Wendy takes matters into her own hands, exposing them at the company's annual meeting. With the shares Anna entrusts to her, Wendy seizes full control, punishes the perpetrators, and protects those who truly deserve justice.

data.title: Tied to My Dangerous Mafia Husband
data.intro:
“Lauren, you're pregnant with twins..." Having lost her memory, Laurent returns to the country to search her father and foster brother with only a necklace as a clue. She thinks she could put up with Vivian and Jacob's harassment for the work visa, but all she got is nonstop abuse and insults. In a turn of fate, Laurent ends up spending another night with Ryan after being fired. 
"You're the Lor?"

data.title: Their Legend, Written in Love
data.intro: The warlord Elliot Nash appears tough, yet beneath him lies a gentle and devoted heart. Maya Elmer, the empress of Dareth, is decisive and bold. Having been reborn, the two push through challenges and misunderstandings. In the face of trials, their love remains unwavering as they stand side by side, writing a new chapter of their lives.

data.title: Dear Ex, Kiss My Crown
data.intro: In her past life, Nancy Scott died discovering Joe Foster had faked his death to elope with Yara Cork. Reborn, she exposes their lies, fakes her own death, and escapes abroad—where she meets Will Foster, who teaches her love again. But when Joe finds her, his obsession costs him his sight and Yara's life. For Nancy, his downfall marks the end of revenge—and the beginning of a new life with Will.

data.title: Letting Go of What Once Was
data.intro: Vincent Young, the adopted son of the Young family, is cast aside when their long-lost biological son, Daniel, returns. His fiancée, Kate Quinn, turns on him—forcing him to make sacrifices for Daniel and even stealing his research to hand over to him.

data.title: The Maid With His Blood Came Back to Burn
data.intro: Five years ago, maid Diana was set up and spent a night with mafia boss Calvin, only to be imprisoned, robbed of her child, and left for dead.Five years later, she returns under a new identity—Elsie—infiltrating an underground auction house and moving step by step toward the center of power, determined to reclaim her daughter and take revenge on Camilla, the woman who stole her place as “Mrs. Becker.”Old love resurfaces, the truth begins to unravel......

data.title: Heartbreak Collector: A Taste of Revenge
data.intro: Ava Lane's husband, Trevor Gray, has a suspiciously close relationship with his female best friend, Leah Jackman—one that ultimately leads to Ava's death at Leah's hands. When Ava opens her eyes again, she finds herself back in time, greeted by the AAA Narrative System, which tells her she must collect 100 heartbreak points within a limited timeframe to return to life for good. Given a second chance, Ava sets out to make those who wronged her taste their own medicine.

data.title: The World in My Grasp
data.intro: To marry his girlfriend, Finn Cooper toils as a laborer, enduring long days and surviving on instant noodles to save money, all while facing the scorn of those around him. Deeply troubled by his circumstances, he wishes for strength beyond his current limits. To his astonishment, his wish is granted, but in an unexpected twist. Everyone else becomes as fragile as water, making him the strongest man alive on the planet.

data.title: When Vows Turn to Dust
data.intro: For six years, Nancy Reed believed she had a happy marriage. But after being discharged from the hospital, she discovers her husband's affection for the new intern. He gives her luxurious belongings to the other woman and grows closer to her despite Nancy's protests. Heartbroken, Nancy leaves with their son, losing everything she once thought she would never lose.

data.title: Love, not Lost to Memory
data.intro: After giving birth to twins for the powerful Todd family, Vera Bell is drained of her blood in the delivery room to save their chosen heir, Finn Todd—leaving her lifeless, clutching a blood-stained lucky charm. Seven years later, mute and stripped of her memory, Vera survives by scavenging while raising her daughter, Grace Bell.

data.title: In the Snare of Love
data.intro: To save her sister Nina from heart disease, Cheryl Snow asks Sean Hall for a cure and becomes his lover in the process. Worried that Cheryl will eventually win Sean’s heart, Sienna Zane conspires with Heath Clark to frame Cheryl, resulting in Nina’s death in the operating room. Devastated, Cheryl demands a breakup. It is then that Sean realizes he is already in love with her. Sean later investigates the circumstances surrounding Nina’s death.

data.title: Even Eternity Couldn't Save Us
data.intro: Banished from the celestial realm for loving Evelyn Marsh, Gabriel Reid is condemned to live 999 lifetimes, bound to her fate. In each life, he gives up everything to save her and her family—only to die forgotten and unthanked. In his final life, Gabriel chooses differently. He turns away, leaving her to the destiny she was always meant to face.

data.title: The Fatal Rewind: Echoes of a Broken Bond
data.intro: Craig Lunt goes to prison to protect his adopted daughter, Claire Lunt. But on the day of his release, she stabs him to death. When both of them awaken five years in the past, the gears of fate violently reverse. This time, Claire severs ties with Craig first and goes all out to ruin him, while he endures it all in silence. It isn't until the moment Claire takes a fatal blow meant for him that she finally realizes Craig, like her, remembers their past life.

data.title: Till Stars Align and Hearts Return
data.intro: Annoyed by his mother's unbearable nagging, Emperor Jonah Saul storms off and bumps into Byron, a boy identical to him when he was young. Refusing to believe the boy is his son, Jonah exiles both Byron and his mother, Wynn Scott, who has been tricked by her own father into lying. It is only when he finds proof that he realizes his mistake and rushes to their side—only to find them taken and placed in harm's way.

data.title: Peace Out, Toxic
data.intro: Seven years into a loveless marriage, Roxy York has endured torment from her mother-in-law and neglect from her husband, Clyde Cohen. When she uncovers their deceit, she files for divorce and sets out to reclaim her life. By the time Clyde realizes what he's lost, all he can do is watch her flourish—thriving in a world where he no longer belongs.

data.title: A Stormy Marriage
data.intro: Anna Kurt, daughter of a global tycoon, leaves home to escape her father's control. Hiding her identity, she marries Jason Zahn, only for him to fall for Emily Shaw, a fake heiress, and seek a divorce. Heartbroken, Anna enters a contractual marriage with Henry Wood, and as they uncover each other's true selves, love gradually blooms between them.

data.title: Reborn for My Happy Ending
data.intro: Kim Hee Won once believed in love, but the end was a betrayal. Bae Jun Hyuk, the man she risked all of, sold her information to his enemy in order to protect his fake identity. Eventually, Hee-won was brutally murdered as she was targeted for revenge. Faced with her body, Yoon Seung Woo followed her to death after being enraged and killing all who killed her.But Hee-won opened her eyes, back in her senior year in high school.

data.title: Power Beyond Mortals, Fear Beyond Heaven
data.intro: Ten thousand years ago, Elias Rowan failed his ascension and became confined to Mount Voidfall. Awakening millennia later, he finds the world changed and the Aetherion Sect in ruins. Disguised as an ordinary disciple, he returns to save the sect. Ironically, no one recognizes him. To make matters worse, they all think he's a lazy disciple who doesn't train. At the sect competition, Elias turns the tide and finally goes beyond what his past self was capable of.

data.title: Shh... We Are A Secret
data.intro: In a world where loyalty clashes with temptation, a rebellious heir and his alluring new stepsister navigate dangerous power struggles, family betrayals, and a forbidden romance—risking everything to protect their secrets and each other.

data.title: Married for Money, Swayed by Love
data.intro: News of the infamous Hugh Xavier entering a whirlwind marriage shakes all of Juset. Everyone assumes he's smitten by the sweet and charming Linnie Trent—but what no one knows is that Linnie only agreed to the marriage as a high-paying part-time job. Little does she realize, what starts as a carefully crafted façade will gradually turn real... and their relationship will never be the same again.

data.title: The Emperor Can Hear My Thoughts?!
data.intro: After an unexpected encounter, five-year-old Zoe Lowe finds herself transmigrated into a novel as the princess who faces beheading by the orders of her tyrant father, Emperor Zac Lowe. As Zoe quickly thinks of a way out, her thoughts sound clear in Zac's mind, unintentionally leaking his fate of death in seven days as well as the empire's downfall. Initially, Zac does not take her seriously, but as everything she says comes true, he starts to panic.

data.title: The Lust Game: Seduce Me If You Can
data.intro: A virgin signs up for the ultimate seduction show—$5M on the line, no rules but lust. Stuck with her shameless ex, a dangerous lawyer, and a bad boy who knows exactly how to touch her, every task drags her deeper into temptation. To win, she must play with fire... even if it costs her innocence.

data.title: Her Betrayal, His Hidden Crown
data.intro: After saving wealthy heir Jim Yale, Jane Shaw—a poor fish seller—marries him and lifts her family into high society. A year later, she returns from studying abroad, pregnant with the child of Hank Dunn, a mercenary leader. She not only betrays Jim but also plots to steal his entire fortune to support her unborn child. Disillusioned by her heartlessness, Jim reveals his true identity at the Drako Banquet, determined to make Jane regret her selfish choices.

data.title: Dead to You, Back for Revenge
data.intro: Miles Shaw proposes to Hallie Roane for the 99th time—but she rejects him once again, claiming that marrying him would leave blood on their hands. Later, Miles survives an accident and becomes engaged to heiress Faye Keller. Months afterward, Hallie runs into Miles again, who shuns her and no longer pines for her like a lovesick puppy. As obsession and the desire for revenge collide, the three are pulled into a dangerous web of love and hate.

data.title: Reveal, Rise and Reign (DUBBED)
data.intro: Lance West generously supports his girlfriend, Lara Olson, throughout her academic journey. Thanks to his financial assistance, she successfully graduates and attains significant financial success, earning tens of millions annually. Despite Lance's unwavering support, Lara callously severs their relationship, citing the gap in their social statuses. However, in the wake of this heartbreak, fate intervenes.

data.title: No Way Out of That Night
data.intro: The night soft-spoken intern Bonnie Paige gets drunk, an unexpected encounter ties her fate with someone she has never met. However, despite running the next morning out of fear of responsibility, she soon meets him again at the hospital. He stares her down, cold and aloof.

data.title: Darling, Is It All Coincidence
data.intro: Jeong Ha-yun's life hit rock bottom—her brother was bankrupt and seriously ill. Just as she was being humiliated at her part-time job, she ran into Lee Jun-hyeok, a chaebol heir. Desperate for her brother's treatment money, she agreed to sell him her first night. But all he saw was a woman selling herself for cash. He had no idea she'd had a crush on him since their school days.

data.title: Lord of Shadows: Dominion of Might and Fury
data.intro: Wyatt Lane, the Underworld King who once suppressed the Divine Prison, returns to the city to uncover the truth behind his family's massacre. Backed by seven extraordinary sisters—a cold CEO, a mysterious strategist, an international flight attendant, a peerless divine physician, a stunning livestream host, a woman of hidden identity, and a legendary actress—he relies on overwhelming strength and vast connections to crush the underworld and protect those he loves.

data.title: Fortune's Favorite, Family's Castoff (DUBBED)
data.intro: Born with extraordinary luck, Emily Duffer is left disabled after saving her brother because her parents refuse treatment. Four years later, overwhelmed by debt, they abandon her. She is later found by debt collector Benson Boyd, who takes her in after witnessing her strange good luck. Nearly dragged into hell by Benson's wicked family, Emily becomes the reason he cuts ties with them—and the family he chooses instead.

data.title: Countdown to Goodbye, Countdown to a New Life
data.intro: In his past life, Adrian Ward faced a painful truth on his deathbed: his wife, Hazel Moore, and their daughter had never loved him. Reborn and returned to seven years into their marriage, he decides to let go this time. He gives Hazel his blessing to be with her childhood sweetheart and, freed from his past, devotes himself fully to the medical research he had once abandoned.

data.title: His Unexpected Forever (DUBBED)
data.intro: Nineteen years lost to time, Leah York is plucked from obscurity by the family she never knew, only to face a chilling fate: marrying a man believed to be dead in her adoptive sister's stead. Just when her world threatens to collapse, a twist shatters every expectation. Her fiancé, the notorious and cold-hearted Chad Ford, isn't only alive—he's enamored with her. As he showers her with tenderness no one thought him capable of, whispers swirl.

data.title: Chasing His Rejected Alpha Wife
data.intro: She gave everything as a mate, a Luna, a wife, but when betrayal struck and she was left pregnant and alone, she decided to reclaim her unparalleled true bloodline and be the Alpha they never expected.

data.title: Hers by Accident, His by Destiny
data.intro: Sadie Tindall and her older sister are set to marry the Wirth brothers under their families' arrangement. Sadie's CEO sister is supposed to marry the elder brother, the head of the Wirth family, while Sadie is meant to marry the younger brother, an actor. However, a mix-up occurs on their wedding night. Sadie ends up marrying the older brother, Rafael Wirth. Since the mistake cannot be undone, they go ahead with the switch of brides.

data.title: Alchemy of Power: From Mute to Muse(DUBBED)
data.intro: Once an Aurum Cultivator of the Immortal Realm, Mitch Lewis is cast down to the Mortal Realm due to overwhelming debts. He transmigrates into the body of a gambler who, like him, is drowning in debt—and has a beautiful yet mute and tormented wife. Unable to bear her suffering, Mitch resolves to embrace mortal life, starting by earning money and crafting pills to heal her.

data.title: A Virgin Surrogate for the Billionaire
data.intro: Honey Myers becomes a surrogate for NFL star Tristan Brown to pay for her sister's surgery, navigating through challenges, betrayal, and unexpected love, ultimately finding happiness and family together despite numerous obstacles and threats from Tristan's ex-fiancée, Jennifer.

data.title: Beg for My Return After Kicking Me Out
data.intro: The U.S. nuclear medical professor, Charlie Clare, quits his career for his family, but is abandoned as his wife and daughter favor his love rival Isaac. After suffering his family's ignorance, he decides to leave for the Unicorn Project, which he designed to heal his daughter's neuro-skeletal birthmark as his life's work.

data.title: I Won't Waste My Love on You Again
data.intro: Rayna Allen loses her father—who urgently needed a bone marrow transplant—all because the donor, Chloe Finch, was busy flirting with Rayna's husband, Hansen Lowe. Living in their shadow, Rayna traps in a web of malice and deceit. Right after her father's death, Rayna files for divorce and leaves for abroad. There, she meets someone new and embraces her new life. That is when Hansen realizes he will never win her back.

data.title: Call Me Stepmom, Fxxkboy
data.intro: After being cheated on by her boyfriend Brad, programmer Victoria accidentally crosses paths with Dante, Brad's father and CEO of Reyes Group. She hides her ex-lover identity to join Dante's company and develop a programming project named Melova, but falls deeply in love with him. Dante unconditionally supports her career, while Victoria struggles with coming to terms with Dante’s complicated identity.

data.title: I Accidentally Slept With My Professor
data.intro: Annie never expected her summer fling to become her professor. Their chemistry is electric, their connection is undeniable—but secrets, jealousy, and scandal threaten to tear them apart. As passion blurs the lines between love and ruin, Annie must decide if he's worth risking everything.

data.title: My Mile High Billionaire Obsession
data.intro: Aaron's younger brother impersonates him to date and gets engaged to Harper—just to trick her into donating a kidney to the girl he really loves. Heartbroken, Aaron leaves the country for three years, believing Harper chose his brother. But just as Harper is about to go through with the donation, Aaron returns and uncovers the shocking truth. This time, he’s determined to win back the girl who was always his.

data.title: Viral Lies, Deadly Payback
data.intro: Frank Yarrow, the chief designer of a seventh-generation fighter jet, returns to his hometown to teach. On the train home, Vicky Lynch accuses him of secretly filming her to boost her viewership. After they arrive on campus, she fabricates evidence and hires thugs. She even incites faculty and students to publicly insult Frank. Pushed to the limit, Frank retaliates and makes her pay a heavy price.

data.title: My Scar, His Debt to Pay
data.intro: Rachel and Ethan were trapped in a war zone. While trying to save Ethan, Rachel was left with a disfiguring scar on her face. They fell in love and got married, but there was only one evacuation spot. Rachel gave it to the injured Ethan, and Ethan promised he would come back for her—unaware that Rachel later discovered she was pregnant.

data.title: Where Our Love Couldn't Live
data.intro: Princess Zoe Cork and General Sean Bard despise each other, yet on the day the empire falls, Sean sacrifices himself for her, wishing to sever their bond forever. Grief-stricken, Zoe follows him in death. Reborn with memories intact, she fulfills his wish by matching him with her sister and marrying an Arvan. But when Sean learns the truth, it's too late to undo the pain that binds them.

data.title: His Lost Boy, His Only One
data.intro: After a brutal attack, CEO Christian is saved by Cole, a part-time delivery guy. In an unexpected moment of passion, they cross the line, but Christian misreads Cole, thinking he's after money. Drowning in medical debt and a family that bleeds him dry, Cole sees no way out—until Christian steps in. Relentless in his pursuit, Christian destroy anyone exploiting Cole. But can Cole accept his love, or will doubt keep them apart?

data.title: Vampire's Temptation，Alpha's Obsession
data.intro: Vampire Prince William is cursed for a century. He discovers that kissing human girl Ivy can ease the curse, and if they become intimate, the curse will be lifted completely—but at the cost of Ivy’s life. Determined to break the curse, William takes control and forces Ivy into a marriage contract, bringing her home against her will. Despite his intentions to take her life, he begins to fall for her. But Ivy sees him as a monster, filled with misunderstandings and fear.

data.title: Hooked on Vengeance: Revenge in 3, 2, Splash!
data.intro: Bryce Larkin, CEO of Larkin Corp, is betrayed and drowned by his wife and her friend—only to be reborn as a small fish in Lake Wilra. Awakening the Shock Evolution System, he uses his expert fishing skills to trick fishermen, evolving from goldfish to increasingly powerful forms. In the end, he exposes conspiracies, protects his family, and claims revenge in a live-streamed battle.

data.title: You Left Us in the Dust, We Rose to the Top
data.intro: Jane Stone and her daughter, Talia, are mercilessly abandoned by Roy Zink. To soften the blow for Talia, Jane claims she is a wealthy heiress. For the next two years, she endures countless hardships to raise her daughter. When Jane and Talia cross paths with Roy and his new wife, the couple cruelly humiliates them. At the most critical moment, Jane reveals her true identity, exposes their hypocrisy, and takes her daughter home to begin a new life.

data.title: Single Mom, Billionaire's Bride
data.intro: Seven years ago, a fateful night entangled Evelyn with Xavier, the ruthless CEO of GT Group. Now a struggling single mother, she desperately seeks a father figure for her son William while fending off her obsessive stalker - William's teacher Richard. Their worlds collide again when Evelyn saves Xavier's mother from a mugging. Unaware he's William's real father, she enters a marriage contract with Xavier, who's hiding his billionaire identity.

data.title: Cherished by My Exhusband's Brother
data.intro: A full-time housewife, Chloe, who is left penniless after being betrayed by herhusband Phillip on her 30th birthday, finds solace and support in her secret admirer,her younger brother-in-law Vernon. With his help, she rebuilds her confidence and achieves success in both love and career.

data.title: From Cell to Crown, Lady Kingsley is Back
data.intro: After three years in prison for her boyfriend Damien, Harper is freed and learns she's the long-lost heiress of the powerful Kingsley family. Expecting marriage, she instead discovers Damien is engaged to her best friend, and her adoptive father is tormented by loan sharks. With only James—the man whose life she once saved—by her side, Harper claims her identity, gains powerful allies, defeats her enemies, and finds love anew.

data.title: The Mind-Editing System: My Thoughts, My Game
data.intro: Celine Lark jumps from the top of a building after being falsely accused of plagiarizing her best friend, Sasha Mitchell. Given a second chance at life, Celine realizes that Sasha can hear thoughts. She binds with a Thought Modification System and begins her retaliation. Using the system and her own wits, Celine exposes Sasha's true colors and finally lives the life she should have lived.

data.title: The Tears of Mona Lisa
data.intro: After Elizabeth came home from the orphanage, she hoped for a warm family life—only to be framed by her adoptive sister Alison, sent to prison, betrayed by her boyfriend, and rejected by her family. Heartbroken, Elizabeth left her family and disappeared without a trace. Five years later, she returned as the acclaimed master painter Q. No longer the fragile girl she once was, she had been reborn—ready to weave a perfect new chapter from the threads of her past.

data.title: Escaping the Mafia, I Married A Homeless Billionaire
data.intro: To escape a forced marriage to a ruthless mafia heir, broke Uebr driver Myra impulsively claims a scruffy homeless man as her husband—only to discover he's actually the mafia heir himself. As secrets unravel and danger closes in, fake vows spark real feelings in this twist-filled, enemies-to-lovers romance packed with deception, desire, and unexpected redemption.

data.title: Whoopsie, I Proposed to Mr. CEO
data.intro: Rosa Meade visits the mortuary to pay respects to her late mom. There, she meets Ian Smart, who has just lost his mom to illness. The helpless Ian reminds Rosa of herself. When his fiancée humiliates him, she steps forward and marries Ian to help him out. However, when Rosa wants a divorce, she realizes that Ian takes their fake marriage seriously. And he is actually a genius who has been lying low. Overnight, he goes from a nobody to the chairman of Smart Corp!

data.title: Seducing Mr. Sterling: The Ice-cold Heir
data.intro: To save her dying sister, Emma agrees to seduce ruthless CEO Ethan Sterling and ruin his reputation. But as she enters his world of power and secrets, she finds herself falling for the man she was meant to destroy. Torn between love and betrayal, Emma must choose: her sister's life—or the man who just might save her own.

data.title: Waking Up Married To My Crush!
data.intro: Jasmine awoke to find herself married her college crush Patrick – who is both handsome and wealthy! Yet, she quickly discovers that her marriage is sinking. A tragic accident had damaged her brain, erased the last few years of her life, trapping her at the age of 21. Determined not to spend her 25th year as a love-struck, subservient wife, Jasmine decides to reclaim her sparkle. This transformation gives Patrick a new perspective on Jasmine, he starts to fall in love with her

data.title: Truth Mode Activated: Can't Lie, Won't Lie
data.intro: Office worker Bree Walker is bound to a system called Verity OS, which prevents her from lying. As a result, she is fired for exposing workplace hypocrisy and corruption. After several failed interviews, she boldly confronts Elias Grimm, the CEO of Grimm Corp, and exposes a fraudulent deal he was about to make. Impressed, he later takes her on as his trusted aide, and she helps him tremendously in his business. In a world full of lies and deceit, Bree proves that honesty is t

data.title: Mr. Williams! Madame Is Dying
data.intro: Madison Evans loved Hunter Williams for 16 years, but was asked to be his mobile blood bank for White Moonlight, Andrea David. Hunter Williams destroyed her family, just to make room for Andrea David. A cancer physical examination report made Madison Evans see his cold-blooded and ruthless true face. When she finally didn't love Hunter Williams, she found that she had been infatuated with the wrong person for 16 years.

data.title: Our Love, Once Perfect, Shattered
data.intro: Emma Shaw and Joe Lowe have been lovers since school days. Emma Shaw is left infertile after saving Joe Lowe, a secret she hides to spare him guilt. When she enrolls their adopted daughter in school, she discovers their marriage is a lie—the child belongs to his mistress. As the truth unravels, Emma is abducted and brutally beaten—by Joe himself, unaware the woman in the bag is her.

data.title: The Intern is the Undercover Boss
data.intro: Don't underestimate the intern because you don't know her true identity.To investigate the truth behind a subsidiary's bullying scandal, CEO Claire goes undercover as an intern, enduring humiliation from the villains. With courage and ingenuity, she uncovers the truth, rebuffs the antagonists, and unexpectedly finds love in the process.

data.title: Trapped in a Deadly Love
data.intro: After a devastating family crisis, Nora White falls into financial hardship and is left to care for her younger brother alone. Meanwhile, Nick Gray secretly works against the underworld while maintaining his reputation as a notorious playboy in Junbert. During a part-time job, Nora unexpectedly reunites with Nick after years apart. Drawn to her once more, he soon finds himself falling for her.

data.title: My Online Crush Is My Contract Husband
data.intro: A quirky nurse unknowingly falls for her billionaire boss through an anonymous dating app. When fate forces them into a contract marriage to fulfill his grandfather's dying wish, their online crush and real-life tension collide. Between steamy misunderstandings, family drama, and sweet chaos, love may just find its way—on and off the screen.

data.title: Apocalypse Game: My Shelter Can Upgrade Without Limits
data.intro: 80 billion people are transported to Xonos to take part in the Apocalypse Game, where extreme climates and scarce resources bring out the cruelest sides of humanity. In his past life, Leo Quill was betrayed and killed. After being reborn, he awakens the "Resource Multiplier System." He stockpiles endlessly and upgrades a hidden shelter into a fortress. From there, Leo grows stronger in every way and begins his legendary conquest of the apocalypse.

data.title: Jacked Janitor Vs Golden Boy
data.intro: A bullied janitor turned underground fighter gets his shot at revenge when his childhood tormentor, now a golden-boy champion, joins his gym as a sponsored athlete. But when they're forced to team up to save the gym owner's daughter from a violent ex, their bitter rivalry evolves into an explosive brotherhood, testing what it truly means to win.

data.title: I'm Not Your Joke, I'm Your Lesson
data.intro: Internationally renowned medical researcher Evelyn Webb returns home to surprise her son, only for an accident to shatter her peace. While saving a child, she halts a speeding luxury car—unaware that the woman inside is her future daughter-in-law, Bianca Hunt. Mistaken for a simple bumpkin, Evelyn endures cruel humiliation. Caught in a twisted web of mistaken identity, she resolves to expose Bianca's true colors and reclaim everything that belongs to her.

data.title: The Last Spark of Us
data.intro: Audrey has secretly loved her brother's best friend, Zachary, for years. A no-strings affair turns serious when she gets pregnant—until his ex returns with a child, making Audrey think he's already a father. She leaves before hearing the truth, and an accident keeps them apart. Ten months later, they meet again, and Zachary fights for her heart. Now Audrey must choose: walk away or reveal that their child survived.

data.title: The Dangerous Touch of Love
data.intro: Sarah Miller is set to marry Nathan Stein to save her comatose brother. However, she discovers that he is having an affair with his secretary—and that they are even plotting her death after the wedding! To fight back, Sarah turns to his half-brother, Caleb Stein, Nathan's sworn enemy. What begins as seduction for survival slowly turns into real feelings. Still, Sarah reminds herself that she cannot afford love: the only goal of her marriage is to save her brother.

data.title: My fated Alpha: Rejected and Reclaimed
data.intro: Sophia suffered domestic abuse at the hands of her father, Antony, since a very young age. As an adult, Sophia encountered a paranoid and abusive partner, Gordon, who eventually pushed her off a cliff. Miraculously, Sophia survived and was rescued by Alpha Bernard, who had recently lost his partner. After being rescued, Sophia decided to move forward despite the doubts and pushbacks. Antony and Gordern, in an attempt to cover up their crimes, had since been planning .....

data.title: The Hockey Star Can't Stop Missing Me
data.intro: Diana, the coach's daughter who secretly powers her boyfriend Benson's rise, is discarded when his ex returns  with a "daughter". Public betrayals from Benson push Diana toward Jake—the man who truly loves her. Amid lies and betrayal, how will she choose?

data.title: The Heiress and Her Three Princes
data.intro: Just as Ria hits her rock bottom in life with her boyfriend cheating and her step-sister bullying, three handsome billionaires come to her save. They offer her a multi-billion inheritance! But, under one condition…… She has to marry one of the three brothers to be the heiress. Who is she going to choose? And who would be YOUR pick?

data.title: The Getaway Heiress Returns
data.intro: Her childhood was stolen, will her entire life be stolen too?Alice was originally the heir of the Damon family,but was kidnapped and abandoned by her uncle,who wanted the family fortune to himself. Alice was then adopted by Lisa. After becoming an adult, Alice ran into her biological parents again,but she's already lost her childhood memories.

data.title: Parallel Hearts: Never to Meet Again (DUBBED)
data.intro: The moment Piper Swift gave birth, her boyfriend Sean Ward abandoned her. For ten years, Will Mack cares for her and her daughter selflessly, asking for nothing in return—only to be mocked as a simp. Will doesn't mind, for he knows his time is short and that he will soon return to his wife and child in the real world. However, once he is gone, Piper and her daughter spiral, realizing too late what they've lost.

data.title: Divorced with a Secret Baby
data.intro: Laura, a hidden heiress, marries Aaron, who believes she loves another man and weds him for money. He never touches her. Laura secretly gets pregnant but catches Aaron with the pregnant Sophia and leaves. Aaron regrets everything and tries to win her back, but she lies the child is someone else's. After being shot rescuing her, Laura confesses the truth—the man on the wedding night was her brother, not a lover. Misunderstandings are finally resolved.

data.title: May We Never Meet Again(DUBBED)
data.intro: For three long years, Esme Quinn has endured her husband's cold indifference while he openly cherished another woman. Her desperate attempts to win his heart prove futile when he abandons her to face a family crisis alone, choosing instead to stay by his mistress' side. Just as she finally gathers the strength to leave him, the last thing she expects happens—he comes begging for her to stay.

data.title: Love Rooted in the Fields
data.intro: At twenty-four, Cary West is forced to marry a stranger in a remote village to replace her sister, Katy, who is favored by their father. To her shock, her husband, Simon Zimmer, turns out to be the richest man in Oceana, and her mother-in-law, Muse Keller, showers her with care. However, Katy and her husband, Howard Gibson, continue to bully Cary and her family.

data.title: Kiss Me, Even if It Burns(DUBBED)
data.intro: As an orphan and Dylan Pitt's bodyguard, Scarlet Novak stands by him through every rise and fall, yet never truly obeys him. To break her defiance, he torments her under the guise of his first love—but she refuses to yield and even fakes her death to escape. Desperate, he brings her back and erases her memories through hypnosis, only to realize that a world without her means nothing to him.

data.title: Watch Out! I Call the Final Shots
data.intro: After being cast aside by the woman he helped rise to power, Arthur Storm—secret CEO of the powerful Titan Group—is thrust back into the spotlight when a mysterious billionaire proposes marriage, shaking high society to its core.

data.title: Our Love, Buried in Regret
data.intro: After Cliff Meyer’s death, his mother orders Liam to father a child with Cliff’s wife, Isla. Liam’s wife, Kate, feels betrayed when told he has already slept with Isla and even her son turns against her. Heartbroken, she leaves with the Empress’s permission to divorce and guards the border, where she meets Prince Steve Lester. Realizing his mistake, Liam cuts ties with his family and begs for Kate’s forgiveness, but she rejects him.

data.title: Mech Era: The Unstoppable SSS-Tier Force
data.intro: After the Insectoid invasion, everyone awakens mech powers. Women become mech girls, while men gain the rare role of handlers. Ethan Astor unlocks a legendary SSS-tier trait, letting him command multiple SSS-tier mech girls. With this unstoppable force, he crushes the Insectoid armies and turns the tide of war!
