data.title: After I Had the Billionaire Hobo's Baby
data.intro: After a fateful night with a homeless artist leaves her pregnant, Carly, a resilient single mother, fights to give her son a better life—unaware that the man she once loved in the shadows is a powerful heir entangled in secrets that could change everything.

data.title: Your Love Came After the Ending
data.intro: When one-sided love crumbles under the weight of disappointment, Harvey Blair chooses to leave. Peyton Nord signs the divorce papers without reading them, too indifferent to notice. By the time Peyton realizes their relationship has ended—a whole month later—Harvey has already built a new life with the warmhearted Nicole Carter.

data.title: Lose You Never, This Time Forever
data.intro: Zack Miller, a ruthless underworld leader, gets engaged to his savior Olivia Larke to repay a life debt. But warned to be destined to kill his wife and child, he marries Isla Wright as a substitute, only to fall in love with her—a fact he tries hard to ignore. It is after Isla "dies" in childbirth that he learns she was his true savior, and given another chance years later, he vows to never let her go this time.

data.title: President's Sexy Wife
data.intro: Heiress of the Lawrence family, Gianna couldn't believe it when she found her fiance had been cheating on her with her half-sister. Heartbroken, she went to get drunk in a bar, but ended up spending a passionate night with a hot guy named Logan. It was only until the next morning that she realized Logan was the owner of the Solomon Group and that she, under the influence, had signed a marriage contract with him.

data.title: By Blood and Betrayal, I Resurge(DUBBED)
data.intro: Betrayed and brutally murdered by her husband, Sean Curtis, and Zara Engel, who framed her in a baby swap scheme, Rhea Engel is reborn with enhanced powers. Discovering that Sean has also returned to life, she breaks free from her cycle of suffering by entering a marriage of power with the Beast King, rising as an untouchable sovereign.

data.title: Oops! Mr. Lawson Got the Wrong Girl
data.intro: After a round of drinks, Sara Joy, an intern at Lawson Corp, acts under the influence of alcohol and has a one-night stand with her boss, Ted Lawson. Upon waking up, she leaves immediately unnoticed but fails to cut ties cleanly as she accidentally leaves her best friend’s resume in the room. Taking advantage of this, Mandy Fox impersonates Sara and moves into Pine View, living under the same roof as Ted.Meanwhile, Sara hopes to maintain a low profile as an ordinary intern.

data.title: Forever After, Never Again
data.intro: Neglected by her father and stepmother since childhood, Elara Rhode hires Ethan Walden as her personal bodyguard—only to fall in love with him and begin pursuing his affection. But Ethan remains distant. Unbeknownst to Elara, he is secretly the heir to the powerful Walden family—and harbors feelings for her stepsister instead. Devastated and furious, Elara impulsively marries Charlie Shaw, a man trapped in a vegetative state.

data.title: Hunter in the Ring: Gloves Off, Blood On
data.intro: Once a ten-time boxing champion, Flynn Pierson hides his identity after serving time in prison and works as a janitor at a boxing club. But when the organization responsible for his father's murder resurfaces, Flynn is forced back into the ring of vengeance. Protecting his friends while unraveling the truth, he sets a deadly trap to draw out the mastermind—and make them pay the ultimate price.

data.title: Love, not Lost to Memory (DUBBED)
data.intro: After giving birth to twins for the powerful Todd family, Vera Bell is drained of her blood in the delivery room to save their chosen heir, Finn Todd—leaving her lifeless, clutching a blood-stained lucky charm. Seven years later, mute and stripped of her memory, Vera survives by scavenging while raising her daughter, Grace Bell.

data.title: Next Chapter, No You (DUBBED)
data.intro: After seven years of marriage, Camila Reed's husband remains cold and distant. Still clinging to hope that she might one day win his heart, she travels overseas to surprise him and their daughter on her birthday—only to discover them celebrating another woman's birthday instead. They had never planned to spend the day with her.

data.title: Whispers of Lies, Shackles of Love
data.intro: Ever since she was cast out of the orphanage at age eight, Sydney Cox has devoted herself to protecting her savior, Tim Hawke—first as his bodyguard, then as his lover—only to discover it was all a lie, meant to prevent her from reclaiming her rightful place as the true heiress of the Gilmores. Disillusioned, she exposes the truth of her identity and walks away, leaving the Gilmores stunned and Tim in turmoil over losing her.

data.title: His Regret Began After My Goodbye
data.intro: Emily Curtis endures five years of deliberate neglect in her marriage to Frank Lester. On the day she suffers a miscarriage, she sees him caring for his mistress. Heartbroken, Emily divorces him. With the support of her childhood friend, she rebuilds her life. Frank is consumed by guilt over the death of his first love—but five years later, she is revealed to be alive. Only then does he realize that all his hatred toward Emily was unfounded.

data.title: Fading Facades: Love Beyond the Deal
data.intro: Qiana Cooper, born into a prestigious family, hides her identity to break free from her father's excessive indulgence. She travels to Green Land intending to marry John Collins, aspiring to lead an independent life. However, John becomes enamored with Cindy Smith, who portrays herself as an aristocrat. To ascend the social hierarchy, John divorces Qiana. Fueled by anger, Qiana enters into a marriage contract with Jack James, who happens to be in need of a partner.

data.title: The Last Goodbye: I Leave with My Heart
data.intro: After saving the fallen heiress Nina Stone, street vendor Blake Fallon stays by her side and helps her reclaim her success—only to discover she's cheating on him with Hubert Judd. Not only is she carrying her ex-fiancé's child, but she also leaves Blake infertile and causes his father's death by forcing his surgeon to abandon a critical operation. Betrayed and humiliated, Blake teams up with Nina's rival, Lucy Clark, and fakes his own death to escape.

data.title: Flash Marriage with My Werewolf Husband
data.intro: To escape her abusive stepfather, Lisa takes the offer from a law firm in New York, where she unexpectedly flash-marries her boss. As she juggles work, she wants to bring the werewolf who once attacked her to justice, her boss becomes more and more suspicious… Caught between his mounting suspicion and her undeniable attraction to him, Lisa struggles with her next move.

data.title: Signed Off, Moved On
data.intro: Maya Shaw, heiress of Isburg, sacrifices her sight to save Cody Reed and marries him—only to witness his affair with his secretary on the day she regains her vision. Heartbroken, she inherits her mentor's legacy and divorces Cody. But as she begins to thrive in the medical field with Wayne Cox by her side, Cody regrets everything and desperately tries to win her back.

data.title: The Crown She Stole, The Fate I Own
data.intro: Married into a wealthy family, Linda Siddon lives the life everyone envies—until her jealous sister, Alicia, brutally ends it. Fate gives them both a second chance, sending them back to the past. Seizing the opportunity, Alicia marries the Lynns' wealthy heir, leaving Linda to a penniless security guard. But Linda surprises everyone by accepting the arrangement—because she knows better than anyone the dark truths hidden behind the Lynns' gilded "glory."

data.title: Love Doesn't Own Me, I Do
data.intro: After five years as Leo York's secret lover, only to witness him get engaged to another, Sara Stone finally realizes he never truly loved her. Resolutely, she resigns from her role as his secretary and reclaims her identity as the heiress of the Coles, leaving him behind without hesitation. When Leo pleads for her return, Sara is already way out of his reach.

data.title: My Lovely Wife is a Big Shot
data.intro: My Lovely Wife is Big Shot-A secretive runaway heiress and a billionaire disguised as a homeless man find themselves in a whirlwind marriage of mistaken identities, outrageous schemes, and laugh-out-loud chaos, as they battle power-hungry exes and uncover shocking truths—one mishap at a time.

data.title: Trapped in Your Toxic Love
data.intro: Racing team doctor Tracy indirectly killed the brother of her legendary racing driver fiance Nolan, and Nolan also suffered a shoulder injury and missed his racing career. Because of Nolan's mother's interference, Tracy, who was pregnant, thought Nolan hated her and left for France. Many years later, she returned to China just to negotiate a cooperation with TGC Hospital Medical Group.

data.title: After all this time
data.intro: A secret lover becomes a wife after an unexpected pregnancy, but is their marriage truly just for show? When past love resurfaces, is it too late to fix everything?For five years, Grace and Andrew’s relationship has been nothing more than a casual fling—he craves her body, while she dreams of his love. But when an unexpected pregnancy forces Andrew to marry her, a simple mistake turns into an inescapable bond.

data.title: Through Lies and Loss, Love Survives
data.intro: Serena Vaughn and Julian Foster are happily expecting their first baby together. However, thanks to the lies of a jealous party—Julian thinks Serena left him and aborted their baby, and Serena thinks Julian died in a plane crash—they are separated. Five years later, the two lovers meet again—Julian furious and vengeful, and Serena shocked and confused. Through the web of lies, they find their way back to each other through life and death.

data.title: The Mafia's Innocent Lover
data.intro: The ruthless gang boss Rafael Moretti has a secret love for Sophia. During an unexpected casino robbery, Rafael Moretti found Sophia, the girl he had been looking for, and they had a one-night stand by accident. Sophia borrowed money for her father's surgery expenses, which led Rafael to mistakenly believe that she was a gold digger, so he proposed a contractual relationship.

data.title: Royal Heir Breaks My Heart In A Warzone
data.intro: Charlie, an ER doctor burdened by family obligations, reunites with her former lover Harry during a medical mission in a conflict zone. Unbeknownst to her, Harry is a prince who once left her due to a misunderstanding but never stopped loving her. Together, they face life-and-death challenges amid warfare, while Selina—a jealous medical officer—plots against Charlie, even colluding with terrorists. As the truth unfolds, Harry discovers that Charlie’s child is his own.

data.title: The Divorced Housewife Turned CEO
data.intro:
Sharon Green, secretly the CEO of MF Group, hides her
identity to avoid making her husband, Martin, feel
insecure. Despite supporting him, she faces betrayal
and humiliation. After divorcing him, she reveals her
true identity at a gala, ends Martin’s business deal, and
reclaims her power, proving she’s a strong,
independent woman.

data.title: No Longer Yours, Born to Shine
data.intro: Once kept as a "pet" by Hector York, Kathy Hagen escapes from him and falls for Sean Fowle, unaware that he is already married with a child. His wife, Jane Smith, causes Kathy to lose her baby and her ability to conceive. The Fowle family frames her for child abuse and humiliates her. Kathy fakes her death and takes on a new identity, finding love with Nick Mercer. When Hector and Sean meet Kathy again years later, they realize there is no turning back time.

data.title: Second Take on Love
data.intro: Ann Stone and Caleb Zane grew up as childhood sweethearts and married young. After her career collapses and long-distance strain sets in, Ann divorces him. Two years later, she joins a low-tier dating show to survive, only to meet Caleb there. They keep their distance in public but start bickering in private. When Ann is once again at the mercy of internet trolls, Caleb defends her. At the end of the day, love always finds its way back to those who never give up on it.

data.title: Sorry, I'm Out of Your League Now
data.intro: Debbie Reid funds Stacy Potts through college, only to have her kindness backfire when her husband, Greg Upton, betrays her for Stacy—and causes her to miscarry. Three years after their divorce, Debbie is now married to tycoon Owen Wilde. When she unexpectedly runs into Greg and Stacy at the airport, they wrongly assume she's begging to reunite with Greg and begin humiliating her. Owen steps in, protecting Debbie and putting the ungrateful couple firmly in their place.

data.title: Little but Dangerous: Back to Girlhood, Revenge Awaits
data.intro: Holly Jepsen was killed by her own father and stepmother, only to be reborn as her childhood self—with the knowledge of the suffering her mother endured for years. Without hesitation, Holly pulls her mother out of her father's twisted manipulation, rewriting destiny to protect her loved one and bring torment to those who deserve it.

data.title: Death Gave Me a Second Chance
data.intro: Planning to fake her own death on a cruise, Lucy Hart calls her friend, Cecelia Lent, asking her to prepare a hyper-realistic disguise mask. She needs to escape Joseph Parker, the man who had sent her to serve eight years in prison for the sake of Eden Parker. Outraged on Lucy's behalf, Cecelia warns her not to make any more meaningless sacrifices for Joseph. Just as footsteps approach, Lucy hastily hangs up.

data.title: Highborn Matriarch: Power Is the Prize
data.intro: Juliet Castro is a classically raised noblewoman. After marrying Stanley Zeller, she discovers he has a concubine from a powerful family and seems to be flirting with his widowed sister-in-law. He detests dull and boring noblewomen. Even when faced with these challenges, Juliet handles everything with ease. As the lady of the house, she cleans up Stanley's mess for now.

data.title: When Love Dies, Nothing Remains
data.intro: Four years ago, Yvonne Scott had to watch her son die before her eyes. She took Queenie Lane to court, but her husband, Charles Grant, accused her of murdering their son instead. After serving her prison term, Yvonne asks Charles why he framed her. When he reveals that he suspects their son wasn't his, Yvonne spirals into despair and jumps off a cliff. Finally, Charles discovers that Queenie was the one behind everything.

data.title: Runaway Bride, Billionaire's Catch
data.intro: To escape a forced marriage to the ruthless billionaire heir Frank Reed, Kate Smith bolts from the altar and impulsively weds a man she believes is a poor driver—only to discover he is Frank himself. As secrets unravel and sparks fly under one roof, a runaway bride finds herself in a twist-filled romance of mistaken identity, sweet revenge, and unexpected love.

data.title: When Regret Comes After Goodbye
data.intro: While all Myra Hale wants is a place to call home, it turns out her husband, Yves Obel, only married her to clear the path for his first love's success. On the day Myra has her heart broken and realizes that he is the reason she hasn’t been able to get pregnant, she decides to fake her own death and leave him behind in search of a new beginning.

data.title: The Best Mistake Ever
data.intro:
A nerdy but smart girl, NIA, has a one night stand with billion-dollar fashion empire
Owner, JAMES, and he mistakes Nia’s best friend, SELINE, for the girl he found
himself infatuated and had relations with. As Seline and Nia serve as his first and
second assistant, the web of friendship and love gets beyond entangled…

data.title: From Flab to Fab: Her Miraculous Transformation (DUBBED)
data.intro: Kenneth Hart discovers that the girl he is engaged to marry, Nicole Bishop, is overweight. She faces ridicule and is cruelly compared to a pig. Kenneth feels ashamed, but Nicole takes a stand for herself. Despite the humiliation, she allows the emcee to continue hosting the ceremony. During the vows, Kenneth reluctantly agrees out of obligation to his family. However, over time, he grows to resent Nicole and begins mistreating her.

data.title: Oath of Rebirth, Debt of Blood (DUBBED)
data.intro: Nina Spur, the prime minister's wife, was slain at a palace banquet by her own sister, Jane Spur—the emperor's forsaken concubine. Yet fate rewinds. Both sisters are reborn at the moment the Levy family's proposal arrives. Jane seizes it, vowing to marry Luke Levy, the future Prime Minister, while "gifting" Nina the chance to enter the imperial selection instead.

data.title: Double or Nothing: Breaking the Cage
data.intro: Yves Tate was framed by his family and spent ten years in prison. There, he met Xander Ford, who would later become his mentor. Upon his release, Yves exposes his family’s schemes and rescues his friend from the casino. With the help of his allies, he confronts Rufus Duke at the gambling table, ultimately putting him behind bars. Free from hatred and resentment, Yves is finally ready to start anew.

data.title: Baby Bump To Billionaire's Wife
data.intro: To pay tuition, Rosa delivers food and accidentally sleeps with billionaire Jonah under false assumptions. Pregnant and betrayed, she refuses to give in. As the truth unfolds, Jonah protects her, and love blossoms amidst hardship and past trauma.

data.title: Beach Volleyball Virgin
data.intro: Jenny Taylor dreams of losing her virginity to her nemesis stepbrother, Chris Riggins, and accidentally kisses him the next day, resulting in public shaming by Chris’s girlfriend Natalie and the rest of the volleyball team. However, Chris suddenly becomes caring and considerate, defending Jenny every step of the way. Could this actually be the start of a taboo relationship?

data.title: Summer Honeymoon with My Secret Billionaire
data.intro: At her wedding, Ellie is dumped by her fiancé for a wealthy heiress. In a bold move, she marries a passing janitor, Daniel, inviting him on her luxury honeymoon. But Daniel is secretly a billionaire and the owner of Rainbow Island, escaping his own arranged marriage. They agree to a 7-day flash marriage ending in divorce—but as sparks fly, love might just change their plans.

data.title: Dangerous Blind Wife
data.intro: Famous blind bestselling writer Leslie unexpectedly regains her sight and discovered that her husband Alfred was unfaithful to her and murdered her best friend, and that her life has been usurped by her lover Kate. She decides to hide the truth about regaining her sight and teams up with undercover cop Joshua to get revenge.

data.title: The Rejected Luna is the Alpha
data.intro: Athena's world shatters after losing her pack and mate. A year later, she regains her powers and demands a divorce from Victor, who brings his lover Selene to claim Athena's pack. With Alpha King Cassian's help, Athena fights back. As Victor and Selene's wedding implodes, Athena exposes Selene's lies and alliance with vampires. After a fierce battle, Athena reclaims her honor, restores her legacy, and finds love again with Cassian.

data.title: Love on the Sidelines
data.intro: Natalie had it all—engaged to football star Karl and carrying his child—until tragedy struck. Her brother caused Karl's sister's death, and Karl's injuries ended his career. Yet, she vanished for seven years. Now, Karl sees her with a "husband" and "daughter," seemingly happy. But he won't let her go.

data.title: Uncle I Love You
data.intro: Alice's 16th birthday turned into a nightmare. Her beloved father, who ran a quiet little tavern, was murdered, which drags her into the crosshairs of the mafia. Just as the killers closed in, her father’s old friend, Uncle Hector, appeared like a storm and saved her. He revealed the truth: her father had been an undercover cop inside the mafia. But instead of taking her in, Hector sent her to an orphanage, promising to return in a year.

data.title: No More Second Chance
data.intro: Five years ago, Anna was forced to leave Ellison by his controlling mother. To protect his future, she walked away in silence—carrying his unborn child. Unaware of the truth, Ellison was left heartbroken and bitter. Now, fate brings them back together. She's a struggling waitress. He's a successful businessman. Can the wounds of the past be healed, or is it too late for forgiveness and love?

data.title: Addicted to Your Kiss
data.intro: Ruth Larson's family sells her off to Logan Harlow for money. He icily says that he won't touch her. But when they run into each other at the club, he downs her alcohol in a jealous fit. Ruth asks him to mind himself. But he responds in an aggrieved tone, "Why? Are you scared of others finding out you're married?" This confuses Ruth. Didn't he say they would be divorced in a month? What is he playing at now?

data.title: Reliving the Past, Claiming Their Hearts
data.intro: Single social elite Hanson Craig is reborn in 2002 on his way to college. Armed with the memories of his previous life, he leverages his knowledge to build connections and launch the courier company Rocket 101, capitalizing on the e-commerce boom. But as his success grows, Hanson faces a heart-wrenching dilemma: choosing between the sincere Carmen Swann and his long-cherished first love, Riley Snow.

data.title: Ascension Awaits, Revenge Demands
data.intro: Oliver Cosby suffered from depression as a child because his parents favored their adopted son, Simon Cosby. By chance, he becomes the disciple of the Quasar Sect's founder. Eighteen years later, Oliver is on the verge of ascension. However, he must face his family one last time. The moment he returns home, his parents demand that he transfer his cultivation to Simon. No longer the meek child he once was, Oliver defies them and strikes back.

data.title: Mistaken Marriage, Right Husband
data.intro: A single mother enters a forced marriage to save her son, only to discover the man she never forgot is her new brother-in-law.

data.title: Soaring Beyond Broken Promises
data.intro: As Anne Smith stands in the spotlight receiving her medal, she declares her love—not for her husband, Noah Jones, but for Dr. Mason Quinn. At that moment, Noah lies on his deathbed, crushed by twenty years of silent sacrifice. No gratitude from Anne—only their daughter's cold disdain sealing his heartbreak... But when he opens his eyes again, it's the eve of Anne's departure. This time, Noah chooses to live for himself.

data.title: My Secret Weapon? A Little Girl!
data.intro: Abandoned as the true daughter of the Clark family, Clara Clark grows up in an orphanage, only to be taken back years later—yet still treated like an outsider. Her life of hardship takes a sharp turn the moment she chooses to protect five-year-old Megan Porter, the very child the Clarks once cast aside. From that moment, Clara's life transforms—she wins the lottery, rises in her career, and meets her Mr. Right, while the Clarks crumble under the weight of their own choices.

data.title: From Fragments, She Brought Us Home
data.intro: Six years after leaving home, Mira Reed succumbs to cancer, entrusting her daughter, Ariel Reed, to her father, Isaac Reed, in her final moments. Though he takes Ariel in, Isaac misunderstands Mira's past, while his adopted daughter, Briar Holt, schemes against Ariel upon learning that her father is Caleb Rowe. When the truth finally comes to light, Isaac realizes his mistakes—and regrets everything he once said to Mira.

data.title: My Heart Dies From Home
data.intro:
From a young age,Greta was abandoned and forced to survive on her own. In her quest to claim her adoptive father's unpaid wages, she encountered ridicule and
Mistreatment at the hands of the Walker family. Unbeknownst to the Walkers, they had been tirelessly searching for a family named Clara, not realizing that Greta, the very individual they had been disparaging, was Clara all along..

data.title: The Alpha's Fateful Mate
data.intro: In the werewolf world, Adriana and her sister were bullied by their foster family. Forced to marry a 70-year-old, Adriana fled and met Christian, an "ordinary" man who was actually the grandson of her saved lady. They impulsively married. Misunderstanding each other, they soon found love. In a crisis, Adriana learned Christian was the Alpha. Meanwhile, Christian uncovered secrets in Adriana's pendant and birthmark.

data.title: Throne of Power: Reborn to Slay the Game
data.intro: In the last life, the Elmer family's adopted daughter, Riley Elmer, wreaked havoc on Jean Elmer's life. With her special ability, she drove a wedge between Jean and her family. In the end, Jean ended up disgraced and ruined. Now, Jean gets a second chance at life. When she hears Riley's familiar wicked thoughts, she smiles. No matter what Riley does and how the Elmers favor her, Jean refuses to submit to them in this life. She will rise, unyielding and unstoppable!

data.title: A Mortal Above All Heavens
data.intro: Douglas Stokes transmigrates into a fantasy world and becomes the founder of the Myriadith Sect. But there's one problem... he's actually a mortal who can't cultivate! He keeps a low profile in his sect quarters to avoid exposure. Unfortunately, the saintess of Dante Sanctum storms in, demanding that he take responsibility. Soon, he's dragged into the messy conflicts between the divine beings.

data.title: Ex-Wife 2.0: Richer, Colder, Untouchable
data.intro: Riley Lester, the stunning CEO of Lester Corp in the city of Horrun, has always cherished her husband, Derek Harmon, above all else. She gifts him a Porsche, the luxurious Skyle Villa, and even a Centurion Black Card with a hundred-million-dollar credit limit—while also covering the living expenses of his parents and sister.

data.title: 65 and Ascending: The Path to Divinity
data.intro: A 65-year-old Aether Stage cultivator, nearing the end of his life, accidentally awakens the "Ninefold Core System." He saves and heals the three beautiful Lawson sisters, and by combining modern methods with highly potent pills, his cultivation soars by leaps and bounds. With the system's guidance, he is destined for greatness and set on the path to ascendancy.

data.title: Summoning System: From Shame to Supremacy
data.intro: When Cody Miller's girlfriend publicly humiliates him with a scion, he accidentally awakens a summoning system. Using it, he performs incredible feats that catch the attention of remarkable people, who choose to support him. With their money and manpower, he crushes his enemies and rapidly amasses power, building the largest business empire in history.

data.title: My Glorious Life Started After Breakup
data.intro: After five years together, when Daniel showed up with his new lover to break up, Natalie took the exorbitant settlement and walked away without hesitation. Daniel was certain she would crawl back—but instead, Natalie revived the career she had once abandoned and soon had someone new by her side. By the time Daniel finally woke up, there was no longer any room for him in Natalie’s life.

data.title: Fortune's Darling: The Lost Heiress Returns
data.intro: The Gale family brings Candice Gale back from an orphanage, but mistreats her while favoring their adopted daughter. By chance, Simon Smith, the richest man in the city, takes Candice in after she saves him once. Candice brings good fortune to the Smith household. With her around, Simon's wife wakes up from her coma, and they even find their missing son. In the end, it turns out Candice is actually Simon's daughter. The Smith family is finally reunited.

data.title: Crown Reclaimed: She Who Rises From Betrayal
data.intro: Princess Ann Russo of Souzar conceals her identity to heal Prince Cyril Walsh of Yorhil and secretly helps him claim the throne. But once crowned, he demotes her to a mere concubine and marries Anna Tate. Betrayed and furious, Ann demands a divorce and reclaims everything she sacrificed, returning to her true self—the ruling princess she was always meant to be.

data.title: His Sweet Bella
data.intro: A young woman becomes a nanny for a powerful mafia boss's niece, only to be pulled into his world of crime, danger, and forbidden desire. As secrets surface and enemies close in, she must fight for survival while resisting a man who could either protect her or destroy her completely.

data.title: Mafia's Captive Bride
data.intro: Mafia boss Sebastian forces Elena into a marriage after she saves his life at her mother's grave. Elena, trapped by Sebastian, fights back, tames him, and falls in love amidst crises.

data.title: Don't Miss Me When I'm Gone(DUBBED)
data.intro: Jenna Steele loved Noah Finch for a decade—until she caught him crossing the line with comatose Lucy Steele. She ends the engagement and turns to Caleb Shaw, the boy she once protected. Framed and humiliated by Noah and Lucy, Jenna's career is destroyed. But Caleb steps in to help. Now, with him by her side, she rises from the ashes—and they're ready to make everyone pay.

data.title: Daddy, This Is Mommy
data.intro: She had a one-night stand with a stranger and gave birth to a son, whom her father took away to settle his debts. Overwhelmed with sadness, she suffered memory loss, unaware that her stepson is actually her own biological child...

data.title: Sorry, My Mercy Expired Last Life
data.intro: In her past life, Giselle Voss, after years of sacrifice in her marriage to Louis Niles, dies when he forcefully takes her heart for his first love, Maisie Reed. Suddenly finding herself sent back one year earlier—before the betrayal comes to light—Giselle awakens from her blind devotion. Determined to make her unfaithful husband and his mistress pay, she vows to exact a heavy price for exploiting her generosity.

data.title: My Vampire Husband Wants to Bite Me Every Night
data.intro: The witch Aurora, who has visions of the future, has been exploited by her father to make money since childhood. One day, she accidentally discovers the secret of an influential figure and becomes the target of a manhunt. While fleeing, she meets the Vampire Howard. To her surprise, she foresees a future in which she marries him…

data.title: Win the Battle, Win His Heart
data.intro: Iris Jewell is the eldest daughter of a battle-hardened general. She dies in war and awakens in the body of Sean Flint's wife, a member of a modern elite family. She signs a one-year contract to play the role of his wife, after which she will receive a house and a job upon divorce. Unexpectedly, she handles herself with confidence and straightens out the people around her. Gradually, Sean falls for her and begins a determined pursuit of love.

data.title: Wife on the Run, Again!
data.intro: While Jay Glover tells others not to bully his wife, Riley Keller, just because she is a country girl, the socialites fall silent. After all, Riley outshines them effortlessly, without even trying. Jay paints her as kind-hearted and innocent, but he seems to have forgotten the patients she has treated and the enemies she has killed. Even he himself is under her control, yet he claims she never opposes him.

data.title: Warning! Handle Him at Your Risk
data.intro: Three years ago, Cedric York went to prison in his brother's place, enduring relentless torment until he was rescued by the Elixir Sage. Armed with supreme medical skills, he marries into the Kent family. Later, he uncovers the truth about his dragon lineage and the Dragon's Bone. Cedric overcomes every obstacle, earns the respect of all, and finally lives the life he was destined for.

data.title: A Loser in Name, a Master in Game
data.intro: Top salesman Francis Cooper transmigrates into the body of the good-for-nothing son of the Minister of War. Despite his flaws, his father and sister continue to love him dearly. Soon, he faces relentless attacks from the son of the Minister of Revenue, who covets their family's wealth. Using his modern wit, Francis plays dumb to outsmart his enemies, purge corrupt officials, and protect his family—all while shaking up the city of Juset.

data.title: What Remains After Love Burns Out
data.intro: After a car accident, Earl Pearce loses all memory of Rowena Ortega—the woman he has loved for seven years. Daniel Ortega, Earl's best friend who has stayed by his side during his recovery, soon realizes Earl truly does not remember Rowena. This marks a turning point for Earl, who had been quietly courting her all this time, unaware that Rowena's heart still belongs to her ex-boyfriend.

data.title: Fated to My Neighbor Boss
data.intro: After a one-night stand with Ethan, Sherry gives birth to twins. Katrina, her wicked stepsister, steals one of the babies, pretends to be his mother, and becomes Ethan’s fiancee. Six years later, Sherry returns as a famous perfumer Siren, exposes Katrina’s lies, reunites with her stolen child, and falls in love with Ethan.

data.title: Cyberstorm: The Ultimate Hack
data.intro: Felix Carter is the top cybersecurity expert in the country. He has a one-night stand with a striking CEO named Lana Young. Felix loses his job when his ungrateful mentee and the newly appointed CEO join forces to get him fired. By coincidence, Felix submits his resume to Lana's company. Before he can even start his new job, he is drawn into a fierce competition between the two companies over a major project.

data.title: Pick up a Billionaire Husband
data.intro: On the eve of the wedding day, Casey finds her fiancé's affair with her half-sister, who's in her wedding dress for the next day! Left high and dry, to ensure her wedding proceeds as scheduled, she impulsively flashes a marriage to a hot stranger, whom she accidentally saves when he's in crisis. Casey, like everyone else, believes her contract husband is just an ordinary person. Two strangers' lives collide with sparks.

data.title: Mated with My Fiance's Alpha Daddy
data.intro:
Jessie finds herself in a perilous situation where she has been drugged and raped, only to be rescued by Alpha Andrew, who discovers they are mates. However, when Andrew attempts to establish a relationship with Jessie, she claims her engagement to another man.
On her wedding with Derek, it turns out Andrew is her fiance's dad....
Where will this "forbidden love" manipulated by fate ultimately lead?

data.title: My L.A. Fireman
data.intro: The Palisade wildfire raged as Margaret Foster rushed to save her mother's heirlooms, only to discover her fiancé in bed with her half-sister. Trapped in the flames, Margaret was rescued by a firefighter named Chris. To secure the inheritance of her late mother's company, the heartbroken Margaret impulsively married Chris—the man who had saved her—shattering her father Jacob's plans to forge a political alliance through her marriage to the Los Angeles mayor.

data.title: If the World Breaks Her Again, I Break the World
data.intro: The daughter of a murderer, Mabel Gabe is in love with Ryan Hail, a wealthy scion. She is accidentally drawn into the life of Trent Hall, Ryan's uncle. Trent carries memories of a past life in which rumors drove Mabel to suicide. This time, he keeps her close, shields her from harm, restores her dignity, and ultimately wins her heart.

data.title: The Day Fate Found Us(DUBBED)
data.intro: Nathan Ford, CEO of Ford Corp, is obsessed with his childhood sweetheart and refuses to marry. Desperate for a grandchild, his mother drugs him, leading to an unexpected night with the young nanny, Yelena Shaw, and the misconception of her being a gold digger. Pregnant, Yelena faces the jealous Lydia Zane's plots and falls victim to danger—until he saves her upon finding out she is his long-lost first love.

data.title: Falling For My Estranged Wife
data.intro: The leads are arranged to marry by their families without meeting. Unhappy, the man flees abroad but returns years later and accidentally meets the woman. They fall for each other, unaware they’re married...

data.title: You're No One to Me Now (DUBBED)
data.intro: Carmen Yates, adopted by the Spencer family, is supposed to marry one of her three brothers. But instead of love, they treat her coldly. Meanwhile, Savannah Cook, the maid's daughter mistaken for their savior, gets all their care and affection. Heartbroken, Carmen marries their young uncle, Frank Spencer, instead—but everyone calls her a liar and attention seeker. When the truth is revealed, her brothers beg for forgiveness, but Carmen leaves without looking back.

data.title: When Distance Became His Answer
data.intro: For the sake of his childhood friends, Winona Shaw and Naomi Zabel, Frank Lovell gives up a prestigious opportunity to study abroad and chooses to attend the same university as them. But after they meet Calvin Gibbs, Winona and Naomi begin to misunderstand and neglect Frank, leaving him increasingly sidelined. Disheartened and disillusioned, Frank finally decides to walk away—choosing to chase his dreams overseas.

data.title: Love, A Memory Away (DUBBED)
data.intro: Elise Snow pursues Calvin Stone for years to forget Zack Olson—only to lose her memory in a crash the night Calvin abandons her. When Zack steps in to care for her, old feelings resurface and grow. Meanwhile, Calvin's obsession turns dangerous, involving Holly, leading them both to jail. In the end, true love stands the test of time, and Elise and Zack find happiness together.

data.title: Return of His Majesty
data.intro: Before leaving his hometown, Leo Lowe makes a promise to his fiancée, Tina Leed, that once he becomes emperor, he will return to make her his empress. Years later, he successfully establishes a new dynasty and becomes the emperor of it, so he returns to the village disguised as an ordinary villager to fulfill his promise, not expecting to be forced to pay just to get through the entrance.

data.title: My Secret Lover is a Prince?
data.intro: After the Taylor family found their long-lost real daughter, Olivia, who had always been regarded as the apple of their eye, was driven out of the house. Moreover, her nominal husband and her best friend flew away together. Lonely and desperate, Olivia met Edward by chance in a bar. She found comfort in Edward's gentle company.

data.title: From Fired to Feared: Beyond Your Reach, Forever
data.intro: To honor a childhood engagement, Ian Lake joins Olson Corp, secretly helping his fiancée Winona Olson rise to power. But she repays him with humiliation, sparking his rage and breaking their marriage pact. When Olson Corp collapses—and Ian's secret as Lake Corp's heir is revealed—Winona can never hope for forgiveness from the man who once vowed to love and protect her.

data.title: Martial Gourmet: Cooking, Crushing, Conquering!
data.intro: Xavier Lowe is accidentally transported to an arcane world and awakens a Master Chef System. As long as customers pay, he earns praise points from their reviews. With these points, he levels up while staying true to a chef's devotion to great food. Excelling in both cuisine and combat, he becomes unstoppable!

data.title: Beneath the Ordinary (DUBBED)
data.intro: In a quiet, unremarkable neighborhood, Hugh Randall lives a seemingly ordinary life as a security guard. His days pass in routine—unnoticed, uncelebrated. But hidden beneath the surface is a genius-level business acumen capable of shaking the foundations of the entire industry.

data.title: Flash Marriage to My Billionaire Hobo Hubby
data.intro: Katie, an andrologist, is forced by her mom to marry within a month to secure her family business，while Nate, the CEO of Blake Group, is forced into an embarrassing andrology exam to prove he's "functional". Their unexpected meeting at the hospital pushes them into a contract marriage—without knowing she’s the hidden Reed heiress and he’s undercover as an ordinary employee.

data.title: From Broken Nights to His Light
data.intro: Coral Marsh's sister stages her own kidnapping, framing Coral and getting her locked up in a detention center. After her release, her family condemns her and treats her cruelly. Heartbroken, she severs ties in despair. That is when Ian Napp enters her life. She later discovers that he has always been quietly watching over her. His love, protective and healing, belongs to her—and her alone.

data.title: The Father She Called Useless
data.intro: For five years, William Zimmer fought through bloodbaths, clinging to life for the chance to return to his beloved daughter. When he finally comes back as the hero of Tereon, revered by millions, he discovers she is no longer the girl he once knew.

data.title: CEO's Naughty Secret
data.intro: To take back her mother's hotel, she secretly had a baby with a CEO who was drugged and escaped before he woke up. Little did she know, her evil stepsister pretended to be her, making the CEO believe she was his one-night stand. For the sake of the hotel, she had to see him again, but she misunderstood him as being in a relationship with her stepsister, and then she found out she was pregnant...

data.title: Threads of One Night, Knots of a Lifetime
data.intro: Nadine Lane, compelled to spend the night with a man by her family, accidentally ends up sleeping with Jesse Steele and gives birth to his daughter, Stacy Lane. Years later, the toll of difficult birth and relentless family pressure leaves Nadine on the brink of death. To save Nadine, Stacy is forced to plead for help. This journey culminates in a hospital room, where Stacy comes face to face with her biological father, Jesse.

data.title: Her Heart on Trial, His Love in Waiting
data.intro: Elite lawyer Vivian Snow marries government official Tristan Ford, twelve years her senior, unaware that he has secretly loved her for eight years. After their wedding, tension ignites into desire as they navigate power struggles and a trillion-dollar conspiracy. Vivian wields the law as her blade, while Tristan shields himself with authority.

data.title: Falling for You Again
data.intro: Torn apart years ago by Bruce's prejudiced mother, former lovers Bruce and Julia are thrust back into each other's lives. Bruce is determined to rekindle their romance. But amidst new misunderstandings and relentless outside manipulation, Julia is hesitant and tries to leave the painful past behind. In the end, they are forced to confront the truth, leading them to reconcile and reclaim their destined future together.

data.title: This Heart Belongs Elsewhere Now
data.intro: To repay cancer patient Naomi Finch for saving both him and Alina Pryce, Jamie Hale fakes amnesia and showers Naomi with attention. Heartbroken, Alina stages her own death and leaves to chase her dreams abroad—never imagining that Jamie would torment Naomi in her name. Yet no matter how much he does for her, he cannot win Alina back—not when she has already found someone far better than he could ever be.

data.title: Scorned Wife's Revenge
data.intro: Jason Wright, a young and capable general manager, is secretly married to Cindy Sully, the mysterious chairwoman of their company. When Cindy visits the office to deliver Jason's forgotten watch, his secretary Nina—who harbors a secret crush on him—mistakes Cindy for Jason's mistress. Fueled by jealousy, Nina humiliates and assaults Cindy, even causing her to miscarry their unborn child. Upon discovering the truth, Jason and Cindy orchestrate a plan to expose Nina's schemes.

data.title: Pregnant As the Boss's Secret Wife
data.intro: A poor waitress, Lily Carter, sacrifices herself to save her grandmother, but is rescued by the cold CEO, Ethan Blackwood. One night binds them by accident, leading to pregnancy and a secret marriage. At Walter Group, love, betrayal, and power struggles test whether their fates can truly be rewritten.

data.title: Sorry, I'm Out of Your League Now (DUBBED)
data.intro: Debbie Reid funds Stacy Potts through college, only to have her kindness backfire when her husband, Greg Upton, betrays her for Stacy—and causes her to miscarry. Three years after their divorce, Debbie is now married to tycoon Owen Wilde. When she unexpectedly runs into Greg and Stacy at the airport, they wrongly assume she's begging to reunite with Greg and begin humiliating her. Owen steps in, protecting Debbie and putting the ungrateful couple firmly in their place.

data.title: Love Moves On Without You
data.intro: Despite being in love with Nina Lane, Gavin Bowen marries Ava Green under family pressure, vowing to divorce after three years. Over the years, he neglects her, and the situation worsens when Nina returns from abroad. Heartbroken, Ava eventually leaves, and only then does Gavin realize what he's lost. As he faces bankruptcy and Nina reveals her true colors, Ava flourishes in her career and finds happiness with someone who truly loves her.

data.title: Step on Lies, Break Them All
data.intro: Trisha Stewart loved her husband Fred Quinn for ten years, building their company from a small food stall to a listed corporation. But she discovers he caused a car accident that made her lose their unborn child and her chance to have children, all while having an affair with her adoptive sister. Furious, she strips him of everything, leaving him broken and insane, while her sister ends up in prison.

data.title: The Captain's Baby Girl
data.intro: After being abused and kicked out by her aunt, 18-year-old Lexie is rescued by her late father's best friend, Ethan, a wealthy and handsome pilot. As he becomes her guardian, their bond grows from protective care to forbidden desire. Through school bullying, career challenges, and romantic tension, Lexie blossoms—and so does their taboo love.

data.title: Size Doesn't Matter, Power Does
data.intro: After giving birth, Empress Sophie Shaw gains weight and faces her husband's scorn, while her son grows distant under Tara Cox's influence. Tara, scheming for the throne, humiliates and murders Sophie at the Rain Ceremony. But as Tara celebrates, a modern medical graduate transmigrates into Sophie's body and seeks revenge. Using modern knowledge, Sophie defeats enemy princes and corrupt officials, winning the people's admiration and the emperor's heart.

data.title: Surrender to My Dangerous Boss
data.intro: Clara was in trouble for her mother's medical expenses and was forced to be a barmaid. The powerful Elliott appeared and rescued her, bringing her into his own world. The two gradually developed feelings in a complex emotional and workplace environment. Elizabeth repeatedly framed Clara and tried to drive her out of Elliott's life. With Elliott's support, Clara gradually found herself and learned to face life bravely.

data.title: Fierce Grace: Braving the Betrayal
data.intro: For the sake of her boyfriend, Kyle Jensen, Myla Young sacrifices her studies and pursues a career abroad. She founds Rosa Corp, which rapidly ascends to become the world's leading company within seven years. Secretly supporting Kyle's education, she ensures his success, even securing him a position at Foster Corp in Osian. However, upon her return to reveal the truth and propose to Kyle, he publicly ends their relationship to pursue another wealthy woman.

data.title: Prison by His Hands, Escape by His Mind
data.intro: Top engineer Sean Zane discovers his son, Ben Zane, has been framed and imprisoned in the Dawn Prison he designed. To save him, Sean infiltrates as an inmate, winning the crime boss Phil Gould's trust while secretly exploiting the prison's design. With patience and brilliance, he plans not only his son's escape but also the ultimate trap for the greedy Will Judd.

data.title: The Love She Lost to the World (DUBBED)
data.intro: Claudia Zabel is the daughter of the Judd family’s maid. She fell for Hector Judd the moment she laid eyes on him. However, Hector’s heart had long been claimed by his childhood sweetheart, Natalie Yowell. At seventeen, he was even blinded in a car accident while trying to save her. Natalie eventually left Hector for another man. Meanwhile, Claudia stayed by his side and devotedly cared for him for seven years.

data.title: Postscript of Love
data.intro: A mismatched marriage binds Ruth Shaw and Ivan Green for three years, until Ruth is diagnosed with liver cancer and discovers Ivan's ninety-ninth affair. She demands a divorce with five promises and reinvents herself as the artist "Rina" to exact revenge. Later, she exposes the truth behind a car crash and a deadly scheme, unmasking Summer Ford's true colors. Ivan repents, but Ruth leaves a final, tearful farewell.

data.title: Love In The Golden Age
data.intro: After losing her farm due to a sexist will clause, 50-something farmer Teresa marries "farmhand" Augustus in a flash to retain her land—unaware he's a wealthy CEO hiding his identity. Their lies unravel amid ex-wives' sabotage, a long-lost daughter's return, and deadly threats, yet they discover true love that bridges their worlds, fighting to rebuild both the farm and their unexpected bond.

data.title: Heart of Obsession
data.intro: Under unexpected circumstances, Sean Mace falls for Clara Gray at first sight and pursues her relentlessly. However, Clara rejects him, harboring deep hatred for his role in her father’s suicide. Undeterred, Sean refuses to give up and ultimately forces her into marriage through ruthless means. Once wed, Clara does everything to make Sean despise her, yet, to her surprise, she finds herself falling for him instead.

data.title: You're Out of My Life, Forevermore
data.intro: Sue Gould, a wealthy heiress, has always been cherished by her seven adopted brothers—until their driver's daughter, Xena Kurt, turns them against her. Heartbroken as she watches them confess their feelings to Xena, Sue makes the painful decision to sever ties and marry Jim Shaw, a paralyzed heir. By the time her brothers uncover the truth, it's already too late—there's no returning to the family they once were.

data.title: Keep the Ring, I'll Take My Crown
data.intro: More than a decade after wealthy Jake Carr marries the stunning but ordinary Sara Stokes, he throws it all away with an affair he doesn't even take seriously. Humiliated and heartbroken, Sara files for divorce—and over the next year, reinvents herself as a popular streamer. Now, Jake is drowning in regret, but it's too late. Sara has already found happiness in the arms of tycoon Bryan Searle, who can't wait to make her his wife.

data.title: Belly Full of Power: Mama's Mini Mastermind
data.intro: Honest, simple country girl Sophia Snyder interns at a hotel when she unexpectedly spends the night with wealthy Shawn Granger. She becomes pregnant and, hearing her baby's thoughts, realizes her past mistakes left them both to suffer. Determined to change their fate, Sophia vows to protect herself and her child. Guided by her unborn child, she rises to wealth, finds true love, and embraces a happy life.

data.title: The Choices of Fate
data.intro: After their mother’s death, Kate and Amelia Morse face a cruel choice—only one can leave with their grieving grandmother. Believing wealth awaits, Amelia departs, only to find an ordinary life. Years later, envy consumes her when Kate marries into the wealthy Warren family. In a fit of rage, she kills her sister before taking her own life.

data.title: She is not your Fiancée
data.intro: Elena and Charles had a childhood engagement. When Charles visit Elena. He bumped into Elena. As a result, Charles mistakenly identified Chloe as his fiancée. Charles wants to cancel the engagement because of Chloe's behavior. However, Elena's identity gradually emerges. Will Charles recognize Elena and discover that Chloe is not his real fiancée?

data.title: The Wedding Day Reckoning: Crush Them All
data.intro: After years of ruling the business world, Wanda Craig, the formidable chairwoman of Craigon Corp, retires to live quietly in Draco Village—only to have her peace shattered when her adopted son and his fiancée publicly humiliate her at their wedding. Having traveled all that way for them, Wanda reclaims her former glory, and resolves to teach them a lesson they will never forget.

data.title: A Marriage Buried in Lies
data.intro: Years after her husband, Pierre Kemp, jailed her for Avery Sadler's crimes, Nancy Willer is finally released—frail and broken from years of torment. Pierre refuses her treatment and smears her name when he finds her gathering evidence of bullying. He even watches her lose her grandmother before demanding a divorce for Avery's sake. When Nancy leaves, they celebrate—unaware she is already plotting her return for revenge.

data.title: Restarted as His Forever
data.intro: Sofia Xander was betrayed by everyone she loved. Her parents favored her adopted sister. Her husband and son turned their backs on her. When a mysterious system offers her a new life, she accepts. Three days later, she wakes up as Sophie Pace. Soon, she receives a shocking proposal—from Zeke Harmon, heir to the Harmon family and her ex-husband’s biggest rival. He’s a stranger, yet he knows everything about her. He defends her, protects her, and never leaves her side.

data.title: A Dose of Love a Day
data.intro: While gathering herbs in the mountains, Lauren Sullivan accidentally saves Tristan Fletcher and agrees to a 99-day marriage to learn the Fletchers' secret herb cultivation method. She marries with her own ulterior motive, while Tristan is pressured into it by his grandfather. Yet even after their divorce, they promise to reunite once Lauren has avenged her mother.

data.title: One Fateful Night with My Boss
data.intro: After having a one-night stand with an old geezer for money, Anita said goodbye to this cold city and went abroad. Six years later, she comes back with her son and bumps into the legendary CEO, Tristan, who later turns out to be her new boss. Before she knows it, her son starts calling this handsome new boss: “dad”. Could this be fate?

data.title: Midlife Flash Marriage: My Billionaire CEO
data.intro: After divorcing, Amy lost her daughter and raised her son alone. One day, while visiting her grandson, she saved Sophie and met CEO Mr. Smith, who hid his identity and married her. Although she was bullied by her in-laws, Smith always rescued her, defending her and improving her life. Her kind but inept son eventually sided with her against his wife's family. Later, Amy learned Smith was a billionaire and that Sophie was her long-lost daughter, reuniting the family.

data.title: Flames of Love and Lust
data.intro: After a passionate one-night stand, Ethan Sherman can't seem to forget Nancy Sinclair. When he learns she’s determined to please her husband, he offers to help—but not in the way she expects. Nancy believes Ethan will teach her the art of seduction, but instead, he introduces her to the world of foreign languages, current affairs, and politics, encouraging her to expand her mind and embrace her true potential.

data.title: Our Love, As If Meant from the Start
data.intro: Nicole Gildon has spent her life devoted to her family, but her husband, Gerald Lane, grows distant, her son drifts away, and neighbor Megan Page keeps interfering in their relationship. A car accident exposes their betrayal, leaving Nicole devastated and forced into a cruel divorce. Amid her heartbreak, wealthy Andrew Kemp appears, offering concern and revealing a shared past that could change everything.

data.title: The Spy Fiancé Who Stole My Soul
data.intro: Heiress Blair uncovers her fiancé Ethan’s plot to kill her and flees—crashing into undercover agent Liam. When they wake up, they’re shocked to find they’ve swapped bodies.To escape danger and protect their identities, the two make a crazy choice: get married first, then figure out how to switch back.As they bicker through cohabitation, training, and missions, their reluctant partnership turns into real chemistry.

data.title: Queen's Fury: Fall Before Her Wrath
data.intro: Sadie Firth is the daughter of the city's most notorious crime boss. After she gets married, she hides her true identity. Her daughter, Becky, suffers a heart attack on her birthday. Sadie rushes her to the hospital. As she is in a hurry, she overtakes her dad's girlfriend, Lyla Seyfried, who is offended and blocks her way. Backed by her dad and three brothers, Sadie deals with Lyla and exposes her cheating husband. She walks away with dignity for herself and Becky.

data.title: Haunted by Shadows of You
data.intro: It has been six years since Jessica Quinn fell deeply in love with the cold and aloof Harlan Spencer at first sight. After much effort, she finally married him, but their two-year marriage remains unconsummated. By chance, Jessica discovers Harlan harbors an unhealthy obsession with his non-biological sister, Talia Spencer, whom he dotes on endlessly.

data.title: If Only You Remembered Our Love
data.intro: Samuel Fraser is gravely injured, losing both his sight and memory. Zara Sutton, a young woman from a village, saves him. He falls in love with her and marries her. She donates her corneas to restore his vision, but while his sight—and his memories of the past—return, he forgets her entirely. Six years later, he leads a demolition project and reunites with the now-blind Zara and their twins. She recognizes his voice immediately, but he remembers nothing.

data.title: Goodbye, My Once and Forever
data.intro: Wendy Jensen, a wealthy heiress, begins a relationship with Jerry Hale in college and makes a five-year bet with her parents. She never expects betrayal. Yet, in the fifth year, Jerry brings home his assistant, Tina Sutton. While Wendy is asleep, Tina gives Wendy’s son a glass of wine. Furious, Wendy demands accountability, but Jerry defends Tina, telling Wendy not to overreact. Torn and heartbroken, Wendy decides to file for divorce.

data.title: If Love Is Sin, Let It Burn
data.intro: For four years, Sandra Carter has shared a secret love with Blake Keaton—but everything shatters the day his first love, Vivian Hart, returns. Though Blake loves Sandra deeply, he can never marry her. Yet when he hears that she is engaged to another, his eyes ignite with obsession and madness, and a fierce determination to win her back consumes him.

data.title: Broken in the Silence of Your Lies
data.intro: After trying 99 times to win over her fiancé, Arnold Flint, only to find he still loves her adoptive sister. Diana Gregg accepts to marry Arnold's brother, Jasper Flint. Jasper cherished Diana for three years—until a shipwreck seemingly takes his life. However, Diana discovers it was actually Arnold who died, and Jasper had lied to take Arnold's place beside her adoptive sister. Diana walks away in heartbreak, leaving behind the death certificate of their unborn child.

data.title: The End of Us, The Rise of Me
data.intro: Tessa Hebert, heiress of one of Redcliff's most powerful families, conceals her true identity to help her husband, Alec Glover, climb to the pinnacle of success. But fate strikes cruelly—her son is killed in a tragic car accident after Alec abandons him on the roadside for his mistress's sake. Shattered yet unyielding, Tessa rises from grief, determined to reclaim everything she once gave Alec and to make every culprit pay the price.

data.title: Cheers to Love at 50
data.intro: Louisa Coen, a 50-year-old single mother who runs a small tailor shop, endures constant harassment from her abusive, alcoholic ex-husband, Vince Bennet. In an effort to help her move forward, Louisa's daughter encourages her to go on a blind date at the park. There, Louisa unexpectedly meets the renowned Ryan Westland, CEO of Westland Corp, disguised as a motorcycle rider.

data.title: Revenge in My Heart, Love in His Eyes
data.intro: After Mindy Stabler was betrayed by her childhood sweetheart, she meets Zeke Lockwood, who has secretly loved her for years, on a rainy night. They get married swiftly to get back at their exes and eventually find love after marriage. As Zeke looks after Mindy with quiet devotion, she heals from her emotional scars, unaware that he had schemed meticulously for their marriage to happen. Their hearts draw closer until secrets surface and test whether real love can last.

data.title: I Became Mrs Grayson by Bragging
data.intro: On the day of the interview, Alice, an ordinary girl, saved the CEO of the Grayson pharmaceutical group, and bragged that she was the CEO's financee. Unexpectedly, the CEO not only asked her to be his personal assistant, but also married her in a flash.

data.title: Operation: Catch That Dad
data.intro: To investigate his mother's murder, Leo Gray goes undercover as a taxi driver and has a one-night stand with CEO Ava Snow. Years later, Ava returns with their daughter, Lucy, asking Leo to marry her and raise their child. When Lucy suffers a life-threatening asthma attack after being locked in a room by Ava's parents, Leo saves her just in time.

data.title: Ashes of Rebirth: She Wakes the Vengeance
data.intro: Betrayed and set up by her "beloved" and his mistress, Duchess of Fairwind Eleanor Thorne is labeled a traitor, bringing a tragic death to both her family and herself—only to see devastation in Gabriel Hearst's eyes as she dies. Reborn five years earlier, Eleanor turns toward the man who truly loves her and tears down the despicable, beginning a new life with Gabriel.

data.title: Return in Glory: A Son's Oath
data.intro: Because of his father's humble background, Hugo Shaw is separated from his mother after his maternal grandfather selfishly forces his parents apart. His father returns to their hometown and raises him alone. Determined to change his fate, Hugo studies relentlessly and gets into a prestigious college. After achieving success, he returns home in triumph to seek justice for his bullied father, rescue his mother, and reunite his family.

data.title: Forever, If Only
data.intro: Mike Abbot has loved Elsa Parker for fifteen years—devoting himself to her, even giving up his passion for art. But everything shatters when he watches her fall for someone else. Heartbroken, Mike changes his name and leaves the country, never expecting that Elsa will one day search the world for the man she let slip away.

data.title: Awakened from Disgrace, Rose to Glory
data.intro: Mark Lowe, once an immortal, is punished and transmigrates as the head of the Lowe family—one of the legendary Four Great Martial Families. Branded weak and disgraced, he inherits a family on the brink of collapse, along with a gifted wife, Clara Lane, the one holding everything together. With a confident smirk, Mark casts aside his former cowardice. Dual cultivation or not, he couldn't care less. Restoring the family's glory, however, has become his mission.

data.title: The Cleaner with a Billion-Dollar Secret
data.intro: Female lead is the daughter of the richest man, but pretends to be a cleaner for her boyfriend, andsecretly brings him great benefits. When the female lead thinks that her boyfriend is going topropose to her, she discovers his betrayal. The betrayed female lead reveals her identity but is ridiculed and disbelieved, at this moment the male lead stands up for the female lead and says he will marry her.

data.title: Stuck in Today: The Man Who Lived a Millennium
data.intro: Trapped in a 24-hour time loop, Caleb Wright masters countless skills and uncovers secrets, enduring endless repetition until he meets a new girl one day—and time finally moves forward. Now equipped with invincible abilities, he steps into the future to begin a legendary new life.

data.title: Chained by Affection
data.intro: After three years in a loveless marriage, Skylar Litt finally decides to break free from Julius Vance's indifference—and from the pain of watching him love someone else. Once, she believed his affection was real, but that illusion shattered when he left for two years without a word. Now that he's back, Skylar leaves her ring behind, but Julius refuses to let her go.

data.title: Crushing the Crown, Claiming the Throne
data.intro: Once murdered by a cruel crown prince for failing to conceive a son, Edith Nisbett is reborn with a vow to rewrite her fate. This time, she swaps marriages with her half-sister, wins the heart of the heirless emperor, bears his child, and claims her rightful place by his side—crushing the crown prince and proving she is the true empress.

data.title: Leave the Lies, Take the Crown
data.intro: For six years, Celia Sutton sacrificed her career for her family—only to face her husband’s coldness and betrayal when he falls for Petra Irving. Neglecting their sick son, forgetting their anniversary, and burying her talent, he pushes Celia to her breaking point. Determined, she returns as the designer Ember, thriving in her career, exposing Petra's lies, and reclaiming her life—this time, entirely on her own terms.

data.title: The Invincible Legend (DUBBED)
data.intro: As the heir to Nagar Palace, Tyler Ellis stays by Kaia Clarke’s side as an ordinary man to repay the favor of saving his life in the past. He helps and supports the Clarke family, but after Kaia rises to a higher status, she seeks to divorce him. Little does she know that the husband she despises wields influence over powerful figures.

data.title: Virgin Unveiled, Love Unleashed
data.intro: Eleanor, a daughter in a strict Catholic family, has a one-night stand with new student Noah. She must keep it secret or face harsh punishment from her stepmother. Worse, she finds out she's pregnant with Noah's child.

data.title: Love at First Bite
data.intro: Adopted by werewolf hunters, 18-year-old Staysha's mission to kill her first werewolf changes when she unknowingly spends a night with the charming Alpha King, igniting a forbidden romance.

data.title: You Left Us in the Dust, We Rose to the Top(DUBBED)
data.intro: Jane Stone and her daughter, Talia, are mercilessly abandoned by Roy Zink. To soften the blow for Talia, Jane claims she is a wealthy heiress. For the next two years, she endures countless hardships to raise her daughter. When Jane and Talia cross paths with Roy and his new wife, the couple cruelly humiliates them. At the most critical moment, Jane reveals her true identity, exposes their hypocrisy, and takes her daughter home to begin a new life.

data.title: Saint of Medicine Reborn
data.intro: The millennium-old founder of traditional medicine fails his transcendence tribulation and transmigrates into the body of a young man named Wade Nash. When faced with a patient on the brink of death, there is nothing the fake miracle doctor can do. To everyone's utter surprise, Wade cures him with one needle. Faced with their doubts, he proves the medical tome in their ancestral hall is his own work. With his unmatched skills, he shocks his descendants into deference.

data.title: Talking to Everything, Making My Dad Rich
data.intro: Eight-year-old Tina has special powers. She lives in a sanctum until she discovers her true lineage. Her father, Jim Bard, is devastated after losing her and her mother. He drifts through life aimlessly, so the Bard family patriarch places no hope in him. Determined, Tina hastily descends the mountain to reunite with her father and help him rise to power so he can inherit a billion-dollar empire. Along the way, she even finds herself a mother.

data.title: From Kitchen to Throne
data.intro: The granddaughter of a deceased cooking legend returns to compete for the title of Ultimate Chef and wins the restaurant CEO's heart.

data.title: My "Gigolo" Alpha
data.intro: In a world where humans and werewolves coexist, Miranda Harrod must marry before 25 to inherit her family's business. Forced to wed Thomas Mill she doesn't like, she meets Brian, Charles's Alpha, and marries him after a one-night stand. Brian, knowing Miranda is his mate, helps her overcome obstacles while hiding his identity, and they fall in love.

data.title: My Secret Agent Husband
data.intro: To escape a politically motivated arranged marriage, a privileged heir Lucas Walton fakes being gay and engaged to his company's new executive, unaware that his "fiancé" is actually an undercover agent investigating his family's corrupt dealings, leading to a hilarious clash of secrets, danger, and unexpected feelings.

data.title: Got Pregnant by Billionaire Brothers
data.intro: Audrey, the sole heiress to a business empire, faces her father's ultimatum—find a suitable husband at her debut party. As she plots her escape, she stumbles into the seductive world of the Vanderbilt brothers—Caspian, a notorious playboy with a hidden heart of gold, and Killian, a brooding, tortured soul with hypnotic eyes. A surprise beach getaway turns their friendship into a tangled love triangle.

data.title: Hurt My Family? Regret Is Guaranteed
data.intro: Legendary businessman Jared Lyle adopts the four orphaned children of a man who gave his life fighting a flood. Upon retiring, Jared remains on the outskirts to watch over the man's grave. When his daughter's fiancé and his family desecrate the martyr's tomb and assault Jared, they expect no consequences. But Jared's daughter and her three powerful brothers return—and they are furious to see him injured and being pushed around.

data.title: The Mechanist Consort: Betrayal Rewound
data.intro: Wary of the Moore family's mechanical arts, the imperial family raises Freya Moore in the palace and plans to betroth her to the crown prince, Alan Elmer, to gain the Moores' support. In her past life, Freya showed Alan how to unlock the clockwork lock—only to be betrayed by him and lose her family. Given a second chance at life, she marries Cyril Elmer, completely changing her fate.

data.title: Power Overdue: Awakening of His Might
data.intro: Zion Sable transmigrates into a cultivation world but fails to awaken any abilities for over a century. On his deathbed, the "Invincible Cultivation System" finally activates. Its first task? Learn the language of mortals. Zion curses at it—instantly clearing the task and gaining the "Sacred Sword Physique." He realizes the system is faulty and started a century too late. With that, his passion for cultivation is reignited!

data.title: Letters to the Boy Who Will Break Me (DUBBED)
data.intro: Unable to conceive, Faye Shaw is betrayed by her husband of thirteen years, Caleb Steele, who turns to his secretary, Nina Dench, for an affair—and even gets her pregnant. One day, Faye stumbles upon the notebook through which Caleb once confessed his love to her years ago. To her surprise, she discovers she can now communicate with eighteen-year-old Caleb through it.

data.title: Sleeping with My Fake Sister
data.intro: In order to fulfill her best friend's dying wish, Chloe impersonated the long-lost daughter of the powerful and wealthy Smith family. This disguise made her fall into the abyss of money, secrets and desires, and she also met the "brother" Ethan who she shouldn't have fallen in love with.

data.title: She Played Her Cards, He Lost His Heart
data.intro: A modern assassin transmigrates as Harper Langford, a woman who has spent her life living as a man to survive with her mother. Deep down, she longs to reclaim her female identity. Fearing exposure, she plans an escape with her mother—only to be captured by Lucian Sinclair, a duke feared for his ruthlessness and cunning, who has taken a keen interest in her. From that day on, Harper must engage in a battle of wits, striving to outsmart Lucian at every turn just to survive.

data.title: Taming the Mafia Boss: He’s Mine Now!
data.intro: Leah, the daughter of the Cruz family, appears to be a "fierce delicate flower" who throws money around in nightclubs and acts in a cynical way on the surface. In reality, she is a down-and-out heir whose power was seized by her stepfather.

data.title: Tycoon in Disguise: The Deliveryman Above Them All
data.intro: Andrew Finch hides his billionaire identity and works as a delivery driver. One day, while out delivering, he accidentally sees Nadine Royce bathing and is confronted by a security guard. The next day, Andrew meets Nadine again and casually helps her resolve her company's financial crisis. This changes Nadine's initial impression of him. She thinks that, although Andrew is older, he seems like a reliable man. So, she asks him to pretend to be her boyfriend.

data.title: The Way Back Into Love
data.intro: After knowing she had cancer and wouldn't have much time left to live, in order not to become a burden to her boyfriend, who booked a big role in Hollywood, she allied with his best friend to play "cheating" and successfully got caught in bed by him. However, she was pregnant and more surprisingly, eight years later, he came back for her, now a superstar...

data.title: In Love's Name: The World at Her Side
data.intro: The richest man in Cordea, Tristan Clark, falls into a coma after a car crash. His girlfriend, Renee Lloyd, has always been unaware of his true identity. Even so, she never gives up on him, no matter how much scorn or hardship she endures. Six years later, Tristan finally wakes up. He is heartbroken when he learns of everything Renee has done for him. He vows not to spare anyone who has ever hurt her. To him, she is the only one worthy of all the honor and glory in the world.

data.title: When Love Expires(DUBBED)
data.intro: To fund his grandmother’s treatment, Ian Judd signs a ten-year contract with Sue York’s mother to help Sue move on from heartbreak. For a decade, he stays by her side, but to her, he’s nothing more than Sean Shaw’s replacement.When the contract ends and Sean returns, Sue rushes back to him, unaware of Ian’s silent devotion. Only after Ian leaves, divorce papers in hand, does she realize his love—but by then, he’s already gone, stepping into a new life without her.

data.title: Swap & Swoon: Caught in Your Body
data.intro: Cora Reid infiltrates Jordan Hale's private room to gather evidence for the Narcotics Bureau. After an accidental kiss, they are horrified to discover that they have swapped bodies! Forced to work together, they investigate a drug ring and the mystery behind the death of Jordan's father. Initial suspicion turns into trust as they defeat the mastermind and uphold justice. Cora fulfills her dream, and she and Jordan fall for each other after their thrilling time together.

data.title: Falling for My Fake Dating Coach
data.intro: Ashley only wanted to be a quiet secretary. But when she's forced to drag her reckless ex-racer boss, Victor, back into the boardroom, her life turns upside down. He's arrogant, dangerous, and refuses to be tamed—yet he offers her one deal: he'll teach her how to win love, if she keeps his secrets. Every "lesson" blurs the line between business and desire. Every kiss meant as a mistake burns hotter than the last.

data.title: I Loved, I Hated, I'm Done(DUBBED)
data.intro: Valerie Jackman experiences a rebirth and wakes up at the age of 27 with two kids and a husband—Lucian Floyd, the world's richest man and every woman's dream. While everyone envies her for having him, Valerie has other plans. Holding the divorce agreement in her hands, she sets out to return him to his first love, Serena Morse, completely.

data.title: Tiny But Mighty: Watch Out, World!
data.intro: After 30,000 years of cultivation, Bella Litt remains stuck at the same stage, unable to break through. Seeing this, her mentor, Zac Shaw, tricks her into leaving the mountains, sending her on a quest to find her senior, Sam Frost. Believing herself weak, Bella clings to Sam for protection—unaware that he has long since passed his prime.

data.title: Blue Complex
data.intro: An Olympic diver, Parang, who quit due to trauma, joins the swim team, sparking a fierce love and growth story.

data.title: Love That Survives the Hurt(DUBBED)
data.intro: Seven years ago, Mable Graham donated a kidney to her boyfriend, then left him—afraid she'd become a burden. She raised their daughter, Cora Flint, alone, only to be branded a gold-digger by the man she once loved. Now, with Mable in a coma after a tragic accident, young Cora fights to raise money for her recovery—until Heidi Lane steps in to sabotage her efforts.

data.title: Christmas With a Country Bad Boy
data.intro: After a sold-out world tour, country music’s good girl returns home for Christmas to rest—only to be cornered by her money-hungry family pressuring her to sign away her estate. When her label sends its scandal-ridden bad boy to rehab his image, she least expects him to be the one who helps her fight back, reclaim her voice, and take control of her life again.

data.title: Shelter in the Mafia
data.intro: Tasha, betrayed by her husband and her mistress, lost her company and ended up on the streets. A stranger, Ken, a taxi driver, offered her a helping hand. Despite their initial separation, Ken kept reappearing in Tasha's life, leading her into a romantic entanglement. Little did she know, Ken was the son of a mafia boss, on a quest to find a figure from his past.

data.title: After Divorce: I Become Heiress
data.intro: In order to get rid of her billionaire father’s overwhelming love, Sally hid her real identity as the wealthy heiress and chose to make her own living. Her husband Felix cheats on her. In retaliation, Sally married Aiden in a flash. Unknown to her, Aiden is CEO of Taylor family. After the divorce, Sally chose to reveal her identity but was jeered by Felix and others. Aiden didn’t believe her either. But when would Sally and Aiden know their real identities?

data.title: No Shadow Can Hide Her Light
data.intro: Taken into a temple, Sansa loses her pendant—and nearly her life—to Wanda, the impostor. Fortunately, she is rescued by the Prince of Kinia and later granted the title "Princess Serena" after healing the empress. Consumed by jealousy, Wanda never stops scheming, but ultimately dies in regret. In the end, Sansa saves everyone from Wanda's poison and reunites with her family.

data.title: You're Out of My Life, Forevermore (DUBBED)
data.intro: Sue Gould, a wealthy heiress, has always been cherished by her seven adopted brothers—until their driver's daughter, Xena Kurt, turns them against her. Heartbroken as she watches them confess their feelings to Xena, Sue makes the painful decision to sever ties and marry Jim Shaw, a paralyzed heir. By the time her brothers uncover the truth, it's already too late—there's no returning to the family they once were.

data.title: A Love Paid in Tears (DUBBED)
data.intro: After returning to her biological family, Jane Gray does everything she can for them, only to be set up by her brother to sleep with a stranger. However, by chance, she spends the night with Hans Bale, the CEO of Bale Corp, and soon marries him despite only knowing him for days.

data.title: Apocalypse Reborn: Power Grows with Every Woman I Recruit
data.intro: Transmigrated to a week before doomsday, Edison Clarke awakens the Doomlord System, which multiplies his powers and unlocks abilities as long as he recruits beauties to his team. Despite the devastating environment, Edison leads his army of beauties and crushes his enemies, rewriting the rules of the apocalypse and building an empire of his own.

data.title: Step Aside, Make Way for My Heiress!
data.intro: Iris Levine, lifelong maid to Vera Stone, serves her faithfully until Vera becomes the empress. At 60, Iris transmigrates into the body of a humble housemaid's daughter—only to meet an heiress who shares Vera's name and looks exactly like her. Seeing the timid girl bullied by a fake heiress and unfair parents, Iris steps in to fight, protect, and help her start a brand-new life!

data.title: Mocked Me as Weak? Watch Me Level Up into Doom
