data.intro: Ten years ago, mysterious Spirit Gates erupted worldwide, flooding it with wild spiritual energy. Some awakened powers—we call them Spirit Tamers. But the gates brought more: terrifying beasts broke through, threatening humanity. The Spirit Tamer Alliance rose, and the battle raged nonstop. Jason, an unremarkable E-ranked Tamer—mocked and overlooked—now faces betrayal, schemes, and sealed fate, yet will rise, defy all odds, and unleash unimaginable power.

data.title: Break Me, Lose Me, Burn in Regret
data.intro: Tom Whitmore once devoted his life to the Ashfords as a seemingly useless son-in-law, only to be betrayed by his wife, Kelly Ashford, and die in misery. In a twist of fate, both are reborn. Tom walks away, allowing Kelly's love for Andrew Somerton to run its course. Yet he faces oppression and humiliation before finally receiving help from Cheryl Shaw. By the time Kelly learns that Andrew is a liar and rushes to Tom for forgiveness, it is far too late.

data.title: Miss Secretary, Don't Do This to Me
data.intro: Caroline Sinclair, the hidden heir of the Montgomery family, has been Nathan Reed's loyal secretary and secret lover for years. When she realizes that he won't give up his fiancée, Vivian, for her, she decides to leave and regain her independence. After returning to the business world, she faces schemes and suppression from Vivian and her cousin, Oliver Montgomery.

data.title: The Rewrite: Falling Off Script
data.intro: Clara Hart is pulled into a novel, cast as the villain meant to humiliate the male lead, Julian Blackwood, and make him stronger. Intimidated by his fierce presence, she carefully adjusts her lines, all to steer the plot without crossing him. Clara believes she'll return home after accomplishing all her mission—but she doesn't realize Julian has already fallen for her. Five years later, Clara and Julian, the sworn enemies, find their fates intertwined once more.

data.title: The Rejected Alpha Queen Comes Back
data.intro: Lucia, the Alpha Queen, returns to her home pack as a wolfless commoner to reunite with her mate, Frederick, only to discover his betrayal. Rejected and tortured, she reveals her true identity and power. With her true mate, Neo, she overthrows Frederick's tyranny, restores justice, and unites the pack under her rule. Love and vengeance intertwine in this tale of redemption and strength.

data.title: Finally See You: Carrying Our Baby
data.intro: Chloe fell in love with Damian at first sight during a nursing job. Later, in order to save her seriously ill father, she married Damian, who was accidentally blind, at the suggestion of Damian's grandmother. After the wedding night, Damian misunderstood Chloe and drove her away. Eight months later, Chloe was alone with twins and had to deliver food because of lack of money.

data.title: Our Forever, Laid to Rest
data.intro: On their wedding day, tragedy strikes when Jolene Hale's parents, drunk at the wheel, accidentally kill Mason Bell's entire family—turning joy into heartbreak. To atone for her parents' sins, Jolene endures Mason's torment for five long years before walking away. Another five years later, she reappears in a hospital—but Mason doesn't know the truth: she has already erased him from her heart.

data.title: Where Love Failed to Anchor(DUBBED)
data.intro: To fulfill his life-saver's dying wish, Sam Lowe marries Gina Zane and gives up his aerospace research career to become a househusband, unaware that she secretly looks down on him for it. When her first love, Neil Bale, returns from abroad and moves into their home without Sam's consent, he not only steals Gina's heart but wins over their daughter as well. Abandoned by his wife and child, Sam finally decides to walk away.

data.title: Loving You From the Football Sidelines
data.intro: Brian, the agent, had a secret crush on football star Terry for seven years and finally decided to resign. Terry realized he couldn't live or work without Brian and vowed to do anything to get him back. Meanwhile, the mysterious man Brian had been secretly in love with became Terry's biggest rival in jealousy...

data.title: Haunted by Shadows of You (DUBBED)
data.intro: It has been six years since Jessica Quinn fell deeply in love with the cold and aloof Harlan Spencer at first sight. After much effort, she finally married him, but their two-year marriage remains unconsummated. By chance, Jessica discovers Harlan harbors an unhealthy obsession with his non-biological sister, Talia Spencer, whom he dotes on endlessly.

data.title: Secret of the Other Half
data.intro: Jack Dolan is a wealthy and influential key member of the research and development sector in the country. However, such an extraordinary man has only one simple thing that he lives for - the warmth of his home. His wife’s smile, his children’s voices, and the happy regular days are what keep him going, but as his wife accidentally uncovers his secret one day, a hidden history of his slowly comes to light.

data.title: Don't Miss Me When I'm Gone
data.intro: Jenna Steele loved Noah Finch for a decade—until she caught him crossing the line with comatose Lucy Steele. She ends the engagement and turns to Caleb Shaw, the boy she once protected. Framed and humiliated by Noah and Lucy, Jenna's career is destroyed. But Caleb steps in to help. Now, with him by her side, she rises from the ashes—and they're ready to make everyone pay.

data.title: A Lifetime Too Late
data.intro: It is only after Heidi Jaffe's death after donating her heart to Chad Shelby's first crush does Chad realize he had already fallen for her a long time ago. Overwhelmed with guilt, he chooses to end his own life—only to unexpectedly transmigrate into the system and enter Heidi’s world. Determined to make amends and win her back, he tries everything to regain her love, yet uncovers a cruel truth regarding what he thought was Heidi's unconditional love for him.

data.title: You Wore My Name, I Own It
data.intro: When genius designer Wynter Stone helps her CEO husband reform the workplace, she faces a former colleague pretending to be the CEO's wife and a scheming design director. Determined to protect her family, Wynter sets out to purge the corruption—only to uncover an even darker, hidden conspiracy.

data.title: No Escape from His Obsession
data.intro: Upon her rebirth, Brielle Lorant exposes her hypocritical fiancé and seeks an alliance with the notorious Samuel Montel. To her surprise, Samuel draws her into a closer relationship, and from that day forward, everyone knows that she is the only one who truly has a hold on him.

data.title: Stitches of Regret: The Mistaken Heartbeat
data.intro: Why do two people who definitely love each other hurt each other so much?Erik, driven by a misguided desire for Evelyn's happiness, resorts to hurting her in an attempt to force a divorce. Unable to comprehend the sudden rejection, Evelyn endures increasing pain with each cruel action from Erik. Exhausted and broken, Evelyn reluctantly agrees to the divorce, her spirit shattered.

data.title: Falling In Love with the Rascal in A Suit
data.intro: Betty has to work two jobs for her mom. She is both a stripper and a hotel cleaner. One night, Marcus, the infamous mob boss, enters Betty’s club, hoping to regain his “man power”. Every woman is a disappointment, except for Betty. He falls for her instantly, not knowing that Betty’s friend, Anthony, is also willing to sacrifice everything for her. A choice had to be made. An overly domineering mobster or an innocent scion. Who would she choose?

data.title: Sorry, This Script Has No Divorce Ending
data.intro: Steven Miller transmigrates into a drama as the male lead who is manipulated into divorcing his wealthy but disabled wife. Upon seeing his beautiful, rich wife, he decides to hold on to her tightly. When her first love tries to sabotage their relationship, Steven shuts her down, shocking her with his change. He takes his wife out to have fun, treating her like a normal person. The way he looks past her disability slowly wins her heart.

data.title: Runtime Error: Love Not Responding
data.intro: Deaf since childhood, coding prodigy Joel Klein grows up neglected by his family. His only comfort is his fiancée, Peggy Scott. On the eve of their wedding, he suddenly regains his hearing—only to discover her betrayal. Disillusioned, Joel joins a top-secret AI program that demands total isolation and executes the ultimate revenge on their wedding day.

data.title: Even Love Has Its Limit
data.intro: Synopsis:Betrayed by his CEO wife of three years, Melody Smith, lecturer Henry Zahn gives her a second chance, only to be hurt again. Shattered, he divorces her and moves to another city for research, where he meets Belle Mosley, who has secretly loved him for years. To escape Melody's obsessive pursuit, Henry and Belle enter a fake marriage—one that soon feels all too real.

data.title: Sovereign of All
data.intro: When Sean Lendor is a mere nobody, he promises to marry a plump girl named Ariel Lavine. However, his father makes him break his promise because he thinks that Sean cannot possibly provide her the happiness she deserves with their current financial situation. Ariel then mistakes Sean’s decision as a sign of disdain for her figure and insists on being the one to call off the engagement.

data.title: Breaking off to Fall In Love
data.intro: Edward and Bella, childhood sweethearts torn apart by fate, reunite years later. Now a successful lawyer, Bella is unknowingly arranged to marry Edward. Seeking to escape the unwanted marriage, Edward hires Bella to dissolve the contract, unaware she is his bride-to-be. Though Edward recognizes her soon, she believes he is someone else and reveals she is engaged. Choosing to protect her from afar, Edward hides his feelings. Will they finally fall in love again?

data.title: Love, A Memory Away
data.intro: Elise Snow pursues Calvin Stone for years to forget Zack Olson—only to lose her memory in a crash the night Calvin abandons her. When Zack steps in to care for her, old feelings resurface and grow. Meanwhile, Calvin's obsession turns dangerous, involving Holly, leading them both to jail. In the end, true love stands the test of time, and Elise and Zack find happiness together.

data.title: My Sister Is Not Someone To Mess With
data.intro: Tina and Alan escape an orphanage as children, but years later, their reunion sparks jealousy and betrayal. As secrets unravel and hidden truths come to light, Tina confronts her past and walks away from everything she once knew. In the end, the reunited siblings stand strong, overcoming the lies and infidelity that once tore them apart, ready to face their future together.

data.title: Infertile Alpha's Pregnant Mate
data.intro: She breaks his curse of infertility and childlessness. He showers her with all the love in the world, spoiling her endlessly.

data.title: His Mission: Win Her Back
data.intro: To save her sick son, single mother Jill Walker goes on a blind date with Commander Seth Rowe in the place of a wealthy heiress. To her shock, Seth knows her—he met and fell for her five years ago and has searched for her ever since. As chaos unfolds, Jill tries to escape, but Seth won't let go, determined to keep the woman he loves, even as he realizes he's entangled in lies.

data.title: Epic Underwear, Legendary Life
data.intro: Neil Litt, a worker at a recycling center, sells his property to support his mother and is forced to endure a harsh life. Everything changes the moment he comes across the Epic Underwear, and his fate takes a legendary turn.

data.title: Moving On From You
data.intro:
Jane Rowe has been in love with Sam Bale ever since he took her in at the age of seven. Every year on her birthday, she confesses her feelings, only to be rejected as Sam, believing their ten-year age gap is too large, chooses someone else.
One night, they get drunk and spend the night together, but Sam has no recollection of it. When Jane becomes pregnant, Sam accuses her of being indecent. Heartbroken, Jane leaves him to continue his life with his girlfriend.

data.title: Take My Memory, Keep My Heart
data.intro: Esme Payne rescues Elijah Knott, a mute slave, from an underground fighting arena and falls in love with him. But when she discovers he grew close to her as part of a deal, she severs ties immediately. In response, Elijah drugs her to erase her memories, then strategically pursues her, maneuvering for marriage. As Esme's memories resurface, long-buried truths begin to emerge.

data.title: The Professor I'm Dating is A Billionaire
data.intro: Reese, a talented student, is humiliated after being cheated on by her boyfriend and losing her internship at WG Group due to the strict professor, Sanger. Unbeknownst to her, Sanger is actually WG's CEO, secretly paving the way for her comeback. Through a high-stakes robot competition, Reese proves herself, wins love, and discovers Sanger's true identity.

data.title: My Ex-Wife the Mafia Princess
data.intro: Vera and her husband Lucas once survived a life-or-death fire together. Yet years later, in their contractual marriage, Lucas—plagued by selective amnesia—failed to recognize that his wife was the "white moonlight" he'd never forgotten. Instead, he treated her with cold indifference and even pressed her for a divorce.Vera tried to reveal her true identity to Lucas, only to be sabotaged by her romantic rival.

data.title: Perfect Score, Perfect Payback (DUBBED)
data.intro: After being brought back to the wealthy Litt family, Elsa Litt endures constant disdain and bullying from her parents and three brothers—all for the sake of their beloved adopted daughter, Stacy Litt. On the eve of her SATs, Elsa is falsely accused and thrown into juvie for a hit-and-run crime actually committed by Stacy. When the SAT results are released, Elsa walks out of juvie due to lack of evidence—only to be met with her brothers' scorn and ridicule.

data.title: How to Handle Ex's Wild Uncle
data.intro: Betrayed by her boyfriend Rob and best friend Layla, Selena is humiliated and abandoned on the day she had planned to propose. That night, she meets Rob's uncle Darian, New York's most powerful bachelor, and a one-night stand leads to marriage. Unaware he's loved her for years, Selena uses this chance to rise again, reclaim her career, and make Rob and Layla pay—while finding true love with Darian.

data.title: Vengeance in Check: The Board is Mine
data.intro: Orphaned at a young age and taken in by her enemy Rodney Linden, Joelle Linden conceals her thirst for revenge behind the guise of a reckless socialite. She forms an uneasy alliance with Hayden Burke, a tycoon determined to uncover the truth behind his sister's death. Together, they unravel the dark crimes of Rodney and Marcus Corwin, risking everything to bring down their empire—and along the way, they discover an unexpected love.

data.title: Love in the Time of Shadows
data.intro: At Neville & Partners' anniversary celebration, law student Margaret Humphrey accidentally saves Edward Neville, a lawyer who suffers from PTSD caused by witnessing his mother's death when he was young. After catching Margaret's boyfriend, Clarence Greene, cheating, Edward's already wavering heart moves into a decision to expose Clarence with Margaret.

data.title: The Day She Became Herself
data.intro: Born into a biased family, Daisy Ward becomes Victor Hale's kept woman just to survive—only to meet a tragic end after daring to demand an official title. Reborn, she rejects status and leverages the knowledge from her past life to open a restaurant, achieving success on her own terms. Meanwhile, Victor regains memories of their past and finally sees Megan Cole's true nature. But it's too late—Daisy no longer needs his love, for she has found happiness in her own hands.

data.title: Together Through Bullets and Shadows
data.intro: Riley Smith travels back in time to the third year of the Luminous. She escapes a hellish mountain village and encounters a commander named Ethan Gray. To reclaim the life stolen by a fake heiress, she treads carefully and does whatever she must. Ethan silently protects her, extending a hand whenever she needs it. Together, they uncover conspiracies and face the ravages of war, yet they remain entangled in the schemes of the fake heiress and lingering family feuds.

data.title: When I Became the Stranger in Our Story
data.intro: Casper Garner and Sara Jensen have been married for five years, seemingly perfect together—until he discovers their marriage certificate is fake. His world shatters when he witnesses her wedding to Warren Locke in Paendley. Learning she's been waiting all this time to marry Warren, Casper leaves in heartbreak, only to be drugged and beaten by Warren's men. The truth surfaces too late, leaving Sara drowning in regret.

data.title: Through You, Even Darkness Blooms
data.intro: After Zeke Floyd's blindness plunges Floyd Group into ruin, his wife, Paige Allen, agrees to donate her corneas—only to lose her life in the operating room... or so he thinks. Six years later, fate reunites them, but Zeke fails to recognize her and even harms their daughter over the loss of a dog he once shared with Paige, unaware of the girl's true identity. By the time the truth comes to light, regret consumes his heart—but some mistakes can never be undone.

data.title: Mafia Lover
data.intro: The protagonist, Ace, is a ruthless and decisive mob boss who has firmly established his position at the top of London’s underworld. However, during an ambush orchestrated by his archenemy, Jack, a young stranger named Max unexpectedly steps in to save him. This act of bravery sparks Ace’s interest and earns his trust. Ace brings Max into his inner circle, seeing him as a valuable ally and even hiring him as his personal bodyguard.

data.title: I Rise, You Fall, That's the Rule
data.intro: To repay her biological parents, Sara Cole leaves her foster family—the wealthiest in Xonos—to reunite with the Rowes, only to face neglect, bias, and even a false three-year sentence. But her struggles don't end there. Upon release, she is forcibly taken away. Even when she returns to the Coles, they still expect her to beg for acceptance.

data.title: The Scent That Stole His Heart
data.intro: Caught in the chaos of her family's bankruptcy, Ruth Leed is heartlessly sold by her own father to Zac Quinn's grandmother in a desperate bid to save himself. Intrigued by Ruth's scent, Zac tries to drive her away with money—but a series of misunderstandings end up securing her a place by his side. As they face trials together, Ruth finds the courage to pursue his heart. Over time, Zac becomes her unwavering pillar of support, and love quietly begins to blossom between them.

data.title: Veil of Vengeance, Heart of Desire
data.intro: After discovering that her father and stepmother caused her mother's death, Yara Lind seeks revenge. While she accidentally drives away her bodyguard, Nathan Grant. As the Grants' heir, Nathan hides his identity to secretly protect her. Along the way, she comes to recognize his unwavering devotion. Her strength also heals the emptiness in his heart. Together, they find love and redemption.

data.title: Roses & Riches: Secrets Behind the Name
data.intro: Growing up together, Laura Depp and Jake Carter promised to marry after college. But on the day of their wedding, as Laura stands outside City Hall in her gown and holding a bouquet, she realizes she is nothing more than a joke Jake used to amuse Vivian Lown. Heartbroken and humiliated, she hands the bouquet to a scorned laborer and impulsively proposes marriage—unaware that he is, in fact, the wealthiest heir in Osted.

data.title: A Misstep to Mr. Right
data.intro: Ivory Jensen's ex dumps her, and she's determined to get back at him and his mistress. With a clever plan in mind, she decides to marry Steve Wade. By chance, she discovers that "Mr. Stevie," the man who has long been close to her family, is actually Steve Wade. Recalling how she's repeatedly gushed about wanting to marry Steve in front of him, Ivory can't help but feel utterly embarrassed.

data.title: A Flash Marriage with the Billionaire Tycoon
data.intro: Elise was a normal accountant of Hawthorn Group. She worked very carefully to avoid any problem, but she made a huge mistake despite of her caution. She was on a business trip and was drunk, then she accidentally had an one-night stand with her boss Lucian. Her fate had changed since then...

data.title: Kiss Of Power, Endless Desire
data.intro: Skylar Ellis, an award-winning commercial lawyer, is determined to investigate an arson case in order to save her seriously ill sister. At the same time, she meets Zion Baldwin, the illegitimate son who fights for the family property and clears her mother's name. The two met on their own road, from the initial use of each other, to the later emotional interweaving and fierce confrontation, and finally to the revelation of the truth and the salvation of the soul.

data.title: Tides of Goodbye(DUBBED)
data.intro: Obeying her family's wishes, Gina Tillman marries her three childhood friends—only to face betrayal after betrayal. Branded as cursed and driven to despair, she ends her own life. Reborn with her memories intact, Gina takes a new path: she marries Cody Rowan and severs all ties with those who wronged her. Only after losing her do they regret their actions—but by then, it's far too late for redemption.

data.title: I'm Over You, Over Everything
data.intro: Lucy Litt is rescued by Paul Grant during her darkest days and falls deeply in love. Ignoring her parents' objections, she marries him despite knowing he only agreed to the marriage to appease his family. Life seems perfect, giving her the freedom to chase her dreams—until Mona Meyer comes between them. Reality forces a divorce, and with Ian Seed's help, Lucy finally rediscovers herself.

data.title: Lose Me, Watch Me Slay
data.intro: After uncovering Austin Davis's infidelity, Ruth Walker divorces him—only to become Yelena Baker's target. With the help of her powerful ally, Jasper Zeller, Ruth turns the tables, destroying Austin's and Yelena's reputations. Just as she's ready to start a new life, she finds herself unexpectedly entangled with the caring gentleman who barged into her world.

data.title: Parallel Hearts: Never to Meet Again
data.intro: The moment Piper Swift gave birth, her boyfriend Sean Ward abandoned her. For ten years, Will Mack cares for her and her daughter selflessly, asking for nothing in return—only to be mocked as a simp. Will doesn't mind, for he knows his time is short and that he will soon return to his wife and child in the real world. However, once he is gone, Piper and her daughter spiral, realizing too late what they've lost.

data.title: Oh No! The SAT Has Gone Insane!
data.intro: What should one do when they can keep getting perfect scores on the SAT? The most logical answer is to take it repeatedly and keep improving. As a result, the SAT questions become increasingly absurd. In physics, the question asks how to achieve nuclear fission. In mathematics, test takers are asked to produce a proof of Goldbach's conjecture. Students across the country are losing their minds!

data.title: Where My Love Ran Out
data.intro: To bury the memory of her first love, Nina Smith marries Felix Lloyd—only to abandon him the moment Liam Young becomes available again. As Nina weaves a web of deceit, Felix's love slowly turns to ice. But when he finally walks away, Nina realizes the man she truly loves has been by her side all along.

data.title: The Reborn Heiress' Reckoning
data.intro: Freya Scott, who grew up on the streets, dedicates herself to her family upon reuniting with them, determined to earn their love and approval. Despite her efforts, they lavish affection on her adopted sister, Yelena Scott, and blindly believe every false accusation Yelena makes about Freya. This misplaced trust leads to Freya’s tragic death, shattering any remaining connection she had with her family. Given a second chance at life.

data.title: The Billionaire's Rescue
data.intro: Emily works tirelessly at a bar to save money for college, but her life takes a dark turn when she's assaulted by a customer. In her darkest moment, Luke heroically intervenes, saving her and sparking a deep emotional connection between them. Initially determined to raise her unexpected child alone, Emily reconsiders when Luke reappears, offering unwavering support and love.

data.title: Food, Love, Robots
data.intro: Seven years after her soulmate Elliot’s sudden death, Lily’s quiet Christmas is upended when her and Elliot’s son Evan’s wish comes true: Elliot returns. But this Elliot is a humanoid robot, programmed with her late boyfriend’s memories. As Lily’s heart reopens to love, she must navigate the charming chaos of family, romance, and technology, discovering whether this second chance at happiness is real or just a perfect AI program.

data.title: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress
data.intro: On our third wedding anniversary, my husband divorced me and I was publicly humiliated by his mistress. They said I wasn't worthy of being in their presence. Little did they know, I'm the daughter of the richest man in the States, and all of my ex-husband's resources came from me. Luckily on the same day, I accidentally ended up marrying a dashing billionaire. Now, I have wealth, leisure, a handsome husband, and another mysterious identity. Can anyone top that? Just wait.

data.title: Rebel in Devil's Shackle
data.intro: Sold out by someone in dark web, Nina Morgan bumps into mafia lord, Max Luther in the riches’ hunting game. Once an aristocracy, Nina is now dragged into inferno by Max, lost in sweetness and tortures. She finally makes up her mind to leave, but Max confines her no matter how many times she tries. It’s out of love, or of hatred? Overwhelmed by love and forbidden desire, the two hurt each other but simultaneously save each other.

data.title: Mini Villainess: Father, Take Back the Throne!
data.intro: Notorious villain Renee Walter transmigrates into a book as the three-year-old daughter of Jacob Ansley, the useless prince who is manipulated by his crush into making her cousin the crown prince. Shocked by Jacob's willingness to abandon his own power, Renee takes matters into her own hands. Her mischievous interference soon captures his attention, and determined to protect her, he finally takes the initiative to reclaim his rightful power.

data.title: Stripped of Honor, Crowned in Vengeance
data.intro: In Dalton's twelfth year, the imperial court holds a tournament to choose the greatest martial champion. General Liam York gives his heirloom Star Blade to his adopted son, Trevor York, leaving his own son, Cyrus York, with a broken wooden sword. Betrayed, humiliated, poisoned, and robbed of love, Cyrus endures years of suffering—until, on the eve of the tournament, his body finally gives out, and he bleeds to death.

data.title: Farewell, For I Am Your Forever Regret
data.intro: Kurtis Dexter, ninth prince of Holgen, grows up with Rosalie Zeitlin as childhood sweethearts, devoted solely to her. Yet, bound by gratitude, Rosalie gives her heart to Ralph Wyman, even going so far as to hurt Kurtis for his sake. Heartbroken, Kurtis departs for Khorbet to enter a political marriage with Teresa Ebert, stepping into the world of royalty.

data.title: Secretary's Secret
data.intro: Small-time assistant Mia has a one-night stand with a billionaire heir, and her life unfolds when she goes to work for him. Her new boss needs a wife in order to secure his inheritance, and he winds up in an arranged marriage with Mia's greedy sister. Mia navigates her relationships while falling in love.

data.title: A Choice That Breaks Us
data.intro: Nadia discovers she's pregnant with Renzo's child, but his mafia father forces her to break up with him to save his life. Years later, they reunite under hostile circumstances, with Renzo now engaged to another woman. As secrets unravel—including their daughter's leukemia and Diana's schemes—Renzo learns the truth. After rescuing Nadia and their child from Diana, they reconcile and vow to stay together as a family.

data.title: Flip of Fate: From Crumbs to Crown
data.intro: At her birthday banquet, Sierra Raven is stabbed to death by fellow orphan Demi Scott. Both are reborn on their adoption day. Demi chooses wealth, leaving Sierra with nothing but bread, assuming she will lead a life of misery. However, Sierra is thrilled to finally be part of a real family. Years later, Demi schemes against Sierra at a gala. Humiliated and framed, Sierra is nearly ruined. Fortunately, the truth and powerful allies arrive just in time.

data.title: Why Women Cheat
data.intro: Frances,a housewife who is losing herself to her husband's control and contempt,falls in love with his brother,not realizing the danger of discovery is looming.

data.title: From Trouble to Triumph: When All Turns Around
data.intro: When a PhD graduate in mechanical and materials engineering accidentally transmigrates into the body of the notorious wastrel Ralph Wright, he faces the threat of losing his family's wealth and his wife. Armed with modern knowledge, he leads the village to prosperity. Though his actions appear reckless, Ralph reshapes his destiny, saves his family from disaster, and gradually earns Silvia Lowe's respect across time.

data.title: They Chose Him, But the World Chose Me (DUBBED)
data.intro: Sam and Finn Leed are kidnapped, but under Finn's secret manipulation, the Leed family ransoms only him, leaving Sam to endure three years of torment. When Sam finally returns home, he is met only with indifference and prejudice. So, when pianist Ian Larson invites him to train overseas, he chooses to leave—abandoning his family with nothing but a letter to sever ties and break off the engagement.

data.title: Together, We Rule the World
data.intro: Labeled the cause of her own mother's death, Yara Sutton is forced to marry Aiden Moore, a mute prince stripped of power. Mocked by all as cursed and worthless, they rise together, forging a legacy of love and ambition—and writing a legend entirely their own.

data.title: My Love, Out of Service
data.intro: For five years, Finn Carter has silently fulfilled a contract signed with Renee Lane's mother—to heal her daughter's shattered heart. Day by day, he builds a life with a woman who sees him as nothing more than a placeholder for her first love. When Mike Smith's return coincides with the contract's end, Finn recognizes his cue to exit the stage of Renee's life.

data.title: A Heart Reborn
data.intro: Granted by the emperor himself, Sandra Wayne happily marries the fourth prince, Leon Shaw—a man admired by all. But little does she know, her wedded life will be nothing like she imagined, for Leon’s heart has long belonged to another. From the moment they wed, Sandra endures neglect and hardship, until she takes her final, regret-filled breath. But death is not the end.When she opens her eyes again, reborn into the past, she vows not to make the same mistakes twice.

data.title: Secret Pleasure
data.intro: On a moonlit night, Nancy's brother, Orlando, is gravely wounded by a werewolf. Unless they find and kill the werewolf who attacked him before the next full moon, Orlando will remain cursed, doomed to become a werewolf himself. To save her brother, Nancy must infiltrate the werewolf clan. Reluctantly agreeing to her stepmother Tina's scheme, she becomes engaged to Adam, the youngest son of the werewolf Smith family and the future Alpha.

data.title: Growing to Love You Day by Day
data.intro: Xena Ward is the heiress of the Young family and the adopted daughter of the Ward family. Caught between two families, she is never fully accepted by either side. She marries Mason Page, a prominent businessman. Her birth parents favor the adopted daughter, and her adoptive mother deliberately makes her life difficult. Even her younger brother sees her as an enemy. But Mason stands before her and declares, "She is my wife. No one is to upset her."

data.title: The Unrivaled Overlord  (DUBBED)
data.intro: Theo Larsen, alias the Overlord, commands a Wolf Army of a million strong. Shrouding his identity, he ties the knot with Sarah Welsh, the daughter of the prosperous Welsh family, securing the future of Glory Group before ascending to the pinnacle of his life.

data.title: The Wolf Queen in Human Guise
data.intro: My husband killed me, my brother betrayed me, but my enemy Alpha Eric died for me. Once reborn, I swear I will reclaim everything!

data.title: 30 Days of Hidden Marriage
data.intro: Tessa, a small-town girl with dreams of painting, enters into a shotgun marriage with the domineering CEO Dave due to a marriage contract. The two choose to keep their marriage a secret due to their circumstances. Facing difficulties, misunderstandings, romantic rivals, and life-and-death crises, how long can their marriage last? Can they overcome the numerous obstacles and truly come together?

data.title: Through Peril and Blade: The Fatal Escort
data.intro: The nation's top courier department is tasked with the dangerous mission of escorting the infamous traitor Matthew Cole to the capital for execution—while the powerful Shroud lurks, ready to seize him at any moment. As the escorts vow success, their leader discovers that the unassuming subordinate Nico is the retired Blade Lord and calls on his aid, culminating in a final showdown against the Shroud.

data.title: Stock Market Prodigy: I've Got You, Mom and Dad
data.intro: To save his sick mother, Stacy Ives, Leo Grant begs on the streets and unexpectedly crosses paths with his biological father, tycoon Vernon Grant. A DNA test confirms their bond, and Leo is brought into the Grant family. But Vernon's cousin, Gemma Clark, plots with her family to destroy the Grants. Using his remarkable talent, Leo wins the favor of powerful financiers and turns the tables, while Vernon exposes Gemma's schemes and reunites with Stacy.

data.title: Alpha Queen Claimed By Her Contracted Sugar Pup
data.intro: After "adopting" a male wolf who bore a striking resemblance to her first love, the female Alpha believed she had found the stunt double for her heart. Unexpectedly, after the misunderstanding was resolved, he turned out to be the savior and lover whom she had been waiting for so long.

data.title: My Domineering Prince
data.intro: Amelia, a struggling actress, is betrayed by her manager, losing all her money and finding herself homeless. Just when she hits rock bottom, she encounters Alex, a mysterious man who takes her in. What begins as an accidental invitation to a role-play party turns into a life-changing discovery when Amelia learns that Alex is actually a prince. He proposes a contract for her to pretend to be his fiancée, to save his reputation and avoid a forced marriage.

data.title: She Who Ruled His Heart
data.intro: Serena Hader, a motherless farm girl, cares for her ailing father while enduring abuse from her stepbrother and cruel stepmother. To survive, she sells vegetables—until one night, she shares an unforgettable encounter with the powerful Prince Regent, Jason Shaw. Mistaking her intentions, Jason leaves her with only a pendant, unaware she’s pregnant. Eight months later, Serena flees home to escape her stepbrother’s advances and nearly miscarries—only to be saved by a marquis.

data.title: Once Divorced, He Dominated the Game
data.intro: Max Lowe spends a year abroad for work. When he returns, he discovers that his wife, Yara Smith, has appointed her childhood friend, Cody Muhl, as a director. When Max tries to fire Cody, Yara and the top management all threaten to quit. Only then does Max realize that he has been reduced to a mere figurehead. Not one to give in easily, Max retaliates with full force. He sends both Yara and Cody to prison. With that behind him, Max begins a new, happy life with Hannah Bell.

data.title: His Obsession, My Prescription
data.intro: Mona Ryver, a modern battlefield doctor, transmigrates into the body of a young noblewoman who was murdered by her fiancé and sister—only to fall straight into Crown Prince Elias Wright's bath. To cure his Redfrost, Mona offers herself, never expecting that the cold and indifferent prince would become utterly obsessed with her.

data.title: Seduced by My Childhood Sweetheart
data.intro: Senna, an optimistic and strong girl, living with her boyfriend and her bestie, got the internship opportunity of James Group, top dog of the industry. Everything seemed very happy. But one day, Klaus, Senna's childhood neighbor, showed up at her house and stumbled on Senna's boyfriend's affair with her best friend. Senna treated Klaus like a child, but didn’t realize that the so-called child is a hunter disguised as a prey, and gradually encroached on her territory.

data.title: The Tragic Love with a Billionaire
data.intro: She loves him desperately, while he hates her fiercely. Their marriage is broken apart just because of some dirty schemes of another woman.

data.title: Crowned in Love: The Mother of Three Big Shots (DUBBED)
data.intro: As a single mother, May Judd raises three exceptional sons on her own, despite the challenges posed by her family. On her father’s seventieth birthday, her mother invites her to return home for a gathering. However, during her visit, May encounters unwarranted hostility from her father and younger sisters. Undaunted, she stands up to their biases and ultimately discovers her own path to happiness.

data.title: His Darling Troublemaker
data.intro: After losing her family and being cast out of her home, Chelsea Greene is taken in by Michael Roden—and unexpectedly becomes his most cherished person, even as she brings him endless trouble.

data.title: The Stormbringer
data.intro: Craig Bush, the master of martial arts and medical techniques, returns to the city. And that unfolds the story fraught with challenges as he navigates his way through them.

data.title: Cheer Queen Returns To Slay
data.intro: A washed-up cheer legend wakes up in her 17-year-old body and infiltrates her daughter's summer cheer camp — ready to protect her bullied daughter, humiliate mean girls, and flip her way back to glory.

data.title: When the Past Comes to Burn (DUBBED)
data.intro: Jack Fallon finds love with Stacy Baird long after witnessing Lucia Wale's betrayal. When his family faces ruin, Stacy seeks help but is gravely injured in an accident. Lucia offers aid on one condition—Jack must marry her. Misunderstandings tear him and Stacy apart, leaving him alone when he's diagnosed with his father's disease. The truth emerges too late, leaving nothing but regret.

data.title: General's Lustful Confession
data.intro: Aaron adopted Leah in his youth, but as they grew older, Leah's feelings for Aaron evolved into something quite different. Alongside a series of trials and tribulations, Leah's true identity gradually came to light. The bond between Aaron and Leah deepened with each passing challenge, and in the end, they overcame these hurdles, finding happiness together.

data.title: The Invincible Bodyguard
data.intro: Seth Page, merely a security guard, unintentionally offends a billionaire heiress and has since been harassed by her investigation and the threats posed by her followers—but if this goes on, his true identity might be exposed.

data.title: One Night, One Baby, One Forever
data.intro: After a misunderstanding sparks a special night between ordinary girl Xenia Gregg and CEO Carson Penn, they are forced into a contract marriage when she discovers she's pregnant. Amid business battles, betrayal from her ex-boyfriend, and hidden truths about her past, love quietly blossoms between them. In the end, Carson's heartfelt confession seals their promise, and they build a happy family of three.

data.title: He Returns, Power in Hand
data.intro: Evan Bell, the sole survivor of the annihilated Bell family, is framed and sentenced to death. Rescued by a mysterious ally, he returned ten years later and began revenge. Facing the scorn of his in-laws, Evan demonstrates his strength, transforming contempt into respect and trust. While protecting his contract wife and her family, he uncovers the identity of his true nemesis and finally exacts justice for his fallen family.

data.title: Kiss Me Under The Vine
data.intro: A virgin violinist runs away from her abusive landlord and ends up at a mansion, where she meets her first love, thinking he's just a hot gardener. She quickly enters a whirlwind relationship, only to discover he's the heir to a huge winery.

data.title: After the Divorce, the Heiress Takes It All
data.intro: After divorcing her indecisive husband, the enigmatic writer Dorothy chose to prove herself through her talents， as she filmed her most significant work, silenced her jealous "sister-in-law", and ultimately found her true soulmate.

data.title: Dare you to love again, Mr. CEO
data.intro: Lucy Torres faces betrayal, heartbreak, and a second chance at love as she navigates a complex web of deception, revenge, and ambition, ultimately finding her path to happiness and success in a world of high-stakes corporate rivalry and personal turmoil...

data.title: When He Steps In, Empires Shift
data.intro: Dickson Varden starts as the personal driver to Coleman Corp CEO Linda Coleman. After saving her from a deadly accident, he's promoted to chairman's secretary. Amid a brutal clash with Loughton Corp, he exposes a mole, endures relentless tests, and protects Linda. When his girlfriend Jane Hartnell humiliates and dumps him, Dickson rises with Linda's backing, becoming a new powerhouse who turns the tide in a high-stakes corporate war.

data.title: System Error: Revenge Activated
data.intro: Before the math competition, Qianna Webb saw her score appear above her head and was stunned to discover she had only ten points. It wasn't until her death that she learned Suzanne had been manipulating their scores all along. Reborn with a new purpose, Qianna outsmarts the system and takes on daring challenges for the institute. In the end, she exposes Suzanne at the celebratory party and completely turns the tables.

data.title: Tides of Goodbye
data.intro: Obeying her family's wishes, Gina Tillman marries her three childhood friends—only to face betrayal after betrayal. Branded as cursed and driven to despair, she ends her own life. Reborn with her memories intact, Gina takes a new path: she marries Cody Rowan and severs all ties with those who wronged her. Only after losing her do they regret their actions—but by then, it's far too late for redemption.

data.title: Your Love Was the Fate I Couldn't Escape
data.intro: Marcus Braun, the leader of Red Coffin, hides in another city under a fake identity to escape an arranged marriage. There, he meets and falls in love with a university student, Mabel Preston. She becomes pregnant with his child, but he is forced to return to Velmark. Refusing to believe Marcus has abandoned her, Mabel goes after him. With interference from Marcus's fiancée and a series of misunderstandings piling up, their love story is destined to be tempestuous.

data.title: Rejected Luna's Prince
data.intro: Rejected by her mate upon discovering her pregnancy, Willa leaves the Blue Ridge Pack to raise her son, Emmett, alone. Meanwhile, her fated mate, Prince Dracos, embarks on a relentless quest to find her. Will their love conquer the secrets and dangers that threaten their future?

data.title: Skeleton King: Contracted to the School Belle
data.intro: 18-year-old Matthew Cross transmigrates and becomes a small, talking skeleton. He awakens the SSS-rank Insatius System, which allows him to grow stronger by devouring. The genius campus belle, Freya Freeman, accidentally summons him, and the whole school mocks them. When the villains force Freya into an impossible situation, Matthew devours the dungeon boss and evolves into a ripped Skeleton King. He exclaims, "Watch me crush them, Freya!"

data.title: My Hockey Alpha
data.intro: After breaking up with her disloyal boyfriend, Nina has a one night stand with their school hockey star, Enzo Rivers. Nina swears off of hockey players, but Enzo isn't done with her yet. However,he seems to be hiding a big secret on this unusual campus.

data.title: From Last Pick to First Choice
data.intro: Erin Sanders finds herself entangled in a risky romance with her billionaire arch-rival, Nolan Duffy, who covertly becomes her houseboy. But when his deceptions are exposed, threatening her heart and her company, Erin must choose between safeguarding her family legacy or embracing their unconventional love.

data.title: Taming the Billionaire Tycoon
data.intro: In order to avoid a marriage with the rumored greasy bald boss of Frontier Group, Mia, the eldest daughter of Geneva Group, found a male model to prepare a fake marriage to deceive her family. At the same time, the assistant of Dylan, the president of Frontier Group, also found a woman for Dylan. As a result, Mia accidentally met Dylan in the club, and both of them recognized the wrong person. The two who originally did not want to marry each other got married by accident.

data.title: Desired by My Unknown Husband
data.intro: Frank, a small-town boy, hastily married urbanite Andrew, chosen by his grandmotherly friends, without recognizing each other. Andrew disappeared after going abroad for work. A year later, Frank's boss, the wealthy and charming Andrew, pursued him, leading to an affair. The once-playboy Andrew learned commitment and restraint, while Frank, once betrayed, regained trust and learned to love freely. At the divorce site, Frank discovered his husband and boss were the same person.

data.title: Billionaire Daddy: the Hunt Is On!
data.intro: Novice mother Miranda works hard to support her son, but always accidentally offends the black-hearted boss Raymond, and this handsome, rich man, who is cold outside and warm inside, is actually the biological father of the child...

data.title: A Marriage Buried in Lies (DUBBED)
data.intro: Years after her husband, Pierre Kemp, jailed her for Avery Sadler's crimes, Nancy Willer is finally released—frail and broken from years of torment. Pierre refuses her treatment and smears her name when he finds her gathering evidence of bullying. He even watches her lose her grandmother before demanding a divorce for Avery's sake. When Nancy leaves, they celebrate—unaware she is already plotting her return for revenge.

data.title: Free My Heart, Mr. CEO
data.intro: After years of secretly dating her billionaire boss, Mable is shocked by his engagement news, realizing she's been a stand-in for his lost first love. Fleeing his pursuit, Mable stumbles into a whirl of fate, love and scandal.

data.title: Fated to My Cruel CEO
data.intro: Helen and Algar escaped an orphanage and embarked on separate journeys, with only their hearts connected by a promise that refuses to break. A fated reunion filled with love, secrets and echoes of their past.

data.title: Deliver Me
data.intro: To reclaim her family legacy stolen by her cousin Cain, Veronica deliberately gets close to mafia leader Enzo. Amid revenge and power struggles, their relationship evolves into a complex game of love and deception. They eventually expose Cain's murder of Veronica's parents, join forces to overthrow him, and reclaim the De Vere empire, finding genuine love through truth and sacrifice.

data.title: Shadowed Thrones (DUBBED)
data.intro: Felix Young, known as the Supreme, discreetly supports his wife, Madison Xavier, in her ascent to a higher position. However, the day she is appointed as the War God, Madison files for divorce. Disheartened, Felix is determined to reclaim everything he once granted her.

data.title: Our Love, Burned Out
data.intro: Once a couple envied by all, Zack Sachs and Sarah Jones's relationship teeters on the edge. He gives everything to her, yet she keeps putting her depressed childhood friend, Braxton Tate, first. Zack reaches his breaking point when, on the anniversary of his mother's death, she leaves him for Braxton—again. Only after losing him does Sarah realize her mistake, but by the time she tries to win him back, Zack has moved on, and their love becomes an irreversible regret.

data.title: Flunked Exams, Built a School for the Supernatural
data.intro: After failing the college entrance exam, Mason Litt awakens a system that commands him to establish Netherfall Academy. This academy doesn't offer standard subjects; instead, it teaches ghost hunting, corpse wrangling, body retrieval, and spiritual healing. As its fame grows, more and more students enroll. With their support, Mason walks the unconventional nether path to ascend to immortality.

data.title: Spoiled by Four Billionaires
data.intro: Yvonne, who had no family of her own, financially supported her boyfriend Josh through his college years. However, once Josh found success, he left her for Clair, a woman with deep pockets. Together, Josh and Clair made Yvonne's life miserable, not realizing that Yvonne was actually a lost daughter of the wealthy Hoffman family. When her three powerful brothers and her fiancé finally located her, they rallied to her side to help her exact revenge on Josh.

data.title: Justice Served: Greed Gets Burned
data.intro: On her birthday, Susan Cohen helps a woman who has fallen, only to be falsely accused and humiliated by her family. With her identity still under wraps, she is mercilessly mocked. Her father, Yale Cohen, steps in to protect her and expose their heinous schemes. Having had enough of fame and power, he returns to a simple life with Susan. The wrongdoers, meanwhile, face the consequences of their actions.

data.title: A Love Set to Expire
data.intro: Years after falling in love with Vicky Wood, Blake Evans marries her under a pact with her father: if she does not get pregnant within three years, their marriage will end. Blake hopes he can win her heart in time, but Vicky continually prioritizes Caleb Wood—even going so far as to carry Caleb's child. Feeling betrayed and trapped, Blake leaves to take over his family business.

data.title: Cheers to the Mess You Made
data.intro: For three years, Ella Hale and Ken Miller seemed like the perfect couple. But behind the picture-perfect facade, Ken was siphoning her money to fund his mistress—and even handed over Ella's beloved winery to please her. What he doesn't know is that he's crossed the wrong woman.

data.title: Reborn, Reviled, and Ridiculously Loved
data.intro: Betrayed, business legend Jane Spencer wakes up as Mira Quill, a rural woman who married the Hewitts' disabled heir in place of her stepsister. Scorned by those around her, she rises in high society and the business world, ultimately bringing down the abusive Quill family and the unfaithful scumbag who framed her.

data.title: Hired and Hooked: Flirt, Fight, Forever
data.intro: Unwilling to go through with his arranged marriage, Luke Harper hires a butcher, Avery Quinn, as his contractual bride. She agrees for money and plays the part boldly. As they grow closer, hidden truths about Luke's savior and Avery's true identity come to light. What begins as a business arrangement turns into destined love.

data.title: His Secret Plan, My Heart's Surrender
data.intro: When a dog ruins Lily Wade's marriage certificate, she has it remade—only to discover it's fake! Not only has Joe Hark deceived her, but he's also been cheating on her with her maid's daughter. Furious, Lily storms off to a university and impulsively chooses a handsome student to marry. Little does she know, the man she picked is far more complicated than he appears.

data.title: No One Waits Forever
data.intro: After being in love with Ryan Zeller for seven years, Lydia Russell is devastated to learn that he wants to break up and plans to marry Claire Shaw instead—simply because Claire is as pure and obedient as Lydia once was. Respecting his wishes, Lydia walks away and marries Jonah Brown, the most powerful man in Glayden. Yet on her wedding day, Ryan finally realizes he needs her by his side.

data.title: From Rags to Riches: Pet Shop Cinderella
data.intro: By a twist of fate, pet shop owner Elise Moore got married in a whirlwind to billionaire Alexander Alger. Due to misunderstandings, Alexander had to disguise his identity to prevent him from being exposed. With Elise believing her husband to be an ordinary person, what kind of funny stories will unfold between them?

data.title: Cause You Were Never Mine
data.intro: When Jade's mother falls ill, Jade pretends to cheat with Dexter to avoid burdening Bruce, who was planning to propose. Heartbroken, Bruce breaks up with her. To revenge, Bruce starts his own business with the help of his family. Five years later, as CEO of Morgan Group, he hires Jade, thus beginning a love story of mutual torment that would touch hearts.

data.title: Not Yours, Not Today, Not Ever (DUBBED)
data.intro: Moments before her death, Scarlett Kendall discovers that her husband, Connor Langley, sabotaged her chance at college by stealing her admission letter and giving it to her sister. Reborn, she wastes no time—claiming what should have been hers. Meanwhile, Connor heads to the college with her sister, holding the fake admission letter in hand.

data.title: This Love Ends with Me
data.intro: In his past life, Jason Clark sacrificed a promotion to save Scott Wallace, all to marry Yelena Brown. Yet he was met with betrayal and resentment, ultimately dying of a heart attack. Reborn in 1990, just before their wedding, Jason severs ties with Yelena and immerses himself in building his own empire. By the time Yelena realizes her mistakes, it is far too late.

data.title: Dr.Wifey Please Touch Me
data.intro:
Chase Hopkins, suffering from gynophobia, meets Dr. Kate Collins, his ex-wife, during therapy. He doesn’t recognize her, thinking she’s just his “one-night stand,” while Kate tries to hide her true identity, believing she
"cheated" on him. As Chase works through his fear of women, their dynamic shifts between intimacy and distance. Will he realize the woman he loves is his ex-wife? What will happen next?

data.title: A Lifetime Too Late (DUBBED)
data.intro: It is only after Heidi Jaffe's death after donating her heart to Chad Shelby's first crush does Chad realize he had already fallen for her a long time ago. Overwhelmed with guilt, he chooses to end his own life—only to unexpectedly transmigrate into the system and enter Heidi’s world. Determined to make amends and win her back, he tries everything to regain her love, yet uncovers a cruel truth regarding what he thought was Heidi's unconditional love for him.

data.title: Breaking Free From Their Thirst (DUBBED)
data.intro: Alex Falkner is born to be nothing more than a blood donor for his brother, Shawn Falkner, enduring years of mistreatment under Shawn’s manipulation. Even the only person who ever shows him kindness, Faye Cole, agrees to get engaged to him solely because she fears he will stop donating blood to Shawn if he marries someone else.

data.title: Come Back For You
data.intro: After murdered by her ex-husband Ricky, Shannon reborn 10 years ago to start her revenge for Ricky and second chance love with Johnny Wonder.

data.title: The Mafia's Forbidden Virgin
data.intro: After being rescued by Kieran, a mafia heir, from her mother's attempt to sell her virginity, Elena discovers her mother is marrying his father. Now step-siblings, their forbidden attraction intensifies when Kieran becomes her professor, forcing constant contact. From defending her against bullies to simmering home tension, hostility turns into dangerous desire.

data.title: Masked Magnate: The Dominant Son-in-Law (DUBBED)
data.intro: After being reunited with his biological father, Chris Bell assumes the CEO position at the Olgow branch of Apex Group. However, at his father-in-law's birthday party, he faces rejection from the family table, labeled as a useless live-in son-in-law. His challenges escalate as his wife faces disdain alongside him, a suitor tries to take her away, developers attempt to forcibly demolish their home, and his daughter falls victim to a brutal attack by a wealthy man.

data.title: When Love Pulls the Plug
data.intro: When a heart match is finally found for his gravely ill mother, Lucas Hart is betrayed by his wife of seven years, Nadia Reid. She threatens him, insisting the heart be given to Damon Morse instead. Heartbroken, Lucas leaves with his mother, only to return years later as a renowned heart specialist. Along the way, he not only saves lives but also finds love with Faye Smith—while Nadia is left to face regret as Damon's true nature is finally revealed.

data.title: A Prism of Truths
data.intro: After eight years of being deceived and hurt by her boyfriend, Ian Bolt, Jane Cole, a jewelry designer, escapes his manipulation and brainwashing with the help of Joe Shaw, the CEO of Shaw Corp. She starts a new life with her newfound confidence and returns to her career of passion, then exposes the person who has been stealing and copying her work, winning the approval of her colleagues and clients while earning herself a place of status in the society.

data.title: A Promise to Another, A Divorce to Us
data.intro: On his daughter Yara's birthday, Chad Scott hands out flyers with her to earn money so they can pay off Ruby Judd's debts. However, when they perform as mascots at a lavish party Ruby throws for Zach Smith's son, they realize she was never bankrupt. Everything she has said over the past six years has been a lie, and she has vowed to spend money only on her old flame. Feeling betrayed and heartbroken, Chad decides to leave with Yara.

data.title: One Last Chance, One Final Heartbreak
data.intro: For eight long years, Elise Franco devoted herself to Mark Gelman and the success of Gelman Corp, sacrificing both her health and her chance at motherhood. But on the day the company goes public, she discovers his affair with Helen Casey. Despite the heartbreak, she chooses to give him one last chance—unaware that this decision is steering their relationship toward an irreversible break.

data.title: One Night Altitude
data.intro: Evelyn, heartbroken by her boyfriend's infidelity, drowned her sorrows in alcohol and unexpectedly had a one-night stand with the renowned pilot Grayson. Afterward, fate kept them apart. Evelyn forgot what Grayson looked like, but Grayson fell head over heels for her at first sight. He found her lost employee badge and sent his assistant to track her down. Unfortunately, the assistant made a mistake—Evelyn's coworker Katie claimed the badge and impersonated her.

data.title: Hate That Binds, Desire That Burns
data.intro: Larkfield's most feared heir, Cedric Storme, has spent four years despising Sierra Brighton, convinced she schemed to trap him with a baby. But when their son's life hangs in the balance, requiring cord blood only a sibling can provide, he has no choice but to remain by her side. But as the truth emerges, Cedric's hatred transforms into pity before giving way to love.

data.title: Queen of My Own Fire
data.intro: Separated from her family as a child, Winnie Zahn is raised by Alex Burke, the chairman of Ascend Corp, until her biological family finds her at 18. When danger strikes, they save their adopted daughter and leave Winnie behind. Rescued by Alex's men after his death, she becomes Ascend Corp's CEO. She hides her identity, wins the championship, and exposes her sister, leaving the Zahns full of regret.

data.title: Underlying Dawn: The Rising Ruler (DUBBED)
data.intro: There are rumors that if one can gain the favor of Lord Cloud, he will be a man of honor. On this ordinary day, Lars Baxter barges into the conference room of Royal Corp, intending to settle matters quickly and move on to the next delivery. At this time, a meeting about the company crisis is taking place. To everyone’s surprise, Lars suggests the best solution to the problem as if it is nothing to be worried about.

data.title: The Reunion of Genius Baby
data.intro: Single mother Caroline participated in an AI competition with her genius son, but unexpectedly her first love boyfriend John was the organizer. Ten years ago, Caroline was an intern at STM Group and fell in love with John. On Christmas, John invited Caroline to a family gathering, and Caroline unexpectedly discovered that John's mother may have been the culprit behind the parents' fall.

data.title: Love You Whoever You Are
data.intro: Alpha Liam finds out that his mate, Dora, is a regular human who hates werewolves to her guts. To be with her, Liam keeps his werewolf identity a secret and pretends to be a regular human, not knowing that a mystery child is going to reveal a deep secrete of them from 5 years ago…

data.title: Betrayed to Brilliance: Her Life, Her Rules
data.intro: Jade Kemp stays dutiful in marriage, running the household flawlessly while tolerating her husband's blurred boundaries with his "female best friend". But when they eventually go too far, she decisively puts an end to their marriage and rises from being a housewife to a powerful CEO, thriving in success while beginning a new life with someone new.

data.title: Love in the Shadows
data.intro: Sophie agrees to marry a stranger to save her family, believing he’s just a quiet, absent businessman. But her world is turned upside down when she discovers her husband is Robert Kensington, a powerful CEO with a dangerous reputation—and a family willing to betray him for control of his company. Pulled into explosive boardroom battles and shocking family secrets, Sophie finds herself in a world where love and survival are anything but guaranteed.

data.title: No Tears, Just Cheers
data.intro: Believing she has the perfect marriage, Zoe Stone is furious to discover that her marriage certificate with Ian Ford is fake—he is legally married to someone else, and the orphan he insists on adopting is his illegitimate child. Refusing to betray herself, she walks away decisively, leaving the unfaithful man buried in the dust of her past.

data.title: Signed, Sealed, Secretly Married (DUBBED)
data.intro: With the help of his grandfather, Dave Quinn marries Tessa Gray, a girl he does not know much about. After marriage, Tessa works in Quinn Corp as a cleaner and makes Dave promise to keep their relationship a secret from their colleagues. However, some of her colleagues show disdain towards her, especially Dave’s childhood sweetheart, Lana Harris, who has a crush on him. Out of jealousy, Lana sets Tessa up in an attempt to get rid of her, hoping to ruin her marriage with Dave.

data.title: Bridal Gown Showdown: Mistress vs. Matriarch
data.intro: Lydia Shaw, chairwoman of Shaw Corp, discovers that her son, Alvin, has been cheating on his fiancée, Carmen Stone, who just had their baby. After forcing Alvin to promise he would end the affair, Lydia goes to pick up Carmen's wedding gown. There, she unexpectedly encounters Joyce, Alvin's mistress. Confident of Alvin's indulgence, Joyce insults and bullies Lydia relentlessly. While Alvin finally arrives, Joyce is in for a brutal reality check.

data.title: Our Love Is Beyond Cure
data.intro: Sophia Wood discovers her husband's secretary, Kayla Smith, has a serious health condition and intends to tell him—only to catch him cheating with Kayla. In a cruel attempt to humiliate Sophia, he lavishes Kayla with luxurious jewelry and takes her to elite events, even blaming Sophia for the illness. But Sophia turns the tables, presenting a health report that reveals the truth and exposes his deceit.

data.title: All for Myself: My Life, My Choice
data.intro: After being betrayed by her husband, Ryan Dane, and her cousin, Lena Carter, Maya Vale is rescued by Julian Mercer. Reborn, she chooses Julian without hesitation—only to discover that two years into their marriage, he has a child with Lena. This time, Maya turns her back on love and chooses herself.

data.title: The End of Your Season in My Life
data.intro: Layla Nelson sacrifices her youth to help Zander Carlson rise from a struggling student to a renowned professor—only to watch him grow close to the principal's daughter, Chloe Young. Betrayed by Zander and threatened by Chloe, Layla lets go of love and opens her heart to Noah Scott, a devoted entrepreneur she comes to deeply respect. As she begins a new life filled with love and fulfillment, Zander sinks into regret and obsession, realizing too late what he lost.

data.title: My Serial Killer Lover
data.intro: Charlie,aprofessorofcriminalpsychologyattheuniversity,hasbeenhauntedbynightmaresforyears—hisdeceasedmother,cladinbloodstainedclothes,lingersinhisdreams,refusingtoleave.Hehasdevotedallhisenergytoassistingthepoliceintrackingdownherkiller—theelusiveserialmurdererknownas“TheFalcon.”Thetraumaofhischildhoodandhissenseofaimlessnessinadulthoodoftenmakehimfeelasthoughheiswanderingalonethroughadark,fog-filledcanyon,withnopathforwardandonlysolitudesurroundinghim.

data.title: Once Is Enough to Break Me
data.intro: Rene Xander and Skyler Hunt have been in love for seven years. Yet on the day of their engagement party, Skyler leaves Rene alone at the venue all because of a single phone call from his first love. At that moment, Rene’s heart shatters. She sends Skyler a breakup text and takes her leave. Skyler thinks she is just being dramatic. It isn’t until he finds that Rene has married someone else that the high-and-mighty CEO of Hunt Group finally unravels.

data.title: Regret in the Shape of Her Name
data.intro: Rose Baker and Nathan Shaw built their success from nothing, standing by each other through every hardship. As husband and wife, they were once inseparable. But after achieving everything they had dreamed of, Nathan betrays the woman who helped him rise. When Rose confronts him, he refuses to take responsibility. Instead, he suggests they live separate lives, convinced she would never leave him—never love anyone else. But he underestimates her.

data.title: After Everything, I Still Lost You
data.intro: Seven years ago, Grace Smith saved Chad Larson but was left mentally impaired in the process. Her parents died while searching for her. Devoted to her, Chad remains single, yet his mother refuses to accept it. Her interference drives Grace away. Years later, just as he's diagnosed with cancer and pressured into marriage, he discovers the beggar he once met was Grace. Heartbroken, he races to the hospital as everything spirals out of control.

data.title: The Legacy of Her Name
data.intro: Due to the bias of her grandmother and father, Joey Scott is cast out of her home and humiliated alongside her mother. Determined to reclaim their dignity, she dedicates herself to achieving success, eventually earning an honorable status. When she returns to her hometown, faced with disapproval, she proves her worth and power through her remarkable comeback. In the process, she reflects on her father’s mistakes, leading to a reconciliation once he acknowledges them.

data.title: The Divorce Game: The 99th Is Final
data.intro: Ray Crane and Ella White enter the courthouse for their 99th divorce. This time, he refuses to reconcile. During the proceedings, he discovers hidden love letters proving that she truly loves him. However, he can no longer tolerate Ella constantly using divorce as a way to exert control in their marriage. As she sides with her childhood friend and ignores repeated schemes against Ray, he accepts an overseas invitation and decides to start anew.

data.title: Crown of Her Own Making: Rewritten in Blood and Silk
data.intro: Reborn, Sophie Laurent—once an abandoned wife—returns stronger as the duke's daughter. Armed with cunning, strategy, and the power of medicine, she exposes the schemes of imposter Elena Laurent and the deceitful Julian Sinclair. Joining forces with Victor Armand, Sophie reclaims what was stolen from her. Now, standing above all, she wields power that Julian can never hope to reach.

data.title: When the Throne Betrays Its Blade
data.intro: Non-royal Prince Lucas Steele leads his army north to reclaim lost lands. On the verge of retaking the imperial city, Empress Simone Erwin issues eighteen edicts ordering a retreat. The countless lives sacrificed over five years of battle were all for nothing. Back at court, Lucas is framed, publicly humiliated, stripped of his rank, and watches the recovered lands handed back to the enemy. Disheartened, he walks away.

data.title: Welcome to My Secret Immortal Life
data.intro: Tricked into the mountains by his wife, Frank Lundy spends five long years under the guidance of a reclusive master, returning as a formidable cultivator. Now back, he puts those who once scorned him in their place—and ensures the assassins who hunted him regret ever drawing their blades. But when his wife's family demands a divorce, he drops the one truth they least want to hear: the mighty cultivator they grovel to is nothing more than his errand boy.

data.title: Queen in Disguise: Play Nice, Strike Hard
data.intro: Hilary Auden appears to be a well-behaved overseas student, but she is actually the leader of the Giorvina Guild, unmatched in combat. When her grandfather falls gravely ill, she returns home with her bodyguard, Leo Dorman, and is forced into marriage. After enduring humiliation from her husband and his wealthy friends, Hilary strikes back with icy precision, showing them what true power really looks like.

data.title: A World in Her Pocket, Hearts in Her Hands
data.intro: A post-apocalyptic warrior transmigrates into the body of an evil woman, Jolene Wood—who, coincidentally, shares her name. Exiled with scarce provisions, she relies on her secret pocket dimension stocked with abundant supplies. In the past, Jolene had left a terrible impression on her husband and children. Now, through extraordinary feats, she begins to change their hearts and rewrite her legacy.

data.title: Shock Points Activated: Rising from the Famine
data.intro: During a time of famine, thug Arnold Zorn transmigrates into the body of a notorious gambler—a man destined to bring his family's ruin by selling his sister for his own gain. Awakening to his family's contempt and rage, Arnold triggers the Shock System.

data.title: The Martial Prodigy: Fists That Shatter Worlds
data.intro: Raoul Levine, once ruthless in his quest for power, loses his parents to his enemy, Lazlo Ryker. Consumed by regrets, he seals his abilities—only to awaken as five-year-old Hugo Clark, heir to a martial family. He soon realizes part of his power remains when he accidentally shatters the Clarks' trial stone, sparking rumors of a hidden grandmaster.

data.title: Love Went Quiet Before I Did
data.intro: After losing his parents, Nathan Gunn is taken in by the Larson family and promised to one of their three daughters. But when Elijah Scott appears, all three back out. Heartbroken, Nathan marries Zendaya Irwin, who has loved him for years. The Larson sisters think it's just for show and try to provoke him by favoring Elijah and giving him Nathan's parents' keepsakes. That final betrayal makes Nathan walk away for good.

data.title: Choices and Fate: Double-Edged Marriage
data.intro: In her past life, Mia Saxon was a Lady of Distinction, while her sister, Kate Saxon, became a lonely young widow, consumed by jealousy, and ultimately killed Mia in a fit of rage. Now, both are unexpectedly reborn on their wedding day. Blinded by ambition, Kate seizes Mia's fiancé, Seth Payne, believing it will alter her fate—unaware that she is marching straight toward her own ruin.

data.title: Fifty Shades of My Professor
data.intro: To save her dreams, Shannon agrees to auction her virginity—only to fall into the arms of a man tangled in every corner of her life: her piano professor, her aunt’s fiancé... and her late mother’s forbidden love.

data.title: The Cast-Off Heiress's Dominion: Revenge, Power, and Love
data.intro: Vivian Trent unexpectedly has a child with Nathan Holt, the hidden heir to the Marquis. Her family casts her out, while Nathan forgets her entirely. Five years later, Vivian returns with her five-year-old son. To protect and avenge, she makes a deal with Nathan arranging for him to become her husband in a three-year marriage contract. Nathan gradually realizes that it's Vivian who saved him years ago. Together, they foil their enemies' schemes. Along the way, they uncover Nat

data.title: Her Cold-hearted Alpha
data.intro: Kiara, a weak Omega with night blindness and no wolf is dumped by her pack, and sodecides to promote herself to a stronger wolf with Alpha King Alejandro’s training, andmeanwhile, they step into an adventurous relationship journey.

data.title: My Billionaire Sugar Baby
data.intro: She thought he was just a charming sugar baby - until he bought her company, crashed her marriage, and dropped to one knee. Now, with her life flipped upside down, she has to choose between pride, power… and the billionaire who never stops loving her.

data.title: Divine Reckoning: She Walks Among Mortals
data.intro: Decades after she built Quesdia, the Lady of the Moon is reborn as Elena Sinclair, an unloved daughter who is shoved into torment as a sacrifice. At the brink of death, she regains power and aids the worthy in seizing the throne while dragging the Sinclairs off of the pedestal they put themselves on—but despite her power and effort, darkness still lurks nearby.

data.title: Seeds of Hope: The Girl of Wonder
data.intro: Abigail Carter awakens in the body of a six-year-old girl named Abby during a time of famine. Abandoned in the remote mountains under the cover of night and left to die, her fate seems sealed—until Sam Hutton, the poorest yet kindest man in the village, discovers and saves her. From that moment on, fortune begins to favor him: his harvests flourish, and he finally wins the heart of the woman he’s always loved.

data.title: My Teenage Mother
data.intro: 24-year-old Kim Ha-rim dies in a car accident and discovers that she is the first love of Yu Jun-hyeok, the male lead of a novel. After her death, her children lead miserable lives. Reborn as her 18-year-old self, Ha-rim is determined to change her family's fate. She reclaims the stolen villa, guides her son to change his ways, and protects her daughter. With Jun-hyeok's support, the broken family reconciles and finds their happily ever after.

data.title: Bound to None: She Wrote Her Own Fate
data.intro: Hannah Lane was in a car accident with her parents. They died, and their driver also lost his life protecting her. Her six brothers despise her and take in the driver's daughter as their adopted sister, making Hannah's life a living hell. After getting a second chance at life, she cuts ties with them and forges her own path. Along the way, she meets Cedric Morse, who became a campus doctor because of her. As they spend more time together, their hearts grow closer.

data.title: The  Genius Returns
data.intro: They took her in just to treat her like a servant. Her adopted sister kept stealing her math answers, and her family always took the liar's side. So Ada cut ties with them all, right there in the exam hall. But when her solutions kept getting stolen, she did the only thing left—she solved an unsolvable problem in ten minutes. Proof? She just gave it.

data.title: Return of His Majesty (DUBBED)
data.intro: Before leaving his hometown, Leo Lowe makes a promise to his fiancée, Tina Leed, that once he becomes emperor, he will return to make her his empress. Years later, he successfully establishes a new dynasty and becomes the emperor of it, so he returns to the village disguised as an ordinary villager to fulfill his promise, not expecting to be forced to pay just to get through the entrance.

data.title: Blades of Glory
data.intro: A battle claims thousands of lives from the land of Cirla, and as their leader, Chris Moore leads his men in bringing the deceased soldiers home for the Sacrificial Ceremony. However, that is not the only reason he returns. This time around, he is back to also uncover the truth behind his father’s death.On his journey, he encounters an arrogant rich man who humiliates him, resulting in Chris giving him the punishment he deserves.

data.title: Ultimate Food Deliveryman
data.intro: He was once the revered master of the Sky Medical Palace, respected by all. Obeying the orders of his master, he pretended to be a food deliveryman and married into the Lewis family for a year. In this duration, he plowed through countless side eyes and now... His one year duration is up—it is time to turn the tables around!

data.title: Silken Intrigues: Lust, Power and Betrayal
data.intro: Eden Shaw happens to save the drugged emperor, Ryan Jones. However, her good deed is stolen and credited to her best friend, Lisa Hal. After Lisa enters the palace as a concubine, she tries to eliminate her. Despite this, Eden's medical skills lead to her promotion as the vice director of the Royal Infirmary. Fortunately, the truth soon comes to light, and Lisa is sentenced to death. In the end, Eden and Ryan embark on a peaceful life together.

data.title: Blade of Vengeance
data.intro: Cody Hale possesses the Divine Frame, which makes him a supreme cultivator. He dedicates his efforts to his mentor and seniors, yet is loathed and even mercilessly murdered after his junior framed him. Soon after rebirth, he decisively betrays Skyle Sect and joins Azure Sect instead, becoming a member of the rivaling party. It is only at this moment that his mentor and seniors regret their past behavior.

data.title: Moving On From You (DUBBED)
data.intro: Jane Rowe has been in love with Sam Bale ever since he took her in at the age of seven. Every year on her birthday, she confesses her feelings, only to be rejected as Sam, believing their ten-year age gap is too large, chooses someone else.One night, they get drunk and spend the night together, but Sam has no recollection of it. When Jane becomes pregnant, Sam accuses her of being indecent. Heartbroken, Jane leaves him to continue his life with his girlfriend.

data.title: Kisses Laced with Lies
data.intro: A leaked video shatters Stella Quinn's reputation and ends her relationship with her boyfriend—who had been playing her for her sister, Willow Quinn. In despair, Stella takes Willow's place in an arranged marriage and exposes what she did. With her new partner, Stella steps into a new life—but her ex isn't ready to let her go just yet.

data.title: Revenge Beyond the Grave
data.intro: If you didn't kill me completely before, I will make my enemies pay with blood in the future.Matthew conspires with his lover Fiona to push his pregnant wife Grace off a cliff to seize her assets. Alice, Grace's twin sister who has been separated for twenty years, returns to take Grace's place and seek revenge. Just as Alice is about to succeed, Grace returns with a new face and lost memory, leading to continuous misunderstandings with Alice.

data.title: The Thorn in His Rose
data.intro: After witnessing her father's murder as a child, Clara is raised by Marcus, a powerful and emotionally distant mafia boss. Years later, she uncovers a link between Marcus's fiancée, Leona, and the crime. As secrets unravel, Clara is forced to face a devastating truth: Marcus himself may be connected to her family's ruin. Caught between forbidden love, betrayal, and revenge, Clara must decide whether to expose the truth or let love blind her.
