data.title: Spend to Rule: No Discounts, Only Dominance
data.intro: Betrayed by his gold-digging girlfriend and humiliated by an arrogant rich heir, college student Fred Allen awakens the "Super Tycoon System," granting him limitless wealth—with one rule: he can never bargain again. Armed with fortune and unstoppable power, Fred rises to the top, determined to erase every past humiliation and make everyone who ever wronged him pay... in the wildest ways imaginable.

data.title: The Return of the Amnesiac Heiress
data.intro: To afford her mother's medical expenses, Eun Seong turns to her estranged grandfather for help, only to be told she must sever ties with her mother in exchange, simply because her mother once eloped with an ordinary man. Twenty years after the separation, her mother becomes president of Cheonhae Group, determined to find her lost daughter. Meanwhile, Eun Seong, now suffering from amnesia, throws herself into a relationship with her secretly unfaithful boyfriend of five years.

data.title: Queen of the Battlefield: Her Return to Glory (DUBBED)
data.intro: Sophie Devin uses her formidable strength to defend the nation in honor of her father and brother, who lost their lives on the battlefield. However, for the sake of assuring her mother, she promises to hide her capabilities and stop involving herself in the battles. Instead, she marries Blake Jaffe, the man her mother has chosen for her, and embraces a life as an ordinary woman. On their wedding day, Blake leaves for a mission and returns only a year later.

data.title: Famine? Not at My Table
data.intro: Transported from the 21st century with a PhD in Agronomy, Cassidy Coleman lands in a nightmarish famine, reviled by all. Yet, her modern expertise becomes the ultimate weapon. Witness her defiant rise as she transforms barren lands with miraculous sweet potatoes, wields medicinal herbs to heal the sick, and confronts those who scorned her. This isn't just about survival; it's about a woman single-handedly saving a world on the brink.

data.title: What Began in a Miracle Ended in Love
data.intro: Eight-year-old Samuel Graham meets Lisa at a care center. Lisa possesses a mysterious power to heal. Warm and kind, she lights up his life and miraculously heals his legs. Sixteen years later, Samuel vows to find Lisa and marry her. He searches everywhere, but she's nowhere to be found. Tasha Blair, the woman Samuel's family wants him to marry, unexpectedly enters his life. What follows is a marriage filled with misunderstandings, chaos, and laughter.

data.title: Honey, I'm the Real Queen
data.intro: To live authentically, billionaire heiress Alicia Turner attends school under a false name. Tina Anderson, an ordinary student, impersonates her for status, bullying Alicia and flaunting stolen luxuries. After being drugged and kidnapped by Tina at prom, Alicia escapes and exposes her. Tina is arrested, and Alicia's true identity is revealed. Three years later, her fiancé Liam returns to reunite with her.

data.title: The Chosen Blade: Path of the Legend
data.intro: Selena Finley's father forces her into marriage for cultivation materials, but Lucian Reeve sacrifices his 7th-grade energy core to help her become a top disciple at Crastic School. Trapped in the Holy Spring and enduring relentless flames, Lucian, on the brink of death, uses a mysterious sword from his late father and astonishingly reaches Level 999,999.

data.title: The Dual Nature of His Seductive Wife
data.intro: In her previous life, Diana was deceived by her sister and fell in love with a scumbag, regarding her loving husband Teddy as a monster. In the end, she was betrayed by both the scumbag and her sister, and died in a fire with Teddy. When she opened her eyes again, Diana was reborn. She decided to reverse the tragedy of her previous life.

data.title: My Trash-Rank Summon Is a Zombie King?!
data.intro: Summoner Amelia Spicer is expelled from university after losing her bound eidolon. By accident, she summons Damon Raven, a triple-F-rank zombie from another world. But Damon is actually a Zombie King with triple-S skills and multiple forms. Once the underdog, Amelia makes a comeback with Damon by her side. Through countless challenges and trials, their bond deepens in unexpected ways as they face wicked schemes and conspiracies.

data.title: The Little Healer Who Restored Love
data.intro: Bea Ford, a young doctor born into poverty, rescues an elderly woman on her way to the city after being cast out by her mentor. In gratitude, the woman adopts Bea as her granddaughter. This leads Bea to meet her new adoptive father, Jim Hark, the city's wealthiest man, who is confined to a wheelchair by a mysterious ailment.

data.title: Reborn, Her Only Mercy is Victory
data.intro: After being reborn, Ann York changes from the top commander of a post-apocalyptic world to a timid daughter of a rich family. Covered in blood, she helps Skylar Freeman win a street race and later stuns Arva's elite by kicking her scheming sister into a pool. Once a warrior, always a warrior—Ann will never yield, unless it's to someone truly worthy.

data.title: System-Built City: I Construct, I Command, I Control
data.intro: Charles Grant, a failing student at a third-rate academy, suddenly becomes a construction foreman—and discovers he has a building system with magical properties. A toilet he casually builds turns into a "treasure for the constipated," and a simple footbridge becomes a "bridge for criminals to confess their sins." That's right—whatever he builds, he decides its rules!

data.title: From Lost Heiress to Royal Highness
data.intro: Kidnapped as a child, Grace is raised by a cruel family until the powerful and wealthy Morgans find her. As she embraces her true legacy, she falls for a hidden prince. Through heartbreak and schemes, she transforms into a fearless woman, claiming both her destiny and love.

data.title: Make My Mom Bloom Again
data.intro: Emma is a single mother who's relied on her wits and guts to raise threewonderful sons. On her father's 70th birthday, Emma's mother invites her home... but Emma is greeted with nothing but harassment and bullying from her two jealous sisters and money-grubbing father. Even her eldest son's fiancee humiliates her at a party, and her long-divorced ex-husband and best friend treat her like trash!

data.title: Not Too Late to Love
data.intro: Mila Gale gives her first time to the man she's loved for years—Henry Byer—only to overhear him mocking her poverty to his friends. Devastated, she walks away without looking back, leaving a scar he can never forget. A decade later, when fate brings them face-to-face once more, he plots to make her his wife... only to be greeted by divorce papers instead.

data.title: Till Truth Do Us Part
data.intro: A CEO and a barista's flash marriage spirals into chaos as hidden agendas, a jealous ex, and a shocking family secret unravel. Will their hearts survive the lies—or crash harder than their hasty "I do's"? Drama, heat, and humor guaranteed.

data.title: His Return Marks Your Ruin
data.intro: Despite suffering from leukemia, Nina Carter works hard to pay medical fees for her father, Darius, who is in a vegetative state after saving her in a car accident. Her efforts pay off as her devotion moves many. Even her scornful grandmother supports her and confronts her selfish mother, Clara Zane. Just as Nina faces the threats from Zander Morse, Darius miraculously wakes up and comes to her rescue.

data.title: Daddy, The Plants Told Me Everything!
data.intro: On the day her mother dies, Shayla is abandoned by her family—only to be taken in by the wealthiest man in the city as his own daughter. From that moment, her life takes a dramatic turn: cherished by the powerful Hart family, she uses her sharp mind to solve crimes and mend broken hearts. But when her estranged father suddenly appears to reclaim her, the Harts are ready to fight for the daughter they've chosen.

data.title: Reign of the Indomitable
data.intro: Homes are forcefully demolished by the demolition team, heedless of the plea from an elderly woman awaiting her son's funeral. Despite her desperate pleas, they continue their merciless actions, threatening her with callous words as they attempt to tear down her home. The elderly woman's son was a revered warrior stationed at the western border, deserving of a dignified burial, yet his home is slated for destruction before his ashes can be returned to his family.

data.title: Slay to Fosters: I Took His Uncle
data.intro: Caroline Harrington, the only daughter of a top wealthy elite family in LA, concealed her true identity and broke away from her family to marry middle-class CEO Liam Foster. Throughout their marriage, she secretly used her family's resources to support Liam's business. However, Natty Parker, the youngest daughter of the Parker family, had long harbored feelings for Liam. She conspired with Liam's mother to set a trap.

data.title: My Secret Agent Husband 2
data.intro: After surviving the chaos of their first adventure, Lucas and his secret agent husband, Wyatt, finally settle into a new chapter of their lives. Lucas is thriving as CryptoLink's CEO, while Wyatt juggles his undercover missions. But just when they think they’ve found stability, old threats resurface, new betrayals unfold, and their long-awaited wedding is once again in jeopardy.

data.title: Once Scorned, Now Supreme
data.intro: Once hailed as a prodigy, William Quinn abandons his cultivation at the behest of his mentor’s dying wish, enduring three years of humiliation and scorn. When the promise is due, he awakens the Immortal Body and receives a marriage contract, only for his sect to mistakenly award his enemy as the honored fighter instead. During the Heir Selection, William returns in full force, shaking the Dela Drum and bringing his foes to their knees.

data.title: Crowned by His Love	(DUBBED)
data.intro: To escape the marriage her mother tried to force on her, Tina Carter has a one-night stand with Ethan Brooks and ends up unexpectedly pregnant. Five years later, Ethan discovers the truth: he has a son. As he fights to win back both Tina and his son, jealousy and sabotage from Zoe Turner threaten to tear them apart. Ethan risks everything to protect them. Just then, she finds she is the true heiress of the Turner family—switched at birth by the very woman she called mother.

data.title: When Suns Burn: Rise of the Chosen
data.intro: Adopted by the Zanes, Caleb Litt dedicates himself to taking care of their comatose son, Jim Zane, only to be murdered and abandoned in the forest after Jim awakens. But accidentally transported into a celestial realm, he cultivates for millennia before transforming into a divine being and returning to earth—where only seven years have passed, and the end is near with burning twin suns.

data.title: Between Goodbye and Forever: A Farewell of Love
data.intro: Princess Emilia York of Navara grows up alongside Zorvia's princes, knowing she must one day choose her husband—and the heir to the throne. Close to Lucius Tate since childhood, Emilia is expected to become his future wife—until he shocks everyone by insisting on marrying Winona Langston, turning Emilia into the object of ridicule. As she discovers true happiness with Conrad Tate, Lucius finally realizes his own feelings for her—but by then, it's too late.

data.title: Knockout King: The Ring of Retribution
data.intro: Transmigrated into the past as a young man who shares his name, boxing champion Derek Zane has no choice but to enter the underground boxing circuit to earn quick money for his ailing father and the family business his mother sacrificed her life to protect. Amidst sweat and blood, he finally confronts his mother's killer—each strike a debt paid for her death—as he fights to claim the throne as the boxing legend of his era.

data.title: The Heiress and Her Bodyguard
data.intro: In the hushed stillness of the night, Reginald met a tragic end in the sanctum of his study.Meanwhile, Emma, ensconced in the sterile walls of the hospital, received the heart-wrenching news of her father's demise. The very next day, Emma’s uncle, Ethan, exploiting Emma's newfound vulnerability in her blindness, demanded she relinquish her stake in the family empire.

data.title: Traded to Love You
data.intro: After seven years together, Elise Levin's boyfriend trades her like a business deal—handing her over to his young uncle, the cold and powerful Andre Harmon. To her surprise, instead of casting her aside, Andre marries her in a flash—exactly as he planned.

data.title: I Can Hear His Thoughts!
data.intro: After saving a mysterious elderly woman's life, Hailey Summers is stunned to discover that she's been gifted a bizarre power — she can hear her boss Ryker's thoughts just by touching him! With this unexpected mind-reading ability, Hailey turns her failing career around and even wins her boss's heart. But when the power is suddenly taken away, will everything still be the same?

data.title: Signed in Secret, Sealed in Farewell (DUBBED)
data.intro: Zoe Walker has been secretly married to Hansen Stone for four years, when to others, she is nothing more than his most capable subordinate. She always believes their relationship is unbreakable—until, under her mother-in-law’s lead, she gradually notices Hansen crossing the line with Tracy Gable, a young and lively lady. Not only does he take Tracy on private ski trips, but also let her do whatever she wants in the office.

data.title: When Love Transcends Time
data.intro: Gloria Mayer, once a skilled practitioner of medicine in her own time, finds herself unexpectedly transported to ancient times, where she assumes the role of the second daughter to a prominent prime minister. In this unfamiliar world, she is compelled into marriage with Prince Evan Pearce, a prince with physical limitations. Initially viewing the marriage as yet another obstacle, Gloria soon discovers that Prince Evan's affections run deeper than she had imagined.

data.title: If Only I Had Loved Her More
data.intro: On New Year's Eve, Bella Joslin is hospitalized due to a cancer relapse, while her husband, Hugo Pitt, spends the night at an amusement park with his secretary, Gwen Lowe. Denying Bella's illness, Hugo cuts off her financial support and showers Gwen with expensive gifts. Even as Bella faces a critical surgery, Hugo refuses to sign the consent form, leaving her alone. Yet, when Gwen has an allergic reaction, Hugo rushes her to the hospital in a panic.

data.title: Runway Queen's Revenge: My Rise, Your Ruin
data.intro: Marred by scandal, top model Nancy Turner sacrifices herself for Ivan Hunt's rise, only to have her heart shattered in return. Entering a flash marriage with another man, she soon faces threats from Ivan, who demands she serve as a stand-in on the runway for his pregnant mistress. Ivan continues to mistreat her—until her powerful husband steps in to protect her from the world.

data.title: Mr.Right & Ms.Wrong
data.intro: Tristan loses his sight in an accident and becomes emotional closed off and cold. Ashley, needing to care for her sick father, is forced into an arranged engagement with a blind Tristan. Mistaken for a servant, she endures his harsh treatment. But as they spend time together, their hearts begin to open, and an unexpected love grows between them, bringing healing and hope to their lives.

data.title: Ashes of Betrayal
data.intro: On the way to his girlfriend Louisa Astor's house for a meal, Henry Lowell and his mother, Agnes Byrd, are stranded by the roadside when Louisa receives a call from her childhood sweetheart. Left in the severe cold, Agnes tragically succumbs to a heart attack. Grieving his mother’s death, Henry ends his relationship with Louisa. However, unaware of Agnes’s passing, Louisa mistakes his solemn words for a mere tantrum.

data.title: Wedding Day Revenge: Ex, Watch Me Rise
data.intro: Sonya Bronte is left to cycle to her own wedding after Jake Harlow abandons her for his childhood sweetheart, Vera Caine. Devastated, she calls on Calvin Reid, who has long harbored feelings for her, to stand in as her groom. When Jake and Vera attempt to mock her, Sonya unveils her true identity—the wealthy heiress of the esteemed Bronte Corp.

data.title: Betrayal Cuts Deep, Revenge Hits Hard
data.intro: On her third wedding anniversary, Judy Gibson learns of Wayne York's betrayal from his best female friend—and first love—Maisie Quinn. She divorces Wayne and teams up with an old friend, Trevor Olson, to take them down. However, Maisie is hell-bent on destroying Judy at any cost, even if it means double-crossing Wayne. When Wayne finally learns the truth about his "true love," he can only despair over what he once had—and has now lost.

data.title: The Love She Lost to the World
data.intro: Claudia Zabel is the daughter of the Judd family’s maid. She fell for Hector Judd the moment she laid eyes on him. However, Hector’s heart had long been claimed by his childhood sweetheart, Natalie Yowell. At seventeen, he was even blinded in a car accident while trying to save her. Natalie eventually left Hector for another man. Meanwhile, Claudia stayed by his side and devotedly cared for him for seven years.

data.title: Objection! The Legal Queen in Charge Now
data.intro: Elly Spears, the undefeated queen of law, secretly builds a global empire but gives it all up for love. After marrying George, she becomes a housewife—only to be betrayed. During the high-profile Louis assassination case, George steals credit and pushes Elly to the brink. Humiliated and heartbroken, she loses her child and vows revenge. As Elly returns to claim her power, she reunites with Will Carpio, a hidden billionaire who has always loved her.

data.title: Death Answers to Me (DUBBED)
data.intro: Nina Bale is an immortal who controls life and death. A year ago, the head of the Ford family accidentally severed a geomantic vein, cursing his bloodline. To protect them, he traded his life for Nina's help—for just one year. Now, the Fords, tired of her presence, are ready to cast her out. But just as they do, the powerful Cork family arrives, falling to their knees. Only Nina can save their dying patriarch—and time is running out.

data.title: The CEO’s Baby Mama
data.intro: Vanessa Scott, a young woman struggling to save her sick sister, agrees to be a surrogate for a wealthy, enigmatic CEO, Alexander Moore. Unbeknownst to both, fate intertwines their lives further when Van unknowingly becomes Alex’s assistant. As secrets unravel and tensions rise, their growing attraction is threatened by misunderstandings, family pressure, and hidden pasts. Will love emerge from their tangled fates, or will deception tear them apart?

data.title: Cinders of a Love Once True
data.intro: An innocent woman, raised alongside two wealthy brothers, finds her life torn apart when a single lie from a scheming maid shatters fifteen years of trust, stealing her love and altering her destiny forever.

data.title: Falling for You, Time and Again
data.intro: Seven years ago, wealthy heiress Jenny Gale had a one-night stand with Harry Finch, a man struggling to make ends meet. Years later, Jenny's family faces bankruptcy, and she raises their daughter alone while battling her own illness. Meanwhile, Harry has become a billionaire, finally matching her social standing.

data.title: Forced to Love the Ruthless CEO
data.intro: To cover the medical expenses for her mother's surgery, college student Nina sells her first sexual experience at a hefty price to a stranger named Ian. Shortly after, her mother's condition deteriorates, and she urgently needs an artificial kidney transplant. Evan, a suitor of Nina's, takes her to seek help from his uncle. Nina is shocked to discover that the uncle is none other than Ian, the man from that fateful night.

data.title: Fated Love with My Fiancé's Uncle
data.intro: In a misunderstanding, Freya Brown was kept by Eric Cooper under a contract. In the two years of getting along, Freya, who could not speak, fell in love with Eric. Eric terminated the contract after learning that Freya was going to marry and fell in love with him. Eric went back to discuss his nephew's marriage, only to find out that his nephew's marriage partner was Freya...

data.title: Between Lies and Love
data.intro: Determined to tear apart Emma Boyer's marriage, Penny Chandler orchestrates a meeting between Emma and a stranger, hoping to drive the couple to divorce. However, Emma is unexpectedly rescued by Steve Chandler, who becomes her savior. As their bond deepens, Emma discovers she is pregnant with Steve’s only child.

data.title: Alpha’s  Perfect  Love
data.intro: Alpha Liam finds out that his mate, Dora, is a regular human who hates werewolves to her guts. To be with her, Liam keeps his werewolf identity a secret and pretends to be a regular human, not knowing that a mystery child is going to reveal a deep secrete of them from 5 years ago…

data.title: The Deal with Love
data.intro: Katherine, a single girl with no intimate relationship, gets knocked up to her own surprise, like Virgin Marry. Right upon she gets informed of the pregnancy, her CEO Felix's fiancée jumps out claiming that the mysterious father of the baby is Katherine’s boss, Felix Morgan. However, Mr. Morgan seems to have no clue nor interest in this unexpected baby…

data.title: Faded Petals: Our Once-Promised Love
data.intro: Once, Dana Flint was the cherished daughter of a wealthy family, while Keith Baker was a talented yet impoverished man who could only afford inexpensive clothing. Now, six years later, the tables have turned. Dana, a single mother, faces daily struggles for survival, while Keith has ascended to the upper class—a wealthy man whose words can easily determine another’s future.

data.title: Don't You Sleep with Me
data.intro: Clara agrees to marry her best friend's fiancé, per her request, only to find out that he is her former crush! In order to protect her best friend's marriage, she racks her brain for all kinds of excuses to avoid intimate contact with Miles, but somehow keeps falling into a deeper trap.

data.title: The Wife's Gambit
data.intro: After discovering her husband Eric's betrayal and secret sterilization plot, Lauren joins forces with Cindy, a woman he once framed, to take revenge. Together, they create a seductive trap that drives Eric into financial and emotional ruin. As the plan unfolds and Lauren's ex-lover Miles reappears, vengeance collides with love and morality. In destroying Eric, Lauren must confront whether she's reclaiming justice—or losing herself completely.

data.title: I Left You in the Dust of Me
data.intro: After losing her family's favor to Selene Jayle, Merrin Jayle falls for Lucien Falkner, hoping for love. But after marriage, she learns he's been manipulating her into donating blood to Selene. Heartbroken, Merrin ends the relationship. Even after Lucien loses his legs in Selene's schemes and tries to make amends, she refuses to forgive.

data.title: The Rejected and Unstoppable
data.intro: After traveling through time into the body of the Marsh family's live-in son-in-law, Ethan Wells is subjected to indifference, humiliation, harsh criticism, and constant oppression. Faced with a life-threatening crisis, he finally decides to fight back—using his unique talents to claim his rights and carve out a path to his own redemption, setting the stage for his moment to shine.

data.title: From Red Carpet to Dirt Road
data.intro: Yvonne Shaw was a popular celebrity before she accidentally travels back in time and becomes a villager in the 1980s, where she gets caught red-handed in an affair by her fiancé. However, this is all part of her fiancé’s scheme to call off their marriage! To preserve her reputation, Yvonne decides to marry the man she was found in bed with, unaware that her seemingly ordinary husband is the director of the Steelworks Factory!

data.title: Love on the No-Go List
data.intro: Ariel Adler's dying mother longs to see her daughter married. For 27 days, Ariel pleads with her boyfriend of six years, Ivan Nash, to wed her. He agrees—but never appears before her mother's death. Instead, on the very first day Ariel begged him for marriage, he wed Karen Scott. Shattered, Ariel severs all ties with him, only to rise stronger than before and discover true love with another man.

data.title: His Dangerous Obsession
data.intro: Austin Gorman, the illegitimate son of a powerful family, returns from overseas service—only to find himself hunted by the directors of his family's company in a ruthless power struggle. While on the run, he crosses paths with Diane Hoover, who saves him, and that fateful night becomes the beginning of their destined love.

data.title: Kiss Me, Even if It Burns
data.intro: As an orphan and Dylan Pitt's bodyguard, Scarlet Novak stands by him through every rise and fall, yet never truly obeys him. To break her defiance, he torments her under the guise of his first love—but she refuses to yield and even fakes her death to escape. Desperate, he brings her back and erases her memories through hypnosis, only to realize that a world without her means nothing to him.

data.title: Our Love Died First
data.intro: Aaron Miller and Sophia Lawson, a couple envied by all, face the greatest challenge of their relationship when he discovers that she has been cheating on him for three years. Devastated by her betrayal, Aaron fakes his death by jumping into the river on their wedding day. As he embraces a new life under a new identity, Sophia is left to drown in regret and agony.

data.title: Touching Your Heartbeat
data.intro: A contract marriage for the survival of the head of a conglomerate infected with a deadly poison and a poor college girl with the only antidote ability that could save him. A fateful romance that transcends death and misunderstanding, saving each other and leading to true love.

data.title: When Love Was All and Nothing
data.intro: After six years of being deeply in love with Dan Irvin, Flora Kent discovers that she was merely a replacement for his first love, Iris Lake. Heartbroken, Flora decides to go through with her family's arranged marriage. Left with Iris, Dan eventually uncovers her true nature and punishes her for it. Later, he receives a wedding invitation from Flora's brother, Evan Kent, and sees this as his chance to win Flora back.

data.title: Lies Worn as Love
data.intro: For seven years, Riley Jensen trusted Noah Archer—only to discover he lied about having a split personality disorder and that she had endured relentless torment from Morgan Walker. When the pain finally eclipses her love, Riley divorces him and opens her heart to someone new.

data.title: Fated to Miss: The Luna in His Dreams
data.intro: Amelia and Daniel, separated as kids when Amelia was captured, spent ten years searching for each other. When they finally met, they didn ’ t recognize each other and, due to misunderstandings, missed their chance to reconnect.

data.title: Call Me Gone and Gorgeous
data.intro: Lois Glyn cared for blind Arthur Herbert for five years, only to be betrayed and replaced by Juliet Glyn. Dying in despair, she's reborn and chooses to let go of Arthur—but Juliet won't let her go. At a banquet, Juliet frames her for theft and turns her parents against her, leaving her for dead in a car crash. Disheartened, Lois cuts all ties—until Arthur learns the truth and begins a desperate pursuit.

data.title: Married a Secret Millionaire as a Substitute
data.intro: In order to pay for her mother's medical expenses, Olivia Walker, the illegitimate child of the Walker family, marries a poor ex-convict in place of her sister. She has no idea that this man is, in fact, Andrew Smith, the richest person in Cascadia. Their lives then take a sweet but dangerous turn.

data.title: Take Me Home
data.intro: On the day of her son Adam's 6th birthday, Helen Walker, living in a small town, leaves him momentarily to buy a birthday cake, only for him to go missing. At the same time, Elon Hall, a passing businessman, rescues Adam and unknowingly adopts him, taking him to New York. Twenty years later, Adam, now the heir to Hall Group, is sent to Camden to handle a real estate project.

data.title: Love in the Wrong Name
data.intro: Disguised as a man, Taylor Snow becomes the top scholar, but is drugged by the princess and spends the night with the feared Prime Minister Wyatt Xyler, leaving him impotent. Terrified, Taylor fakes illness to avoid court, but neither the princess nor Wyatt intends to let her off the hook.

data.title: Falling Into Ceo's Embrace
data.intro: In order to reject the marriage arranged by his grandmother, Lucas claims that he would only marry if a bride falls from the sky, as it would be God's will. At once, Michelle falls from a tree while trying to save a puppy. To accept 'God's will',  Lucas and Michelle hastily get married and then he goes abroad. Michelle, who haven't seen Lucas for four years, falls in love with her boss Lucas at work but hesitates to confess,  because of his married status....

data.title: When Silence Breaks Her Heart
data.intro: Cara and Leander were once a married couple, but after a car accident involving a pregnant woman named Kara—Leander's first love who has a name almost identical to hers—his hidden secret shatters their seemingly perfect marriage. As an educated and principled doctor, Cara faces betrayal with dignity, balancing family responsibilities and personal pride. After a series of conflicts and realizations, she decides to divorce and study abroad while caring for her aging parents.

data.title: Unveiling Her Secret After Divorce
data.intro: In an unexpected turn of events, Abigail Rowe shared an intimate encounter with her long-time love, Jordan Larson, ultimately leading to their marriage. Throughout their three-year union, Abigail concealed her true identity, enduring humiliation, and torment, desperately hoping for Jordan's reciprocation. It wasn't until Jordan decided to donate his corneas to Claire Haynes that Abigail finally gave up on him.

data.title: I Conned a Billionaire to Be My Husband
data.intro: Amelia, a struggling sales woman, gets a visit by her estranged brother who blackmails her into a job of assuming someone else’s identity and seducing CEO Noah Greer in order to tank Greer Corp or else her mother might be killed. Under pressure, Amelia applies a job at Greer Corp and runs into Noah accidentally. However she doesn’t recognize him despite saving him years ago, while Noah vaguely remembers her by her name tag.

data.title: Once a Joke, Now a Jewel
data.intro: Winona Talbot, a modern-day doctor, is stunned to wake up in the body of a woman from the past who shares her name. After disrupting her ex-fiancé’s wedding, she unexpectedly wins favor with her in-laws by saving her stepson, Joseph Scott, subtly shifting their perception of her. Determined to change, Winona discovers her weight gain is caused by poison. She ventures into the mountains, finds a rare herb for treatment, and earns her first income.

data.title: The Divorced Heiress' Fightback (DUBBED)
data.intro: Having fallen victim to a scheme orchestrated by June West, Mona West is wrongly accused of having an affair with her brother-in-law, resulting in the loss of her child due to a miscarriage. To Mona's dismay, her husband, Hubert Jones, places more trust in June than in his own wife, going as far as pouring their child’s ashes on her.Feeling devastated, Mona believes she has nothing left in her life under such hopeless circumstances.

data.title: The Return of the Unwanted Wife
data.intro: I made a deal with the demon for the man I love to reach his peak. The price was harsh: should he never love me in return, I’d have to give up my own life. Yet, after five years of marriage, my hope that his heart might soften towards me shattered completely. Instead of the love I yearned for, I was served divorce papers, a cold reminder of my failure. The demon came to collect its due, but in the twist of fate, a soul sacrificed her own to restore mine. Now that I’m back…

data.title: Star of Fortune: Luck Is My Superpower
data.intro: Elena, the heavens' blessed star, is reborn as the daughter of the calculating Crown Prince Conrad Silva. Mistaking his other daughter, Gloria, for the blessed maiden, Conrad tries to have Elena killed. Saved by the disabled Prince Jason Silva, she restores his health, helps him rise to the throne, and uncovers her true lineage on her path to victory and family.

data.title: Thistles and Thorns: Her Rise to the Top
data.intro: Rose Yale, the daughter of a commander’s concubine, endures bullying at home and tragically loses her elder sister, who tried to shield her. To protect herself and the people she loves, Rose gets herself into the palace and rises against the noble consorts led by the Reeds. With her cunning, she eventually wins the emperor’s heart and defeats the other consorts, ultimately triumphing over the Reeds.

data.title: The Power System: Marry and Conquer
data.intro: After an accident during a field expedition, history doctorate Mateo Levin wakes up in the body of an orphan in a chaotic era. With only his limited farming knowledge to survive, he scrapes by—until the MarryBoost System activates. From that moment, he rises through strategy and charm, evolving from a humble farmer into an unstoppable ruler.

data.title: Daddy Mommy Don't Divorce
data.intro: Dexter, the president, and Lilian, a recent graduate, spend the night together after their families move to get a marriage license without ever meeting. Six years later, Dexter comes back from abroad and hires Lilian as his personal assistant. What they don’t know is they are husband and wife both trying to get a divorce from each other. But with the help of their adorable son Danny, the two will realize their destiny and gradually fall back in love.

data.title: He Who Shaped the Empire
data.intro: After years of devoted service to the late emperor, Cedric Zeller is worn out, having sacrificed his health for the good of the nation. But when the new female emperor, Xaviera Spencer, ascends the throne, she replaces him with Lucas Quinton, a scheming official unworthy of such a crucial post. Cedric has sworn to the late emperor that he will endure Xaviera a hundred times—but after that, he intends to leave without ever looking back.

data.title: Queen of the Battlefield: Her Return to Glory
data.intro: Sophie Devin uses her formidable strength to defend the nation in honor of her father and brother, who lost their lives on the battlefield. However, for the sake of assuring her mother, she promises to hide her capabilities and stop involving herself in the battles. Instead, she marries Blake Jaffe, the man her mother has chosen for her, and embraces a life as an ordinary woman. On their wedding day, Blake leaves for a mission and returns only a year later.

data.title: My Love, Out of Service (DUBBED)
data.intro: For five years, Finn Carter has silently fulfilled a contract signed with Renee Lane's mother—to heal her daughter's shattered heart. Day by day, he builds a life with a woman who sees him as nothing more than a placeholder for her first love. When Mike Smith's return coincides with the contract's end, Finn recognizes his cue to exit the stage of Renee's life.

data.title: Rewound in Time, Master of the Board
data.intro: In 1976, nine-time Go champion Ronan Smith meets a pair of immortals and plays a game for one of them. After that single game, 49 years pass in the mortal world, and Ronan is given a magical peach that transforms him into a ten-year-old again. In 2025, Ronan returns home as a child, unsurprisingly facing doubts and numerous obstacles. He proves his identity by solving the Labyrinth Go, saves his wife with the magical peach, and uncovers a deeper family conspiracy.

data.title: Lottery System Dad: Hearts to Win, Fate to Rewrite
data.intro: Andy Grant time-travels to an ancient era of famine and finds himself the resented father of five daughters. But despite a terrible start, he awakens the HeartBond System where winning the girls' favor can get him resources, so he works hard and eventually earns them a comfortable life. Unexpectedly, their mothers begin arriving one by one—and each of them holds an extraordinary status.

data.title: I Hid My Crown, Not My Power
data.intro: The wealthy Lucas Hale hands Pearly Trent, a street cleaner, a bank card. He wishes to help her, knowing he is dying soon and has no use for his money. She claims she can cure him, but is mocked relentlessly. When even the top doctors fail, she reveals that she is the legendary "Ms. Panacea" and saves Lucas. Then she leaves without a word. Later, her fiancé refuses to go through with their wedding and insists on marrying another woman.

data.title: A Duet of Happily Ever Afters
data.intro: Serena and Anna Zahn are on the run from Anna's abusive husband when Serena crosses paths with Shane and Victor Moore. Serena has a one-night stand with Shane and, a month later, discovers she's pregnant. As she's about to abort the child, Shane finds her and proposes marriage. He brings both Serena and Anna back to his home. As the Zahn sisters and the Moore brothers live under one roof, sparks fly with every interaction.

data.title: Reveal, Rise and Reign
data.intro: Lance West generously supports his girlfriend, Lara Olson, throughout her academic journey. Thanks to his financial assistance, she successfully graduates and attains significant financial success, earning tens of millions annually. Despite Lance's unwavering support, Lara callously severs their relationship, citing the gap in their social statuses. However, in the wake of this heartbreak, fate intervenes.

data.title: When Lies Speak Again
data.intro: Framed by his adopted brother Shawn Warner, who uses his mind-reading ability to manipulate others, Howard Warner loses all connections and his reputation, ultimately falling victim to betrayal by his own family. Reborn and hardened, Howard no longer desires familial affection. Cutting all ties, he takes the first step toward revenge without hesitation. The moment he hears Shawn's familiar voice trying to slander and manipulate him once more, he knows it's time to act.

data.title: Racing to My Heart
data.intro: Zoey, a janitor for a racing team, finds herself betrayed and exploited by her husband, James. As she seeks a way out, James proves unwilling to grant her an easy divorce. In her moments of need, her boss, the renowned NASCAR champion Justin, steps in to assist. Their shared trials spark a growing affection between them. Just as they grapple with revealing their feelings, Justin discovers that Zoey is, in fact, his long-lost childhood sweetheart.

data.title: You Were My Everything, Once
data.intro: As a token of gratitude, Morgan White agrees to Lily Oswald's grandfather’s request, hiding his true identity as a researcher and marrying into the Oswald family as Lily’s seemingly ordinary husband. For eight years, he tenderly cares for Lily and their child, but her heart remains with her first love, Brett Oswald.

data.title: Found You, Heart Thief
data.intro: Luke finally finds a woman he's not allergic to. He proposes immediately, but Emma, aware he's her boss, rejects him and flees. Unexpectedly, she bumps into him at work the next day. To her surprise, Luke doesn't recognize her in her usual attire. He even mistakenly thinks Emma's infatuated with him. So he warns her off, claiming his heart belongs to his true love—that date girl. Unbeknownst to him, that girl is none other than Emma, standing right before him!

data.title: Fortunes Unveiled: My Husband Is a Big Shot（DUBBED）
data.intro: On the first day of Chinese New Year, Jay Wade pays a visit to his wife's family, only to be ill-treated with contempt. Little do they know that Jay is, in fact, the chairman of Win Corp, one of the top ten companies in the world.

data.title: My Three Knights
data.intro: Rita once gave everything to her boyfriend, Henry—dropping out of school and working as a food delivery girl to support his startup. But her world falls apart when she discovers that Henry has been betraying her. Humiliated and thrown out of their home, she finds herself with nothing. Just when she hits rock bottom, three men appear and take her back to the Hart family estate.

data.title: Oops, I Accidentally Made You Rich!
data.intro: Ruby Young, known as the Golden Child, brings fortune to those around her. However, her mischievous antics in the Celestial Realm—culminating in devouring all the celestial peaches at the Celestial Peach Banquet—force Richard Shaw to send her to the mortal world for training and to spread fortune among humans. As expected, Ruby faces numerous challenges, but fate leads her to Sue Dean, an unlucky CEO struggling even to keep her restaurant afloat.

data.title: Chasing My Rejected Wife
data.intro: Love, lies, and mistaken identities! … As Aileen Smith navigated her new life at work, she unexpectedly fell deeply for her boss—THE BILLIONAIRE. But Aileen had been married for a year, although she and her husband's encounters were so scarce they could barely recall each other's faces. Through a series of jaw-dropping twists, Aileen was stunned to discover that the captivating CEO was, in fact, her husband...

data.title: To Be By My Side
data.intro: Ten years ago, Aurora Miller waited all night in the rain for a pen pal who never showed—shattering her faith in love. Now, she enters a sudden marriage with an honorable former sailor, Damien Hawke… only to discover he's the very man she once waited for. Fate reunited them—but can trust survive the truth?

data.title: Your Scheme, My Countermove
data.intro: Coming from an insignificant background, Rhea Tate earns a place at a prestigious university. But one mistake—dating the principal's son, Lex Gray—threatens everything. Despite all her hard work, she loses it all in an instant. Mocked and bullied by Sally Logan, and burdened with her mother's illness, Rhea faces a dire choice. With her scholarship at stake, how far will she go to save her mother and secure her future?

data.title: When He Lifts the Hammer
data.intro: The God of Blades, Ian Gould, has traded his legendary past for obscurity—living quietly as an overlooked son-in-law. But peace ends when Lori Kurtz, a senior from Artisan Hall, descends to seize Highblade Manor's most valuable mine. Cornered and out of options, Highblade stakes everything on a forging duel. To protect the mine—and the family that scorns him—Ian must finally break his silence, unveil his true mastery, and reclaim the name feared across the realm.

data.title: Sold As The Alpha King's Breeder
data.intro: Rosalie thinks her father sold her to the ruthless future Alpha King Ethan as a maid, but she's actually there to be his breeder. Though she falls for him, she learns he plans to kill her after childbirth. Heartbroken, she escapes with Madalynn’s help, faking her death. Ethan realizes too late she's his mate and searches for her. Rosalie starts a new life, but Ethan finds her, saves her from danger, and slowly earns back her love.

data.title: House of Cards: All In or Nothing
data.intro: While the festive season closes in, Claudia Roman loses 200 thousand dollars in a gambling scheme plotted by her best friend Jane White. The money was meant for her daughter's tuition, her father's medical bills, and the living expenses of her family of three, so to win the money back, Matt Swain joins the game. Initially, he intended to leave after winning the same amount back, but Jane and Kelvin Grant kidnap Claudia, forcing him back into the gamble.

data.title: From Fifty to Fearless: Rising to Rule All
data.intro: Neo Baar, a man in his fifties, regains his youth through the System amid chaos and wins the hearts of several women. To survive, he strikes a deal with the wounded General Ava Jagger and sneaks into the military camp with her, where she disguises herself as a man—searching for a way to rise.

data.title: She Is Not Your Wife: Love Actually All Around
data.intro: Julianna Belle, once a wealthy heiress, is left destitute and taken in by the Jeffrey family. Growing up alongside Kelly Jeffrey, their relationship is a tense mix of dependence and rivalry that continues into adulthood. One fateful night, Julianna saves Osmond Landon, a client she meets by chance, leading to an unexpected one-night stand.

data.title: Blade of Destiny
data.intro: Joe Lowe, the almighty Sword Sage, once conquered the world and stood above all. However, he could never forgive himself for causing his wife's death, so he punished himself by striking the Mending Stone ten thousand times every day. After 30 years, the stone finally split in half, but Joe, exhausted beyond his limits, took his last breath. Unexpectedly, his soul endured.

data.title: The Virgin's Deal with Her Sugar Daddy
data.intro: Medical student Charlotte sells herself to cardiac surgeon Noah to save her grandmother. What begins as a financial arrangement gradually develops into genuine feelings. However, their relationship faces numerous trials: Noah's ex-girlfriend Emily shows up with a "love child," Charlotte's grandmother's life is threatened, and Robert's schemes create further turmoil. In the end, the truth comes to light, and the couple ends up together.

data.title: Slay Queen's Second Life
data.intro: She reincarnates before her wedding and exacts fierce revenge on her scheming bestie and heartless freeloading husband, saving her family from ruin.

data.title: Ties That Bind
data.intro: Myla Abner, whose real name is Bella Stone, is the daughter of a wealthy family in Valia known as the Stones. She was abandoned in a fire during a family trip in the mountains when they chose to save her brother instead of her. Surviving against the odds, Myla is later taken in by Sarah Abner, who raises her under the assumption that she has lost her memory. Fourteen years later, Myla goes to work and coincidentally has her long-lost brother, Ben Stone, as her superior.

data.title: Three Years Old, Luck Follows Her Steps
data.intro: Yvette Turner, daughter of the general's long-lost heiress Jane Turner, finally returns to her rightful family home—only to face the schemes of Jane's adopted sister, Megan Turner. After Yvette's lonely death, the ancient Harbinger rises in her place, exacting vengeance on Megan, earning the general's favor, and even helping Jane overcome her fears to survive the trials ahead.

data.title: Lusting For The Hot New Preacher
data.intro: In a small town, a fiercely independent single mom working for the stoic and ambitious new preacher at her Christian church, finds herself in a dangerous dance of forbidden attraction while battling her powerful ex-husband for custody of her son.

data.title: Ride or Lie: Falling For The Racing Kingpin In Disguise
data.intro: An undercover agent infiltrates an illegal racing syndicate to assassinate its mysterious Kingpin—only to discover he's the man who once saved her life, forcing her to choose between duty, desire, and vengeance as buried secrets about her father's death resurface.

data.title: The Billionaire I Dumped is My New Boss
data.intro: After junior designer Ava Harrison has a one-night stand with a charming "construction worker," she disappears the next morning—misled by the lies of his manipulative ex-girlfriend. She never suspects the man she ditched is actually William Baker, the billionaire CEO now revealed as her new boss. As old misunderstandings collide with new desires, the question remains: will the truth finally pull them together, or tear their second chance apart?

data.title: My Professor Is My Alpha Mate
data.intro: When Lila kisses a stranger to get back at her cheating ex-boyfriend, she has no idea she's just locked lips with Colton Denizen, a billionaire and her esteemed college professor. Their passionate yet secretive relationship leads them into a thrilling adventure. Together, they must unravel the mystery and bring down the elusive Rogue King. Lila and Colton's bond is tested in ways they never imagined. Will their love survive the secrets and perils they uncover?

data.title: Pregnant with My Brother's Baby
data.intro: After a one-night stand with Devin, who is not related to her by blood, Sabrina discovers that she is pregnant with his child. To avoid subjecting the child to gossip and rumors, Sabrina feels compelled to return to her unfaithful husband. However, Devin keenly senses that something is amiss. After a series of struggles and misunderstandings, the two of them ultimately end up together...

data.title: Ex-Wife, Meet My New Love
data.intro: After transmigrating, Nate Jepsen divorces his CEO wife, Daisy Ernst, who wants to reunite with her first love. He lets her go without a second thought. But when she realizes she still needs him, she rushes to win him back—only to find him in a relationship with her rival, Joan Olson.

data.title: My Heart No Longer Beats for You (DUBBED)
data.intro: Terry Ford does everything he can to win over Helen Yale, the woman known for her cool demeanor and distant heart. For six years, they're together—but not once do they cross the line into true intimacy. Then one day, the truth hits him: Helen has only stayed by his side in an attempt to bury her lingering feelings for their neighbor, Shaun Jensen. Hurt and unwilling to live in someone else's shadow, Terry makes the hardest decision of all—he walks away.

data.title: The Hero Who Walks Among Us
data.intro: Greg Wright, formerly the Supreme Commander of Darvon, retired and became a humble street sweeper. One day, after finishing work, he returns home only to find his daughter-in-law and her mother occupying his house without reason. Mercilessly thrown out of his own home, he wanders aimlessly and ends up rescuing a young girl named Xenia Janz from a group of bullies. Grateful for his help, Xenia introduces him to her mother, Yvonne Zeller, the CEO of a renowned company.

data.title: I Rise, You Fall, That's the Rule (DUBBED)
data.intro: To repay her biological parents, Sara Cole leaves her foster family—the wealthiest in Xonos—to reunite with the Rowes, only to face neglect, bias, and even a false three-year sentence. But her struggles don't end there. Upon release, she is forcibly taken away. Even when she returns to the Coles, they still expect her to beg for acceptance.

data.title: No One Waits Forever (DUBBED)
data.intro: After being in love with Ryan Zeller for seven years, Lydia Russell is devastated to learn that he wants to break up and plans to marry Claire Shaw instead—simply because Claire is as pure and obedient as Lydia once was. Respecting his wishes, Lydia walks away and marries Jonah Brown, the most powerful man in Glayden. Yet on her wedding day, Ryan finally realizes he needs her by his side.

data.title: Marry Again My Billionaire Ex
data.intro: After a tragic crash kills her parents, Alexandra Grey assumes a new identity Adrianna for safety. Years later, Lucien, the man she married for protection, asks for a divorce. Heartbroken, she reclaims her true self and returns to take her father‘s company. But claiming her CEO title requires fulfilling a secret arranged marriage—to Lucien. As the danger escalates, he becomes her unlikely ally, and ultimately, her love.

data.title: At Her Behest: The Lady's Dominion (DUBBED)
data.intro: Released from a three-year imprisonment in jail in place of her boyfriend, Jim Norman, Ciara Lopez learns that she is the Lady of Dragon Hall. She plans to marry Jim, but he is set to wed her best friend, Fanny Todd. Meanwhile, Ciara discovers that her father has endured harassment from loan sharks for the past three years because of her. Determined to uncover the truth, she visits the Emperor Hotel and witnesses Jim’s cold-bloodedness firsthand.

data.title: Just Married, Just Divorced
data.intro: Choi Yu Na returns from overseas to celebrate her brother Choi Woo Chan's birthday. However, his fiancée, Song Ji Yeon, insists that Yu Na is a mistress. The misunderstanding quickly escalates into malicious bullying, and Yu Na suffers a miscarriage. Upon learning what happened on the wedding day, Woo Chan vows to clear Yu Na's name. Ji Yeon and her family beg for mercy, but in the process, they inadvertently reveal their ugly true colors and a shocking conspiracy.

data.title: Hurt Me,Love Me
data.intro: Even though Katherine and Eric got married, Eric was still entangled with Riley, which caused Katherine great suffering. Despite her pain, Katherine endured it out of guilt and deep love. Unexpectedly, she became pregnant again, but Eric continued to neglect and hurt her. For the sake of their lost child, Katherine decided to divorce.

data.title: The Devil Wears Desire
data.intro: A woman with a failing heart becomes the center of a dangerous love quadrangle, torn between her amnesiac childhood sweetheart, a cold billionaire concealing his true feelings, a ruthless playboy heir, and an obsessive crime lord with a transplanted heart, as she navigates a maze of secret contracts, false identities, and twisted passions in a high-stakes game of love and survival.

data.title: Oops! I married a CEO by mistake
data.intro: Abigail lies dead in the hospital, while her fiancé Kyle and stepsister Chloe gloat over their murder of her.	Overhearing their evil plan, Abigail later comes back to life and immediately marries a broke model named Henry as revenge.	Abigail thinks her marriage is all just a play, but when she faces betrayal and difficulties, Henry secretly helps her. However, just as things are getting real between them, she finds out a shocking secret about Henry’s identity...

data.title: The Untamed: His Fury of Retribution
data.intro: Just before Micah Wright seeks guidance from the Moon Goddess, he is forced to give up his ninth-grade core to the girlfriend who betrayed him. Five years later, he finds himself cultivating in a random sect but continues to struggle with making any breakthroughs due to the loss of his core.

data.title: Mafia Daddy Next Door
data.intro: A former mob enforcer turned single mother, Veronica was once drugged and set up by a crime boss to spend a night with mafia king Clive—unaware she would give birth to a daughter later trafficked as leverage to secure his loyalty. For years, Veronica searched for her stolen child, while Clive secretly hunted for the woman from that night.

data.title: Hit Me Hard, Make Me Mighty
data.intro: Max Clark transmigrates into a cultivation world as a worthless playboy—but awakens a system that makes him stronger every time he's beaten. If ten minutes pass without a hit, the system will erase him. Desperate, he must find ways to get beaten while the female lead, carrying grudges from her past life, is reborn.

data.title: Jilted to Jewel: The Rejected Bride's Rise
data.intro: On her wedding day, Maya York discovers that her fiancé, is having an affair with her sister. She even learns that she is adopted and is subsequently thrown out. However, she soon finds out she is the sole heir of the prestigious Stone family. Back at her true home, Maya is doted on by the CEO of Stone Group. She also meets her new fiancé. However, her adoptive family continues to challenge and humiliate her. So Maya decides to make them pay for their mistreatment.

data.title: Bow Down, The Killer Queen is Back
data.intro: Reborn as the disfigured Carly Eaton, the top assassin sets out to avenge her host. On her quest for justice, she accidentally saves Jasper Moore, the city's most powerful man—and instantly captures his attention.

data.title: Signed in Secret, Sealed in Farewell
data.intro: Zoe Walker has been secretly married to Hansen Stone for four years, when to others, she is nothing more than his most capable subordinate. She always believes their relationship is unbreakable—until, under her mother-in-law’s lead, she gradually notices Hansen crossing the line with Tracy Gable, a young and lively lady. Not only does he take Tracy on private ski trips, but also let her do whatever she wants in the office.

data.title: Pampered by Him
data.intro: Lia was arranged a blind date by her stepmother. To teach the guy a lesson, Lia caught a handsome guy, Jeremy, and kissed him in front of the man. Although the man left her angrily, she found herself trapped in bigger trouble. That man was the famous President of the Smith Group, Jeremy Smith, at the cafe to meet his contract bride. However, she did not show up, and Lia snatched his first kiss instead.

data.title: Love Reckoning
data.intro: She thought she married her savior—the man who gave her his kidney. But it was a lie. The true donor was the orphan her father raised, the loyal protector who loved her all along. Betrayed, nearly murdered by her scheming husband, she returns from the dead, burning for revenge. Love or vengeance—what will she choose?

data.title: Where We Begin Once More
data.intro: When Renee Locke crosses paths with Jace Frost again, she is now the modest representative of the second party, while he holds the position of the esteemed principal party. It feels just like their school days—when she admired him from afar, and he was the most popular student, infatuated with someone else. Years may have passed, but Renee's heart still races at the mere sight of him.

data.title: Love at Midnight
data.intro: After signing the divorce agreement, Stella determined to break free from the past. However, she met Dereck at a bar, a handsome and mysterious man whose appearance injected new sparks into the story. Dereck timely helped Stella out of trouble, and the relationship between the two began to heat up.

data.title: All I Want Is Your Heart
data.intro: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Madison Pearce breaks up with him and meets Seth Doyle, leading to a night that unexpectedly binds them together. When she discovers that Seth is her ex's cousin, she tries to cut ties, but he relentlessly pursues her, showering her with love. What she doesn't realize is that his pursuit has nothing to do with that night—he had fallen for her long before.

data.title: My Heartless Alpha
data.intro: Rejected by her mate and cast out of her werewolf pack, Avery meets Ryan, the feared Alpha of the largest wolf pack in America. Despite the rumor of him being heartless, she finds herself falling for him, with an uncertain fate ahead.

data.title: Forever, Gone With Her(DUBBED)
data.intro: To repay Tim Holt for saving his life, Hugo Keller marries Elise Holt, who has secretly loved him for years. But after three loveless years of marriage, Elise realizes that his heart belongs to Piper Upton. To free him without forcing him to break his promise, she fakes her death and pursues her dreams—only for Hugo to discover that he cannot bear a life without her.

data.title: Super Crush
data.intro: On the eve of the professional football league's Super Bowl, an unknown reporter named Bella is assigned a last-minute interview with Mark, a famous football star—and her former flame from seven years ago. Bella, raised as the nanny's daughter in a wealthy household, was unjustly mistreated by the family's heiress, Rose. In truth, Bella was secretly switched at birth and is the rightful heir, but the nanny and Rose conspired to force her out.

data.title: Spoiling My Sweet Wife to Her Core（DUBBED)
data.intro: On the day of the engagement, Anne Miller was framed in a cheating scandal. Her fiance, Shawn Smith, was furious and vowed never to marry Anne. She knew that her pretentious step-sister, Elsa Miller, was the mastermind behind it all. Shawn believed entirely in Elsa's lies. Devastated, Anne died with resentment and regret.A soul of a heroine—who shared the same name as Anne—transmigrated into Anne Miller's body and swore to avenge her.

data.title: The Officer Fell For Me
data.intro: Lorenzo found Jane's photo in a dead comrade's stuff. He protected her from harassment at the base, thinking she was the comrade's widow. This led to misunderstandings. Jane uncovered a deadly plot. Lorenzo, jealous and deceptive, pushed her away, and she left, tricked by a rival. Believing him missing, she sought revenge but was trapped. Lorenzo rescued...

data.title: Peace Out, Toxic (DUBBED)
data.intro: Seven years into a loveless marriage, Roxy York has endured torment from her mother-in-law and neglect from her husband, Clyde Cohen. When she uncovers their deceit, she files for divorce and sets out to reclaim her life. By the time Clyde realizes what he's lost, all he can do is watch her flourish—thriving in a world where he no longer belongs.

data.title: Fool Me Once Revenge On You
data.intro: Eartha Buckman, the heir to the most established corporation in Grimmington City, basks in the fairytale romance with her boyfriend Kevin, only to find he’s conspiring to kill her father and to swallow her family wealth. After surviving the hellish year in jail, Eartha comes out a brand-new woman with a vendetta—making Kevin lose everything he cares about.

data.title: Beyond the Spirit Galaxy, He Commands All
data.intro: Evan Carson transmigrates into a world where everyone can connect to the Spirit Galaxy. He fails to do so for three years straight, prompting the campus belle to cut ties with him. What she doesn’t know is that while Evan cannot connect to the Spirit Galaxy, he can connect to the Mythic Galaxy and make pacts with mythical figures to rise against all odds.

data.title: Love Falls Apart, Hearts Break Free
data.intro: It's been nearly a decade since Hansel Harris and Serena Page first fell in love, but even a bond forged by time and devotion can falter under the weight of misunderstandings and betrayal. Only after losing Serena for good does Hansel finally see the truth. Yet after everything they've endured, can he ever win her back?

data.title: What Makes a Mother
data.intro: When Joanne Lawson learns that her daughter, Sara Flynn, is being bullied at school, she intervenes to protect her and exposes Lydia Quinn for falsely claiming to have a connection to Edgar Flynn. Although Lydia tries everything she can to defend herself, Joanne confronts her fiercely, making sure she and her husband face the consequences they deserve.

data.title: Redemption of the Heart
data.intro: After six years of marriage, Sarah Jordan became nothing more than a caretaker to Joe Fitch, working tirelessly and losing herself in the process. When Joe wanted to drive her away because Mary Grant returned, Sarah filed for divorce. When they met again, Sarah transformed into a confident and successful businesswoman, effortlessly negotiating at the table. Joe Fitch, once the powerful president of the Fitch Corporation, was no longer worthy of standing by her side.

data.title: For Love and Nothing Less (DUBBED)
data.intro: Seven years ago, Luna Sawyer was pregnant when she discovered that her boyfriend, Samuel Payne—who was battling cancer—was secretly the heir to Payne Corp in Reydon. Samuel was offered a deal: if he broke up with Luna, they would pay for his treatment. But deeply in love with her, he rejected the offer, unaware that Luna had overheard the conversation. Determined not to hold Samuel back, Luna silently chose to leave—only to be presumed dead in a car accident.

data.title: The Lie I Called Love
data.intro: Hank Quinn, the CEO of a prominent company, faces his wife Nora Lane’s deep resentment over his refusal to let her have a child with her first love, James Gray. When James tragically takes his own life, Nora blames Hank and exacts her revenge by brutally murdering him and his family during a trip.Reborn with a chance to rewrite his fate, Hank decides to grant her request—but this time, he’s determined to make her pay the ultimate price for her betrayal.

data.title: Billionaire Alpha Won’t Let Me Go
data.intro: Zoe Lopez returns to New York with her young son and crosses paths with Alexander Blackwood, a past lover—and a werewolf. As old feelings resurface, buried secrets of power, family, and supernatural heritage threaten their lives. With danger looming, their intense romance reignites, forcing them to face a fate beyond their control.

data.title: The Regret That Consumed Us
data.intro: Ethan Gray’s life seems perfect—he has a beautiful wife and a charming daughter. His love for his wife runs deep, and even as the busy CEO of Gray Corp, he makes it a priority to care for their daughter, Lily. Though Lily rarely gets to spend time with her mother, she takes immense pride in her mother’s successful career. However, everything changes when Lily falls gravely ill.

data.title: When the Curtain Falls on Us
data.intro: Originally a dancer in the Army Entertainment Unit, Quinn Porter first caught the eye of crew leader Joel Flint the moment she stepped on stage. Their connection was instant, and what began as a spark quickly led to marriage. For five years, they built a life together—until Joel’s first love, Winter Trent, suddenly returned. When Quinn discovers she was merely a stand-in for Winter all along, she makes the painful decision to leave both the unit and the man she once loved.

data.title: Whispers to His Mind
data.intro: Amidst the chaos of the hospital, skilled surgeon Linda Brown finds herself time-traveling to the Astren era due to a mysterious pendant. There, she becomes Prince Brad's princess consort and the chancellor's daughter, who shares her name. Ten years have passed since Linda heroically saved Brad Miller from drowning—a man she has harbored feelings for ever since.However, the tides turn when Mindy Black, with the Empress's scheming support, usurps Linda's position.

data.title: Memory Reset: Mr. Restraint Begged for Love
data.intro: When Juliette Walker wakes up in a hospital, she realizes she's lost the last three years of her memory. One moment she was a 22-year-old college student—The next, she's 25, married into a powerful family, and her husband is none other than her former campus crush, Felix Langford. Determined to uncover the truth behind her attempted suicide, Juliette begins to dig. But the deeper she goes, the more dangerous this marriage appears.

data.title: No Return for This Goodbye (DUBBED)
data.intro: Tessa's husband, Adrian Sinclair, embarks on a mission alongside his twin brother, Miles Sinclair. Tragedy strikes when Miles dies in action. To protect his sister-in-law, Adrian assumes his late brother's identity, intending to father a child with her before revealing the truth. Unable to accept her husband's death, Tessa spirals into despair. When she unexpectedly learns that Adrian is actually alive, her heart breaks with disillusionment.

data.title: When Silence Breaks Her Heart (DUBBED)
data.intro: Cara and Leander were once a married couple, but after a car accident involving a pregnant woman named Kara—Leander's first love who has a name almost identical to hers—his hidden secret shatters their seemingly perfect marriage. As an educated and principled doctor, Cara faces betrayal with dignity, balancing family responsibilities and personal pride. After a series of conflicts and realizations, she decides to divorce and study abroad while caring for her aging parents.

data.title: Keep Your Hands Off My Heart
data.intro: To afford Sophie Kent's medical treatment, Sharon Quinn signs a contract to help Jared Fox recover from a past heartbreak. For ten years, she devotes herself to him—building a family, supporting him, and standing by his side—only to watch him remain tethered to the woman he once loved, who has now returned from abroad. Disheartened, Sharon leaves for Auvia to pursue her dream in music, while Jared realizes far too late that the person he truly loves has always been her.

data.title: Awakened: His Absolute Might Unleashed (DUBBED)
data.intro: Cade Leed raises his sick younger sister, Amy Leed, on his own despite his young age. Though it breaks his heart, Cade has no choice but to put her up for adoption, hoping that a family with resources can provide the treatment she needs. Twenty years later, Cade falls into a coma after an accident, and his fiancée, Rue Kirk, cares for him tirelessly for five years, never giving up hope.

data.title: Sip the Lies, Toast to True Love
data.intro: Seron Corp founder Jeremy Logan suffers a betrayal when his wife Mia Finch believes her vile secretary Vincent Smith over him, dismissing Jeremy's illness as an act. Jeremy breaks free from Vincent's schemes and Mia's control, starting over in Jeston by marrying a childhood flame, Queenie Blain. For the first time ever, he experiences unconditional love and trust as he builds a new life–but an ex's jealousy and a new rival's greed threaten it.

data.title: The Gifted Quadruplets
data.intro: Hanna Hale has superpowers, which are inherited by her children. However, her enemies capture her children, and Hanna is forced to live without them. Six years later, they escape from the laboratory using their superpowers and find her. They protect Hanna from vicious attacks from her enemies. Ultimately, they find their father and return home, and they reunite as a happy and complete family.

data.title: I Survived, But Our Love Didn't
data.intro: Born with a rare heart condition, Betty Quinn is abandoned by her parents and forced to survive on her own. At eighteen, while working at a bar to pay her tuition, she meets Hubert Spark—the man who becomes her lover and the only family she has ever known. But everything falls apart when Hubert's first love, Roxy Graham, returns from abroad.

data.title: Love Beyond Words: Mr. Kane's Mute Wife
data.intro: There is a beautiful woman who Asher Kane holds dear to his heart. To him, she is worth more than money or even his own life, and he fiercely defends her against any harm. Then there is another woman, his mute wife, who lacks significant status or achievements. In his eyes, she is merely someone dependent on him for survival. That’s what he believes, at least. However, when she suggests a divorce, he feels an unsettling sensation stirring from deep within his heart.

data.title: Hearts Through the Haze
data.intro: At 18, Amelia Davis falls for her father's subordinate, Tyler Myers, who is eight years her senior. Their ten-year relationship comes to an end when he refuses to marry her and instead gets together with his childhood sweetheart. While Tyler marries another, Amelia turns to Elliot Logan, the feared mercenary captain, for an impulsive marriage.

data.title: Goodbye Mr. Sampson
data.intro: As her world descends into silence and her marriage crumbles, Lilian Carter faces a race against time to uncover deadly secrets and reclaim her identity before her past, and those who betrayed her, destroy her future.

data.title: Unrivaled: His Might Knows No Equal (DUBBED)
data.intro: For three years, Ethan Moore, the Lord of Kuberg, lived in obscurity, quietly supporting the Gray family while married to Claire Gray. But his world unravels when he steps in to save Vera Kurt, the second daughter of the Kurt family, drawing the ire of Finn Trent. Seeing him as a liability, Claire ruthlessly casts him out.At an investment banquet, Ethan is framed and publicly condemned. Just when all seems lost, Vera intervenes, effortlessly turning the tide.

data.title: My Mother, The Valor Princess (DUBBED)
data.intro: The Valor Princess of Clusia, Reign Lynch, secretly starts a new life on the outskirts as a hawker with her daughter after her heroics in a fierce battle. Years later, an attendant searching for her discovers that her son-in-law, Caleb Scott, has taken the Civic Exam and informs the emperor. In recognition of Reign’s contributions to the country, the emperor quickly decides to name Caleb the Premier Scholar for that year.

data.title: Married in Disguise
data.intro: Gigi Jaffe hides her identity as the CEO of Minley Corp and goes for a blind date in hopes to find a good man, while Leo Burke is the head of Chilton Corp who pretends to be a poor guy because he does not want a gold-digger as his wife. The two of them find each other a great match, not knowing that their respective companies are business partners, and they almost get their own hidden identities exposed multiple times.

data.title: Haunted by Her Goodbye
data.intro: To repay her late boyfriend for saving her life, Clara Reed remains by his brother Hugo Lundy's side for five years, fulfilling the hundred wishes of his first love without complaint. As Hugo watches her sacrifice her own dignity, he becomes convinced she will never leave—unaware that Clara is secretly planning to end her life in the name of love, on the very bridge where her boyfriend lost his.

data.title: Ablaze With Vengeance (DUBBED)
data.intro: Years ago, Layla York, Balton’s Valkyrie, believed Sean Groff had saved her life, and that belief led to their marriage. Over the past three years, she has devoted herself to him and his family, aiding in his ascent to prominence and facilitating his entry into the Onyx Group. She plans to announce his appointment as CEO during the Phoenix Gala.

data.title: Not Your Second Choice
data.intro: Growing up in a biased family, Aurora Smith suffers torment from a young age, and Lucas Shaw is the only light in her youth. Even as an adult, she still lives in the shadows of her family's mistreatment and is forced to marry a stranger for three million dollars by her parents and younger brother. Little does she know, a great turning point in fate awaits.

data.title: Red Carpet Lies, Blood-Stained Vows
data.intro: Three years ago, explicit photos of Hank Lawson surfaced online. Wanda Reed stepped in and married him, despite his being sterile. Hank fell deeply in love with her. Three years later, he discovers that Wanda staged the scandal. Using the photos, she forces Hank to give up his Best Actor title to her nephew, Sean Foster. Sean also kills Hank's sister and was the one who ran over their mother years ago. Heartbroken, Hank divorces Wanda and vows to make both her and Sean pay.

data.title: Mr. Williams' Mistaken Missus
data.intro: Intern Audrey accidentally had a night with CEO Hunter Williams. But left her friend Jennifer' resume behind while she leave. Jennifer took the opportunity to impersonate Audrey.Unexpectedly, Audrey, with her plain appearance, is promoted to personal secretary by Hunter. As they spend more time together, Hunter suspects she may be the one at that night.As Audrey navigates her new role, Jennifer attempts to seduce Hunter and rid herself of Audrey for good.

data.title: The Many Faces of Mrs. Finn
data.intro: When the truth was revealed that Charice was not the biological daughter of the Larson family, James Larson found her biological parents and insisted on sending her back to avoid spending money raising her. The Larsons mistakenly thought that Charice’s biological parents were from the countryside and hinted to her not to ever come back, for fear that she would return asking for money in the future.

data.title: Heiress Reborn: Her Wrath Knows No Mercy
data.intro: Having been through a tragic death, Serena Ford is reborn and transforms from a weak and timid woman to a messenger of vengeance, determined to make Bella Shaw have a taste of losing her beloved, friends, and family.

data.title: No Title Is Worth Betrayal
data.intro: Seven years into a loveless marriage with Landon Lopez, Yelena Larson has devoted herself to raising his son, Grant, into a successful man—only to be cast aside on Grant's wedding day. Reborn, Yelena refuses to be used again. This time, she vows to make them both regret ever betraying her.

data.title: Family Ties? More Like Family Lies
data.intro: Reborn five years ago, Cara Lowe discovers that her work has been stolen by her adopted sister, Faye Lowe. Framed and killed in her past life, Cara now vows revenge—determined to crush her siblings in their own fields of success. Even when they beg for forgiveness, she shows no mercy, exposing their selfishness and true colors. There is no family bond left—only war.

data.title: When Forever Only Means Five Years
data.intro: When Helen Leonard went blind, Sheldon Hurst stayed by her side for five whole years—until his identity and credit were stolen by his brother. Betrayed and framed, he died full of resentment. Reborn, he tries to walk away from the pain, but the past won't let go. When a watch sparks false accusations, he's cast aside again. Only when Helen uncovers the truth does she realize her mistake—but by then, he already belongs to someone else.

data.title: The Princess of His Heart (DUBBED)
data.intro: A Baby, A Billionaire And Me. After an unexpected encounter, Sophie Gray gives birth to a son, Tommy Gray, changing her life forever. Six years later, Lucas Lind learns about the child he never knew existed and sets out to find him. As fate brings them closer, Sophie starts working at Lind Corp, where her relationship with Lucas deepens, and love begins to grow between them.

data.title: Crown Reclaimed: She Who Rises From Betrayal(DUBBED)
data.intro: Princess Ann Russo of Souzar conceals her identity to heal Prince Cyril Walsh of Yorhil and secretly helps him claim the throne. But once crowned, he demotes her to a mere concubine and marries Anna Tate. Betrayed and furious, Ann demands a divorce and reclaims everything she sacrificed, returning to her true self—the ruling princess she was always meant to be.

data.title: Where Love Sets Me Free
data.intro: Though outwardly adored, Quinn Steele harbors a profound secret: her muteness is not congenital, but the result of her mother's poison. Her every bid for freedom is thwarted until Steven Yates enters her life. Just when Quinn believes she's finally within reach of freedom, fate intervenes once more. But this time, she chooses to reclaim her voice.

data.title: When Love Is a Losing Bet
data.intro: Five years after Alfred Gill marries Iris Logan for money, her first crush, Owen Kane, returns from abroad. It is then that Alfred realizes he has never truly captured her heart. Despite the pain, he decides to let her go, knowing she deserves a love with Owen. To make a clean break and ensure Iris fully belongs to Owen, Alfred stages his own death and disappears overseas. However, when Iris learns of his death, she is consumed by remorse, realizing too late what she’s lost.

data.title: Billionaire Playboy's Replacement Bride
data.intro: Under her stepmother's pressure, Alicia substitutes her sister to marry a stranger. Disheartened, she finds solace in Lucius's company for a night. Later, at the wedding, she discovers Lucius is the groom, sparking an unexpected love story.

data.title: The Hero Who Walks Among Us (DUBBED)
data.intro: Greg Wright, formerly the Supreme Commander of Darvon, retired and became a humble street sweeper. One day, after finishing work, he returns home only to find his daughter-in-law and her mother occupying his house without reason. Mercilessly thrown out of his own home, he wanders aimlessly and ends up rescuing a young girl named Xenia Janz from a group of bullies. Grateful for his help, Xenia introduces him to her mother, Yvonne Zeller, the CEO of a renowned company.

data.title: The Dominant Heir's Triumphant Return（DUBBED）
data.intro: Sean York is born into a respected family. For the past three years, he has been in a relationship with Mia Leed. But he gets injured in a car accident and falls into a coma.
