For his sake, Mia works multiple jobs to pay for his medical bills. Mia's relatives often mock and tease her. They introduce Mia to the son of a wealthy family. However, as Mia resists, Sean wakes up. To return her favor, Sean reclaims his title with his parents and confronts those who have wronged Mia.

data.title: Flexed into History: Protein Powder Saves the Day!
data.intro: Matt Hale is exasperated to discover that he has gone from a muscular fitness trainer to a starving, scrawny refugee in ancient times. Against his will, a drugged princess sleeps with him. Determined not to give in, Matt uses modern training techniques and homemade protein powder to turn the villagers into muscular fighters. Together, they crush bandits, repel rebels, quell a plague, and defeat invaders.

data.title: Where Love Failed to Anchor
data.intro: To fulfill his life-saver's dying wish, Sam Lowe marries Gina Zane and gives up his aerospace research career to become a househusband, unaware that she secretly looks down on him for it. When her first love, Neil Bale, returns from abroad and moves into their home without Sam's consent, he not only steals Gina's heart but wins over their daughter as well. Abandoned by his wife and child, Sam finally decides to walk away.

data.title: My Son, The Richest Tycoon (DUBBED)
data.intro: It is Joe Archer’s first time visiting a prosperous city. Unfortunately, he is mistaken by Kate Hill and Tina Lowe—who are in a hurry to get a contract signed with Skye Inc.—for a pervert on the subway. Things escalate quickly, and the two women even start harassing him, not knowing that he is the father of Skye Archer, the CEO of Skye Inc.

data.title: His Return to Supremacy
data.intro: The Lord of Hope of Rayne, Leon Jenkins, faces a devastating blow in an enemy attack, losing not just his memories but also his esteemed position, relegated to the role of a mere laborer transporting heavy bricks at construction sites.On his wife’s birthday, he prepares a surprise for her, only to see her enter the room hand-in-hand with another man. Leon gets humiliated and bullied by him, suffering another blow to his already miserable day.

data.title: Reborn to Four Times the Love
data.intro: Despite reuniting with her family, Serena Cole always felt like an outsider. Her brothers blindly sided with their adopted sister, Sophie Lowe, leaving her in the shadows. When the family hit rock bottom, Sophie fled with their money—while Serena stayed and helped the Lowes rebuild. She eventually lost her life saving someone. Now, fate gives her a second chance to live again.

data.title: Boss Moves: He Who Turns Tides
data.intro: When Jasper Zabel fails his scholar exam, his brothers' mockery barely registers—he has bigger problems, like the drugged commandery princess of Lostaria he's just rescued. But she vanishes at dawn, and all that remains of their night together is the money she left behind.

data.title: Heart of Obsession (DUBBED)
data.intro: Under unexpected circumstances, Sean Mace falls for Clara Gray at first sight and pursues her relentlessly. However, Clara rejects him, harboring deep hatred for his role in her father’s suicide. Undeterred, Sean refuses to give up and ultimately forces her into marriage through ruthless means. Once wed, Clara does everything to make Sean despise her, yet, to her surprise, she finds herself falling for him instead.

data.title: Tycoon in Disguise: Their Downfall Begins
data.intro: Nate Cohen, heir to a vast fortune, gives up his inheritance to build a life with his wife, Faith Stone. He works tirelessly in delivery jobs to support their struggling marriage. After five years of hardship, Nate discovers the truth—Faith, influenced by her best friend, rekindles an affair with her first love, Jason Hall. Her gold-digging nature is exposed. Things worsen when Nate’s grandmother falls critically ill.

data.title: Seven Days to Goodbye
data.intro: Jake Grant, a time traveler who entered the world of a novel to complete a mission, chooses to stay for the sake of his beloved, Rena Jonas, at a great cost—his legs. Initially thinking that he has found his true love, Jake discovers that Rena has long been building another family with her secret lover behind his back. Heartbroken, Jake decides to leave her and return to reality while she still lies about her feelings for him, unaware that she has been compromised.

data.title: The Time-Traveling Special Agent
data.intro: Theo Scott, a special agent, time-travels into the body of a fool who, by the empress’s decree, is blessed with two extraordinary wives—one, the leader of the Saintess Sect with tens of thousands of followers, and the other, a great general, both beautiful and extraordinary. However, on Theo's wedding day, the empress unexpectedly regrets her decision and fights to make him her husband, adding a surprising twist to his already dramatic change of fate.

data.title: Don't Mind Me, Just Being the Villainess
data.intro: Transmigrated into a novel set in 80s, Wren Stone becomes the vicious ex-wife of a crippled tycoon. To return home, she plays her role to perfection, reveling in her villainy—unaware that every one of her thoughts can be heard. As her family rallies around her and her husband miraculously recovers, he makes one thing clear: she is never allowed to leave.

data.title: The Outcast Makes a Comeback
data.intro: Despised by his in-laws, Marshall leaves with his wife and daughter, only to reveal his true identity as Harrington Group’s new CEO. Facing betrayal and family rejection, he fights to reclaim his dignity and build a new life on his terms.

data.title: My Boss, My High School Enemy
data.intro: Lee Suzy was the most popular student in her high school. After graduation, she tasted the harsh realities of the world and, after enduring all kinds of hardships, finally succeeded in getting a job at Hanseon Advertising Agency. But for some reason, Kang Yuna— the model student who was bullied by Suzy back in high school— joins the company as Soo-ji's direct supervisor. And so, Suzy's ordeal of "retribution for one's past wrongs" begins...

data.title: Reborn in Ruins: Hidden Brilliance
data.intro:
Betrayed by his stepbrother, Nathan Cole suffers public humiliation when he is strung up at the entrance of Juset, his reputation left in ruins. His fiancée, Renee Zabel, immediately calls off their engagement. Worse still, he loses the chance to marry the female Emperor, disappointing his father so deeply that he is cast out of the family.

But his father has no idea—the son he abandoned is no longer the same Nathan.

data.title: Agents' Undercovered Love
data.intro: During a mission, Agent Noah had the intelligence hidden in jewelry stolen by Agent Olivia, who was disguised as a blonde, blue-eyed high-end escort. The two also had a one-night stand. Seven years later, they meet again without recognizing each other. They get married to maintain their covers as agents, only to fall in love later. Eventually, Noah discovers that Olivia's seven-year-old daughter Lucy is actually his biological child.

data.title: Once Upon a Time, I Loved You
data.intro: When the Emperor of Calvon ascends to the throne, he arranges a marriage for Princess Alexa Green of the Aurick Clan to secure a political alliance. On her way to the wedding, Alexa saves the life of a wealthy crown prince, Hubert Jill, and the two fall deeply in love. Under the moonlight, they exchange meaningful gifts and vow to one day be together.

data.title: Your Highness, Your Wife Wants a Divorce
data.intro: Facing peril during a mission, special agent Stella Jensen is transported through time to become the princess of Daprein, where she is commanded by the emperor to marry the War Duke, Cedric Shaw. At that time, Cedric is engaged in a fierce battle against Xosa. Stella aids in treating the general’s poisoning, designs weapons, and creates explosives to safeguard the people of Daprein and its borders.

data.title: Alpha's Fated Surrogate
data.intro: Leah becomes a surrogate to help her boyfriend but is betrayed. She meets Alpha Lucas, her fated mate. Pregnant and heartbroken, she enters the werewolf world and rises as Luna through love and strength.

data.title: Eyes of Heaven: All-Seeing, All-Dominating
data.intro: After Leon Cavill, a disciple of the Genesis Sect, awakens the Eye of Heaven, his mentor entrusts him with half of the Duality Pendant and instructs him to find his fiancée, who holds the other half, so he can achieve his breakthrough. Leaving the depths of the mountains, Leon encounters his fiancée and saves her life—only to be branded a rogue. Determined to prove himself, he steps into the city, wielding his Eye of Heaven to carve out a carefree legend.

data.title: Chessboard of Power: Planned, Played, Perfected
data.intro: Forced to serve her brother-in-law when her sister Zoe Gould is pregnant, May Gould loses her life on the day of Zoe's delivery. Reborn, she seizes power and the life she deserves by winning over the favor of the powerful, becoming the Duchess of Arva and making sure bullies always pay the price.

data.title: The Underdog's Triumph (DUBBED)
data.intro: How does it feel to end up at the wrong table during a blind date? David mistakenly marries a gorgeous CEO, and from then on, his life is completely transformed!

data.title: Ascension of the Supreme One
data.intro: A millennium after Cedric Lorne rescues a young girl named Nyra Prynn in the Spirit Realm, Nyra brings the reincarnated but dimwitted Cedric back to the Lunaris Sect. By a twist of fate, Cedric reawakens his Heavenly Eye and regains his past memories. Soon after, he stuns everyone by accepting a daunting mission from the Lunaris Sect’s Mission Hall.

data.title: Divorce to Frontline: A Woman Reborn
data.intro: Paisley Jenkins, a war correspondent, gave up her career to become a housewife after getting married and having a child. Ten years later, her husband, Lucas, gifts Paisley's late mother's camera to his "little sister," Sophia. Paisley discovers Lucas and Sophia's ambiguous relationship, and their daughter, Anna, idolizes Sophia. Heartbroken, Paisley applies to return to the warzone.

data.title: His Secret Power Within
data.intro: Bryson Layne seems like your average security guard, a quiet orphan with an unremarkable life. But beneath his unassuming exterior lies a celestial constitution, a gift left by a mysterious sage—one he dismisses as mere ramblings of a madman. When he saves Joanna Jensen, a woman caught in a perilous situation, she marries him out of gratitude, believing she's the protector of their unlikely union. Little does she know that Bryson's true potential is about to change everything

data.title: One Breath to Forever, One Breath to Ruin(DUBBED)
data.intro: Erin Quinn hides her true identity while dating Isaac Ford for three years. During a birthday celebration, Isaac's close friend, Margaret Walsh, drunkenly gets intimate with him. She smokes afterward, triggering Erin's heart condition. Isaac continues to side with Margaret even as she steals Erin's medicine and frames her for hitting her, eventually letting Erin slip into a coma. At the most critical moment, Erin's mother, Freya Quinn, arrives to confront the chaos.

data.title: You Are Still The One
data.intro: Bound by an arranged marriage to a man she’s never met, Emma, a once-wealthy heiress on the brink of losing everything, returns to the U.S. as the assistant to her ruthless ex-boyfriend, Zachary. Unbeknownst to her, Zachary is plotting revenge for her past betrayal, all while appearing to be married to another woman—a mysterious figure he has been avoiding ever since Emma left.

data.title: Tripped Into Time, Forged a Legend
data.intro: "Miguel, do you want a wife? Just say the word, and I'll bring her to you." Modern engineer Miguel Stewart wakes up in the body of a rogue in a war-torn era. When he meets a noblewoman on the run, survival turns into something deeper. With a sword in hand and family in his heart, Miguel vows to protect them all—no matter what this chaotic world throws his way.

data.title: Revenge Served Cold: A Life Reclaimed (DUBBED)
data.intro: Deeply in love with Jane York, the daughter of his driver, Zayn Smith gave her everything—his time, wealth, and heart. In return, he fell victim to a cruel scheme, ultimately losing his life at her hands. Now reborn back to his college days, Zayn is determined to reclaim everything he lost. This time, he sees Jane for who she truly is: a regular girl pretending to be the daughter of a wealthy family.

data.title: Snowbound with a Homeless Prince
data.intro: To fulfill her dying mother Margaret’s last wish, Noelle plans to marry fiancé Kevin—until she catches him cheating with Sophie, the mayor’s daughter. Prince Luke, disguised as a homeless man, helps her, and they impulsively marry. As they live together, Luke’s habits—especially his look after bathing and love for hot cocoa—remind Noelle of her childhood memories with a young prince…

data.title: Everything's on My Side: Daddy, I'm Coming
data.intro: During a conflict with the Quinn fake heiress, young Ellie Quinn gets hurt while protecting her ill mother, unexpectedly awakening her ability to hear the voices of everything in the world. As impostors take their places in the reunion with her wealthy father, Ellie speaks to the world—animals, vases, and even desks—guiding her mother toward their true home.

data.title: Every Thought, Every Love, Is You
data.intro: Ellis Hill is known for being cold and aloof, so no one ever suspected that his marriage pact involved Claire Newton. Everyone is therefore stunned when he fills in her name as his wife. Claire had assumed their relationship would remain purely nominal, making it all the more surprising when he begins to shower her with love and tender care after their marriage.

data.title: Spellbound Hearts
data.intro: Laura Tanner, a witch, struggles to survive in a complex society full of exhausting rules where she faces threats against the things she treasures and betrayal from the man she loves. As the truth slowly comes to light, the hidden secrets behind each character begin to unravel one by one, picturing a romantic yet dangerous world filled with emotional entanglements, fantasy elements, and suspenseful twists.

data.title: Say You Remember, Say You Love
data.intro: After her family went bankrupt, Elizabeth reconnected with her first love, Jason, who had become a world-renowned football star. Despite never forgetting the pain he once caused her, she couldn't resist being drawn to his brilliance.

data.title: Jilted to Jewel: The Rejected Bride's Rise (DUBBED)
data.intro: On her wedding day, Maya York discovers that her fiancé, is having an affair with her sister. She even learns that she is adopted and is subsequently thrown out. However, she soon finds out she is the sole heir of the prestigious Stone family. Back at her true home, Maya is doted on by the CEO of Stone Group. She also meets her new fiancé. However, her adoptive family continues to challenge and humiliate her. So Maya decides to make them pay for their mistreatment.

data.title: Revenge Marriage Sweet Love
data.intro: Cate's sister Rebecca had not only stolen her boyfriend Ethan, but had also stripped her of her inheritance. Fueled by desire for revenge, a drunken Cate impulsively decided to seduce Ethan's handsome uncle, Shaun, who later was ignited by Cate and fell madly in love despite his cold demeanor. However, when they both realized Shaun was mistaken as Ethan's uncle, Shaun realized that she initially approached him only for revenge against Ethan, putting their love to the test.

data.title: Our Forever, Laid to Rest (DUBBED)
data.intro: On their wedding day, tragedy strikes when Jolene Hale's parents, drunk at the wheel, accidentally kill Mason Bell's entire family—turning joy into heartbreak. To atone for her parents' sins, Jolene endures Mason's torment for five long years before walking away. Another five years later, she reappears in a hospital—but Mason doesn't know the truth: she has already erased him from her heart.

data.title: Checkmate: The Trap I Set for You
data.intro: Freya Levine has her bank card money stolen by her roommate, Fiona Zeller, who pretends to sponsor a trip—and Freya is killed after trying to expose her. Reborn, Freya is determined to stay one step ahead, outsmart Fiona's schemes, protect her money, and ensure that the guilty are brought to justice.

data.title: Anything, and Everything to Win Her Back
data.intro: For the sake of her family, Yelena Summers weds Landon Palmer—the man she's loved for years. But what begins as a dream turns into a cage of desire and mistrust. Misunderstandings tear them apart, ending in a divorce. Only when she's gone does Landon realize his true feelings—and this time, he's willing to fight the world to win her back.

data.title: The Day Love Was Lost
data.intro: After a car crash, Lillian Swan loses her memory of Callum Hart, the man she has loved deeply for seven years who never loved her back. Unwilling to watch her dive back into endless pursuit, her friend tells her the truth. So, Lillian moves onto a new life—until Callum finally realizes he has long-developed feelings for her.

data.title: Double Down: Fold or Fight
data.intro: Crushed by towering gambling debts, Seth Logan tried to end his life—but failed. Desperate to save him from his self-destructive obsession, Max Logan drags Seth into a casino. Masking his brilliance behind a façade of folly, Max reads every trick, every bluff, and turns the tables. When the game ends, victory isn't just his—it's a brutal lesson for Seth: greed destroys everything, and only by letting go can he hope to find the light again.

data.title: Regret Is Only the Beginning
data.intro: Yara Lennox, the chairwoman of Yova Corp, tragically spends her final moments in remorse at the thought of her agony and loss of wealth being caused by the man she loved most—the son of her family housekeeper. It is only when she breathes her last breath that she finds out that the feared boss of the top company has only stayed single for her. Given another chance at life, Yara vows to ensure vengeance against everyone who has ever done her harm.

data.title: The Regret That Consumed Us (DUBBED)
data.intro: Ethan Gray’s life seems perfect—he has a beautiful wife and a charming daughter. His love for his wife runs deep, and even as the busy CEO of Gray Corp, he makes it a priority to care for their daughter, Lily. Though Lily rarely gets to spend time with her mother, she takes immense pride in her mother’s successful career. However, everything changes when Lily falls gravely ill.

data.title: Got you! Mr. Always Right
data.intro: Jane's ex and high school rival get engaged, inviting her to humiliate her. Jane hires a "ride-share driver" named Mike as a fake husband, unaware he's wealthy and knows her. Jane enters high society, loved by Mike but facing pressure from wealthy heiress Sissy, who opposes their union, leading to a tangled web of love, family, and jealousy.

data.title: Fierce Grace: Braving the Betrayal（DUBBED）
data.intro: For the sake of her boyfriend, Kyle Jensen, Myla Young sacrifices her studies and pursues a career abroad. She founds Rosa Corp, which rapidly ascends to become the world's leading company within seven years. Secretly supporting Kyle's education, she ensures his success, even securing him a position at Foster Corp in Osian. However, upon her return to reveal the truth and propose to Kyle, he publicly ends their relationship to pursue another wealthy woman.

data.title: Spoil Me Please
data.intro: After being jilted, Violet proposes to the first man she sees—who just so happens to be Sean, a former high school classmate who has always loved her. When he says yes, their marriage sets them on an unexpected path to revenge and true love.

data.title: Goodbye, My Once and Forever(DUBBED)
data.intro: Wendy Jensen, a wealthy heiress, begins a relationship with Jerry Hale in college and makes a five-year bet with her parents. She never expects betrayal. Yet, in the fifth year, Jerry brings home his assistant, Tina Sutton. While Wendy is asleep, Tina gives Wendy’s son a glass of wine. Furious, Wendy demands accountability, but Jerry defends Tina, telling Wendy not to overreact. Torn and heartbroken, Wendy decides to file for divorce.

data.title: Triple Life with My Billionaire Crush
data.intro: What? Engagement? No way, no so-called golden bachelor compares to my boss Wesley, said Aurora, heiress to the Burton family. She ran from her engagement party, determined to get back to her job as Wesley's little assistant. But instead, she found herself face-to-face with Wesley Ashford, her boss, who'd been drugged accidentally. Wesley pulled her into his arms, kissed her hard, and said, Spread your legs.

data.title: Sisters in Power, The Crown Is Ours
data.intro: Having been swapped at birth, Eva Litt returns to her biological family. She soon learns that the one who took her place is not her sister, Zelda Litt, but her adoptive brother, Micah Litt. Even so, their parents continue to favor him as the heir. When Eva exposes his schemes and helps the easily manipulated Zelda come to her senses, the sisters transform from rivals into allies. Together, they join forces to take control of their own fate.

data.title: Her Fury Unleashed, Their World Crumbled
data.intro: After five years teaching in rural areas, Olive Carson returns to Juston to reunite with her brother, Noah Carson, now the city's richest man. She risks herself to save his fiancée, only to be humiliated, beaten, and falsely accused. As the siblings uncover the truth, Olive reveals her hidden power, the villains are brought to justice, and Noah fulfills his promise to protect her forever.

data.title: Find Me, Mr. President！
data.intro: Eight years ago, to help her boyfriend Ethan fulfill his dream of becoming president, Grace left him without a word, even though she was pregnant and fresh out of college. Eight years later, Ethan has become the youngest president in history, while Grace has fallen into hardship, working as a cleaner in the slums while raising their 8-year-old daughter alone.

data.title: Orders to Kill, Orders to Love
data.intro: Lucius Trent, the world's most dangerous mercenary, works for one thing: money. The higher the pay, the deadlier the job—including taking out the top assassin. Disguised as a delivery man for his latest mission, he encounters Josie Stone. She claims to know him, insisting he had bullied her back in school. Lucius, having no memory of her, keeps his distance, insisting he's just a random delivery guy.

data.title: The Stay-at-Home Billionaire
data.intro: After a one-night stand with Noah Holt, Jane Shaw walks away, never expecting to see him again. Five years later, she's raising their twins alone—until fate brings Noah back into her life. Believing him to be just an ordinary construction worker with little income, Jane works tirelessly to support their family, unaware that Noah is actually the world’s wealthiest man. To stay by her side, he keeps his identity a secret, taking on the role of a full-time stay-at-home dad.

data.title: The Dragon King's Return
data.intro: Lucas Brown went to jail for love, yet all he got in return was indifference and betrayal. The fires of rage engulf the heavens and earth... All who dare cross him will soon pay the price!

data.title: With That, I Rest My Case
data.intro: Ruth Nash has spent three years as a devoted wife, quietly supporting Ian Ford's legal career. But when his first love returns and captures all his attention, Ruth finds herself pushed aside. Longing to reclaim her title as the "Legal Queen," she returns to the courtroom—ready to shine once more on the stage where she truly belongs.

data.title: Silk and Blood: Her Shadowed Vengeance
data.intro: Charlene Judd loses her status as the heiress of Earl Judd’s family following the tragic death of her parents. Subjected to relentless bullying by the Judds, she is even forced to marry Edmund Gale, the notorious son of the Gale family, as a substitute for her cousin, Imelda Judd. Despite her despair, Charlene’s resolve strengthens. Determined to change her fate, she takes control of her circumstances and her marriage, setting the stage for her ultimate revenge.

data.title: My Enemy Has A Crush On Me
data.intro: Fu Ci and Jiang Nai have been sworn rivals ever since high school. After graduating from university, Fu Ci joined a corporation as a sales representative. While Fu Ci was undoubtedly a rising star among the young professionals in the company, it was pure coincidence that Jiang Nai also joined the same company shortly after, becoming a key figure in the technical department.

data.title: You Call It Love, I Call It Over
data.intro: Connor Quest pursues Wendy Jade and finally marries her, only for her to file for divorce 99 times in the span of three years for ridiculous reasons. He thinks she doesn't love him, but then he discovers in her diary that she enjoyed his desperate affection. Seeing how toxic the situation is, he walks away to start a new life.

data.title: Parting Ways, Parting Hearts
data.intro: Ryan Jaeger builds Grant Corp with Yara Grant, but a drunken night changes everything. Yara conceives Xavier Scott's child and hides it for three months. Though Ryan forgives her, he later learns she broke her promise to leave Xavier. Heartbroken, he divorces her and marries Maddy Quinn. Desperate, Yara rushes to his wedding to beg forgiveness—but it's too late.

data.title: I Loved, I Hated, I'm Done
data.intro: Valerie Jackman experiences a rebirth and wakes up at the age of 27 with two kids and a husband—Lucian Floyd, the world's richest man and every woman's dream. While everyone envies her for having him, Valerie has other plans. Holding the divorce agreement in her hands, she sets out to return him to his first love, Serena Morse, completely.

data.title: The Invincible Time-Traveling Prince
data.intro: In this tale of time travel, Zion Yates inhabits the body of the unremarkable Third Prince of Dvalor, leveraging modern-era knowledge to outmaneuver his scheming brothers. Rising above the other princes, he ascends to the position of Crown Prince. Despite his newfound prestige and power, all he desires is a life of carefree peace.

data.title: Fated Flames
data.intro: Nina Jewell's world shatters when Elsa Jewell's ruthless scheme claims her parents' lives and pushes her to the brink of death. Six years later, she resurfaces as Kiera Young, a mesmerizing casino dealer with one goal: destroy the woman who stole everything from her.

data.title: Temptation of the  Ex-Wife
data.intro: Talia, framed by her sister Melania, lost everything, Including her husband Nick and her child! Years later, she came back as Aelia. She swore with her blood that all the traitors would face what they rightfully deserved. The first step was to seduce Nick, the man she once loved deeply...

data.title: When Goodbye Becomes the Only Choice
data.intro: Larry Sawyer, CEO of Silas Corp, gave up his career for love when he married Fiona Carver. He never expected Fiona to reconnect with her first love, Yosef Sutton, after his return from abroad. Worse still, their son starts calling Yosef "father." This pushes Larry to his breaking point. Frustrated and disillusioned, Larry decides to divorce Fiona and reclaim what is rightfully his.

data.title: Dying Taught Me Revenge
data.intro: In her past life, Sue Shaw discovered that the poor student she had sponsored, Nina Holt, was actually the illegitimate daughter of her husband, Ian Judd. Moreover, Nina had even stolen the custom gown Sue had gifted to her own daughter, Yael Shaw. Enraged, Sue confronted Ian and Nina, only to be brutally murdered along with her beloved daughter. Reborn, Sue destroys the gown and casts all three of them out of her home.

data.title: The New Rich Family Grudge
data.intro: For power, money, and love, an absurd hidden war began in the big family of Walton’s

data.title: Boss! U Almost Got Her
data.intro: When childhood sweethearts arrange to reunite at a bridal shop after twenty years apart, a manipulative best friend steals the bride's place and her billionaire groom. Now working as his secretary, the real bride must navigate growing feelings for her boss while unaware he's her long-lost love - even as her friend rushes them toward a wedding built on lies.

data.title: The Real Daughter Returns: Everything Comes Due
data.intro: On the day of the patriarch's passing, Elise Alder returns to uncover the truth behind her abandonment years ago. But believing she is back for the heritage, Mara Keene hires a top lawyer to fight against Elise. However, not only is the lawyer Elise's eldest son, but Elise's other sons also have control over what she thinks can be her leverage. Left with nothing, Mara is put behind bars as the patriarch's murder suspect, while Elise finally unveils the truth of her past.

data.title: Your Love Is My Chains
data.intro: Sienna Quill fakes a betrayal and breaks up with Harry Ford after her father is sent to prison, leaving her a single mother caring for their seriously ill son. Six years later, already burdened by mounting medical bills, she crosses paths with Harry—now a wealthy heir—and is mistaken for a gold-digger. Amid misunderstandings and public humiliation, the truth finally comes to light, and Harry is consumed by regret.

data.title: After Love Breaks Everything
data.intro: Ian Gould clears the Judd family's debts on one condition—Wren Judd must start a family with him. Five years later, though the promise has been fulfilled, Wren remains indifferent to both him and their daughter, reserving her affection only for her first love, Ken Lowe, and his child. Heartbroken and disappointed, Ian and their daughter finally decide to leave.

data.title: Reborn Under Siege
data.intro: Clara Watson is five months pregnant when her husband General Adam Bronson's childhood sweetheart, Sheila Cork, lures the Narians into the palace to assault Clara. Unexpectedly, the Narians mistake her as Clara, and she falls victim to her own schemes, losing her life yet spending her final moments framing Clara for everything.

data.title: Second Chance? No Thanks
data.intro: In their third year of marriage, Sara Ryder discovers Matt Foster's affair with his student, Jenny Greer. Faced with his unrepentant infidelity, she outwits him into signing a divorce and prepares to leave after thirty days—only for her grandmother to be killed by the pair. As Sara rebuilds the career she once sacrificed for love, Matt uncovers Jenny's true nature and finally realizes how much Sara means to him—but by then, his second chance is already gone.

data.title: Before the Last Goodbye
data.intro: Diagnosed with terminal leukemia, Evelyn Kemp travels to Sutvia for assisted death but unexpectedly meets her ex-boyfriend, Noel Roth, who is soon to marry Joanna Duvall—the woman he cheated on her with—on her birthday. Only after Evelyn's death does Noel learn of Joanna's schemes, breaking down in remorse. Three years later, Evelyn is reborn as "Sue Hertz," returning to confront Noel.

data.title: Off My List: Over and Out
data.intro: In their third year together, top student Liam Burke takes out a loan to pay off Hilda Scott's massive debt, even resorting to working as an escort at a bar. Unbeknownst to him, Hilda is only with Liam to avenge Gerald Nash—the bully who has long oppressed him. Heartbroken by her betrayal, Liam agrees to marry the mute heiress of the Elmer family and exposes Gerald's lies. Though Hilda later tries to win back his heart, Liam's love for her has already faded beyond repair.

data.title: Our Story Died in Your Hands
data.intro: Despite a ten-year relationship and three years of marriage, Simon Grant faces hostility from his wife, Amy Ford, after she loses her memory in an accident. No matter how hard he tries, she insists she's in love with his brother, pushing him away and even having him committed to a psychiatric hospital. When heartbreak finally overwhelms him, Simon marries the heiress of the Zane family—leaving Amy to regret everything, too late.

data.title: A Mother's Reckoning
data.intro: Rosa Parker and her daughter, Mia Carson, are severely injured in a car accident, with Mia's condition critical due to glass shards. Despite the urgency of their situation, Rosa's husband, Theo Carson, arrives and first rushes to assist Karen Hadley and her son, Adam Hadley, before attending to his own wife and daughter.

data.title: Forever His First and Only
data.intro: Sophie Clark has stood by Caleb Smith through his darkest days, supporting him as he rises to success. However, on her birthday, just before their wedding, Caleb leaves her stranded in the wild after receiving a call from his first love. His betrayal shatters her heart, prompting Sophie to marry Yale Steele, the heir to Hubbard's wealthiest family, who has just returned from abroad.

data.title: Addicted to You, On Air and Off
data.intro: After a family misfortune, Dakota Noyce becomes Hudson Zerkle's possession for three years while studying abroad—until graduation night, when she finally leaves for home. That same night, the man who was always composed loses control. Convinced a small gesture will bring her back, he doesn't realize she will be soaring free... while he remains behind.

data.title: Lured by Hidden Passion
data.intro: Abandoned as a child, Julie Sinclair is raised by Rory Sutton. Mistaking dependence for love, she is sent abroad when her feelings are exposed. Years later, she repays the Suttons by becoming Timothy Hill's secret lover—unaware that he has loved her in silence for years and that he will teach her what true love really means.

data.title: Riding into Love
data.intro: Renegade biker Lyon falls in love on the first sight with Kat, a beautiful yet fragile young girl who lands a new job at Lyon's bike shop. As they fall in love, old wounds resurface when Lyon’s pursuer, unwittingly brings danger closer. Bound by love, Lyon and Kat decide to ride on towards a path of confrontation and salvation.

data.title: Her Death Was Step One
data.intro: Lana Axley's mother dies for "ruining" a dress—tortured and drowned by the vindictive Aria Stetson. Worse, Aria's defense attorney is Lana's husband, Liam Gray, who abandoned his own family to be with Lana and now demands that she sign an apology letter. Refusing to be broken, Lana pretends to surrender while secretly building her case. With evidence secured, she fakes her death and begins her calculated revenge.

data.title: Pregnant With My Rival CEO's Baby
data.intro: After a one-night stand between the infertile and my mortal president, I was pregnant with his child! After that, he actually pursued me and wanted to be my husband as the father of the child!

data.title: Escape to Italy with My Undercover Lover
data.intro: Nica Marino, codenamed "Poison Rose," is a mafia heiress and elite assassin. Disguised as a sweet university student, she's sent to eliminate Alessandro Genovese—the heir of a rival crime family. But Alessandro isn't who he claims to be either. Both are undercover, both hiding secrets—and yet, they fall in love in the shadows of New York. As betrayal and family vendettas unravel, they face an impossible choice: kill each other, or escape everything together.

data.title: To My Future Wife
data.intro: On Mia Park's first day at Wilson Group, she married a man she had only met once, fulfilling her grandmother's wish. However, her husband, Tim Shaw, disappeared right after the marriage and never reappeared. Left alone, Mia quickly moved on and focused on her career.“That's outrageous! After a year of disappearance, the first thing he wants upon his return is a divorce? What on earth? Fine, let’s get a divorce!” Mia complained, then noticed something peculiar.

data.title: Where Love Turns to Ruins
data.intro: On his 25th birthday, Xavier Cahill receives a devastating diagnosis: pancreatic cancer. Meanwhile, his family is preoccupied with celebrating the 15th anniversary of his adopted brother, Zeke Judd, joining the family. Zeke hasn't just stolen their affection—he's even captured the heart of Xavier's fiancée, Nancy Flint. So when Nancy and Zeke stage a fake wedding, Xavier resolves to reveal Zeke's true colors to the world.

data.title: Answer to My Heart
data.intro: For years, Cecelia Collins lived in silence, forced to pretend she could not speak. During a kidnapping, she mistakenly believes Ivan Justice doesn't want her unborn child. To protect the baby, she poses as the kidnapper, drawing him into a tense game of confrontation. As their misunderstandings unravel, Cecelia, encouraged by him, finds the courage to speak—and to follow her heart.

data.title: Love On The Run(DUBBED)
data.intro: Fresh out of college, Hannah Marshall covers her mom's night shift at a hotel, where she crosses paths with Miguel Elsher, who has been drugged. As fate would have it, she ends up spending a night in bed with him. Later, when Hannah applies for a position at Elsher Corporation, she becomes Miguel's assistant.As they spend more time together, a gradual romance blossoms between Miguel and Hannah.

data.title: Love Blooms in Contracted Hearts（DUBBED)
data.intro: One tipsy night at a company getaway, Cecilia Caine and Liam Lamberth unexpectedly hooked up. However, she was aware that the CEO had feelings for someone else, so she quietly slipped away, thinking their night meant nothing. Little did she know, Liam had different plans—he wanted to marry her. Desperate for cash, Cecilia reluctantly agreed and endured his unreasonable demands.

data.title: Falling In Love With My Secret Boss
data.intro: Kim was a well - known US finance influencer. Her bluntness ticked off the Garrison Group, and she ended up in total disgrace. With no other options, she cut a deal with Damian from the group and joined the G Group. There, she met Damian, the cold and bossy younger guy, and his seemingly kind, gentle older brother.On one hand, she had this deep - seated hatred she couldn't shake. On the other, she felt this uncontrollable crush.

data.title: In Love's Blind Spot
data.intro: When Lily Ingram regains her sight, she is shocked to discover that the man she has been dating for six months is none other than her fiancé’s uncle. However, escaping the situation is not so simple—Oliver Cobb has developed a deep sense of possession over her. Determined not to let her go, he drafts a one-month agreement to keep her by his side.

data.title: The Billionaire on My Couch
data.intro: Mistaken as an imposter of the family heiress, Kate Gorman is cast out of home and left with no choice but to earn a living at a bar. The day she meets a handsome gigolo, she offers to support his living with three grand per month out of pity. Thinking that he is living off her, Kate is in for a surprise—not only is he a gentle homemaker, but also the owner of a billion-dollar company.

data.title: To Love, To Burn, To Begin Again
data.intro: The scar on Lily Devin's face reminds her of Luke Irwin, the boy she once saved. But Luke mistakes Jewel Kirk for his savior and believes Lily is lying. After twelve years of loving him, Lily marries Luke by investing in him at his lowest point. Yet as his wife, she's blamed for his ex-girlfriend's departure and accused of seduction. Six years after their daughter's birth, Lily dies of cancer but is reborn, able to see everything Luke and their daughter do.

data.title: Eclipsed by Destiny
data.intro: Ian Shaw, once the mightiest of all princes, is cursed from birth with a rare light essence that dooms him to die before the age of thirty. But there is a way to break the curse and secure a long life—and the throne: he must unite with a woman born with dark essence. After ten years of fruitless searching across the land, fate leads him to Lina Judd, a bride caught at her wedding while fleeing assassins.

data.title: Jade Foster Is Mine
data.intro: After a painful breakup with Aslan, her billionaire contracted lover, Jade swears never to see him again. But when his identical twin, Lucas, offers the love she's been seeking, she's drawn back in. As Jade moves in with Lucas, she uncovers a dark family secret that traps her in a dangerous, luxurious world. To break free, she must face the truth about the man she now calls her lover.

data.title: Forged in Betrayal: The Spear of Vengeance
data.intro: Hector Zane, the Grand Marshal of the Realm, retires to marry Sierra Steele in accordance with his parents’ will. Ambitious as she is, Sierra is determined to prove herself on the battlefield. Before she departs for war, Hector gifts her the "Ruby Spear"—a legendary weapon. Three years later, Sierra returns home clad in silver armor and visibly pregnant, holding another man’s hand and a divorce letter. She declares that her husband must be a mighty hero, not a weak scholar.

data.title: Christmas Homecoming of My Trillionaire Husband
data.intro: Philip, the chairman of the Wharton Group and investor in the Ravenham Auto Plant, returns to his wife, Caroline's family to celebrate Christmas. However, unaware of his true identity, her family mocks and mistreats him and even tries to convince Caroline to divorce him, causing her to doubt Riley, until his true identity is revealed, shaming everyone who doubted him. Riley and Caroline reconcile and enjoy their Christmas together.

data.title: The Treasure That Never Ends
data.intro: From the moment Ethan Gray gets his hands on a treasure bowl, he is destined to make a fortune—because the treasure bowl can duplicate anything, whether it’s a brick of gold, a diamond ring, a rare artifact, precious medicine, or an expensive smartphone.

data.title: Her Final Experiment: Their Regret
data.intro: Leia Sutton, once a highly respected medical student, was cherished by her lab teammates—until the arrival of Maya Newman. Falling victim to Maya’s subtle schemes, Leia’s reputation crumbles, leading to betrayal and abandonment by the five teammates she once trusted. As she becomes a public target, her downfall spirals into imprisonment and a lonely death. But fate grants her a second chance. Reborn with the knowledge of her past, Leia refuses to repeat her mistakes.

data.title: Falling for the Internet's Sweetest Temptation
data.intro: After catching her fiancé in bed with her best friend, a rising chef scrambles to save her restaurant by hiring her viral nemesis from culinary school. Sparks fly in and out of the kitchen as the two clash and connect while competing in a high-stakes cooking showdown that could secure—or shatter—their future.

data.title: Light My Fire
data.intro: After three years in a no-love, no-sex arranged marriage, Edith asks for a divorce when she discovers her sexy firefighter husband has gotten another woman pregnant! Even though it means burying her decade-long crush on him! However, her husband refuses to sign unless she agrees to play as a loving couple with him for one last month... Edith is shocked to find that there’s a huge misunderstanding between her and her husband...

data.title: The Wastrel Who Turned Into A Legend
data.intro: Ray Dunn, a notorious outcast scorned by everyone in Hayle, squanders his family's wealth and contributes nothing to society—until a sudden accident transforms him, and he awakens as an entirely different person.

data.title: The Princess of His Heart
data.intro: A Baby, A Billionaire And Me. After an unexpected encounter, Sophie Gray gives birth to a son, Tommy Gray, changing her life forever. Six years later, Lucas Lind learns about the child he never knew existed and sets out to find him. As fate brings them closer, Sophie starts working at Lind Corp, where her relationship with Lucas deepens, and love begins to grow between them.

data.title: The Secret Life of My Dad
data.intro: After a decade of hard work, Sam Wolfe and his wife, Renee Cohen, finally establish a stable foothold in Glendor’s business world. Determined to connect with the influential business tycoon Susan Paige, they attend a grand banquet, hoping to catch her attention. However, to their shock, they encounter Sam’s father, John Wolfe, who is working as a security guard at the event to conceal his identity.

data.title: Married My Way to the Throne: More Wives, More Power
data.intro: Gareth Bush transmigrates to Rassac as a seventy-five-year-old man on the brink of death. Offered four young wives, he awakens the "WifeForce System", which grants him youth and strength through marriage. Since then, he crushes ungrateful family, dominates the army, and rises from common soldier to a founding elite amid chaos.

data.title: Love Is a Game, I Play for Power (DUBBED)
data.intro: Switched at birth, Ruby Wright endures twenty years of hardship in the countryside before being returned to the wealthy Wright family—only to be warned not to outshine their beloved adopted daughter. But Ruby is no fool. Beneath her meek facade, she stirs her father's guilt, turning pity into power. While others scheme, she quietly amasses wealth and shares—until the so-called country girl claims her place as the true heiress.

data.title: The Runaway Heiress
data.intro: The story of a rich girl, Veronica, who is about to marry her beloved fiancé, Logan, but Veronica realizes that Logan's love isn't real, but an elaborate scheme for the benefit of the family. Ellie has been secretly planning to take advantage of Veronica's status and wealth to marry into the family.

data.title: If We Ever Meet Again
data.intro: She once pursued him for two years and helped him get over his father's death. Later, he found a new lover and coldly declared that he was bored of her. Now that he's back, he runs into her and their daughter, who resembles him. His possessiveness takes over. He resorts to lies and threats just to keep her by his side. As the past comes to light, it turns out that both their fathers died in the same tragedy. Can they overcome all misunderstandings and finally be together?

data.title: Running Into Love: My Kind of Mess is You
data.intro: Five years ago, Stacy Olson spent a night with Steve Flynn after being drugged by her stepsister, Megan Olson. She gave birth to quadruplets, but Megan secretly took two of them. Now, five years later, Stacy is raising the remaining two children on her own. She meets Steve again when she applies to Flynn Group, but they fail to recognize each other due to Megan's interference.

data.title: Ruthless and Supreme: His Dominion Absolute
data.intro: Marcus Holt, the great "Lord Valen", ascends the throne and leaves the mountain to the Nash family, meant to save their granddaughter who has Trifrostia Syndrome with his final life-saving treatment and fulfill an old marriage pact. However, despised as a mere mountain man, he is humiliated at her engagement party with the Liddells—until he calmly reveals his true power, stunning all who mocked him.

data.title: Boss Behind the Scenes Is My Husband
data.intro: Holy moly! How could my husband be the most powerful person on earth?

data.title: Reunited with My Three Billionaire Brothers
data.intro: After being betrayed on her anniversary, Hailey—a paralyzed young woman—uncovers the devastating truth that her fiancé and friend have been secretly cheating on her. Trapped and humiliated by the cruel couple, she's on the brink of despair until three powerful billionaire brothers appear, claiming she's their long-lost sister. As doubts about their true identities arise, Hailey is ready to teach those who once hurt her a lesson.

data.title: My Son, The Richest Tycoon
data.intro: It is Joe Archer’s first time visiting a prosperous city. Unfortunately, he is mistaken by Kate Hill and Tina Lowe—who are in a hurry to get a contract signed with Skye Inc.—for a pervert on the subway. Things escalate quickly, and the two women even start harassing him, not knowing that he is the father of Skye Archer, the CEO of Skye Inc.

data.title: A Kiss That Pierced the Night
data.intro: Trapped under the Wynn family's control, adopted daughter Fayne Wynn lives in the shadows as "Willa," painting for her sister and keeping the family's status and wealth. When the Wynns push her into danger, a fateful encounter with the powerful CEO, Yates Lee, changes everything. He becomes her shield against her manipulative father and the family's schemes, helping her reclaim her freedom, glory, and love.

data.title: Her Betrayal, His Reckoning
data.intro: Charles Lawson, the Prince of Jansor, steps down from his prestigious position and devotes himself completely to his wife, Ruby Lane. But his loyalty is shattered when Ruby returns from a year-long business trip, pregnant with her ex-boyfriend’s child. When the truth comes to light, Ruby humiliates Charles, blaming him for the crumbling of their marriage and exposing her true, malicious intentions.

data.title: The Ashes of His Name(DUBBED)
data.intro: Eason Morris was once the pride of his family—until they adopted Colin Yeats, a master manipulator who turned everyone against him. Betrayed by his parents and fiancée, Eason was thrown into prison and left to suffer. After his release, a twist of fate led him to Master Quinn, a legendary artist who took him in as his final student. When Eason faked his death and vanished, those who betrayed him—his fiancée, parents, and sister—were left drowning in regret.

data.title: When the World Burns, So Does Love
data.intro: In a zombie apocalypse, where survivors develop superpowers, Jean Leston sacrifices her Power Core to save her boyfriend, Mason Jones, who was severely injured protecting another survivor, Shannon White. Mason appears to lose all memory of Jean and grows close to Shannon instead. Despite suffering unjust treatment, Jean remains by Mason's side—until she discovers his amnesia was a fabricated scheme to be with Shannon. Betrayed, Jean finally turns and walks away.

data.title: Done With Love, Done With You
data.intro: On the night of their tenth anniversary, Gabe Gibson finds a cheating video in the company group chat. His heart sinks as he recognizes the red mark on the woman’s foot—Sonia’s. Her excuse of being too busy suddenly feels like a lie. Sonia rushes home with smooth explanations, easily winning back his trust. But when she brazenly brings another man home, Gabe realizes the fool he’s been. Enough is enough.

data.title: She Commands the Shadows of Destiny
data.intro: Esme Sanders, lady of Crestfall Estate, looks like she's in her twenties—ethereal and mysterious—but her true age is unknown. Centuries ago, she helped the Four Great Families rise to power, only to be humiliated by them. Now, Hector Gordon, heir of the Gordon family, seeks her help to break a curse. Seeing a hidden connection, Esme keeps him close and lifts the family's centuries-old curse.

data.title: I'm in Every Step You Take
data.intro: Returning to the age of 17, Hannah Smith is given a second chance to rewrite her destiny—but life has other plans. When Zane Ward reappears, she does everything to stay away, determined to break the ties fate has woven between them. Yet no matter how far she runs, he's always one step ahead, ready to claim what's his.

data.title: Velvet Revenge: Crowned in Blood
data.intro: Ten years ago, Nancy Silva witnessed her mother being torn apart by the hounds of Sevyn Lawson, the future empress. She herself was dragged into the mountains, left to die at the jaws of wolves. Just as death was about to claim her, a mysterious savior appeared, teaching her the art of seduction as a weapon for revenge. Years later, Nancy claws her way into the palace, unveiling Sevyn's true nature and avenging her mother's brutal fate.

data.title: Wanted By The Rogue Alpha
data.intro: Driven by an instinctive pull, Xavier, the Alpha of a rogue wolf pack, senses the emergence of his fated mate. Tracing this profound connection, he finds Dr. Isla, an Omega. Captivated by her unique blend of gentleness and resilience, Xavier is determined to claim her. However, Isla believes her destined partner is another.

data.title: Veil of Eternity: Awakened to Her Power
data.intro: At Jim York's funeral, a mysterious veiled woman appears, claiming she made a pact with him a century ago—and demanding that the York family offer their finest descendant as her servant. Outraged, the Yorks dismiss her as a fraud, even accusing her of being Jim's mistress. But when her veil is lifted, long-buried secrets and century-old feuds come to light, revealing her true identity—and forcing the family to choose between honor and desire.

data.title: Hot Marshal Begs for Marriage
data.intro: For years, Zoe Lane harbored a secret love for Yuri Sheen, longing to marry him. However, Vivi Jenkins, leveraging Yuri's debt of gratitude to her mother, deceived Yuri into marriage. Exploiting Yuri's protective instincts, Vivi succeeded in her scheme. Yuri trusted Vivi and unwittingly became an accomplice to Vivi's actions. As Zoe grapples with the news of her terminal illness, She proposed a divorce and is consequently driven out of her home.

data.title: His Eye of Fortune
data.intro: When clairvoyance awakens in Alan Fowler, a staff member at an antique store, the glorious journey of his life begins.

data.title: A Second Life as an Unrestrained Heir
data.intro: A multi-talented agent time-travels into the body of Mason Snyder, a prodigal whose engagement is on the verge of being canceled by his fiancee due to contempt. Despite inheriting the reputation of a supposed loser, he cleverly leverages his knowledge to live a carefree life, indulging in his desires and gaining notoriety as an infamous feckless prodigal.

data.title: Love That Survives the Hurt
data.intro: Seven years ago, Mable Graham donated a kidney to her boyfriend, then left him—afraid she'd become a burden. She raised their daughter, Cora Flint, alone, only to be branded a gold-digger by the man she once loved. Now, with Mable in a coma after a tragic accident, young Cora fights to raise money for her recovery—until Heidi Lane steps in to sabotage her efforts.

data.title: Dominion Reclaimed: His Path to Supremacy
data.intro: Vance Zahn, known as Lord Zahn, single-handedly slays the Ten Savage Deities, inscribes the laws of the universe, and ascends as the Deity of Creation across the Nine Realms. After bestowing divine enlightenment upon the Azure Empress, the Human Emperor, and the Demon Emperor, he retreats into a deep slumber. But a hundred thousand years later—before his strength fully returns—the sages strike from the shadows.

data.title: Out of Your Life, On Top of Mine
data.intro: Sam Yates devoted 30 years of his life to his family, even giving up the chance to become the country's top news anchor. But just as he thinks his happiness is secured, Julia Ford files for divorce to be with Connor Linton, humiliating him in front of their children before moving in with Connor. Consumed by anger, Sam dies—only to be reborn with a second chance to set things right. Meanwhile, Julia immediately regrets her choice when Connor's abusive nature is revealed.

data.title: Mr.Johnston,Don’t Torment Her
data.intro: Swain Ross and Shane Johnston have been lovers for five years. One day Shane Johnston decided to end the relationship with Swain. Meanwhile, Swain unexpectedly learns that she has only three months left to live due to heart failure. In order not to being implicated in love again, Swain decided to leave Shane, but she didn't realize that a relationship of pain had just begun...

data.title: Badge of Duty, Heart of Trouble
data.intro: Seth Brock enjoys a quiet life in retirement, far from the violence and chaos of the financial world. But when his son drags him back to the company as a security guard, he reluctantly agrees—for his son's sake. What he doesn't expect is that this unassuming job will lead him to cross paths with a stunning female CEO, who enters his life in the most unexpected way.

data.title: No One Like Her In This World（DUBBED)
data.intro: Zoey Summers made a deal with a mysterious man called Raven Moses to exchange her life for Ian Jennings’ company to be saved. On the day Ian became the richest man in the country, he asked Zoey for a divorce. After Zoey died, she returned as Willow Waters to protect her daughter, and won Ian’s heart in the process.

data.title: Wild for My Boy Toy
data.intro: In a world where ambition collides with desire, fashion photographer Charlotte Watson learns that love and survival often demand impossible choices. After an impulsive one-night stand with Devin, a captivating model who disrupts her career and her heart, Charlotte finds herself entangled in a stormy love triangle with him and Noam, her loyal yet conflicted boss.

data.title: Misplaced Love
data.intro: Perhaps it was destiny that brought many chances together to create a beautiful marriage.Annie, a poor girl, becomes a surrogate mother to pay off her debts. But due to a mistake in sperm implantation, she finds herself in a dilemma as the employer refuses to pay the final installment. Desperate, Annie seeks out the biological father for financial help. Meanwhile, billionaire Jason is bewildered by the news that he has a surrogate child. Their encounters are riddled .....

data.title: Call Me Gone and Gorgeous(DUBBED)
data.intro: Lois Glyn cared for blind Arthur Herbert for five years, only to be betrayed and replaced by Juliet Glyn. Dying in despair, she's reborn and chooses to let go of Arthur—but Juliet won't let her go. At a banquet, Juliet frames her for theft and turns her parents against her, leaving her for dead in a car crash. Disheartened, Lois cuts all ties—until Arthur learns the truth and begins a desperate pursuit.

data.title: No More Lies, No More Tears (DUBBED)
data.intro: On the eve of a prestigious drawing contest, Kelvin Pace suffers severe injuries in an accident and is unable to pursue his dreams any further. While his caring sister explodes with rage and his loving fiancée is overwhelmed with heartbreak on the surface, they are secretly the culprits behind the incident—so that their adoptive brother, Luther Statham, can win instead. Upon learning the truth, Kelvin sinks into endless despair.

data.title: Forever Was a Lie
data.intro: Nicole Quinn is taken in by her mother’s best friend after her family goes bankrupt, beginning a 20-year bond with Colin and Abel from the Smith family. The brothers dote on Nicole, but everything changes when the nanny’s daughter, Mandy Moore, enters the picture. Nicole becomes the target of Mandy’s schemes and humiliation, placing her in a difficult situation where the Smith brothers start distancing themselves and lose interest in her.

data.title: Raised by Love, Denied by Blood
data.intro: A DNA test report reveals that Serene Wood is the lost child from years ago, with her mole and bracelet as irrefutable evidence. She's at death's door just as her lost identity is restored, both redemption and mortal peril arriving hand-in-hand under the dim moonlight.

data.title: Sleeping Handsome, Let's Mate!
data.intro: Avery, a struggling call girl, seizes the chance to marry the sole heir of the rich Waldorf family to earn money for her mother's medical bills. However, her future husband, Elliot, is a vegetable. Can Avery fulfill her commitment in this unexpected situation?

data.title: No Looking Back, No Mercy Left
data.intro: Nora Keller, once a gifted finance prodigy, gave up her promising future to marry Liam Levin. Seven years later, her son's birthday wish for a stepmother exposes Liam's betrayal and deepens her heartbreak. When she discovers he caused her miscarriage, Nora files for divorce and rises to success in her career, while he remains arrogant. Eventually, he tries to reach out—only to face her cold disappointment.

data.title: Married But Available: Perfume And Moon
data.intro: Alpha Arthur's return marked a grand estate feast where he rescued Chloe, the butler, from noble Eileen's insults. Despite Chloe's engagement for her grandfather's sake and Arthur's subsequent departure, she silently worked at William Manor to cover her grandfather's medical expenses. Arthur, captivated by Chloe's talent, defied opposition and annulled the engagement. In a surprising twist, Chloe's awakened werewolf genes unveiled her as Arthur's destined mate.

data.title: Love on a Deadline
data.intro: As Celeste Garnet prepared to leave for Afresia to start a well-paid job, she unexpectedly crossed paths with Arthur Creek, the CEO of Creek Corporation. Due to a misunderstanding, the two agreed to marry to quell public rumors. However, on the day they got their marriage certificates, they also filed for divorce, planning to separate quietly once the mandatory waiting period was over.

data.title: Where Love Once Lingered
data.intro: What Hannah Steele thinks is a special bond between her and Ronald Shaw, the crown prince she grew up with, turns into something else the moment Ronald meets Noelle Steele. Left with nothing but disappointment, Hannah marries Ronald's uncle, Zachary Shaw, instead, and Ronald only realizes his mistake after the truth is revealed—but it is already too late for amendments.

data.title: Signed Off, Moved On (DUBBED)
data.intro: Maya Shaw, heiress of Isburg, sacrifices her sight to save Cody Reed and marries him—only to witness his affair with his secretary on the day she regains her vision. Heartbroken, she inherits her mentor's legacy and divorces Cody. But as she begins to thrive in the medical field with Wayne Cox by her side, Cody regrets everything and desperately tries to win her back.

data.title: Restarted as His Forever(DUBBED)
data.intro: Sofia Xander was betrayed by everyone she loved. Her parents favored her adopted sister. Her husband and son turned their backs on her. When a mysterious system offers her a new life, she accepts. Three days later, she wakes up as Sophie Pace. Soon, she receives a shocking proposal—from Zeke Harmon, heir to the Harmon family and her ex-husband’s biggest rival. He’s a stranger, yet he knows everything about her. He defends her, protects her, and never leaves her side.

data.title: Trapped in the Allure
data.intro: Tanya Abell sells her virginity at a high price to Taylor Wayne in order to raise money for her sister’s medical treatment. One year later, she bumps into him at a gathering. Taylor recognizes her and traps her against the wall. She escapes and rushes back into the private room, only to be dragged back to Taylor by Jason, who tells her that the only person who has the cure to save her sister is Taylor.

data.title: Bow to Me, Mortal, or Be Crushed
data.intro: After failing a heavenly test, the Radiant Goddess transmigrates into Clara Bennett. Over the next ten years, she achieves greatness, commanding respect—and fear—from countless prominent figures. But to return to heaven, Clara must fulfill her host's final wishes. The moment she steps into the Bennett residence, she finds her parents being mistreated! Naturally, Clara strikes back. Her enemies fume—but what can they do? She is the goddess they dare not offend!

data.title: The Cure for a Broken Heart
data.intro: They were the perfect couple, inseparable with their dog, Lacy. But he was secretly allergic—forcing down pills just to stay close. His jealous stepsister twisted the truth: if she truly loved him, she'd leave with the dog before his career was destroyed. Heartbroken, she disappeared. He thought she betrayed him. Years later, he's not just a football superstar but the CEO of a company that created the miracle cure for canine heart disease.

data.title: Spoiled By My Billionaire Husband
data.intro: Scarlett, on a journey to fulfil her grandmother's last wish, chooses the path of a flash marriage. However, she ends up targeting the wrong person: her husband is none other than a mysterious billionaire whom she met long before.

data.title: You're No One to Me Now
data.intro: Carmen Yates, adopted by the Spencer family, is supposed to marry one of her three brothers. But instead of love, they treat her coldly. Meanwhile, Savannah Cook, the maid's daughter mistaken for their savior, gets all their care and affection. Heartbroken, Carmen marries their young uncle, Frank Spencer, instead—but everyone calls her a liar and attention seeker. When the truth is revealed, her brothers beg for forgiveness, but Carmen leaves without looking back.

data.title: A Love That Devours
data.intro: In the game of love, Rey Quinn has always been the conqueror—the ruthless plunderer. He gives Sonia Reed ten days to surrender while executing his own plans, shattering her once-stable life like a predator. Yet before he can claim victory, Rey finds himself stepping down from his throne, consumed by an obsession that only grows stronger each day.

data.title: My Heart Has Always Known
data.intro: To save her mom from an abusive relationship with her father, Nina Judd agrees to take the place of her sister, who has vanished, in a marriage alliance with the heir of the powerful Zanes, Sean. Despite supposedly marrying into a life of luxury, she realizes her new husband is a workaholic who has little interest in her. Little does she know, her caring nature melts Sean's cold heart, and what appeared to be a marriage of benefit turns out to be the true love.

data.title: Ablaze With Vengeance
data.intro: Years ago, Layla York, Balton’s Valkyrie, believed Sean Groff had saved her life, and that belief led to their marriage. Over the past three years, she has devoted herself to him and his family, aiding in his ascent to prominence and facilitating his entry into the Onyx Group. She plans to announce his appointment as CEO during the Phoenix Gala.

data.title: My Secret Husband: The Billionaire
data.intro: Tired of her sister and brother-in-law’s endless quarrels, Tasha Hale impulsively enters a flash marriage with Ian Zahn—unaware that he is the nation's top CEO. As they navigate family conflicts and the constant risk of Ian’s identity being exposed, their bond deepens, and Ian finds himself truly falling for her. Determined to make their union real, he finally proposes, and Tasha joyfully says yes to the man she has come to love.

data.title: Masked, Mighty, Mine
data.intro: Refusing an arranged marriage, Jill Stork enters a contract marriage with a mysterious male model who protects her in secret while she seeks revenge. Little does she know, behind the mask of the penniless model hides Zac Quinn, ruler of a peerless business empire who supports her every decision—and will soon prove she has always been his one and only choice with a one-of-a-kind grand wedding.

data.title: A Breath Away From Foreverd (DUBBED)
data.intro: Five years ago, Callista Summers rescued Jeremiah Fuller when he was drugged. She then pursued her career abroad, driven by her initial self-doubt as a housekeeper. Over time, Callista became a renowned designer and a devoted mother to her son, Scotty Fuller. When she learns of Jeremiah’s kidney failure, she selflessly returns to donate her kidney, saving him once more. However, misunderstandings breed animosity between them.

data.title: Revenge Wears the Crown
data.intro: After dying alone and filled with resentment after being abandoned by her husband, Sarah Allen awakens to the day of her wedding to Ethan Zabel. Determined to change her fate, she calls off the marriage and instead aligns herself with the disabled but powerful Prince Regent, Lucas Crane.

data.title: Bride Exchange: Her Second Chance
data.intro: At a lavish banquet thrown by the Murphy brothers to celebrate Tina Klein’s pregnancy, Emma Klein, consumed by jealousy, disguises herself as a cleaner to sneak into the event. In a fit of rage, she murders Tina in the dressing room before taking her own life to evade the consequences. In a shocking turn, Tina is inexplicably reborn, back in time to the day her marriage was arranged.

data.title: Buried Secrets, Burning Hearts
data.intro: Right before their wedding, Ethan Stone makes a shocking discovery: his girlfriend, Sharon Royce, is actually his stepsister. After his mother takes her own life, he chooses to leave Sharon and bury the truth, no matter how much it hurts. Five years later, he learns that Sharon was adopted and that they were never related by blood. With this revelation, Ethan returns from abroad—determined to win her back and avenge his mother.

data.title: Thorns and Thrones: Her Rise Amid Shadows
data.intro: Scarlett Neal transmigrates into the past as the marquis' illegitimate daughter and spends six years preparing before entering the palace. Though she desires a peaceful life, she is framed as the one plotting against the royal heir. Realizing the only path to power is through the emperor's favor, she clears her name and cunningly wins his heart, forging her own way to success.

data.title: Before the Divorce: My CEO Husband Can't Get Enough of Me
data.intro: Sophia is set up for a one-night stand with a man, only to find out that the man she had sex with last night is her husband, Matthew Soro. Unexpectedly, Matthew does not recognize Sophia as his wife, whom he has not seen for three years after getting a marriage license. Sophia is already a PR manager and meets Matthew again while collaborating on a project.

data.title: Years Apart, Heart to Heart
data.intro: To save her comatose mother, Kate Sutton, young Mabel scavenges for money and accidentally scratches Roger Howe's luxury car. She refuses his charity and insists on repaying him in the future, reminding him of his long-lost pregnant wife—until Mabel's pendant confirms that she is his daughter. As relatives scheme to force Kate into a bone marrow donation for money, Mabel risks her life to save her mother, but to no avail—until Roger shows up just in time.

data.title: Our Paths That Shall Never Cross
data.intro: To keep a deathbed promise to her late friend, Paula Young dedicates herself to taking care of her friend's husband and daughter, neglecting her own family to an unbearable extent. Her husband Jared Grant, unable to tolerate any more, files for divorce and leaves with their daughter, later starting a new life with his admirer Sophie Lang—and only then does Paula realize her mistake, overwhelmed by regret.

data.title: The Dangerous Kind of Love
data.intro: To pay for her grandmother's medical bills, Chloe Levin takes a secret side job posing as clients' girlfriends. When a deal goes wrong, she's rescued by the infamous John Havok. Disguised as "Hunter," he later hires her, revealing his true identity only when they meet again. Terrified but desperate, Chloe stays for her grandmother's sake—yet she laughs off his arrogant claim that she'll fall for him within a month... until she does.

data.title: Reborn in Blood: The Vengeful Princess
data.intro: In her past life, Juliette Sutton was the unfavored third princess of Xucror, whose family faced a miserable fate due to royal conflicts. Right before her death, she saw Elijah Shaw rushing to her aid, slaughtering her enemies along the way and being deemed a heartless traitor. Now that she’s reborn, she vows to take revenge on those who wronged her.

data.title: Love That Comes Too Late
data.intro: When Jill Shaw uncovers her husband Sam Ford's betrayal with her own sister, Nina Soot, she makes a bold choice to walk away—leaving both her marriage and her job behind. At Ford Corp, she seizes the chance to shine, unleashing her full potential and gaining a clearer picture of Sam's true character. As Jill excels in both her career and love life, she unexpectedly attracts Sam's attention once again—but this time, nothing will ever be the same.

data.title: Game Flipped, Crown Slipped (DUBBED)
data.intro: When Renata Jennings can't stand losing to brilliant Juniper Keaton, she makes her charming childhood friend, Neil, seduce Juniper and ruin her focus. But Juniper is three steps ahead, playing the perfect mark. As Renata gets ready to expose Juniper's downfall on results day, she has no idea the real trap has already been set for her. What was meant to be revenge may become her ultimate humiliation.

data.title: When Love Runs Out
data.intro: Wanting to make the most of his life before marriage, Nick Frye pretends to have lost only his memories of Ruby Wright in a car accident. Desperate to help him, Ruby spends all her savings on a rumored cure—only to uncover the truth just as she is about to give it to him. Shattered by the betrayal, she changes her name and moves abroad to escape the unbearable heartbreak.

data.title: Velvet Chains: His Sweetest Trap
data.intro: To save her ailing sister, Mia Tate accepts a lucrative job disguising herself as a man to secretly film tycoon David Burke—but to her shock, she becomes the target. Forced to take another mission to earn her freedom, she's sent to seduce the wheelchair-bound heir, Philip Kent—only to learn he and David are the same man. Caught between revenge and desire, Mia is drawn into a dangerous game of love, power, and redemption.

data.title: Her Perfect Disguise, His Devoted Love
data.intro: The seemingly perfect golden girl, Ella Clark, is actually an impostor. To free her grandmother from a gilded prison, she navigates the elite world with lies. Mason Jaffe sees through her disguise. Torn between contempt and obsession, he becomes the only one who walks toward her against the light. When the mask shatters, his outstretched hand rewrites their fate. The most dangerous hunter has long risked his sincere heart.

data.title: Whirlwind Vows: The Storm of Love (DUBBED)
data.intro: After her father ends up in a vegetative state, Sophie Lush is tricked by her stepmother and stepsister into sleeping with a stranger, then kicked out of her home. To pay for her father’s medical bills, she sells the ring left behind by the stranger, not knowing that he is Colin Reid, the CEO of Mirage Corp. Unbeknownst to her, Colin searches for her for years but fails to track her down.

data.title: Reborn to the '80s: Turning Over a New Leaf
data.intro: The notorious CEO Desmond York was reborn to the 1980s. Not only was he penniless, but he was reborn as the well-known loser, Norton Brooks. His first love who had tragically died in his previous life was actually Norton’s wife? Then in this life, she would just relax and enjoy the life while he would bring home the bacon.  His adoptive family were bloodsuckers? He would deal with them. Were the Desmond of this new life and his gang up to no good? He would take them down.

data.title: Cuteness Overload: The Empire Trembles
data.intro: After five years on the mountain, Jenna Stirling returns home, only to witness her heartless father beating her mother half to death. Furious, Jenna punishes her own brutal father and reports him to the emperor—who is her uncle. Not only does she demand a divorce for her mother, but also vows to protect the land with her ability.

data.title: If Loving You Kills, I'll Choose Life
data.intro: Opal Klein is deeply in love with Bruce Eaton and does everything she can to forgive his affair—but the pain of betrayal ultimately ends their marriage. Soon after, she is diagnosed with gastric cancer and falls gravely ill. Just when all seems lost, the man who has been searching for her for years finds her, saves her, and fakes her death, giving her a chance at a completely new life.

data.title: Surrender is Your Only Escape
data.intro: Five years ago, Coraline Judd crossed Jason Lawson's forbidden line—drugging him and vanishing after a night of forbidden passion. Now, even while hiding her true identity, she can't escape his grasp when they cross paths again—for the trap was set the moment their eyes first met.

data.title: Return of the Dominant Queen (DUBBED)
data.intro: Layla Moore, formerly the second-in-command at Seradel Palace, moved to Redville with her daughter, Clara Moore. Six months ago, Clara married Harry Chase, who has subjected her to abuse and violence. Not only is Harry a poor husband, but he also conspires with a bandit named Michael Kane for personal gain. As word of their schemes spreads, Layla returns to Seradel, reclaiming her throne as queen to save her daughter and thwart Michael's conspiracy once and for all.

data.title: You're My Impossible Goodbye
data.intro:
In her school days, Winnie Scott fell for Cody Foley at first sight. Lacking confidence, she stepped aside to help her best friend win his heart. But one fateful night changed everything, beginning a secret relationship between Winnie and Cody.
For four years, their love remains hidden—along with the daughter they unknowingly conceived. But when Winnie's best friend returns from abroad, secrets begin to unravel.

data.title: Ms. Billionaire’s Love Business
data.intro: Evelyn, a career driven single lady in her 20s, the general manager of the Smith Group, meets Daniel, a college student with a chivalry heart. During a blind date, she leans that Daniel is the neglected third child of the Johnson family. The two quickly agreed to marry and resolve their practical dilemma. Yet after the wedding, the fake couple started feeling something real towards each other, and become the light in each other’s shadowed heart.

data.title: Hubby, Show Me The Money
data.intro: Elaine Franklin, pressured into an arranged marriage, impulsively weds stranger Vincent after sabotaging her blind date. Unbeknownst to her, Vincent—secretly CEO of rival Jones Corp—recognizes her as his long-lost love. They maintain façades: she hides her film-director identity ("Andrea"), he conceals his wealth. By chance, the fascinating story unfolds...

data.title: Double Contract Love
data.intro: After a one-night stand, they accidentally reunite at the registry office and get married, pretending to be poor to each other after marriage. The heroine is constantly at war with the female antagonist to reclaim her mother's company, during which the hero's true identity gradually surfaces, triggering a series of conflicts and crises. In the process of reclaiming her mother's relics, their relationship heats up.

data.title: Thorns of Fate: Reborn to Take It All Back
data.intro: In the previous life, Grace and Nina grew up in the same orphanage. When fate offered them a choice, Nina chose the wealthy Grants, while Grace was taken by janitors. But Victor Grant fell for Grace instead, and on their wedding day, Nina's rage ended them both. Given a second chance at life, Nina seizes Grace's path, only to fall into a darker hell. Grace rewrites her fate—rising from shadows with talent, courage, and her own hard-won power.

data.title: The Rise of Mr. & Mrs. Mafia
data.intro: An unpaid debt causes Sophie Laurent to be kidnapped by the dangerous yet captivating mafia prince, Vincent Hastings, who finds himself falling for her. However, salvation seems to glimmer through Lance, Vincent's brother. Will Lance be the key to Sophie's freedom, or will she be drawn into the seductive web of mafia intrigue?

data.title: Forget Me Not: Omega’s Return
data.intro: Elena, a downtrodden werewolf, crosses paths with Theodore, the seemingly merciless Alpha of the Blackvine pack. Their encounter sparks a revelation: they are fated mates. As passion ignites, they are thrust into a perilous dance, battling against societal divides and formidable adversaries. The burning question looms large: will their love conquer the insurmountable odds, or will fate cruelly tear them apart?

data.title: Once Upon a Divorce: The Double Life of Lady Diana
