data.intro: After being betrayed, the secret daughter of a billionaire unexpectedly enters into a contract marriage with a wealthy tycoon. Together, they take down the deceitful ex and navigate intense family rivalries, ultimately finding their path to happiness.

data.title: Back in Your Arms, Where I Belong
data.intro: At a lavish banquet, rising tycoon Zach Young publicly calls out his ex, Nancy Lane—unaware that she is in danger. Her daughter pleads desperately for him to save her, but Zach refuses to believe the girl is his own. Helpless, Nancy watches as hope slips through her fingers, unaware that she is still alive—and that her determined daughter will stop at nothing to bring her back.

data.title: Heart Under His Care
data.intro: Clare Shaw takes her child to the hospital, only to discover that the doctor is the man from her one-night stand. Mistaking her for a gold-digger, he refuses to believe the child is his—until a life-threatening attack forces the truth into the open. As he saves her, love slowly begins to bloom between them. But just when things start to fall into place, a shocking revelation shatters their peace: he is bound by an arranged marriage to another woman.

data.title: Hearts Out of Sync
data.intro: Ever since the day she married Mark Smith, Yara Ward has endured years of neglect. Mark not only shows her no affection, but also turns a blind eye to the way others mistreat her. After her rebirth, Yara is determined to leave him behind and reclaim her dignity as the rightful heiress of Ward Corp.

data.title: You're the Radiance of Night
data.intro: Liam Shaw and Nora York were in love years ago before they separated by accident. However, under complex circumstances, they got married without seeing each other. Two years later, they meet again, but Nora finds out that Liam has forgotten about her. Misunderstandings and events emerge as obstacles in their relationship. Will they manage to overcome these challenges and find their way back to each other?

data.title: When A Substitute Wife Seeks To Lose Favor
data.intro: Stella Payne, the second daughter of the Paynes, acts dumb to uncover the truth behind her mother's death.On the way to the arranged marriage, Stella falls victim to a car accident orchestrated by her stepmother but is rescued by Joseph Chambers. Unbeknownst to her, Joseph is the heir of the prestigious Chambers family and the secret owner of Shadow Villa. As the revenge plan unfolds, their interactions lead to a mutual understanding.

data.title: The End of Happily Ever After
data.intro: Lucas Kent gave up his birthright as heir to Kent Corp for a simple life with Melanie Porter. But on the eve of their wedding, a devastating betrayal involving her closest friend shatters everything he sacrificed. Lucas reaches his breaking point and finally cuts ties with Melanie. He reclaims the life and legacy he once abandoned as heir to Kent Corp. Only then, when the truth unfolds before her, does Melanie drown in bitter regret.

data.title: My Mother, The Hidden Tycoon
data.intro: Mary Lane, once the Queen of Velorian Finance, has been living a quiet life, working in a restaurant after stepping away from her esteemed career. She has remained unnoticed—until Zach Gray, CEO of Gray Corp, witnesses her fearless takedown of a fraudster, instantly earning his admiration. Despite her humble occupation, Mary secretly supports her daughter, Luna Lane, helping her company rise to the top of the automobile industry.

data.title: Power Reclaimed, Glory Restored
data.intro: A tale of power, pride, and second chances spans two worlds and five centuries. Hugh Jaffe had it all in the Immortal Realm until betrayal cut his existence short. Reborn as an ordinary man in the mortal world, he sacrifices his freedom to protect his wife Amber Frost's business empire, only to end up in prison.Behind bars, his noble character earns him an unlikely alliance with Finn Yates, the feared leader of the Teal Gang.

data.title: Love's Unrequited Melody
data.intro: Serene Young fell in love with Mason Davis when she was young and eventually married him years later, fulfilling her wishes. However, she soon discovers that he only married her for the benefits it brought. For nearly a decade, Serene devoted herself to Mason, enduring mistreatment and heartbreak. Now diagnosed with cancer, she catches Mason with Wendy Reed and decides to divorce him.

data.title: Fifty, Fabulous, and in Love
data.intro: Many years ago, Sarah Evans was separated from her son, Alex Evans, and has never stopped searching for him since, all while running a shop on her own. Time flies, and her other son, Jason, now has his own family. Sarah decides to move in with Jason to help with their child, but her daughter-in-law loathes her. To avoid causing trouble for Jason, Sarah chooses to leave and seek a stable life through blind dates.

data.title: My Parents, The Undercover Billionaires
data.intro: The wealthiest couple in the world, Dylan Earl and Helen Gray, finally reunite with their long-lost son, Ryan Earl. To test his character, they choose to disguise themselves as humble laborers when meeting him. To their surprise, Ryan not only accepts their background but also introduces his girlfriend, Alicia Finn, to them. However, the Finn family looks down upon Dylan and Helen, prompting Ryan to call off the engagement to protect his parents.

data.title: Her Pride & His Prejudice
data.intro: After a humiliating betrayal by billionaire Jonathan Silverstein and his rich friends, photographer Celeste Paige tries to move on—until their paths collide again. As they navigate a tense professional reunion, old wounds and new sparks ignite, forcing them to confront class divides, past lies, and the lingering love neither can deny. Can they rewrite their story, or will pride and prejudice destroy their second chance?

data.title: The Immortal's Everyday Life Goes Viral
data.intro: Heath Lawson is the world's only Transcendent cultivator. For a century, he abandons worldly ties, dedicating himself to a solitary life of cultivation. But when he fails a tribulation and his path comes to an end, he returns to experience life's pleasures and make amends with his descendants. Yet his family line has long faded into obscurity—except for one surviving great-granddaughter.

data.title: The Girlboss' Mysterious Guardian
data.intro: Coming from a village background, Bruce Parker visits his aunt, Belle Larson, in the bustling city. When he sees the mistreatment Belle faces, he utilizeui skills to triumph over the bullies. Along the way, he not only earns some money but alss his feng sho becomes a lifesaver, navigating through diverse adventures in the vibrant cityscape.

data.title: When the Puppet Cuts the Strings
data.intro: As the son of the richest man on Earth, Alfred Roger has everything—except the love of his first crush, Haley Peck. He fulfills her every wish, lavishing her with over $1 million a month, obediently granting every request. But when Alfred’s life is threatened by a serious illness, he only asks for $100,000 to cover treatment costs—and is met with cruel rejection.

data.title: Her Final Experiment: Their Regret (DUBBED)
data.intro: Leia Sutton, once a highly respected medical student, was cherished by her lab teammates—until the arrival of Maya Newman. Falling victim to Maya’s subtle schemes, Leia’s reputation crumbles, leading to betrayal and abandonment by the five teammates she once trusted. As she becomes a public target, her downfall spirals into imprisonment and a lonely death. But fate grants her a second chance. Reborn with the knowledge of her past, Leia refuses to repeat her mistakes.

data.title: She Conquers the World, I Conquer Her
data.intro: In a modern world where spiritual energy has all but vanished, true cultivators are rare—and those who exist wield immense power. Monsters hide away, training in secret. The female lead, a white fox who has risen to become an unrivaled demon lord, seeks to take human form and approaches the male lead for a title. But he surprises her—making her his wife instead. Bound by a heavenly contract, their fates intertwine.

data.title: My Billionaire Father's Hidden Life
data.intro: Chris Lynch, a member of the nouveau riche, arranges for his father, Hank Lynch, to participate in a matchmaking show out of fear that he will live alone with no one to care for him. However, what seems like an ordinary matchmaking show reveals Hank's hidden identity. Not only are a beautiful chairwoman, the boss of an underground circle, and a famous actress his confidantes, but even the world's top companies need his investment to keep their systems running.

data.title: Love After Rebirth: Turning the Tide
data.intro: Through sweet talk and petty tricks, Paul Brown marries Yvette Young, the daughter of General Young. Exploiting the General's favoritism, Paul gains allies within the army and sets traps to eliminate the General on the battlefield. After his schemes succeed, Paul falls in love with another woman and forces Yvette to take the blame for his crimes. Consequently, Yvette is compelled by his mother to ingratiate herself with Julian Sheffield, the commander of the Uniform Guards.

data.title: Shadowed Ascension: The Demon Lord's Reckoning
data.intro: After the accidental death of his father, Quinton Zane is left to care for his sister, Layla Zane. In order to survive in the strange and dangerous world, he conceals his true strength and trains hard to become stronger. He reveals his formidable power only after his sister gets hurt, shocking everyone and changing their perceptions of him— the future ruler of Tredon.

data.title: Out of Your Reach, Into Hers
data.intro: Growing up alongside the Gibson sisters, Keith Flanagan was always their favorite—and even their ideal groom. But when the scheming Wilson Steele arrives, he wins the sisters' hearts, leaving no place for Keith. Heartbroken, he marries Nicole Rainford instead. Yet the story isn't over—the Gibsons, filled with regret, are determined to crash his wedding.

data.title: Ultimate Dominance: All Hail to Me!
data.intro: Skyler Larson, known as the Celestial Lord, shatters the barriers between realms and returns to Earth. With swift determination, he seizes control of Skyward, the prestigious academy in Southlin. Yet, his homecoming is marred by turmoil. His mother faces peril, while his wife and daughter endure torment. Driven by fury, Skyler confronts Skyward, showcasing his might by ringing the Mythic Bell before defeating Calista Lane and her brother, Felix Lane.

data.title: Letters to the Boy Who Will Break Me
data.intro: Unable to conceive, Faye Shaw is betrayed by her husband of thirteen years, Caleb Steele, who turns to his secretary, Nina Dench, for an affair—and even gets her pregnant. One day, Faye stumbles upon the notebook through which Caleb once confessed his love to her years ago. To her surprise, she discovers she can now communicate with eighteen-year-old Caleb through it.

data.title: Lion's Dawn
data.intro: Leo was paralyzed and in a coma for three years after a car accident. Davina dropped out of school to care for him. Leo was secretly the heir to the Thorne Group and Brandohr family. During a fundraiser, Joseph tried to take Davina, but Leo woke up and called his family, who stopped Joseph. At their wedding, Davina’s relatives mocked Leo, but Cynthia and the Earl of Brandohr appeared, silencing everyone. Leo then proposed to Davina.

data.title: Rewind to Love, Fast-Forward to Forever
data.intro: In her past life, Grace Hart married Nigel Dawson, a penniless man, yet unexpectedly became a wealthy wife. Meanwhile, her sister Margo Hart married Officer Alvin Kirk—only to lose her mind after he died in an accident shortly after their wedding. Unable to bear such unfairness, Margo murdered Grace but ultimately lost her own life in the ensuing chaos.

data.title: Error 404: Malware of the Heart
data.intro: As Ann Sawyer lies on her deathbed, her final wish is to find a long-lost acquaintance. When Finn Jones arrives at her side, she entrusts him with a solemn request: marry her daughter, Rose, and protect Wellton Group. Finn agrees—but Rose, blinded by misplaced trust in Nigel Snow, turns against him. Only after losing Finn does she uncover the truth he had kept hidden, and the weight of her mistake crashes down upon her.

data.title: My Husband's Secret Empire
data.intro: Behind a perfect marriage lies a devastating secret. When Fred Colton finally unveils his true identity to his unsuspecting wife, her response shatters his world: divorce.

data.title: Whirlwind Vows: The Storm of Love
data.intro: After her father ends up in a vegetative state, Sophie Lush is tricked by her stepmother and stepsister into sleeping with a stranger, then kicked out of her home. To pay for her father’s medical bills, she sells the ring left behind by the stranger, not knowing that he is Colin Reid, the CEO of Mirage Corp. Unbeknownst to her, Colin searches for her for years but fails to track her down.

data.title: System On: Starvation? Not on My Watch!
data.intro: Casey Shaw accidentally transmigrates into her own novel, becoming the doomed heroine destined to starve. Determined to change her fate, she abandons her cruel adoptive parents and marries the comatose farmer Dave Yale—for nothing more than shelter. Unexpectedly, she awakens a mysterious "system" that guides her toward wealth and success. When Dave finally wakes, love blooms, rewriting their tragic destiny.

data.title: Plot Hijackers: Besties Rewrite a Billionaire Romance
data.intro: Rose Steele and Lucy Hicks become the disposable second female leads in an angsty romance novel. They high-five and swear to win over the male lead to get money from him. When his first love returns, they plan to run. Just when everything seems to be going smoothly, the original female lead returns to the country earlier than expected. So Rose and Lucy flee with their money. They run, but their husbands are hot on their heels. This time, escape won't come so easily.

data.title: Sonny's Competition
data.intro: I wonder what it's like to live your life, so different from mine! After 12 years, Son Jinwoo meets a former classmate with the same name. One day, the newly hired Son Jinwoo at his dream company crosses paths with the other Jinwoo, and fate takes a strange turn. Their souls end up being swapped! Now, sharing each other's lives unexpectedly, what challenges and surprises await these two men?

data.title: Desires In Fire
data.intro: After a mysterious one-night stand with a heroic firefighter during a blazing rescue, Nora gives birth to unexpected quadruplets and raises them in secret. Seven years later, fate throws them back together when her kids—tech-savvy and full of mischief—track down their father. As passion rekindles and enemies close in, can Nora protect her family and resist the firestorm of love and lies?

data.title: From Throne to Legacy: My Father is a Legend
data.intro: Reborn as Felix Kemp's daughter, the former empress initially looks down on her new father, dismissing him as ordinary. But she quickly discovers that the cultivation technique he casually gives her is god-tier, his kitchen knife is a holy artifact, and even the family dog is an ancient beast. It turns out her father is far from ordinary!

data.title: Lucifer My Boyfriend from Hell
data.intro: Fragments of Lucifer's soul fall into the unfortunate girl Lilith. To retrieve his soul, Lucifer stays by her side at all times. However, this ordinary girl holds an irresistible attraction for the Lord of Hell.

data.title: He Who Defies Heaven's Flow
data.intro: Icarus Finley, a cultivator of boundless power, has roamed the mortal world for a thousand years. Though invincible in battle, a lingering mystery haunts him: despite his unmatched strength, he remains stuck at the lowest level of cultivation—the Essence Stage—as if shackled by an unseen force. During a brutal clash with Ignirath, tragedy strikes. Seris Lorne, Icarus’ beloved, is slain while defending the Aerwyn Sect.

data.title: Level Up: From Wicked Stepmom to Supermom
data.intro: Top actress Lily Grant transmigrates into her own drama—as the vicious stepmother. To survive, she activates the "Ultimate Mom System", which rewards her for caring for her children. Even in times of famine, she keeps them well-fed, breaks down every wall of doubt between them, and fearlessly faces challenges by their side, patiently awaiting the return of the kids' father from duty.

data.title: The Ashes of His Name
data.intro: Eason Morris was once the pride of his family—until they adopted Colin Yeats, a master manipulator who turned everyone against him. Betrayed by his parents and fiancée, Eason was thrown into prison and left to suffer. After his release, a twist of fate led him to Master Quinn, a legendary artist who took him in as his final student. When Eason faked his death and vanished, those who betrayed him—his fiancée, parents, and sister—were left drowning in regret.

data.title: Gazing Into Hidden Wealth
data.intro: One awkward blind date changes everything when Ernest Lockwood discovers he is blessed—or perhaps cursed—with the Omniscient Eye. With this newfound ability, his gray existence shatters like stained glass, each fragment refracting new hues of possibility he never knew existed.

data.title: Betrayed? Watch Her Reign
data.intro: Luna Frost, the notoriously foolish and ugly woman of Valtera, is shamed for bearing a child of a stranger. On the day of her fiance's wedding, she leaps off the tall city wall in her bride's dress, waking up to launch her retaliation led by the Legendary Valkyrie of the 21st Century—a powerful being which took charge of her body. Unbeknownst to others, the mysterious father of her child is none other than Lord Devaros.

data.title: More Than Love, Forever Us
data.intro: In the middle of a delivery job, Brent Alford encounters a girl who claims to be his future wife, reborn from the past. She even tells him that he will become a billionaire in seven years and that he will love her as if she means everything to him. Needless to say, her words leave him utterly baffled.

data.title: Unstoppable: The Unveiling of His Power
data.intro: Ken Mill, formerly known as "Lord Drako," now lives incognito in Avane, a city plagued by the tyranny of four powerful families. Meanwhile, in Valia, Sue Shaw's mother arranges a marriage between Sue and Ken, unaware he already has a fiancée. When Ken meets his fiancée to give her the ring, he endures humiliation as a humble car cleaner. Despite his generosity, when the mockery targets his parents, Ken's patience reaches its limit.

data.title: Fire Me: The Start of Your Downfall
data.intro: Seth Devin plays a key role in his fiancée Kara Wynn's success, yet he's fired simply for being caught smoking in the stairwell. He soon discovers that Kara has long been in love with another man. Seeking justice, Seth turns to his two foster sisters, who arrive just in time to save him from Kara's schemes and help him plan his revenge.

data.title: Fated to Encounter
data.intro: Bebe Long not only confronts betrayal from her boyfriend but also weathers slander from his mistress. Frustrated, she finds herself in a situation where she ends up sleeping with a man she believed her bestie had arranged for her—unaware that he's actually a big shot. Surprisingly, the man showers her with affection, and they even have a flash marriage. Little does Bebe know that the shotgun marriage is all part of the man's plan.

data.title: Back to Life, Back for Vengeance
data.intro: After her eight-hundred-million-dollar yacht is secretly sold by the housekeeper's daughter, Winter Lowe is brutally confined to an asylum, where her enemies plot her tragic demise. Reborn with a newfound clarity, she realizes that blind kindness and tolerance only serve to empower her foes. This time, she refuses to be a victim. She stands tall against her ruthless opponent, punishes her treacherous brother, and swiftly cuts ties with her unfaithful boyfriend.

data.title: Be My Heart Be Your Eye
data.intro: Wealthy heir Tim marries his equally matched fiancée for family interests, coldly abandoning Laura, his assistant, with whom he had secretly dated for three years. Suffering from critical heart failure, Laura tries to confess but is rejected. Heartbroken and desperate, she intends to donate her corneas to her childhood blind playmate named Tim before dying... unaware this very Tim is now her ex-lover himself, adopted and restored to sight.

data.title: The Reborn Heiress: Falling Into His Arms
data.intro: In her previous timeline, Alora was betrayed by her husband and cousin. She got scammed out of her possessions, and she was hung. After she returned to the past, in order to prevent the tragedy of the previous timeline, she went to meet her savior, Samuel, and exposed her aunt, cousin, and former husband’s scheme. While they continued meeting each other, Samuel also started to love Alora, but Alora thought that he was engaged and kept her distance from him.

data.title: I Said Yes to Danger
data.intro: Ruth Allen is always blamed and framed because of her sister. Desperate to escape her toxic family, she wishes to marry her parents' enemy—then, to her shock, it actually happens! Life as a daughter is hard, but life as the enemy's wife? Thrilling. She fights back, takes revenge, and finally claims her own life.

data.title: The Mafia Boss's Runaway Bride
data.intro: The object of love at first sight, Lacey, turned out to be the daughter of the enemy who killed her parents. In order to keep Lacey by his side and torture Lacey, Eric threatens the life of Lacey's brother David and makes Lacey his mistress. Since then, the long road of falling in love and killing each other has begun.

data.title: Great Sage Ascends: Chains Break, Legends Rise
data.intro: 500 years ago, the Buddha wrongly imprisoned the true Sun Wukong in Avici Hell, while the Six-Eared Macaque took his place as the Victorious Fighting Buddha. Wukong later returns with Patriarch Bodhi's aid, only to find his homeland in ruins. Determined to right the wrongs, he reunites with his allies for the greatest showdown against the ultimate villain. When all is done, he severs ties with his painful past and embarks on a journey to find his revered master.

data.title: Sorry, but Mercy Ends Here
data.intro: Taken in by the wealthy Grants and named their heir, Henry Grant endures three years of humiliation—despite his unwavering devotion—all at the hands of his adoptive brother, Sean Grant. On the day of his release from prison, Henry casts mercy aside. At Sean's own inheritance party, he freezes all assets, declaring without doubt who truly holds power.

data.title: Years of Dedication: Her Path to Glory
data.intro: In the pressure-cooker town of Cluville, college entrance exam results are a matter of life and death—socially, that is. On announcement day, rumors swirl around Dave and Sue Cole. Sue's results are shrouded in secrecy, sparking whispers and scorn from the judgmental villagers. But what if Sue's hidden score holds a truth that could shatter expectations and send shockwaves across the nation?

data.title: Cultivation University: Recruit the Elders, Save the World
data.intro: Ethan Bright acquires a system called the Ultimate Cultivation Academy System. He initially expects to attract many talented students, but things don't go according to plan. So, he turns his attention to a different demographic—the elderly. With this, Brightan Institute officially begins recruiting new students, sparking huge interest among older participants. Ethan dedicates himself to helping them achieve their own miracles on the path of cultivation.

data.title: The Secret Immortal
data.intro: During the summer break, an unremarkable man named Finn Cole accidentally steps onto an ancient teleportation array and is transported to a world of immortals. He spends a thousand years in this otherworldly realm—though only a single day passes on Earth—emerging as an immortal himself. Upon his return, Finn is still looked down upon by others, as he always has been. Little do they know, he is now a completely transformed being.

data.title: Shards of Love, Crown of Power
data.intro: Sandra Wayne, a former CEO, gave up her career to marry Logan Hill. After five years of enduring guilt and grueling IVF treatments, she uncovers a shocking truth: their marriage was never legal. Logan is, in fact, married to Kate Price—and even worse, he was responsible for her parents' death. With billionaire Jasper Pelt's help, Sandra rises from despair, reclaims her power, and vows revenge.

data.title: Mr. Singer’s Lasting Love
data.intro: Three years ago, Sam Singer knelt and proposed to Kat Lane, vowing to make her the happiest wife on earth. However, a year later, she suffered a miscarriage, and he underwent a kidney transplant after a car accident. Since then, nothing has been the same.Having grown tired of all that, Kat wants a divorce. However, Sam refuses and even locks her up in the house. He says, “Don’t even think about getting a divorce! You will spend the rest of your life paying for your sins!”

data.title: Unsheathed: The Butcher's Secret
data.intro: Dave Acton is the master of Starsplit Hall and keeps his identity a secret by working as a butcher. One morning, a customer tells him that she saw his wife on a date with a rich man at the bus station. However, Dave perceives her words as an attempt to ruin his relationship with his wife, so he chases her away in a fit of rage. Soon after that, he receives a call from his father saying that he is arriving home.

data.title: A Thousand Apologies, Too Late
data.intro: Kia Laight and Brian Cordfield's story begins on a rainy night, when Brian lights her path with a flashlight—becoming her gentlest guiding light and the man she willingly shields from his enemy's blade. She sacrifices her chance at motherhood to save him, yet he offers no resistance when faced with his mother's objection. Heartbroken, Kia walks away, leaving Brian with regrets he realizes far too late.

data.title: Turbulence Warning: Love Ahead
data.intro: She was his guardian angel in the sky, and he never knew her name. Air traffic controller Luna Moore has harbored a decade-long secret crush on pilot Leon Gray, guiding him safely through countless flights from behind her radar screen. When fate orchestrates their meeting through a blind date, their instant chemistry ignites into a passionate love story that moves at breakneck speed toward marriage.

data.title: The Plot Twist Called Love
data.intro: Transmigrated into a book as the villain, Summer Locke is assigned to team up with the male villain to torment the story's antagonist, Jim Jaeger, and turn him into an obsessive maniac. At first, she considers the task simple—but with his mind-reading ability, Jim soon discovers that Summer is kind and intriguing, with no intention of causing harm. Slowly, he finds himself falling in love with her.

data.title: Reborn to Make My Dad a Fortune
data.intro: I’m Emily Hall, the CEO of a publicly listed company. After being attacked by my mother at a press conference, I wake up to find myself back in my younger self’s body twenty years ago. Thankfully, I retain all the knowledge from my adult life. Now, I have just one goal: to make my father rich so I can live a carefree life! My first step is to persuade him to buy a lottery ticket.

data.title: Crowned in Ashes
data.intro: Born with Fiera Blood, Leah Cole is a once-in-a-century martial arts prodigy. But her world shatters when her grandfather sacrifices her potential, transfusing her Fiera Blood into her brother to preserve the family's martial legacy—then abandons her. Years later, Leah returns, a formidable force determined to eradicate evil.

data.title: Family in Name Only
data.intro: Once abandoned and raised in an orphanage, Mona Bale is finally welcomed back to the wealthy Bale family—only to discover her place already stolen by Hope, their adopted daughter. With whispers and schemes, Hope turns Mona's parents against her, leaving her unloved and unwanted. When Mona sacrifices a kidney to save her crush, Zayn Moore, Hope seizes the chance to take the credit—and Zayn, blind to the truth, sides with the wrong girl, shattering Mona's heart.

data.title: All the Little Ways I Love You
data.intro: After Penny Reese enters a flash marriage with Professor William Neal on a blind date meant for her sister, true love unexpectedly blossoms from what was supposed to be a simple arrangement. As they grow to become each other's strongest support, Penny pursues her artistic dreams. Meanwhile, her sister falls for William's colleague, and both couples ultimately find their happy ending.

data.title: Divorce A Billionaire To Marry Him!
data.intro: Alex Blackwell and Lydia Bale were 'married by decree.' After signing a contract, they had no further connection. A year later, Lydia was assigned to Alex as a personal assistant. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually husband and wife. As they gradually developed feelings for each other, they found themselves drifting apart due to their married status...

data.title: Divine Healer Ascends: Crushing All Foes
data.intro: Trevor Wood, successor of the Healer Sanctum, descends the mountain, only to have his fiancée, Riley Trout, call off their engagement and leave him at the morgue. There, he discovers Marzia York, a female CEO, showing signs of life despite being declared dead. Acting decisively, Trevor saves her, shocking the entire hospital. With his unmatched skills in medicine and combat, he quickly rises to prominence in the city, while his relationships with the beautiful women around hi

data.title: My Billionaire Husband in Disguise
data.intro:
Yvonne is the Quinns' adopted daughter. Sarah Quinn snatched Yvonne’s boyfriend and also teamed up with her parents, using underhanded tactics to force Yvonne to take her place in marrying the Joneses’ incapable son, Stanley Jones. 
Though dissatisfied and furious about the marriage alliance, Stanley was powerless to oppose his family’s decision. So, he used another extreme method to fight his marriage—pretending to be a poor and jobless man.

data.title: When My Mind Speaks, the Plot Breaks
data.intro: Abducted as a child, Nancy Lowe meets a brutal end at the hands of her adoptive sister, Mabel, and her cold-blooded father, Zach. Moments after a reader—also named Nancy Lowe—comments on the tragic tale, she suddenly finds herself inside the novel, where every thought she has can be heard by her family. Trapped in a web of schemes and family drama, Nancy is determined to make them pay and claim the justice she deserves.

data.title: Burning Through Blood and Love
data.intro: As a child, Mia Calvert watched her mother die at the hands of the Harts and suffered years of torment. Now, posing as a mute to marry Charles Hart, she's drawn into a complex bond with Leo Hart. What begins as mutual use grows into unshakable trust. Together, they expose Charles' crimes and reclaim Page Group—turning pain into power, hatred into love, and taking back the future stolen from them.

data.title: What She Left Behind (DUBBED)
data.intro: After being transported back to an ancient era, Isla Stern devotes herself to helping Shaun Laine, a downtrodden prince, rise to power and become a great emperor. She gives birth to their cherished son, Aaron Laine, and earns her place as a revered empress admired by all. However, years later, both her husband and son fall for Tanya Yale, betraying her trust and breaking her heart.

data.title: Start Over
data.intro: Ophie married the wealthiest man, Elvis, after meeting him through a self-portrait. However, she later discovered that Elvis only saw her as a stand-in for his deceased first love and that his controlling nature left her no room to breathe. After several failed escape attempts, Ophie decided to undergo plastic surgery, fake her death, and completely sever ties with Elvis to start a new life.

data.title: Love in Absence
data.intro: Despite being diagnosed with terminal cancer, Diana Aston faces mockery and ridicule from her own family. She suspects her husband, Mason Payne, of infidelity and feels estranged from their daughter. Diana decides to pursue a divorce, especially after realizing that Mason's family had only pretended to be kind to her during her temporary stay at Noah Bishop’s house. Although Mason hasn't been unfaithful, he prioritizes his dignity over attempts at reconciliation.

data.title: Marry My Ex After a Drunk Night
data.intro: Fashion heiress Selina and poor athlete Noah fell deeply in love in high school, fighting against her father's disapproval of their relationship. Misled by Sophia, Selina fled abroad without a word, believing she was just a replacement. Years later, at a Las Vegas party, their worlds collided again. Noah was now a top rugby star, while she was bankrupt and humiliated by him. After a drunken night, she awoke to find herself married to him.

data.title: Don't Mess With the Time-Traveling Princess
data.intro: Lucia Garret, a doctor from the 23rd century, experiences a laboratory accident that thrusts her into the body of a princess consort, rendered mute by a sinister plot orchestrated by her stepmother and stepsister. Determined to right the wrongs inflicted upon the previous occupant of her new body, Lucia treats her damaged vocal cords with modern medicine.

data.title: The Extra in Your Love Story
data.intro: For ten years, Anna Judd believed she had the perfect husband. But one night, everything shatters when she overhears their young son talking in his sleep—revealing a brutal truth: her husband only married her to spite his first love. The revelation cuts deeper than she ever imagined. In quiet resolve, Anna withdraws the hundred-billion-dollar contract she had once prepared for him and files for divorce. Desperate and in tears, her husband begs her to reconsider.

data.title: When Love Turns to Ash
data.intro: Sophia thought that her marriage was one of love, but she didn't realize that it would be her first step into a living hell. She was imprisoned and one of her legs was crippled, much to her husband Asher's satisfaction, yet when she was pronounced dead after she was caught in a fire, he found himself feeling empty. One month later, a beautiful woman named Anna appeared at a high-profile dinner party, sporting a face that looked far too similar to Sophia's.

data.title: Supremacy Unbound: Ascending Above All (DUBBED)
data.intro: Once a great and powerful Lord of Valor, Maxwell Kane now finds himself grappling with the loss of his memory, leading a hard life toiling away on construction sites. Despite his hardships, he perseveres and tries his best to cope with life, but all sorts of injustices set him back like tides of cruelty.However, fate takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a gorgeous woman named Samantha Claude.

data.title: Love Gone with the Wind
data.intro: Pregnant Nancy Heaton realizes she has never had it all when she finds her husband Lucas Brown and daughter Sasha Brown choosing Mabel Judd—who Lucas is legally married to without her knowledge—over her. Losing her unborn child in brutal abandonment, Nancy learns her true heiress identity and vows revenge, starting anew after they face the consequences of betrayal.

data.title: Stop Calling Me Miss
data.intro: A privileged heiress must navigate a twisted game of power, betrayal, and forbidden love when her former bodyguard, now her master, rises to claim control over her life—and her heart.

data.title: Kiss or Kill
data.intro: Wanda Pike swore vengeance after her mother’s murder—and years later, she’s ready to deliver. As the head of an elite security agency, she infiltrates the life of Mayville’s most feared crime lord, Marco Barone, posing as his lover and fiancée.But on their wedding day, her carefully laid trap erupts in chaos. Marco escapes—only to be shot by the woman he trusted most.Justice? Not quite. When fate throws them together again, the line between predator and prey blurs.

data.title: Back to Win the World
data.intro: After Julius Locke is murdered by his unfaithful wife upon discovering her infidelity, he wakes up in the year 2000, reborn into his past. Armed with knowledge of future events, he seizes the opportunity to rewrite his destiny, using his insights to achieve extraordinary success in stock trading and build a business empire.

data.title: Undercover Heiress, Undeniable Love
data.intro: Bound by a marriage pact with the Neal family, Hailey Sadler disguises herself as a country girl to escape. But fate leads her to a job as a janitor at Neal Corp—and even into the Neal household. A sudden car accident draws her closer to Charles Neal, setting off a chain of events that expose her true identity and spark jealousy among the women around him—and even his own brothers.

data.title: Boss, You're Busted!
data.intro: After her ex Jack's betrayal left 24-year-old Emma without her child—or her ability to have another—she reinvented herself as a "Scumbag Slayer," taking down corrupt rich men in the shadows. But when her operations racked up $25M in damages to tycoon Arthur's hotels, he cornered her with a deal: a fake marriage to help him ruin his upcoming society wedding.

data.title: Game On: When the Genius Strikes Back
data.intro: Mason Quinn, known as "Aether," is a genius programmer who hides his true talents to protect his wife Sophie Scott's feelings. However, on their wedding anniversary, Sophie surprises her first love, Liam White, with a luxury car. When Mason discovers this, he attempts to reason with them but is met with humiliation and ridicule. Fed up with being kind, Mason resolves that it’s time for them to face the consequences of their actions behind his back.

data.title: Pregnant By My Sister's Fiancé
data.intro: Evelyn is accused of drugging and seducing August, her sister's fiancé, leading to an unexpected pregnancy. August's childhood sweetheart conspires to make Evelyn lose her baby. Heartbroken by the betrayal, Evelyn distances herself. Years later, fate brings them back together. Will they find a way to heal and reconnect?

data.title: Rise, Revolt and Revenge
data.intro: It is supposed to be an act of great sacrifice when Michael King, the Holy One, chooses to give up his powers in order to save his wife, who is suffering from kidney failure. However, his wife sets him up, and Michael loses both of his kidneys. Fortunately, he survives, and thus begins the suffering of his wife.

data.title: Eyes of Stone: Darkness in the Peaks
data.intro: Mosley Oberon of Unit 749 escorts a stone statue called the "Ossuary Sentinel" to a remote village with his subordinates, Aaron Leigh and Gary Rickman. Sensing something amiss, he enters the mountains alone, leaving them to guard the statue. When he disappears, a series of eerie events terrorizes the villagers. Holding their post, Aaron and Gary investigate the connection between the statue and the unknown force in the mountains, facing escalating terror at every turn.

data.title: Divorced Yet Dazzling: The Disguised Heiress
data.intro: Skylar Gale is the heiress to a huge company who hides her identity and marries a poor young man. For years, she assisted him in achieving success with his company. However, just before the company is set to go public, he evicts her from their home and marries the niece of the world's richest man. After their divorce, Skylar reveals her true identity and seeks revenge on the unscrupulous couple.

data.title: The Future Me Said Run
data.intro: Maisie Ward stumbles upon a confession letter she once wrote. But something is horribly wrong... There is a bloody sentence that has never been there. "Run. Leave Bryan." Maisie has pursued Bryan Judd for two years before finally winning his love. Now, she is pregnant with his child. How can she leave him? She dismisses the message as a cruel prank, but more bloody words appear. "He will use your baby to save Hilda Baker's child. Maisie, believe me. I am you from the future!"

data.title: Your Absence, My Heart's Lesson
data.intro: Stacy Dell, a struggling college student, marries the wealthy Brad Marsh and becomes the envy of all. But Brad mistreats her for Lisa Ellis and refuses to help her family. Forced to seek aid from his grandfather, Stacy agrees to marry Walt Aston—the Devil of Grafton. While Brad rages, she thrives under Walt's protection and love, finally pursuing the life she's always dreamed of.

data.title: The Beloved of Lycan King
data.intro: In a world where emotions run wild and secrets lurk in the shadows, Kristen, an orphaned servant, finds herself entangled in a web of love and betrayal. When fate unexpectedly leads her to Justin, the enigmatic leader, and Allen, the newly appointed Lycan King, Kristen's life takes a dramatic turn. As emotions ignite and alliances shift, Kristen must navigate the turbulent waters of romance and deception.

data.title: Lost to Memory, Bound by the Heart
data.intro: When Xenia Hewitt is diagnosed with Alzheimer's at just 28, she makes the painful choice to leave her husband, Tom Raven, sparing him the agony of watching her dignity slip away. Six years pass in the blink of an eye: Tom rises to become a wealthy CEO, while Xenia has been slowly worn down by her illness. As her memories fade, their love endures—and when fate reunites them, will it bring salvation or torment?

data.title: Legacy Found, Justice Served
data.intro: Orphan Elsa Flynn excels as a model student, but her success ignites jealousy among her underperforming peers. They steal her financial aid, sabotage her university placement, and even ruin her part-time job. Devastated, Elsa prepares to leave after one final meal—but she is caught on camera during a university promotion livestream. Intrigued, the chairman investigates and is astonished to discover the remarkable history of her family.

data.title: A Moment, A Kiss, A Forever Love
data.intro: After a divorce triggered by her husband's infidelity, Jessie Rowe forms a bond with Erickson Gray, a model, hoping to fulfill her greatest desire—a child of her own. What she doesn't realize is that Erickson, the man she believes she chose, has secretly admired her for years and orchestrated their meeting. Just as Jessie begins to develop feelings for Erickson, her vengeful ex-husband makes a move to complicate things.

data.title: Her Dangerous Younger Flame
data.intro: Marissa Carr, a top attorney in Beckton, has long hidden her feelings for Steven Payne, CEO of Payne Group. Hoping to escape her turmoil, she takes a cruise and spends a drunken night with a mysterious young man who looks strikingly like Steven. What she thought was a fleeting mistake becomes far more when they cross paths again at Steven's father's funeral—and the determined stranger vows to win her heart, igniting a fierce battle for love.

data.title: The Billionaire's Second Wife
data.intro: After her mother's death, Ella is mistreated by her stepfamily, including her stepmother Diana and stepsister Vicky. Vicky pressures Ella into an unwanted marriage. Seeking solace in a bar, Ella meets Justin, a widower. Their one-night stand leads to Justin deciding to marry Ella to care for his son Bobby and their potential future children. However, Justin's lingering feelings for his late wife, Andrea, create tension in their relationship.

data.title: My House, My Rules
data.intro: Celia Snow and Yves Jagger's decision to hire interior designer Mandy Wright proves disastrous when Mandy develops an obsession with Yves. Blurring professional boundaries, she deliberately sows discord between the couple. When Celia's requests for a replacement designer are denied, the situation spirals into danger—Mandy corners her with a knife, delivering an ultimatum: divorce Yves or have her face permanently scarred.

data.title: I Loved You Once, But No More
data.intro: After Ethan Quinn left, Lily Moore was consumed by heartbreak. To help her recover, her sister Yara pleaded with Harvey Reid to marry Lily. Harvey agreed—quietly concealing his true identity. For two years, he cared for Lily and met her every demand, only to be betrayed the moment Ethan returned from abroad.

data.title: My Substitute Wife Is a Bigwig
data.intro: After being abandoned and sent to a remote village, a young girl named Yara Bell saves a severely injured boy, Max Ross. They make a promise to get married in the future. Twenty years later, Yara marries into the Green family in place of her stepsister to find Max and the Medicus Codex. Unbeknownst to her, Hugh Green is in fact Max Ross. As both remain unaware of each other’s true identities, the two of them lead an interesting love story.

data.title: Immortality Was Just the Start
data.intro: Shelia Vaughn, the only immortal on earth, has created countless miracles and quietly written the tales of legends, but she bears a curse—every three years spent awake will be followed by a sixty-year slumber. The servant she once took in has founded Kyoto's Four Great Houses, and even her former helper has become a reputable doctor.

data.title: Loving You to the End of Me
data.intro: Five years after leaving her bankrupt and injured fiancé, Reed Carson, Quinn Wilder returns with their daughter, Naomi, only to face his wrath over her abandonment. But the truth gradually emerges: she had no choice back then—leaving him was the only way to get Anna Lowe's help. Now, diagnosed with cancer, Quinn sees Reed as her only hope for Naomi's future... and her last chance at redemption.

data.title: Love Lies and Bloodline
data.intro: Yveline McKnight is a hardworking and determined young woman, a trait she's had since her teenage years. However, her life takes a sudden turn when her greedy aunt reveals that she was switched at birth. This revelation strains her relationship with her younger sister, Celine, who begins to treat her coldly, leaving deep emotional scars.Meanwhile, Jaden Harrington is a meticulous right-hand man of Rose Lewis.

data.title: Pawns Don't Plot, But I Do
data.intro: Cassidy Hewitt, a weary woman from the modern world, suddenly finds herself transported to a grand palace—where she unexpectedly gives birth to an illegitimate child. Caught in a web of scandal and secrets, she tries to escape. But the sharp and exacting Emperor Charles Steele has other plans. Once he sees how truly unique she is, his guarded heart begins to soften, setting the stage for a captivating tale of unexpected love and royal romance.

data.title: Twice, I Said Goodbye to You
data.intro: Nancy Swain and Caleb Zimmer have been deeply in love for years, until Nancy makes a heart-wrenching decision to disguise herself as a gold-digger and break up with him. Her plan is to protect him from the drug dealers who have been after her family ever since her father, an undercover cop, was exposed. Desperate to stop her from leaving, Caleb tragically gets into a car accident. In a selfless act of love, Nancy donates her kidney to save him before leaving for good.

data.title: From Anonymity to Stardom
data.intro: For seven years, I had concealed my true identity and lived among you as an ordinary person. Yet, all that effort has led to nothing but divorce. Now, it's time I reveal who I truly am.

data.title: We Go Way Back to Forever
data.intro: When Jayden Fuller was young, he hated studying—until his mother hired Nancy Quinn to look after him. Her admirable qualities inspired him to become disciplined, and he secretly vowed to marry her one day. Years later, now the world's richest man, the first thing Jayden does after achieving everything is to return to the countryside and make his promise a reality.

data.title: A Night of Mistakes and Miracles
data.intro: Betrayed on the eve of her wedding, Sarah Lloyd ends up spending a drunken night with CEO Simon Gray, mistaking him for a bartender and getting pregnant with his children. She only learns who he is six years later when she returns from abroad—and Simon proposes to her, promising a great future for the family of six.

data.title: Our Paths Never Crossed Again
data.intro: Mona Leed once believed that poor student Hank Gould was her true love. But the cruel truth emerged—he had hidden his identity and used her only to provoke his ex-girlfriend, the fake heiress Ivy Leed. Crushed by betrayal, Mona gives up on Hank. With her heart in ruins, she makes a daring choice: to marry Jim Judd, heir of the powerful Judd family.

data.title: Trusting Love a Little More
data.intro: After years of fruitless pursuit, Jenny Shaw finally marries Evan Clarke through underhanded means. But a loveless marriage can’t last. In despair, she is reborn and decides to move on—no longer begging for his time or following him to the same university.

data.title: Serenading a New Heart
data.intro: Kayla Tate has been married to Daniel Payne for years, yet on her birthday, he holds a wedding with his first love, Vera Keller—who has already won over their son. Cast aside and stripped of her place in the household, Kayla reclaims her identity by returning to the music world as "Serena," the renowned violinist she once was. For the first time in years, her life begins to revolve around herself.

data.title: You, the Soft Spot in My Heart
data.intro: Jess Quinn, a poor student from the countryside, discovers that her aunt has stolen her money on the very day her tuition fees are due. Desperate, she seizes the only chance she has—a scholarship offered to volunteers for the Hunts' visit. Boldly taking the risk, she tries her luck, only to unexpectedly spend the night with Caleb Hunt and lose her place to her scheming cousin.

data.title: My Husband Has a Secret Name
data.intro: Stella Swain, the CEO of Swain Corp, is determined to prevent her stepmother, Luna Ashton, from seizing control of the company. In a desperate move, she plans to marry a man at random, hoping to claim the ten percent of shares her grandfather left to her future husband. But when she discovers that one of her suitors is a spy, she rejects all of them, choosing instead Eric Green—the strikingly handsome but seemingly penniless man she encounters outside City Hall.

data.title: From Broken Vows to Crowned Glory
data.intro: On their wedding night, Cale Lowe is summoned to war under the emperor's command and doesn't return until three years later—bringing home another woman and their child. Realizing she has loved the wrong man, Victoria Yardley divorces him and captures the heart of Prince Regent Zander Russell instead. Amid schemes and jealousy, how will Victoria rise to success with Zander at her side and lead Wesson toward prosperity?

data.title: Between Pages and Battlefields: Long Live My General
data.intro: Top student Eloise Moore discovers that the slick, wealthy transfer student is a legendary immortal general. Even more shocking, the once-starving beggar strove to become a famed young general because of her influence. Clutching her history books in disbelief, Eloise watches history change before her eyes—and finds herself falling in love with the very general she is supposed to study.

data.title: Back to the 80s（DUBBED）
data.intro: Julie Stein wakes up from her sleep, expecting just another ordinary day. However, to her surprise, she finds herself in the 80s, a totally different era from where she belongs. Not only is she a disowned daughter of a wealthy family to whom she has no blood connection, but she is also supposed to marry an old man with two children, in place of the family’s biological daughter.

data.title: Behind the Sweet Facade, She Hunts
data.intro: The kidnapped Sara Knot finally returns to her birthplace. She wears a gentle facade, but beneath it, she is the leader of an assassin syndicate. She has come back to exact revenge on her family and her ex-fiancé, who betrayed her. After crossing paths with Sean Quinn—her ex's uncle and longtime rival—she hides in his home while plotting her schemes.

data.title: Oh No! The Prince Can See My System
data.intro: Transmigrated into ancient times, Clara Zane is tasked by the system to win the heart of Crown Prince Rowan Ward. She chooses to ignore it—until, at his birthday banquet, her quest interface suddenly appears before him. Intrigued by the mysterious system and its rewards, Rowan decides to help Clara complete her quests, sparking a series of unexpected twists neither of them could have foreseen.

data.title: My Seven Sassy Sisters-in-Law
data.intro: Since childhood, Seth Fritz has been honing his martial arts skills under the guidance of a master on a remote mountain. One day, he receives a letter informing him of his brother's passing and requesting that he arrange the funeral. Upon arriving, Seth encounters seven beautiful women at the funeral, all claiming to be his brother’s girlfriends. To complicate matters, they mistake Seth for his brother and insist that he take on the responsibility of caring for them.

data.title: Ace Pilot Reborn: Mission Mayday
data.intro: Waking up as his eight-year-old self on the doomed flight that once killed his father, ace pilot Shane Bolton carries the burden of saving everyone from death as flames engulf the wing, the cabin tears open, and chaos reigns. In the face of doubtful passengers, the absence of a working pilot and signal, and the leaking fuel, he has to avert danger—or lose his own life along with the others'.

data.title: Disguised Power: Undercover Dad in Action
data.intro: Nathan Larson—once the lord of Dracohall, feared and revered as "Lord Warwyn"—vanished six years ago. In disguise as a mere security guard, he quietly hunts for the truth behind his followers' deaths while searching for the woman who once saved his life. But on this day, fate intervenes: he rescues a girl outside his company and discovers she is his daughter—pulling him into unexpected fatherhood and unearthing a long-buried truth.

data.title: Making the Cut Was Just the Beginning
data.intro: In his past life, Frank Lawson missed an important interview because of his girlfriend, Joan Tucker. She, however, mercilessly humiliated him and dumped him. Upon getting a second chance at life, he enters the interview as a last-minute candidate and is hired with a record-high score. At work, he outmaneuvers a hostile supervisor and earns the trust of the new CEO, which helps him climb the corporate ladder in a flash. When Joan learns about this, she regrets what she did.

data.title: Spoiled by My Step Brothers
data.intro: Just as Ria hits her rock bottom in life with her boyfriend cheating and her step-sister bullying, three handsome billionaires come to her save. They offer her a multi-billion inheritance! But, under one condition…… She has to marry one of the three brothers to be the heiress. Who is she going to choose? And who would be YOUR pick?

data.title: When the Past Comes to Burn
data.intro: Jack Fallon finds love with Stacy Baird long after witnessing Lucia Wale's betrayal. When his family faces ruin, Stacy seeks help but is gravely injured in an accident. Lucia offers aid on one condition—Jack must marry her. Misunderstandings tear him and Stacy apart, leaving him alone when he's diagnosed with his father's disease. The truth emerges too late, leaving nothing but regret.

data.title: A Trust Misplaced, A Truth Lies Hidden
data.intro: Finley Cohen, the wealthy head of Solvia Group, leaves his peaceful countryside retreat to attend his son's grand engagement party in the city—bringing extravagant gifts and the intention of passing down the family business. But when his son's fiancée hurls shocking accusations, Finley suddenly faces ruin and even the threat of prison. Only after his lawyer reveals the truth does his son realize the gravity of his mistake—but can remorse ever repair the damage already done?

data.title: Underestimated, Unmatched, Unstoppable
data.intro: After transmigrating into the body of a despised man in Wallera, Elias Whitmore devotes himself to genuinely caring for the people and rewriting the dark reputation that haunts him. Enduring public humiliation and facing deadly crises, he perseveres, navigating the intricate dynamics with both the duke's daughter and the princess. Rising above his past, Elias transforms into a radiant and inspiring figure, leaving a legacy no one could have imagined.

data.title: My Prime Suspect Lady
data.intro: In a tranquil town, a chilling murder shakes the peace. Detective Logan's investigation takes a twisted turn when he observes suspect Jack entering actress Isabel's home on surveillance footage. As Logan delves deeper into Isabel's world, suspicions of her complicity arise, even as he finds himself drawn to her. But unbeknownst to Logan, Isabel is the true mastermind, luring Jack into her web as her unwitting pawn. As Logan falls deeper under her spell....

data.title: How to Divorce a Billionaire
data.intro: A female lawyer is unexpectedly hired by her estranged billionaire husband to be his divorce attorney. Amidst a series of misunderstandings, they rediscover their feelings for each other.

data.title: The Tyrant's Bride-to-be
data.intro: Struggling with her father's debt, a woman complains about the ending of a web novel, wishing it was more realistic. After expressing her frustration, she suddenly finds herself transported into the novel as the fiancée of the first character to die. Determined to survive, she decides to become the love interest of the main antagonist, a feared tyrant, and proposes a contract marriage.

data.title: They Chose Him, But the World Chose Me
data.intro: Sam and Finn Leed are kidnapped, but under Finn's secret manipulation, the Leed family ransoms only him, leaving Sam to endure three years of torment. When Sam finally returns home, he is met only with indifference and prejudice. So, when pianist Ian Larson invites him to train overseas, he chooses to leave—abandoning his family with nothing but a letter to sever ties and break off the engagement.

data.title: Rewind to Love, Fast-Forward to Forever (DUBBED)
data.intro: In her past life, Grace Hart married Nigel Dawson, a penniless man, yet unexpectedly became a wealthy wife. Meanwhile, her sister Margo Hart married Officer Alvin Kirk—only to lose her mind after he died in an accident shortly after their wedding. Unable to bear such unfairness, Margo murdered Grace but ultimately lost her own life in the ensuing chaos.

data.title: Summer Indigo
data.intro:
Seon-Woo Park, the youngest member of the judo club, has made up his mind to quit the team due to a secret he can't share with anyone. But according to the club's long-standing tradition, he must defeat a senior member in a match to officially leave. As luck would have it, his randomly assigned opponent turns out to be none other than Tae-Hyung Gong, a national judo champion and the pride of the club! 
[STORYMATRIX PTE.LTD]

data.title: Keep Your Names Out of My Second Life
data.intro: Reborn, Winnie Lopez is shocked to find her scheming sister reborn too—stealing the powerful allies she once nurtured. Determined not to lose again, Winnie marries into a powerful family and becomes the beloved sister of a lawyer, a mafia boss, and a superstar. With their support, her ungrateful birth family finally tumbles from their high horse—and their pride along with it.

data.title: Against the Dark: Love in a Game of Lies
data.intro: Journalist Nina Stone has a knack for infiltrating criminal networks. She even took down Dante Reed, a major syndicate boss. Three months later, he resurfaces as Jim Ryder, heir to the prominent Ryder family. Certain he is back for revenge, Nina finds herself outmatched by his meticulous scheme and must risk everything to confront the paranoid, hardened Dante.

data.title: Trap of Desire: Where Love Takes Its Vow
data.intro: After discovering her husband's affair, Kristy Wilde teams up with Josh Leach, who poses as her husband's illegitimate son, to exact revenge. Exploiting the cheating couple's arrogance toward housewives, she cunningly sets traps that catch them off guard. But as she shapes the unpredictable Josh into her willing weapon, Kristy never expects to fall for him herself.

data.title: From Shadows, He Commands
data.intro: Bryce Langdon, head of Drago Corp, hides his identity and runs a night-market stall at a construction site so his son, Scott, can gain real-world experience. But Dariel Zeller—the arrogant son of Bryce's subordinate—bullies Scott and even steals his girlfriend, thinking his father's power makes him untouchable. Even when Bryce reveals who he is, Dariel refuses to believe him—until his father shows up and punishes him.

data.title: Spices of Fate
data.intro: Mandy Jones, a contestant in the modern Master Chef competition, unexpectedly finds herself transported to the olden times as a neglected concubine in the Regal Residence. There, her exceptional cooking skills quickly draw attention, and a romantic connection begins to blossom between her and Prince James Cavill after a series of misunderstandings.

data.title: Beneath the Crown, Behind the Lies
data.intro: Cassius Zeller, a frail but determined general, is forced into marriage with the returned hostage Rowena Lockhart. Bound by political coercion, they clash at every turn, wary of each other's intentions. Yet beneath the tension, a fragile bond begins to form amid royal schemes and family intrigues. As the truths of their pasts surface and hidden missions collide, their marriage hurtles toward an uncertain future.

data.title: Second Time's Forever
data.intro: Once secretly involved with Damian Adler, Marie Olson raises their daughter alone for seven years after a breakup caused by a misunderstanding. When they meet again, Damian doesn't recognize her at first—but once he does, a relentless and devoted pursuit begins, driven by the hope of an overdue reunion.

data.title: Her Name, A War Cry
data.intro: After a grand proposal by the crown prince, William Jones, Nadia Delaney, daughter of the great and feared general, shows up at the banquet, only to wake up and find herself drugged and violated along with the other women around her. Seeking to take revenge on William, she boldly volunteers to join the battlefield and earns great achievements.

data.title: All According to His Heart
data.intro: Niall Hart, a cold man, learns that his longtime crush, Claire Swan, is single again and proposes to her. Claire is stunned; she never expected her aloof boss to suggest a secret marriage. Believing he's only going along with it to get his family off his back about marriage, she reluctantly agrees—until she discovers that Niall has loved her for a decade and planned everything just to be with her.

data.title: Heart in Captivity: Caught in His Own Trap
data.intro: Fresh out of prison, Luna Hart wants a new life, but Ray Bowen drags her into debt and forces her to seduce his brother, Cedric—never expecting to fall for her himself. Now, he regrets setting it all in motion, yet he's trapped in desire and confusion, unsure where he truly belongs.

data.title: Hell is Her Ally: She Burns for Revenge
data.intro: After her sister Winnie Larson's shocking suicide, the antisocial and emotionally scarred Julia Larson unleashes her company's full power, hiring the world's top detectives to uncover the truth. Returning from abroad, she discovers that Winnie's husband, Jason Vance, has been unfaithful. That revelation sets a meticulously planned vengeance into motion.

data.title: Vengeance Awaits His Return
data.intro: Felix Hill is a devoted husband who showers Rosa Snow with endless love. He buys her a billion-dollar villa, a luxury car worth tens of millions, grants her a VIP bank card, dines with her at Micolin’s finest restaurants, and even supports her family—along with her first love, Jay Hunt. Yet, despite indulging in Felix’s wealth and generosity, Rosa keeps an ambiguous relationship with Jay, ultimately betraying Felix by giving him both his company and even his kidney.

data.title: The Stolen Life: Close yet Worlds Apart
data.intro: When Amy Cecil brings her children, Ray and Roxy Lennon, to the hospital for their fevers, a mix-up occurs in the chaotic entrance, and she mistakenly takes home Lily Kirk instead of Roxy. Fortunately, Wade Graham, a local greengrocer, finds and rescues Roxy, who is subsequently raised as Ines Graham.Fifteen years later, Amy, now the head of Lennon Corp, is dedicated to finding Roxy with the help of her daughter Lily, now known as Paige Lennon, and her three sons.

data.title: Chessboard of Hearts and Thrones
data.intro: In her past life, Madison Garner was too innocent to fend off the schemes of her enemies lurking around the palace. Ultimately abandoned and brutally murdered by her own spouse, she is now reborn and planning ten years ahead for her victory. Aside from cutting off her foolish obsession with love, Madison masters dancing, the art of seduction, and expands her power by running a tavern.

data.title: My Ex is a Secret Billionaire
data.intro: Expelled from the elite Turner family, Lucy Turner stages a cheating scandal to save her boyfriend from debt, only to discover years later that he's now a billionaire, her boss, and engaged to her half-sister. Amidst lingering love and misunderstandings, their fates remain entangled.

data.title: My Three Years
data.intro: Ethan, bound by a life debt, concealed his true identity as the heir to a global pharmaceutical empire while enduring years of emotional humiliation from Amanda Carter, the heiress of Carter Pharmaceuticals. For three years, he secretly worked under her father’s employ to develop an anti-aging drug. When his contract ended and his secret was finally revealed, the very woman who had tormented him found herself on her knees, desperate for his help. As a conspiracy-driven viral

data.title: Her Heart's Possession, His Favorite Obsession
data.intro: After two years of marriage to Bryce Jackman, Elise Dixon sees the future in her dream: tomorrow, her husband will spend the night with his "soulmate", Kara Reed, buying her luxurious jewelry and even giving her all of Elise's haute couture and branded bags. In the dream, Elise fights desperately to save the dying marriage, only to be hated and die miserably in an asylum—so the moment she wakes up, she slaps him right across the face.

data.title: Nothing Else Compares（DUBBED)
data.intro: Shawn Moore locked Kesia Foster up in an asylum, torturing and humiliating her to no end, making her pay for her father’s sin of causing his father’s death.Two years later, he married her, but… “You’re just paying for your family’s sins in another way.”

data.title: A Call to the Past
data.intro: Thirty years ago, Timothy Hyde fell victim to a scam orchestrated by his friend, Luke Luther, resulting in the loss of all his money. Crushed by this betrayal, he gave up on life, and tragically, his wife passed away alongside him due to dystocia. Years after this tragedy, their son, Brandon Hyde, finds himself facing a similar misfortune.

data.title: Harvest of Honor: Reunited in Love
data.intro: It has been five years since Nigel Jepsen, the head of technology development bound by a confidentiality agreement, last reached out to his father, David Jepsen. This Thanksgiving, he finally achieves success, winning the favor of his company, getting promoted to president, and becoming engaged to the chairman's daughter, May Logan. Eager for a glorious return, Nigel is blissfully unaware that his father has faced bullying in their hometown during his absence.

data.title: Dominance of the O' Mighty One
data.intro: After Ray Quill finishes his training, he leaves his home to marry Liana Hart and coincidentally saves Zoey Stone, the CEO of Stone Corp, on his way to meet the Hart family. However, the Harts are no longer the people they used to be. Ray is rejected by Liana due to his financial status. After leaving her home, he encounters Zoey again, who suggests marrying him. Ray agrees, unaware of the complexities awaiting him in Zoey's family.

data.title: When the Blade Calls
data.intro: Aaron Blade's master, Norman Steele, sacrifices himself on a mission to defeat Lord Bayleon, wielding the deadliest technique of the Steele lineage. Before dying, he warns Aaron never to draw his sword lightly—only when it's time to protect those he loves. For the next ten years, Aaron watches over Vicky from afar, quietly honing his skills while living in obscurity.

data.title: Fury of a Mother: Payback Comes
data.intro: Hilda Levine left three years ago to develop a cure for her daughter, Roxy, who suffers from a rare illness. When she returns, she is in for a rude shock: her husband has joined forces with the nanny—his mistress—and his illegitimate daughter to take control of their home. They mistreat Roxy until she becomes a fool. Heartbroken, Hilda reclaims her identity, enters high society, and begins her ruthless revenge.

data.title: Falling for My Ex's Uncle
data.intro: As soon as Tony Cohen reclaims his status as a member of the richest family on earth, he breaks up with his girlfriend, Yelena Lowe, who grew up in the same orphanage as he did, and gets close with a wealthy girl. However, Yelena remains calm and even extends her best wishes, as she is now his aunt-in-law.

data.title: Operation Love: Married on Duty (DUBBED)
data.intro: As a police officer trainee, Bella Scott mistakes Peter Chase for her colleague during a mission. Meanwhile, Peter, the CEO of Jaxon Corp, whose grandmother constantly urges him to find a spouse, coincidentally believes Bella is his designated partner.

data.title: Secrets of the Man I Married
data.intro: Eve Blake and Finn Gould, the CEO of Astro Corp, married for reasons other than love. Yet, despite their arrangement, Finn finds himself falling for her. Knowing Eve despises liars, he chooses to keep his identity as CEO a secret. However, as Eve faces constant bullying at the company, Finn struggles to protect her without revealing the truth.

data.title: My Sugar Baby Turns Out to be LA's Richest Man
data.intro: Isabella, a wealthy young lady, falls in love with Andrew at first sight. When she learns that Andrew lives in poverty, she offers to "adopt" him and "buy" his love with money. Andrew gradually falls in love with her. However, Isabella's father's company suddenly goes bankrupt and is heavily in debt.

data.title: I Don't Forgive, I Overpower
data.intro: Bria Ashby, the adopted daughter of the Lowe family, was framed by their biological daughter, Talia Lowe, and died in prison. Reborn with a second chance, Bria vows to make them pay for every ounce of suffering they caused. Returning to the day she was betrayed, she severs ties with the Lowes and turns to her biological father, Lucan Black—a powerful figure in the underworld. With Lucan as her unshakable ally, Bria sets out on a path of ruthless revenge.

data.title: Where Love Once Lingered (DUBBED)
data.intro: What Hannah Steele thinks is a special bond between her and Ronald Shaw, the crown prince she grew up with, turns into something else the moment Ronald meets Noelle Steele. Left with nothing but disappointment, Hannah marries Ronald's uncle, Zachary Shaw, instead, and Ronald only realizes his mistake after the truth is revealed—but it is already too late for amendments.

data.title: Veiled Temptation: Between Duty and Desire
data.intro: Zoey Quirk, raised as the future daughter-in-law of the Smith family, is forced to sleep with the governor of Yanvil, Samuel Fuller, because her husband, Jason Smith, is infertile. Although Samuel initially uses Zoey solely to complete a covert mission, he gradually falls for her. Meanwhile, Zoey begins to see the genuine warmth beneath his cold exterior. When she plans to reveal her pregnancy, Samuel is assigned a new mission.

data.title: Sold Out by Greed
data.intro: In the eighth month of her pregnancy, Freya Summers joyfully receives a five-million-dollar annual bonus after securing a major deal for her company. Taking advantage of her early maternity leave, she plans a surprise for her husband and mother-in-law, playfully joking that she was fired. However, their reaction is nothing she expected—they reveal their true colors, turning on her and even harming her.

data.title: Step by Step, Back to Love
data.intro: Gina Stewart is a kind and ordinary young woman, while Timothy Harris is the cold and aloof CEO of Harris Corp. Initially misunderstanding Gina, Timothy gradually discovers her genuine kindness over time. Soon, a bond deeper than friendship blossoms between them. Yet Timothy's family and corporate crises, along with Gina's troubled past, put their love to the test. But united and fearless, they ultimately overcome every challenge and find happiness together.

data.title: Oops! I'm the Heiress
data.intro: The CEO of the world's top pharmaceutical empire is… my mom?! Isabella, once a pitiful girl forced to perform in livestreams by her adoptive parents, unexpectedly becomes a wealthy heiress at the age of 23. But only Isabella knows the truth: the real heiress, the necklace's original owner, was her late best friend. To fulfill her friend's dying wish, Isabella decides to temporarily take her place and reunite with her mother, Amelia.

data.title: Our Story in Memory
data.intro: After a car crash, Aiden Wynter loses his memory and mistakes Julia Dormer for his wife, Ruby Curran, cruelly tormenting Ruby and their daughter, Heather Wynter. Devastated, Ruby erases her own memory and disappears abroad. When Aiden regains his memory and discovers Heather's urn, he collapses, overwhelmed with guilt, and begs Ruby for forgiveness—but she refuses. Then, in a shocking turn of events, Heather suddenly returns.

data.title: Crowned in Love: The Mother of Three Big Shots
data.intro: As a single mother, May Judd raises three exceptional sons on her own, despite the challenges posed by her family. On her father’s seventieth birthday, her mother invites her to return home for a gathering. However, during her visit, May encounters unwarranted hostility from her father and younger sisters. Undaunted, she stands up to their biases and ultimately discovers her own path to happiness.

data.title: Unexpected Love with The Hidden Billionaire
data.intro: After another failed blind date, she paid to hire a man who had also failed at blind dating to marry her in a flash. But she didn't expect that he was a billionaire. They gradually fall in love. However, the greed and conspiracies of the Brown family cast shadows on them...

data.title: Mr. Holt, the New Intern Is Your Wife
data.intro: In a desperate bid to pay for her grandmother's surgery, Sherry Sutton agrees to an arranged marriage orchestrated by Sue Watson. But due to a fateful mix-up, she ends up marrying Elijah Holt—the heir of Holt Group. A year later, they meet again as strangers, unaware of their shared past. As they overcome life's challenges, an undeniable spark brings them closer until the truth is revealed—they've been married all along.

data.title: The Oscar Winner Is My Ex
data.intro: Lois Kane, a financial reporter, discovers her husband Jim’s infidelity with her best friend Stella, leading to a bitter divorce. Forced to work under Stella at a new job, Lois encounters A-list actor Clark Cavill, her high school sweetheart whom she sacrificed years ago for his career. As their romance rekindles amidst workplace sabotage and public scandals, Clark and Lois navigate misunderstandings, paparazzi, and vengeful schemes from Jim and Stella.

data.title: Tamed by Temptation
data.intro: After discovering her boyfriend's betrayal, Daphne Moore drives away in heartbreak and meets Neal Keller, a student mechanic burdened by family troubles. Their love blossoms, but Neal is soon revealed as the long-lost heir of a wealthy family. The gulf between their worlds tests their bond, and in seeking control over his new life, Neal leaves—unaware that Daphne is carrying his child.

data.title: Three Strikes to My Heart (DUBBED)
data.intro: As his assistant, Eve Wilde has been deeply in love with Hugh Grimm for years. After Hugh gets her pregnant while drunk one day, they enter into a secret marriage. However, what Eve mistakenly believes is the start of a happy romantic life is, in fact, the beginning of a nightmare—all Hugh cares about is his first crush, and he even hurts Eve and their child mercilessly if it benefits his beloved.

data.title: The Court Is Her Chessboard
data.intro: When Juliette Shaw awakens inside a novel as a side character doomed to die, she refuses to play the victim. Armed with intimate knowledge of every secret affair, political coup, and hidden weakness within the royal court, she sets out to rewrite destiny itself. As she dismantles the plot designed to destroy her, seducing Joshua Vale becomes just one calculated move in her grand chess game for survival—and ultimate power.

data.title: Masked Might: When Power Breaks Free
data.intro: Francis Clark, the revered Lord of Dragonspire, is often mistaken for a lowly laborer by those unaware of his true identity. Mocked as a worthless scoundrel who relies on handouts, he endures the humiliation and scorn from those around him. But how will his tormentors react when he finally reveals his true self?

data.title: Love Lost in the Waiting
data.intro: Seth Palmer tirelessly pursued Vera Lane for six years before finally winning her hand in marriage. However, Vera remained wholly devoted to her prayers, never consummating their union. It isn't until Seth finds her praying over a photo of her stepbrother, Steven Lane, that he realizes Steven is the one she has loved all along. Heartbroken, Seth divorces Vera and leaves the country. By the time Vera comes to her senses, Seth has already fallen in love with Sophie Hall.

data.title: Losing You Once is Enough
data.intro: Emily Lacey, daughter of Norvan's chief judge, has been secretly married to Clive Scott for three years. When her family falls into ruin and goes bankrupt, she leaves him in heartbreak, carrying his unborn children. Only after she walks away does Clive realize he has lost the love of his life—and now he's determined to win her back, begging for her forgiveness with all his heart.

data.title: Bloodbound by Fate
data.intro: The Yannick bloodline demands its daughters forge demonic pacts. Sisters Yelena and Melania follow this tradition, but jealousy leads Melania to deadly schemes. Reborn before their fateful choices, Melania tries to claim Elias, unaware of his nature. Yelena bonds with the dormant demon Miles, who awakens to protect her. As the Myra Selection nears, Melania's plotting inadvertently strengthens Yelena and Miles's bond, showing true magic lies in love, not pacts.

data.title: The Love That Missed Its Moment
data.intro: Ray Harding had secretly been in love with Whitney Roper before they got married. In the third year of their marriage, Whitney's first love, Eli Pollard, returns from abroad—drawing a gap between the couple as Whitney shows favoritism toward Eli again and again. Heartbroken, Ray leaves her with a divorce agreement and walks away, vanishes from her life once and for all.

data.title: All Too Late for the Love We Lost
data.intro: After five years of marriage to Jodie Trent, Leon Craig endures cruelty and indifference—even after being diagnosed with stomach cancer. When news of his death spreads, Jodie falls into denial and overwhelming remorse. Yet Leon is secretly alive, rescued by Dr. Lydia Moore, with whom he eventually falls in love.
