As the truth comes to light, Jodie is filled with remorse, while Leon and Lydia embrace a new chapter of happiness together.

data.title: When Affair Becomes Affection
data.intro: Faye discovers that her fiancé is having an affair with the wife of secret billionaire Arvin Sterling, so she takes revenge on him by getting intimate with Arvin. However, it turns out to be Arvin's scheme to lure Faye into his seduction game...

data.title: The Running Wife in Love
data.intro: Lily Saunders faces an emotional whirlwind when her father, Bob Saunders, coerces her into marriage, leveraging the heart condition of her mother, May Garcia. Nick Rogers reluctantly agrees to marry Lily due to his grandfather's indebtedness to her family. However, on their wedding night, Nick's dislike for Lily prompts him to leave her alone.

data.title: One Million Reasons to Love a Prince
data.intro: After losing her father and being thrown out by her stepmother, Lyla feels utterly desperate. Then, an unexpected opportunity takes her to an exotic country. To her surprise, she discovers intrigue, mystery, and meets her true love—a royal prince!

data.title: Beneath the Ordinary
data.intro: In a quiet, unremarkable neighborhood, Hugh Randall lives a seemingly ordinary life as a security guard. His days pass in routine—unnoticed, uncelebrated. But hidden beneath the surface is a genius-level business acumen capable of shaking the foundations of the entire industry.

data.title: Queen of Revenge: Sister's Fury
data.intro: Lisa has a mentally challenged sister named Annie. They've been relying on each other since they were young, living on Lisa's income from underground boxing. One day, Lisa gets into trouble for beating up a hooligan who harassed her sister and is sentenced to one year in prison. She entrusts her sister to her boyfriend, Robert. But when she returns from prison, she discovers that her boyfriend cheated on her and her sister is missing.

data.title: The Phantom Bride: Resurrecting Vengeance
data.intro: In the halls of the afterlife, Elysia Stone dispensed justice as the only female judge in the underworld. Now, she returns to the mortal realm with one purpose: vengeance for her murdered family. But fate has a twisted sense of humor—she awakens as the wife of Rowan Valmont, her childhood sweetheart. Though Rowan doesn't recognize her new form, an inexplicable connection draws him to her.

data.title: Three Chances, Then Goodbye
data.intro: Winnie Smith ends her loveless marriage and plans to take her son, Luca, back to Ausmo. But Luca, unwilling to give up on his father, gives Henry Goode three chances—only to be met with cold indifference. Heartbroken, he finally leaves with his mother. Only when they’re gone does Henry realize his mistake, but it’s too late—Luca no longer sees him as his father.

data.title: Throne Tempest: Her Path to Power (DUBBED)
data.intro: Freya Scott, cherished daughter of the Scott family, was engaged to the kind Michael Lind until Charles Wilde disrupted everything by coercing her family to his side and marrying her against her will. Believing Freya betrayed him, Michael teams up with the Shaw and Jensen families to expose Charles' treason. When Michael becomes king, he keeps Freya as his personal maid, subjecting her to daily mistreatment, unaware that the proof against Charles was provided by the Scotts.

data.title: Some Goodbyes Last a Lifetime
data.intro: Initially deeply in love, Conrad Elmer's affection for Skylar Scott turns into resentment when he believes she abandoned him in a fire, leaving her without dignity. Even after the divorce, he stands by as his friends mock and bully her before leaving for Jolene Scott's banquet. On that day, Skylar finally lets go—and accepts a mysterious offer from a stranger.

data.title: Between Brothers, Between Lies
data.intro: When Layla Lowe's mother disappears, her father takes a job as the Zinn family's driver in search of answers. But tragedy strikes, and he dies in a fatal accident—leaving Layla to be adopted by the very family he served. Years later, a night spent with their second son changes everything. What she doesn't know is that he has loved her all along, and the truth about her adoption lies hidden.

data.title: The Rose That Refused to Wilt
data.intro: After being betrayed by her beloved, Tasha Rowan, a courtesan from the past, is transmigrated into a frail young woman in the modern world. To afford the surgery she needs, she becomes a maid for the Potters, determined to win the heart of their heir, Dean Potter. Despite her fear of romance, Dean falls for Tasha, and she begins to develop feelings for him as well.

data.title: The Man I Love
data.intro: Michelle Shaw had a hearing impairment, which made her the scorn of every wealthy family. Married for three years, her husband Ryan Lawson has never once acknowledged her as his wife. Everyone mocked and humiliated her. Until the day that Ryan's first love returned to the country, stealing Ryan away from her. Ryan, on the contrary, was not willing to let her go. He said with reddened eyes, "You want to leave? Over my dead body!"

data.title: Eternal Love After One-Night Stand?
data.intro: Haruka spends a night with a stranger in anger at her earnest boyfriend's cheating. Later, the stranger turns out to be Jiho Han, the new Director at her workplace. Even worse, Haruka and Jiho become entangled with a conglomerate family after finding out about  a premarital pregnancy and face tons of obstacles to tackle. Will they safely reach a happy ending?

data.title: A Contractual Marriage? Hell No!
data.intro: Keira Snow wakes up in shock, realizing that she had forced herself onto Nolan Blair, the CEO of her company, the night before. Overcome with guilt and pressure, she considers quitting her job. But her heartless parents have other plans, pushing her into a marriage arrangement she has no say in. Reluctantly, Keira decides to go along with it.

data.title: No Fate Stronger Than a Reborn Mom(DUBBED)
data.intro: Reborn thirteen years after her death, Tina Judd wakes to find her life in ruins. Her once-powerful husband surrounds himself with her stand-ins, her son has become a reckless outlaw, and her daughter is blindly in love with a liar. Though everything seems insane, Tina remains unfazed and ready to take control and change her shattered world.

data.title: Years of Dedication: Her Path to Glory (DUBBED)
data.intro: In the pressure-cooker town of Cluville, college entrance exam results are a matter of life and death—socially, that is. On announcement day, rumors swirl around Dave and Sue Cole. Sue's results are shrouded in secrecy, sparking whispers and scorn from the judgmental villagers. But what if Sue's hidden score holds a truth that could shatter expectations and send shockwaves across the nation?

data.title: Forged in Blood: His Wrathful Strike
data.intro: Flynn Hill returns to pay his respects to an old acquaintance, dressed casually without his soldier uniform. Unexpectedly, a wealthy yet rude man named Nick Rowe arrives on a tractor and attempts to desecrate the grave. Flynn confronts Nick and his men, but Nick scoffs at him, even attempting to strike Flynn with a shovel. Flynn skillfully defends himself, revealing his true identity as the heir of Thornia, bestowed with powers by Thornia's former leader.

data.title: Kisses Laced with Lies (DUBBED)
data.intro: A leaked video shatters Stella Quinn's reputation and ends her relationship with her boyfriend—who had been playing her for her sister, Willow Quinn. In despair, Stella takes Willow's place in an arranged marriage and exposes what she did. With her new partner, Stella steps into a new life—but her ex isn't ready to let her go just yet.

data.title: Heart on Fire, Eyes on Him
data.intro: Wendy Sander, the heiress of Lyndale's richest family, was betrayed in her past life. Her four foster brothers fell for a poor student, who framed Wendy for a miscarriage. They forced Wendy to undergo a hysterectomy, leaving her to die on the operating table. Reborn, Wendy vows revenge—and first, she agrees to marry Logan Fowler, a distinguished officer from a prestigious family.

data.title: My Husband is A Big Shot
data.intro: On her wedding day, Selena Lane is betrayed by her fiancé and her half-sister. In a desperate bid to escape her family, Selena impulsively marries a passing driver named Robert. However, Robert is not who he seems; he is actually the CEO of Accord Group. He tries to keep his identity a secret, yet his brother eventually find out where he is...

data.title: Princess Amaya From the Future
data.intro: The top toxicologist of the twenty-second century, Amaya Cresswell, journeyed back in time thousands of years ago to inhabit the body of a feeble concubine’s daughter from the Prime Minister's Mansion.Amaya's stepmother and sister make every effort to hurt her, but she gets her retribution and manages to flee by using her poisoning abilities. In order to save herself, she enters the concubine selection competition for the chance to wed Crown Prince Gideon Lockwood…

data.title: Her Comeback Shocks the Kingdom
data.intro: Upon transmigrating, Janelle Wynford awakens in another world—not as a military doctor, but as a neglected consort with a child to raise. Penniless and unwanted, her first priority is building a new life for herself and her son.

data.title: Master of Shadows
data.intro: The evil dragon, Scarlett Anders, escaped from captivity five hundred years after being defeated by the Grand Martial Uncle, Timothy Longstone. While Timothy is figuring out how to destroy Scarlett, his pending marriages to the daughters of the five families, the White family, the Horton family, the Holt family, the Lucas family, and the Dugan family, suddenly get canceled. Not long after, all of the five  heiresses begin experiencing strange things.

data.title: Witch Magic:True Love's Kiss
data.intro: Vivian, a bartender, catches the eye of the wealthy Davin Grayson. However, at their wedding, a drunken kiss from Davin's illegitimate brother, Hank, disrupts everything. Vivian realizes Hank looks like the man she saw in her dreams, and after their kiss, she discovers she has the power to talk things into reality.

data.title: Throne Tempest: Where Hearts Entwine
data.intro: Mona Lott, daughter of Justria's Grand Marshal, holds the power to command four hundred thousand soldiers. Fierce and relentless, she enters the capital with one goal—to get pregnant, ditch the father, and become the empress. Unbeknownst to her, Evan Pertwee, the newly crowned emperor, plans to marry her solely to get close enough to kill her father and seize absolute military power.

data.title: The Love We Missed
data.intro: Ivor Blythe and Naomi Quentin, once high school classmates, secretly harbored feelings for each other but neither ever confessed. Eight years later, Ivor is living the high life under family pressure to marry, while Naomi struggles paycheck to paycheck. Their paths cross again when Ivor encounters Naomi at her lowest. This time, he steps up and goes after her, but Naomi keeps pulling away. As long-suppressed emotions resurface, will they finally find happiness together?

data.title: Sixth Time's the Charm
data.intro: After five failed attempts to win over Ian Ewing, Raina Tate shifts her focus—this time to Owen Henson. Unexpectedly, Owen has secretly loved her for years. Touched by his sincerity, Raina soon finds herself falling for him. With the task assigned by the System finally completed, her wish is granted, and she embarks on a path of redemption—one that leads her to true happiness with Owen.

data.title: My Comeback Is Your Curse
data.intro: Natalie Young, once the lost heiress of the Claude family, is brought back from the slums as an adult. What seems like a warm reunion is soon revealed to be a scheme: she's to take her sister's place and marry a disabled old man. Betrayed and killed by her sister and her sister's lover, Natalie is reborn—and this time, she's ready for revenge.

data.title: Out of Ruin, Into Power
data.intro: Before George Lane's identity as the son of the world’s richest man is revealed, his ex-wife abandons him, and his adoptive parents, along with his younger brother, betray his trust. Fortunately, his father’s secretary, Stella Dunn, stays by his side, helping him find the right doctor for his daughter and facing hardships together with him. Meanwhile, his former classmate, Rose Spencer, steps in to care for both him and his daughter.

data.title: Power Restored: Return of the Sovereign
data.intro: Maxen Shaw, once the unstoppable leader of the Celestial Sword Sect, a peerless fighter of his time, tasked with guarding the Sacred Realm to ensure the safety of Dragonia, faces his greatest challenge when the Demon Lord’s forces launch a devastating attack on Mount Aether. Gravely wounded and betrayed by his trusted deputy, Tristan Zane, Maxen falls from grace, and is forced to hide in the city to recover.

data.title: Fret Not, Your Highness!
data.intro: Samuel Salvatore, the Crown Prince, is framed for murder by his younger brother, Lucien. He’s thrown into the imperial dungeon and sentenced to death. Before the execution, the Emperor grants him one final mercy—the chance to leave behind an heir. Lucien seizes the moment and sends Charlotte Youngblood, daughter of the Marquess of Concord, into the dungeon. On that same day, a modern-day forensic expert dies in a hospital accident. She wakes up in Charlotte’s body.

data.title: Never Too Late for Love
data.intro: A daughter of a wealthy family was swapped out at birth. From then on, she had been on the receiving end of bullying and malicious schemes until a rich, young man came along and showered her with love.

data.title: Legally Bound by Love
data.intro: To save her brother, who has fallen into a coma due to school bullying, Nancy Aston turns to Caleb Page, a prestigious lawyer who once funded her education. A bond quickly ignites between them, sparking a dangerous game of desire, manipulation, and redemption. Though cold and sharp-tongued on the surface, Caleb has secretly supported Nancy for years, repeatedly rescuing her from threats posed by the powerful Ward family.

data.title: At Her Behest: The Lady's Dominion
data.intro: Released from a three-year imprisonment in jail in place of her boyfriend, Jim Norman, Ciara Lopez learns that she is the Lady of Dragon Hall. She plans to marry Jim, but he is set to wed her best friend, Fanny Todd. Meanwhile, Ciara discovers that her father has endured harassment from loan sharks for the past three years because of her. Determined to uncover the truth, she visits the Emperor Hotel and witnesses Jim’s cold-bloodedness firsthand.

data.title: From Exile to Empire: The Lost Prince's Rise
data.intro: Framed and cast out as a beggar, Crown Prince Tobias Wright is forced into marriage with a woman deemed ugly. But beneath the disguise lies the brilliant and breathtaking female emperor Elise Lindell, who secretly supports his rise. With wit, courage, and her hidden aid, Tobias battles to reclaim his place—until they ascend the throne together, ruling the empire as equals.

data.title: He Who Rose Against All
data.intro: Jareth Zane unexpectedly time-travels and becomes the live-in son-in-law of the Lacy family. After being humiliated and set up by Draven Wycliffe, he uses the knowledge from the future to develop a purple dye that saves the Lacy family from a crisis. With his great talent, he invents gunpowder and designs various types of firearms and cannons, successfully defusing many conflicts between Xevoria and Bryndor.

data.title: Marry, Multiply, Max Out (DUBBED)
data.intro: At 80, Brock Yale unexpectedly binds with the Lineage System after six decades trapped in the cultivation world. The rules are simple: each child born to his spouses grants him bonus years and stacking bloodline buffs. Building his harem across the realm, Brock farms lifespan extensions while power-leveling the Yale family from zero to legendary status.

data.title: Fist of Justice: The Hero Returns
data.intro: After the Yale Martial Arts School is brutally attacked, Theo Yale is adopted by his father’s best friend, Max Wood. Now living under a new name to honor his mother’s dying wish, Theo secretly practices martial arts, driven by the desire to one day avenge his family. Eighteen years later, trouble arises when Darren Judd and his men attempt to abduct Theo’s friend.

data.title: My Million-Dollar Substitute Job
data.intro: Because her gambling father was in debt, waitress Lily was forced by the gangster boss to pretend to be real estate tycoon Gavin's first love, New York socialite Grace, who had gone to England, in order to steal Gavin's family heirloom, the Rose Heart. Facing Gavin's suspicion, Lily tried her best to disguise herself, and in the process, she fell in love with him. However, just when she was about to get the Rose Heart, the real Grace returned from England...

data.title: Senator Uncle, Let Me Go
data.intro: Orphan Lena, groomed by an aristocratic family to be a socialite, fakes her death to escape. Returning as a long-lost heiress, she seeks revenge on her adoptive and biological families. Her vengeance is complicated by Julian, a political star and her "uncle," who loves yet sacrifices her. Through confrontation and entanglement, they find mutual salvation, and she triumphs in career and love.

data.title: A Heartbeat Away
data.intro: Katie heartlessly abandoned her boyfriend Shaun because she looked down on his lack of wealth. Years later, Shaun becomes a young CEO and stands before Katie. He wants her to see her mistake in choosing, but he gradually realizes that the girl before him has actually always loved him.

data.title: Revenge Is Best Served Cold
data.intro: Eliana Jenner, a woman once blinded by love and deceived by the truth, is reborn after being murdered by her beloved for her family’s fortune. This time, she harbors no feelings for him. Even better, during her journey of vengeance, she discovers her true love—unexpectedly, the man who falls for her is the heir to the wealthiest family in Juset.

data.title: Let's Fall in Love Again
data.intro: Seven years ago, Nina Wright, pregnant with twins, left Hayes Peyton. Fate, however, brings them back together when she visits the hospital with their daughter. Once forced to keep their relationship a secret, Hayes finally realizes the depth of his feelings for her and becomes determined to win her heart again. At last, they get a chance to start anew.

data.title: The Lost Heir: His Dawn of Reckoning (DUBBED)
data.intro: Troy Levin puts his heart and soul into designing a patent and gifts it to his fiancée, hoping it will earn her commendation from Traxon Group. Unbeknownst to him, she has already betrayed him and is plotting to break his leg to curry favor with a wealthy man. To his surprise, the chairwoman of Traxon Group identifies him as her long-lost son.

data.title: Child of Fortune: Restoring Life, Restoring Love
data.intro: Due to insufficient vital energy, young Sienna Clark faces challenges with flawed spells. When she finally finds her cure, Zephyr Clark, she becomes his daughter and helps him solve every crisis, even healing his eyes and legs. Eventually, she reunites with her mother, and their happy life as a family of three begins.

data.title: Fake Princess Diary
data.intro: A poor girl becomes a "princess" overnight! To pay off her debts, salesgirl Lily agrees to impersonate CEO William's long-lost sister to comfort his dying grandmother. Through a dramatic makeover, the ugly duckling transforms into a graceful swan. But as Lilly and her "brother" William fall for each other, their forbidden love is torn apart by their fake sibling bond.

data.title: Her Second Life, Their Last
data.intro: Though Tara Judd is family by blood, she's treated as nothing more than a walking ATM by her brother, Chad Judd, his wife, Nina Webb, and her stepmother, Mary Moore. When Tara’s department receives an $800,000 company bonus, Nina steals the money and frames Tara for the crime. Tara begs her to return it, but Nina coldly refuses. Then, tragedy strikes—Tara is hit by a falling chandelier.

data.title: The Secret Recipe to Snatch a Billionaire
data.intro: After being betrayed, Evelyn accidentally meets Leo, and they form a bond due to a misunderstanding. As they face family disputes together, they gradually develop feelings for each other. After helping Evelyn expose Madeline's lies, Leo falls deeply in love with her. And Evelyn, through her interactions with Leo, gradually lowers her guard and accepts him. Finally, after experiencing a series of twists and turns, they gain genuine love and find long-lost family members.

data.title: Ace Pilot Reborn: Mission Mayday(DUBBED)
data.intro: Waking up as his eight-year-old self on the doomed flight that once killed his father, ace pilot Shane Bolton carries the burden of saving everyone from death as flames engulf the wing, the cabin tears open, and chaos reigns. In the face of doubtful passengers, the absence of a working pilot and signal, and the leaking fuel, he has to avert danger—or lose his own life along with the others'.

data.title: Wrath of the Exiled Heir
data.intro: Zane Smith is born with extraordinary talent but is denied the opportunity to showcase it. Though destined to be a leader, he is forced out of his home. When the Dragon's Jade selects him as its rightful owner, Zane rises from rock bottom, determined to fight for his destiny and reclaim what is rightfully his.

data.title: 30 Days With the Vampire's Kiss
data.intro: Bitten by a vampire guy, the half-vampire Ha-rin must hold back her craving for human blood for 30 days to return to human, or she'll be a monster forever. Only Cha Do-hyun's kiss can save her from this curse, but behind him also lies a tragic secret. 500 years ago, his first love was taken away by the wicked Moon Spirit. Ha-rin is now at a deadly crossroads between normal life and eternal love.

data.title: Rage Unchained: Blaze of Retaliation
data.intro: Philip Colin is swiftly sentenced to three years in jail and fined 500,000 dollars for intentional injury. Shortly after his imprisonment, his female accomplice suffers mistreatment at the hands of Leo Shaw. During his time in jail, Philip hones exceptional fighting skills and vows to seek revenge upon his release.

data.title: The Wedding Day Divorce (DUBBED)
data.intro: On Tyson Jordan’s wedding day, his sister, Taylor, returns from abroad to celebrate, only to be mistaken by his fiancée for his secret pregnant lover. Despite Taylor's attempts to clarify the misunderstanding, the fiancée harbors resentment and deliberately causes Taylor's miscarriage. When Tyson learns the truth, he vows to seek revenge for his sister, compelling his fiancée’s family to face the consequences of her reckless actions.

data.title: His Vengeance Knows No Blood Ties
data.intro: Taken back to the family that should have loved him, Dickson Janson was met instead with betrayal, torment, and a death no one mourned. But fate rewinds. Born again, he doesn't look back—he tears off the chains of blood and name, and grinds every enemy beneath his heel. When they crawl and plead, he simply watches. Because this time, he wins—no matter what burns along the way.

data.title: Bucket List with Callboy Prince
data.intro: On the day Jo found out she had stomach cancer, she discovered that her boyfriend David, with whom she had been together for five years, had already betrayed her. In utter despair, she decided to embark on a farewell journey and fulfill her list of ten last wishes. One of her wishes was to have a beautiful wedding, but she was all alone. Arthur, who appeared, asked if she would like to complete the wedding with him. It was because Arthur was a prince on the run...

data.title: Betrayal & Deception: When Lies Unfold
data.intro: At their daughter's celebration banquet, Vance Hale shocks everyone by announcing his divorce, accusing Giselle York of being obsessed with a life-sized teddy bear. Chaos erupts when his own affair is exposed, but he fires back with filmed evidence of Giselle "getting involved" with the bear—only for the situation to take a bizarre turn when the teddy bear in the video suddenly moves.

data.title: Oops! I Mate With My Forbidden Alpha
data.intro: Crystal Spear, on the brink of adulthood in a hidden world of werewolves, finds herself torn between the expectations of her pack and the forbidden love she harbors for Theo, her guardian wrapped in mystery and believed to be kin. As secrets unravel and true identities come to light, their love becomes a beacon, challenging the fabric of their world and leading them to fight for a future where they can be together, against all odds.

data.title: No More Lies, No More Tears
data.intro: On the eve of a prestigious drawing contest, Kelvin Pace suffers severe injuries in an accident and is unable to pursue his dreams any further. While his caring sister explodes with rage and his loving fiancée is overwhelmed with heartbreak on the surface, they are secretly the culprits behind the incident—so that their adoptive brother, Luther Statham, can win instead. Upon learning the truth, Kelvin sinks into endless despair.

data.title: The Matchmaker's Secret Romance
data.intro: An ace manager with a 99% success rate in matchmaking falls in love with a VIP client and must balance her career and love in this entangled romance drama.

data.title: Apple of His Eyes
data.intro: Bryson Hunt, the heir of Capital City's top family—the Hunt family, had been searching for the girl who had rescued his life for years. The girl had given Bryson one half of an emerald pendant, while she kept the other half. When Bryson got word that the girl was in Tolm City, he secretly hurried to Tolm City. At the same time, Celeste Johnson was betrayed by her fiance, Zach Lore, and her older sister, Queenie Johnson.

data.title: Forged in War, Crowned in Victory
data.intro: The illegitimate son of General Charles Doyle, Yale Locke, is met with resistance when he rejoins the family. To save his mother and earn his place, Yale vows to become a general within five years. He heads to the borders and revolutionizes warfare with his advanced tactics. He even devises a novel technique to train soldiers. Yale proves his worth on the battlefield and rises through the ranks to become a legendary figure of his time.

data.title: The Killer Heiress Returns
data.intro: Fiora Levine, leader of the elite Falcon Guild, discovers she's the long-lost daughter of the powerful Levine family. Disguised as a weakling, she returns home—only to uncover a conspiracy led by her relative Seth and the mafia. With enemies closing in, Fiora teams up with her adoptive sister and a syndicate leader, Wilfred Powell. Together, they crush the threats and secure her place in both the family and the underworld.

data.title: I Own You, Body and Soul
data.intro: Daniel Aston is infatuated with Jessie Klein and even stages a car accident to win her—but desire alone isn't enough. As family conflicts and corporate battles rise against him, he battles through every obstacle, punishing those who plot against them, determined to claim his place by her side—for a lifetime.

data.title: Immortal? Been There, Done That (DUBBED)
data.intro: Ben Zimmer, the most prominent figure in Riverton, has only a little time left before he takes his final breath. Yet, despite his frailty, he refuses to let go before seeing the person he longs for the most. His family is bewildered—until a striking young woman, Mia Young, arrives at their doorstep, demanding to see Ben. Suspecting she might be the daughter of the woman Ben once spoke of, the Zimmers watch in stunned silence.

data.title: The Reborn Vengeance: Love Amidst Ashes
data.intro: Betrayed by Vince Ray—the Prince of Aerion—and by her own sister, Mira Giles dies watching her family fall in flames. Reborn with a chance to change her fate, she swears to destroy Vince. To do so, she turns to Adam Ray, the paralyzed Prince of Halberd. In a moment of grave danger, Adam surprisingly rises from his wheelchair and fights beside her. Together, they wage a fierce battle against rebellion, treachery, and a kingdom on the brink of collapse.

data.title: A Feast of Power, A Crown of Supremacy
data.intro: Born in the criminal underworld, Bryan Clark leaves home at 20 and is brought back to his true home at 23. But in the face of his biased parents, arrogant sister, and hypocritical adopted brother, he realizes that only power and money are what he should trust. From then on, he exploits the guilt of others and strikes with ruthlessness, rising as the undisputed family successor.

data.title: Mistaken Surrogate For The B-ball Bad Boy
data.intro: Haley is a financially struggling college student who was supposed to be artificially inseminated with a sperm sample from her ex-boyfriend and professor, Ben Ferguson, but was mistakenly implanted with the sample of her longtime rival, Justin Crosby. According to the plan, Ben was supposed to give Haley a check after the procedure to help her save her brother, but he backed out at the last minute, claiming he would only fulfill his promise if Haley actually got pregnant.

data.title: His Love, My Forever Light
data.intro: Betrayed and heartbroken, Estelle Shaw drowns her sorrows in alcohol—and finds herself entangled with her best friend's young uncle, Martin Sander. Forced into marriage, she discovers Martin is unexpectedly a devoted husband, willing to punish his own brother for her sake and lay aside his own grudges for their future. What began as an orchestrated encounter blossoms into genuine love, as they walk toward happiness together, hand in hand.

data.title: Time-Traveled as an Imposter Prince
data.intro: Liam Alpin time-travels to Valoria, where his striking resemblance to the prince makes him the target of an assassin named Elara Frost. Fortunately, he is rescued by an elite general, Galen Lindt, who brings him to the palace to assume the role of the prince. However, the palace proves to be far more dangerous than Liam could have imagined, rife with insidious schemes and toxic plots.

data.title: Our Love Ends Here
data.intro: When Kimberly Bell sets out to repay her benefactor, Jason Hart, a tragic car accident shatters her plans—and steals her freedom. With no way to return to normal life, she’s forced into the virtual realm powered by the revolutionary system "ECHO." There, she meets Zack Fyre, the man she's assigned to court as part of her mission. What begins as obligation soon blossoms into love.

data.title: Caged No More: She Takes It All
data.intro: After a car accident, Kaylee White loses her memory and becomes completely dependent on others. Jackson Brown finds her and takes her to his villa, drawn by her uncanny resemblance to his first love, Tiana Marsh. But when Tiana suddenly returns, she demands that Jackson hand Kaylee over to a wealthy scion to serve as his plaything. Meanwhile, Kaylee's fiancé, Ryan Stark, arrives in Hrego determined to find her—and reclaim the life she's lost.

data.title: A Love Paid in Tears
data.intro: After returning to her biological family, Jane Gray does everything she can for them, only to be set up by her brother to sleep with a stranger. However, by chance, she spends the night with Hans Bale, the CEO of Bale Corp, and soon marries him despite only knowing him for days.

data.title: Off His Staff List, Into His Heart
data.intro: Yvette Jensen, a legend among nannies, manages to win the favor of the Steeles', earning Mrs. Steele Sr.'s respect and befriending initially arrogant Alice Steele. However, indifferent Cyrus Steele remains displeased, insisting she is too young and must be dismissed—until he finds out only after she is gone that she is, in fact, his favorite influencer.

data.title: My Boss, My Rules
data.intro: K-corporation is the epitome of a hierarchical society. Here, no one dares to speak up against their superiors. At the bottom of this food chain is Se-yeon, a contract worker, and just like any other day, a landslide of tasks befalls upon her lap. But Se-yeon is a Gen-Z contract worker!  With her unwavering confidence, Se-yeon stands her ground, even against  her direct superior, Seung-gi. However, Seung-gi is not an easy opponent...

data.title: The Midnight Tryst: Their Fateful Encounter (DUBBED)
data.intro: It has been five years since Sara Lane spent a night with a stranger and ended up getting pregnant. She hopes to give her son a good life, unaware that the stranger from that night is Sean Graham, the CEO of Graham Group, who has been searching for her all these years. To Sara’s surprise, her best friend meets Sean and takes her place, enjoying a good life with her son. Sara is left struggling with life until one day, she joins a company and finds its boss strangely familiar.

data.title: Winning Her Over a Second Time
data.intro: Despite living with his girlfriend, Sally Nelson, for the past three years and being fully aware of her expectations for marriage, Quinton Young continually delays their potential marital bliss. Although it's clear to everyone that he loves Sally, he refuses to acknowledge their relationship. Eventually, Sally, frustrated by his reluctance, decides to leave him and turns to someone else for what he won’t give her.

data.title: Throne of the Reborn: A New Reign
data.intro: Wesley Quimby, a successful CEO, is assassinated by a hitman hired by his own brother. However, death is not the end of his journey. To his astonishment, he awakens as an infamous emperor in ancient times. With no way to change his fate, Wesley decides to embrace his new life, not expecting that his sister-in-law would fall for him.

data.title: The Divorced Heiress' Fightback
data.intro: Having fallen victim to a scheme orchestrated by June West, Mona West is wrongly accused of having an affair with her brother-in-law, resulting in the loss of her child due to a miscarriage. To Mona's dismay, her husband, Hubert Jones, places more trust in June than in his own wife, going as far as pouring their child’s ashes on her.Feeling devastated, Mona believes she has nothing left in her life under such hopeless circumstances.

data.title: Love's Detour to Destiny(DUBBED)
data.intro: Mia Cole has been married to Joe Holt for three years when she catches him in bed with Sue Cole on the day of their third wedding anniversary. After seeking a divorce, Mia reclaims her title as the founder of MY Corp and overcomes Sue, resolving the misunderstandings between herself and Joe. Having gone through thick and thin together, they finally end up as a happy couple.

data.title: Promises in the Ashes
data.intro: In Cloudia, there's a strict rule—any woman who remains unmarried by the age of twenty must marry the person the government appoints. Everyone in Kloine knows that Cyrus Gadd, the chancellor’s son, is destined to marry his childhood sweetheart, Nora Curtin. However, just before her twentieth birthday, Cyrus shocks everyone by demanding to marry Nora’s maid first, making her his second wife.

data.title: Veil of Steel: Her Blade Remembers
data.intro: Betrayed during the empire's collapse, Lucille Morton loses her memory after falling from a cliff. She becomes Evelyn Sinclair, trapped in a cold marriage to Francis Linwood. When Francis brings home an imposter and tries to eliminate Evelyn, his plan spectacularly fails, triggering her memories instead.

data.title: Fight to Shine: Her Journey Up
data.intro: The day struggling student Yvette Shaw volunteers to transfer to an elite academy full of spoiled, wealthy kids, everyone thinks she's crazy—and sure enough, she's expected to be bullied. But with wit, strategy, and relentless determination, Yvette not only builds a fortune for herself but also takes control of her own destiny. Along the way, she discovers true friendship and begins to carve out a bright, joyful life among the privileged.

data.title: Plan B Bride: She Who Turned the Tables
data.intro: Madge Pearce, a transmigrated daughter, marries into the infamous Marquis Manor in place of her reborn sister. By the time her long-missing husband—rumored to be a womanizer—returns years later, she has already built a fortune of her own. Yet the moment they meet, something about him feels strangely different.

data.title: Veins of Mercy, Flames of Revenge
data.intro: After a fire, Julia Reed is labeled mentally ill and easy to manipulate. Yet secretly wielding Arthean blood—which grants her healing powers—she plots to avenge her mother and the other Artheans' deaths. Faking amnesia, she crosses paths with Joel Clark, who is also probing the Reed family's pharmaceutical crimes. As they go from doubt to trust, a bond beyond partners gradually blossoms quietly.

data.title: By Blood and Betrayal, I Resurge
data.intro: Betrayed and brutally murdered by her husband, Sean Curtis, and Zara Engel, who framed her in a baby swap scheme, Rhea Engel is reborn with enhanced powers. Discovering that Sean has also returned to life, she breaks free from her cycle of suffering by entering a marriage of power with the Beast King, rising as an untouchable sovereign.

data.title: Darker Than Pleasure
data.intro: A chance meeting at a bar pulls Ian Quinn, a driver for Star Corp, into an affair with Ann Shaw, heiress to the Farla Chamber of Commerce. Though he approaches her seeking revenge, Ian unexpectedly falls in love. His heart breaks when Ann chooses to marry Hank Judd after learning Ian's true motives.

data.title: No Escape: Reborn to Die
data.intro: On Lucille Zabel's wedding night, death is inevitable. Framed and executed by the matriarch, she awakens—only to relive the nightmare. Desperate, she escapes, seeks help, and is buried alive before she can explain. Reborn again, she searches for her husband, only to find him murdered. Accused of the crime, she is executed once more. Live. Die. Repeat. Trapped in an endless cycle of death, Lucille must break the pattern. But if every fate ends in tragedy… How will she survive?

data.title: Forbidden Desire:My Mated Stripper
data.intro: To avenge his father's murder, James does the unthinkable: he allows his nemesis, Lawrence, to become his stepfather. James infiltrates Lawrence's world, aiding him in running his strip club and becoming a shadow in his dark empire. Never did he imagine he would encounter Audrey, his ex-girlfriend who once embodied purity in his heart, within those dimly lit walls. Now, she has transformed into a seductive dancer, weaving her charms around Lawrence with calculated allure.

data.title: Ten Years Lost to Lies
data.intro: After being wrongfully accused of stealing medicine, Gavin Carter is sentenced to ten years of forced labor, during which he never stops longing for his wife and children. But on the day he finally returns home, he uncovers a devastating truth: the suffering he endured over the past decade was part of a scheme orchestrated by his wife, Elle Larson, to please his stepbrother—and even his mother had fallen victim to her plot.

data.title: Our Story Ends Here
data.intro: Felix Lange has been married for three years when he discovers the shocking truth: his wife is legally married to Mason Blair—the man she used as a stand-in while he was studying abroad. He remembers uncovering her affair back then, and she had promised to leave Mason. But now, the deception is undeniable. Heartbroken and disillusioned, Felix distances himself from the woman he once loved. Yet, is their story really over so easily?

data.title: Choices of the Heart
data.intro: After Bianca Jenkins lost her parents in an accident, she took on multiple jobs to fund her sister's eye treatment. Amidst her struggles, her boyfriend of four years betrayed her in order to advance his career. Thus, she became embroiled in the Frost family’s inheritance battle over Horizon Group.

data.title: When Forever Turns to Never
data.intro: Can you imagine being humiliated by your future stepmother at your father’s wedding, only to be mistaken for his mistress? In this story, Luna Ward seizes the moment of this misunderstanding and turns it into an opportunity to expose her stepmother. As the scandal stirs the crowd, Luna defends her dignity and protects her family. With Julian Ward’s unwavering support, they unleash their fury, putting an end to the disgrace once and for all.

data.title: A Love Served by Fate
data.intro: Kidnapped and saved by a mysterious woman who gave him a jade and a promise of marriage, Ian Holt's life was forever changed. Separated by circumstances beyond their control, he has never stopped searching for Xena Shaw. Years later, in a twist of destiny, she walks into his restaurant—not as long lost love, but as the new head chef. Neither recognizes the other.

data.title: Grades of Glory (DUBBED)
data.intro: Lily Cage comes from a poor background. Believing in her father’s words that education is the best way out of poverty, she puts her all into her studies and eventually achieves great grades, subsequently earning everyone’s respect.

data.title: Veil of Revenge, Kiss of Desire
data.intro: After her sister is driven to suicide by three wealthy heirs and her mother left in a coma, Beth Durham drops out and enters Cloud Lounge with a single goal: to exact revenge on the powerful Harvey Clark. Posing as a fragile, submissive woman, she manipulates him from behind her carefully crafted mask—yet, to her own surprise, she finds herself falling for him under his unwavering devotion.

data.title: Reborn Healer: Cures for All, Mercy for None
data.intro: Hannah Shaw, the long-lost daughter of the Shaws, is raised by the Celestial Healers' master and destined to become the sect's 56th successor. Yet she gives it all up to reunite with her family—only to face coldness and betrayal. Her parents dote on the adopted Winona, who possesses a strange system that copies every prescription Hannah creates. Framed and despised, Hannah meets her downfall when, during a plague, Winona steals her cure and brands her a traitor.

data.title: Blood Mate
data.intro: Soohyun is just an average college student whose life is turned upside down when she finds out that her classmate Jihoon is actually a vampire. Jihoon insists that he would never hurt humans, but a series of mysterious events causes Soohyun to doubt him. Soon, Soohyun becomes caught up in the world of vampires, oblivious to the danger she's in…

data.title: Over It and Owning It
data.intro: When Casey Upton reapplies for her marriage certificate, she's stunned to discover that her husband, Mitch Lowe, is legally registered to his assistant, Stella Pace. Heartbroken, she soon realizes it was all part of his plan—and even catches them in the act. Determined to escape the betrayal, Casey prepares to emigrate, only to be framed and brutally tormented by Stella. But when Mitch sides with her, the last trace of love within Casey shatters.

data.title: 19+ First Love
data.intro: The main character, a low-tier romance writer, finds that the hero from her own 19+ web novel comes to life. She reunites with her college senior, who inspired her novel, leading to an intense love comedy.

data.title: Her Divorce, Her Triumph
data.intro: Five years into her marriage, Sia Russell is deceived by her husband, Jay Shore, into signing divorce papers under the pretense of a mere formality—unaware that he does it for Emma Lyon, his lover and the mother of his child. Heartbroken by his betrayal and tormented by Emma's schemes, Sia strikes a deal with Sharp Corp to secure her freedom. When Jay finally begs for her return, it is too late—she has someone new standing by her side.

data.title: Sweet Poison, No Escape
data.intro: Once paraded as a showpiece for the powerful families, Tara Grant awakens during a piano performance and escapes. She uses Henry Lane to bring down the Grants—unaware she is the very woman he has long searched for: the mysterious Piano Lady. Touched by his unwavering loyalty, Tara falls for him, eventually walking down the aisle toward a new beginning.

data.title: Missed You Once, Never Again
data.intro: After a misunderstanding leads to her breakup with Arnold Zedler, Nora Searle leaves the country and raises their child on her own. Five years later, they cross paths again. Arnold mistakes her for a married woman, yet can't resist being drawn to her. Meanwhile, Nora keeps her distance, believing he's about to be married. In the end, fate brings them back together, reuniting them as a family.

data.title: Trails of Hope: His Journey Back Home（DUBBED）
data.intro: Theo Levy lost contact with his parents 20 years ago due to a car accident. Fortunately, he was adopted by the chairman of Boyd Group, who raised him into the man he is today. Now that he has finally returned to his hometown, he swears to find his biological parents with the pendant he has.

data.title: A Love Worth Breaking the Rules
data.intro: In hopes to fulfill her late mother's last wish, Lily York, a mischievous young lady who suffers from ALS, crosses paths with her devilish uncle, Jude Ashford. Knowing all of her weaknesses, Jude has her in his control, leaving no way for her to run. However, extreme pressure turns her against him. The more Lily insists on her own stance, the more Jude cannot help but give in to her.

data.title: No Fate Stronger Than a Reborn Mom
data.intro: Reborn thirteen years after her death, Tina Judd wakes to find her life in ruins. Her once-powerful husband surrounds himself with her stand-ins, her son has become a reckless outlaw, and her daughter is blindly in love with a liar. Though everything seems insane, Tina remains unfazed and ready to take control and change her shattered world.

data.title: Fate Rewritten: A Mother's Second Chance
data.intro: In her past life, Emma Lynch watched her son die. Reborn with a second chance, she swears never to let him suffer again. When her ruthless mother-in-law plots to sacrifice him for another child, Emma rises fiercely to protect him. But fate has one more twist in store—the boy's biological father is none other than her former college friend, Austin Gray, heir to a powerful family.

data.title: Capture Me, Capture My Heart
data.intro: Since her mother’s coma, Ruby Pierce has been neglected by her father and stepmother, who lavish all their attention on her younger sister, Cora. Struggling financially, Ruby is pressured by her family into seducing and marrying Ryan Pitt, the heir to a prestigious company. Pretending to agree, Ruby contacts the powerful Shadowlord to crash her wedding, unaware that he and Ryan are the same person.

data.title: How I Became the CEO's Darling
data.intro: As the adopted daughter of the Getty family, Emily endured a lifetime of mistreatment. A single act of unintentional protection from Thomas kept her by his side for years—until the engagement banquet, where he stood by as others humiliated her. That night, she finally gave up on him and married Lyle in a flash wedding. Over time, Lyle's unwavering care healed her insecurities, and she realized he had secretly loved her for the past ten years.

data.title: Love on the Edge
data.intro: Lily Hill receives a diagnosis of late-stage liver cancer during a routine check-up. However, in a moment of confusion, she mistakenly believes that her husband, William Leith, is the one diagnosed. When William ultimately manages to gather $500,000 for her surgery, Lily declares that he doesn’t deserve to be cured and halts the hospital’s arrangements for a liver transplant. Instead, she lends the money to her brother for a new car.

data.title: A Destined Reunion
data.intro: Five years ago, the scheming Cynthia Tipton used Sonia Tipton's terminally ill mother to force her into spending a night with a stranger in her place. Nervous and afraid, Sonia mistakenly entered the CEO's room. Afterward, Cynthia handed Sonia a bank card and warned her to keep the incident a secret. Cynthia then walked into the CEO's room and successfully replaced Sonia as the CEO's fiancée, gaining the wealth and status she had always dreamed of.

data.title: Payback's Coming, Mr. Ex
data.intro: After a whole night spent on a project, Stella Clark steps away for just ten minutes—and suddenly, she's accused of slacking off. Secretary Wendy Kurt insists Stella is at fault and persuades their superior—Stella's own fiancé—to fire her. Shockingly, he sides with Wendy. Sensing a deeper betrayal, Stella uncovers their secret affair and strikes back, ensuring they pay dearly while she reclaims the future she truly deserves.

data.title: I Loved, But I Let Go
data.intro: On their fifth wedding anniversary, Brian Lodge abandons his wife, Linda Grant, and their son, Tim, to spend the day with his childhood sweetheart, Sharon Birch. Heartbroken, Linda takes Tim and leaves. That night, under a relentless downpour, they get into a tragic car accident—one that costs Tim his eye. When Brian returns, begging for forgiveness, Linda gives him a second chance. She can’t bear for Tim to lose both his sight and his father.

data.title: Where Animals Speak, Secrets Die
data.intro: After a failed trial, Ryn Henson is reborn as an orphan with the ability to understand animals. Sensing an opportunity, Paula Bryant ropes her into livestreaming animal communication—only to inadvertently expose the Grant family's buried secrets. Soon, Ryn is invited to the Grants' estate, where a darkness deeper than she ever imagined awaits.

data.title: Serendipitous Love （DUBBED)
data.intro: The day Sylvia Cooper joined Taylor Corp. marked the day she was wedded to a total stranger named Brian Anders, who promptly disappeared right after they signed the marriage papers.A year later, Liam Taylor, the CEO of Taylor Corp., returned from France.Over time, Liam found himself harboring unique emotions for Sylvia. Liam was also pursuing a divorce. When he arrived at the Courthouse, standing patiently waiting at the entrance was none other than Sylvia…

data.title: Kiss Me Into the Light
data.intro: Nancy Jensen, eldest daughter of the Jensen family, has lived her life under the shadow of her mother's tragic and mysterious death. Surrounded by her stepfather's false kindness and her stepbrother's dark ambitions, she finds herself caught in a web of power and deceit. Determined to uncover the truth, Nancy sets her sights on Miguel Lund, the influential heir of Jinvale, skillfully weaving a web of charm and manipulation among three men to break free from her fate.

data.title: Turnaround: Revenge Fuels My Fortune
data.intro: After persuading his ruthless in-laws to accept a ten-million-dollar compensation for a highway demolition project, Liam Kent is framed, imprisoned, and beaten like an animal—only to die a tragic death. But fate gives him a second chance: he wakes up six months before the demolition. This time, he chooses silence.

data.title: From the Ashes, I Rise
data.intro: Liam Reed, accepted into the prestigious School of Economics, encounters his childhood sweetheart, Grace Hall, being publicly harassed by Tyson Kurt just a day before classes begin. Acting out of kindness, Liam intervenes, fighting Tyson and saving Grace. Unexpectedly, Grace turns her back on him, slandering him and leading to his imprisonment.While in prison, Liam inherits the legacy of a business legend, changing his fate and paving the way for a powerful comeback.

data.title: If She's Trouble, I'm Double
data.intro: The day the vengeful Mona Snow meets the sly heir Jerome Zane, everything changes. Their love becomes a whirlwind of ambition and revenge, and together they are an unstoppable force—crushing anyone who dares to stand in their way as they claw their way to the top of the business world.

data.title: Parting With What Once Was Love
data.intro: At eight, Isabella Wyatt witnesses her neglected, pregnant mother's death at the hands of her half-sister—and is accused of slander when she tells her father the truth. From that day on, she lives in torment until she meets Kieran Fletcher, whom she believes is her salvation. Deeply in love, she dreams of winning his heart and finally finding happiness in her miserable life, convinced that perseverance will see her through—only to be shattered by a cold, unforgiving betrayal.

data.title: Beneath Her Velvet Vengeance
data.intro: After being murdered by her husband, Silas Sadler, and her steward, Miranda Parker, Cindy Swain is reborn, burning for revenge. She carefully plots her payback by gaining control of her stepchildren, protecting her dowry, and joining forces with Brad Stark. When a shocking truth reveals Brad's children are actually Cindy's biological kids, their alliance turns to love, ending in marriage and a long-awaited family reunion.

data.title: Solving the Impossible: The Calculus of Glory
data.intro: Paige Judd, a vocational student from a poor family, wins the championship at the International Math Olympiad with her extraordinary talent in mathematics and the unwavering support of her teacher, Zach Zahn, who helps her overcome hardships and discrimination. Through her achievements, she not only proves her self-worth but also earns respect and glory, ultimately changing her and her family's fate for the better.

data.title: You, My Sweetest Hello
data.intro: Forced by the Paxtons to marry Theo Meyer—a man in a vegetative state—Leah West pours her heart into caring for him, never imagining he might awaken. From awkward beginnings to a growing bond, they face enemies, unravel hidden truths, and ultimately discover love and happiness together.

data.title: Her Beacon Burns for Blood
data.intro: To please his illegitimate sister Cecilia Rogers, Jack Rogers takes the entire Juset garrison to the outskirts to light beacons for her birthday, fulfilling her selfish request. As a result, when bandits invade the city, Margaret Rogers desperately sends multiple urgent letters via carrier pigeon, begging Jack to return with the troops. But amidst the chaos, Cecilia mysteriously goes missing. Enraged by the loss, Jack blames Margaret—and, in a fit of madness, kills her.

data.title: Steel and Grace: The Queen of War
data.intro: After earning countless merits, General Luna Reid returns quietly, only to have her engagement to the top scholar, Samuel Gaston, called off. Samuel is in search of someone who can build an era of peace and prosperity alongside him—and that person is General Reid. However, he is unaware that Luna is, in fact, the very general he’s been seeking. Despite narrowly missing each other several times, they eventually come together and lead the nation into a harmonious era.

data.title: Against the Tide: A Harvest of Hope and Love
data.intro: Gary Edge is deeply in love with Zoe Trent, but she is compelled to marry his brother, Ryan Edge, who tragically loses his life at work. Determined to care for Zoe and transform their village's fortunes, Gary begins cultivating herbs. This venture propels him from a humble villager to a tycoon in the herb industry.

data.title: Love's Mysterious Veil
data.intro: After years of living with her adoptive parents, Xandra Stone is finally reunited with her birth family. However, one day, she discovers her fiancé having an affair with her sister. Furious, Xandra confronts them, only to be scolded by her father. Disheartened, she seeks solace at a bar with her best friend, Nancy Key. Under Nancy's impulsive influence, Xandra marries the heir to the wealthy family. With both of them harboring their own secrets, what will happen next?

data.title: When Love Takes the Lead
data.intro: Winnie York fell for her boss, Oscar Fisk. But after being humiliated by his family at a banquet, she chose to take over her family business. Three years later, she's now CEO of Brixton Group and eventually forgives Oscar. Just as their feelings begin to grow again, a devastating truth comes to light—Oscar's mother was the one responsible for the death of Winnie's brother.

data.title: You Are My Forever and Always
data.intro: Nina Shaw accidentally becomes pregnant after saving Ethan Gray, forcing her to drop out and leave home. Years later, fate reunites them in marriage, though neither recognizes the other at first. As they slowly fall in love, Ethan struggles to forget the woman who once saved him, ultimately choosing to divorce—only to realize that the person he's been searching for all along has been by his side.

data.title: Beneath the Laurel Lies a Dagger
data.intro: Leah Shaw is forced into a substitute marriage with Noah Yates, a prince believed to have died in battle. But the man who weds her is Raymond Yates—the third prince, and the very man she once shared a night with. When the Duke's Manor is sealed off amid conspiracy, Leah chooses to stay and protect the family, determined to uncover the truth behind their downfall. Together, she and Raymond face danger and betrayal, fighting to restore the Yates family's honor.

data.title: Behind the Scars, Love Remains
data.intro: As graduation nears, Lucy Tate is forced to take her ailing mother abroad for treatment, pulling her boyfriend, Ian Ford, into a life of hardship. Not wanting to burden him, she fakes an affair and breaks his heart. Five years later, Lucy unknowingly joins Ian's company—only to discover she's fallen into his trap. Though fueled by resentment, Ian finds himself unable to resist drawing Lucy back into his world.

data.title: Timeless Love: A Heroine's Odyssey
data.intro: The top guard of Golden Pavilion was ambushed and killed while carrying out a mission. In a twist of fate, she travels to the future and now inhabits the body of Suzy Lopez, a 21st-century heiress who had previously passed away. Upon her reincarnation, Suzy uncovers the painful experiences endured by the original host, who faced various forms of torture and injustice.

data.title: Her Final Testimony
data.intro: At eighteen, Sally Gould takes on the heavy burden of avenging her parents' deaths, forced to walk a solitary path steeped in crime to uncover the truth and punish those responsible. Thirty years later, the siblings she once sent away are searching for her—not for a heartfelt reunion, but to bring her to justice.

data.title: Unveiling Ms. Lynch's Secret Identities (DUBBED)
data.intro: After her father's passing, Yancy Lynch, a girl from the countryside, is brought to the city by the affluent Watson family, who had arranged her marriage. Mr. Watson allows her to choose from his three sons, and the selected one receives a twenty percent stake in Watson Corporation. The city is abuzz with talk, and online users claim she's not worthy.

data.title: Duo of Valor: Defiance Ignited
data.intro: When Letria falls into Louis Hill’s hands and becomes his tool to rule the world, Merlin Clark and his daughter, Sadie Clark, decide to break ties with him and leave Letria instead of working with him.Facing threats from various adversaries, Merlin hides his identity by marrying Casey Grant. However, little does he expect that Letria is connected to the Irwin family, who aim to take over the Grants’ company and seize control of Calton.

data.title: Legacy Reborn II: Don't Call Me Cute, I Ruled an Empire
data.intro: Once the crown prince of an ancient dynasty, Keith Elmer wakes up in the modern world as a six-year-old boy after a drunken mishap. Hiding a thousand years of wisdom behind his innocent face, he exposes corruption within the Elmer family and rebuilds its power. But just as he's about to become the new family head, a new crisis arises—one that threatens both the family's future and the secret of who he truly is.

data.title: Rising Dawn: The Awakening of Power (DUBBED)
data.intro: Aidan Stein, the Eternal Lord Sovereign of the magnificent Eternity Palace, temporarily loses his memory and intelligence due to his 60-year cycle. He lives alone in Vertania until he encounters Jade Yule, who saves his life and becomes his wife. Years later, Jack Foley, an aristocrat of Vertania, develops an interest in Jade. He sends his men after Aidan, inadvertently triggering the resurgence of his memories and power.

data.title: The Lost Heir: His Dawn of Reckoning
data.intro: Troy Levin puts his heart and soul into designing a patent and gifts it to his fiancée, hoping it will earn her commendation from Traxon Group. Unbeknownst to him, she has already betrayed him and is plotting to break his leg to curry favor with a wealthy man. To his surprise, the chairwoman of Traxon Group identifies him as her long-lost son.

data.title: Invincible Healer: Taming Her Heart
data.intro: Struggling to advance in the Azure Order, Neo Ward is sent home by his teacher. His family tries to force him into a marriage in Jacob War's place. Neo refuses, claiming he is already engaged to Maya Reid. When the Reid family arrives, Jacob proposes to Maya but is rejected. Neo then produces a document to support his claim in front of Maya.

data.title: Mortal Life, Immortal Wife
data.intro: On a mission to eliminate a general who claims to have lived a millennium, top assassin Theo Upton is stunned by her sudden affection—she even hands over her prestigious company. Theo never believed in "immortals," but stepping into the time vortex and witnessing her ancient battles fills him with shock, and an unexpected feeling for her clouds his judgment.

data.title: Cast Out in Shame, Returned in Glory
data.intro: Janice Waldon, a widow, endures endless humiliation just to raise her son, Shane Waldon. However, the ungrateful Shane publicly shames her and drives her out of the house. That night, the heartbroken Janice finds an abandoned infant and names him Sean Percy. Over the next fifteen years, she pours her heart into raising her adopted son. Unbeknownst to her, the pendant Sean carries uncovers a shocking hidden lineage.

data.title: Surrendering to Your Heart
data.intro: Sue Leed, a bright and independent village girl, endures constant oppression from her family. Not only do they refuse to support her education, but they also attempt to force her into an unwanted marriage. Determined to reclaim her future, Sue escapes and, in a twist of fate, finds herself in the luxurious car of Hans Good, a wealthy CEO. Although Hans is typically indifferent to romance, he is instantly captivated by Sue.

data.title: Don't Call Me Cute, I Ruled an Empire
data.intro: Keith Elmer, once the crown prince of Velmore a thousand years ago, drunkenly transmigrates into the body of a six-year-old boy in the modern-day Elmer family. Faced with family power struggles, Keith uses his sharp wit and extraordinary talent to rise through the ranks—earning the favor and support of his formidable grandmother, Peggy Reed.

data.title: Secret Sugar On Me
data.intro: Catherine Rogers—trapped in a loveless marriage to her unfaithful husband—finds forbidden escape in a passionate affair with Abel, a younger man she believes to be nothing more than her kept lover. Their relationship defies age, status, and morality, but when she tries to end it, the truth shatters her carefully constructed facade: Abel is not a disposable secret but Mr. Harris, the city's most powerful billionaire with the ability to destroy her family.

data.title: A+ in Everything, Especially Payback
data.intro: Top student Glenda Glover, born in Oakmont, is unexpectedly reclaimed by her wealthy family in Jeston. Confronted with hostility and her adoptive sister's schemes, she remains unshaken. Devoted to her studies, she earns her place at the top institute—and carves out a legend of her own through hard-won success.

data.title: I Tied Him Up, He Stole My Heart
data.intro: After three years of mourning, Daphne Wood discovers her fiancé has a mistress—and that the entire town is ready to witness her disgrace. Determined to fight back, she ties up a charming and clever man to counter the scorn—only to realize he is the crown prince himself. Just as panic sets in, convinced she has ruined his years of hard work, he reassures her with unwavering devotion and affirmation.

data.title: Triple Bond of Love
data.intro: Because of a misunderstanding, Athena White leaves her boyfriend despite being pregnant. Six years later, she returns from abroad, and her three children encounter Caleb Parker at the airport, who is there to pick someone up. At this moment, her eldest child blurts out a question without much thought, asking, "What is Daddy doing here?"

data.title: Lost Heiress: A Whirlwind Romance with Him
data.intro: When the billionaire Webster, wounded and desperate, takes refuge in a hotel, one passionate night he spent  with the enigmatic Dalle forges a bond that neither time nor turmoil can break. But their brief encounter becomes a storm of betrayal and greed, as Dalle’s life is torn apart by those who seek to control her fate. Just as all hope fades, a missing ring resurfaces, pulling Webster back into her world.

data.title: The Graveyard of Our Love
data.intro: After the tragic death of her twin sister, Michelle Scott, during a shared mission, Alice Scott assumes Michelle's identity to comfort her grieving brother-in-law. She intends to reveal the truth only after bearing his child. But when Michael Thompson discovers the deception, he marries Diane Miller, leaving Alice shattered and drowning in despair.

data.title: Nothing Else Compares
data.intro: Shawn Moore locked Kesia Foster up in an asylum, torturing and humiliating her to no end, making her pay for her father’s sin of causing his father’s death.Two years later, he married her, but… “You’re just paying for your family’s sins in another way.”

data.title: World in Chaos: I Can Upgrade Everything
data.intro: When the apocalypse hits, an eerie white fog engulfs the world, and monsters run rampant. Deliveryman Ian Colt awakens the unique "OmniEnhance System" and upgrades his beat-up truck into a deadly Doom Engine. He teams up with a surgeon and an electrical engineer to fight monsters and ruthless warlords, surviving both the horrors of the apocalypse and the malice of humanity.

data.title: The Day Love Died
data.intro: Yale Levin has devoted himself entirely to Mia Hunt for seven years, envisioning a bright future together. However, his idealized world shatters when he discovers her complicated relationship with her friend’s brother, Zach Jaffe, and catches them in bed. Devastated, Yale decides to leave, returning home to take over the family business and fulfill an arranged marriage to the influential Wendy Blair.

data.title: The Formula Is Me: Single, Successful, Untouchable
data.intro: Ethan Burke breaks up with his girlfriend without hesitation upon discovering she's seeing another man. The moment he returns to singlehood, his life skyrockets. His career takes off, and capable, wealthy women enter his life as if by fate. With their support, Ethan rises swiftly to the top and restores his family's legacy. Those who once betrayed or ridiculed him will now bow before him.

data.title: I Killed My Stepfather with a Kiss
data.intro: At her mother's funeral, young actress Violet prays in tears—only to be "comforted" by her stepfather, Maxwell. But no one knows: this man was once the perpetrator of Violet's most traumatic night. She tries to escape, but Maxwell closes in, controlling not only her career but also quietly infiltrating her mother's life—soon becoming her would-be stepfather. At a lavish wedding, Violet is horrified to discover the bride is her own mother—and the groom, her rapist.

data.title: My Perfectly Quirky Wife
data.intro:
To escape an arranged marriage, a second-generation chaebol and a chaebol heiress enter a contract marriage while hiding their real identities. As they begin living together, the two unknowingly fall in love—each 
unaware of the other's true status.

data.title: Shoot My Heart, My Mafia Boss
data.intro: When the unruly sovereign of the night encounters the tender guardian of life, an extraordinary bond begins—forged through a steadfast pursuit that bridges their worlds. As they navigate the delicate dance of acquaintance, the barriers of estrangement melt away, revealing the depths of each other's souls. United against the shadows of past enmities, they traverse the thorns of adversity together, dispelling the darkness that once threatened their peace.

data.title: For the Family That Chose Me
data.intro: On the run from assassins, Evan Zeller—the sole heir to Zeller Corp—falls into a raging river and loses his memory. Rescued by a kind couple, he assumes a new identity as "Hayden Hoover" and works tirelessly to become a top achiever. Just as he’s about to repay his adoptive parents, his biological grandfather finds him and whisks him away for intensive training.

data.title: You're My Reason the Sky Is Blue
data.intro: Celia Lennon, a humble employee from a remote village struggling with family troubles and a harsh supervisor, spends an unexpected night with CEO Zach Hawk. Offered a permanent job soon after, she hides her pregnancy with triplets—until Zach discovers it through the Hawks' secret gift of physical resonance. From then on, he shields her from harm, showering her with care and promising her happiness.

data.title: Next Chapter, No You
data.intro: After seven years of marriage, Camila Reed's husband remains cold and distant. Still clinging to hope that she might one day win his heart, she travels overseas to surprise him and their daughter on her birthday—only to discover them celebrating another woman's birthday instead. They had never planned to spend the day with her.

data.title: The Blessed Encore: An Odyssey of Joy
data.intro: Ray Brooks unfortunately loses his life while saving another person in a tragic accident. Unexpectedly, in the Immortal Realm, a compassionate sage, moved by his kind deed, grants him divine power in his hands before sending him back to earth. With his power, Ray suddenly finds himself completely irresistible to those around him, including his stepmother, Sandra Stone, and her daughter, Jennie.

data.title: Throne of Blood and Lies
data.intro: Death was not the end for Eloise Judd—it was her beginning. Executed alongside her family by the husband she once believed in, Eloise is granted a second chance at life and revenge. Transformed from a loyal wife to a strategic mastermind, she partners with Hector Crane, the cunning Duke of Northvale, to systematically dismantle Anthony Lowe's empire. But political intrigue is about to collide with an even more dangerous threat.

data.title: Four and Fearless: Chefs, Beware!
data.intro: At just four years old, Rita Keller—a culinary prodigy trained by the renowned chef Jared Goode—surpasses her mentor and is soon chosen to compete in a prestigious international contest. With her cooking skills, Rita dazzles elite families and world-class judges alike, ultimately winning the championship and becoming the youngest top chef in Ulora's history.

data.title: Crashing Into My Magnate Ex
data.intro: Daphne and Julian were once a couple admired by everyone, but Julian's mother intervened and broke them up. Heartbroken, Daphne parted ways with Julian. Unfortunately, her younger brother was diagnosed with congenital heart disease. Three years later, in order to obtain the X-special medicine for her brother's treatment, Daphne re-encounters Julian, who has since inherited the Wilson Pharmaceutical Group, through an introduction by her suitor Colin (Julian's nephew).

data.title: Light in the Pieces of Me
data.intro: Born blind, Morven Cruz has known only hardship—until a desperate escape entwines her fate with Ewan Mead. Amid love, betrayal, and a fierce battle for the heiress' place, secrets surface through pregnancy and surgery. Blood ties and hidden emotions collide, dragging them into an inescapable web of destiny.

data.title: Love Is My Paycheck
data.intro: Reluctant to work, Katie Smith plans to live off her wealthy parents’ assets, but she is soon kicked out and told to fend for herself for three months. When her best friend, Michelle Young, mentions that her young uncle is looking for a wife and offering a generous salary, Katie jumps at the chance to interview.

data.title: Rules Were Never Her Thing (DUBBED)
data.intro: After ten years of suffering with the Lowe family, May Lowe finally glimpses hope when she meets Max Dow. Initially, she sees him only as a means to escape her family's virtual prison, but as time passes, she finds herself falling for him. His unwavering trust and devotion slowly break down her walls. Though their bond begins with deception, it ultimately leads them toward salvation and healing, their souls bound together on the path to recovery.

data.title: Wait, My Secretary Is My Wife?!
data.intro: Thanks to Sam Good’s grandmother, Sam Good and Sue Judd get married despite knowing very little about each other. After their wedding, they part ways and only reunite a year later at Sam's election event for secretary, where Sue becomes his personal secretary. Remarkably, neither of them recognizes the other. Despite several attempts by Lana Bale and Sam’s mother to sabotage their relationship, Sam and Sue gradually fall for each other.

data.title: Return of the Secret Heiress
data.intro: Three years ago, Laura, heiress to the Lewis Group, the nation's wealthiest conglomerate, and a business legend, came to Maplewood to investigate an investment project. There, she fell head over heels for the unknown Ben Harrison. She hid her true identity, married Ben, and secretly helped his company become a rising star in Maplewood. After marriage, Laura worked as a cleaner at Sheppard Group and helped the group's CEO, Bryan Shepherd, resolve a business crisis.

data.title: When the Wrong Door Leads to the Right Love
data.intro: The older sister, Kylie Shaw, is set to marry Chad Fuller, the head of the Fuller family. Meanwhile, the younger sister, Willow Shaw, is to wed Ethan Fuller, a celebrity. On their wedding night, the sisters mistakenly enter each other's rooms. When they realize the mistake the next day, Kylie decisively declares that what's done is done. After the marriage, clashes arise due to their vastly different personalities.

data.title: Flash Marriage: My Soul Exchange with the Boss
data.intro: Top mafia heir Leon falls in love with Bella at first sight and hastily marries her against his family's objections, angering his mother Susan. Under Susan's scheming, Leon mistakenly believes Bella has cheated, leading to their divorce. At this time, Bella was already pregnant and secretly gave birth to twins, vowing to raise them alone. Five years later, Bella worked to raise money for her critically ill mother while also taking care of two children.

data.title: Fading Ties, Fading Love
data.intro: Having grown up with childhood friends Ivan Snow and Fred Lyle, Yulia Webb promises to marry one of them after graduation. But everything falls apart when Stacy Roan schemes to win their affection by sowing discord and playing the victim. Even worse, Stacy secretly bullies Yulia behind the men's backs, driving a wedge between all three friends.

data.title: Mute for Love
data.intro: Bella was pushed off the rooftop by her husband Peter and his mistress Farren on their wedding anniversary night. Fortunately, she was rescued by a mysterious gang leader, who helped her embark on a path of revenge. Bella lost her voice due to trauma but unexpectedly regained it when she reunited with her enemies. Her sudden return disrupted all of Peter and Farren's plans, and Bella made new discoveries during her revenge journey...

data.title: You're My Wish Come True
data.intro: Reborn at 18, Stella Wood carries memories of her past life and a resolve to change her and her family's fate. While plotting revenge, she approaches Oliver Ford to repay his kindness. She thinks he's just a shy, sweet boy—easily flustered by her teasing. But Oliver isn't truly blind or innocent. By the time Stella wants to free herself from him, she realizes she's the one caught in his game.

data.title: Like Roses, in Summer's Tender Kiss
data.intro: Freelance photographer Melody Bale is forced into an engagement with CEO Aaron Zahn, a man she deems dull and keeps at a distance. Misreading his kindness as warning signs, she pulls away—only to fall prey to someone who wishes her harm. Through Aaron's steadfast protection and unwavering devotion, Melody discovers the truth of his heart, and love blossoms between them—pure and true, like roses in summer's tender kiss.

data.title: No Mercy, Only Vengeance
data.intro: In her past life, Zoe Yale fearlessly exposed Joan Cork’s true nature as a demonic cultivator, only to be branded a traitor and slain by her own mentor. Given a second chance at life, she severs all ties with her sect and embraces the Heartless Way, rising far above those who once scorned her. When Joan’s dark secret is finally unveiled, Zoe’s mentor and fellow disciples are consumed by regret—but it is far too late.

data.title: Playing It Real
data.intro: To ditch my cheating ex, I kissed a handsome stranger. Turns out, he's not just anyone, but the richest bachelor in town! And now he wants something in return. So we're engaged in a contract marriage. What could possibly go wrong? The only thing is I'm slowly, uncontrollably, falling in love with him.

data.title: Alchemy of Power: From Mute to Muse
data.intro: Once an Aurum Cultivator of the Immortal Realm, Mitch Lewis is cast down to the Mortal Realm due to overwhelming debts. He transmigrates into the body of a gambler who, like him, is drowning in debt—and has a beautiful yet mute and tormented wife. Unable to bear her suffering, Mitch resolves to embrace mortal life, starting by earning money and crafting pills to heal her.

data.title: Bleed for This
data.intro: Mason Ford is a famous boxer who grew up with his mother. When he refuses to participate in a fake match, his mother and wife are kidnapped by the wealthy Dylan Stone and his men. With no alternative, Mason is compelled to confront them face-to-face.

data.title: Loving You At Sunset
data.intro: Due to medical negligence, Graham Zink's sperm was mistakenly implanted in Hana Allen, resulting in her unexpected pregnancy. Graham's fiancée, Winnie Larson, urges Hana to undergo an abortion. When Graham, the president of Zink Corporation, discovers Hana's pregnancy, he convinces her to fake an abortion to keep it a secret. Struggling with her brother's medical bills, Hana reluctantly agrees. As they maintain the deception, Graham and Hana unexpectedly fall in love.

data.title: Love's Encore
data.intro: To get his revenge, Luke Clark masks his identity for years and marries his enemy’s daughter, Nancy Beck. He then abandons her after killing her father. Unable to accept this, Nancy loses hope and ends her life. Meanwhile, Luke learns that her father was not his true enemy. When Nancy opens her eyes again, she realizes she has been reborn. Given a second chance, Nancy decides to stay away from Luke.

data.title: The Stranger I Married
data.intro: Richard and Irene did not have much time to get to know each other before they got married. They did not even understand each other’s personalities, values, daily habits, and other things. It led to them having all sorts of misunderstandings about each other after marriage.

data.title: Office Scandal
data.intro: A woman trapped in a broken marriage for 8 years finds her heart shaken by a man, and she must choose between her husband and the new man to find true love and happiness.

data.title: The Eyes Have It
