data.intro: Simon Shaw, an apprentice at an antique store, experiences profound humiliation when his wife, Julie Sutton, divorces him after discovering a gemstone worth tens of billions. In the wake of this betrayal, Simon's latent ability Flare Vision is awakened, granting him an uncanny ability to perceive the true value of gemstones with remarkable precision. Leveraging this newfound power, Simon swiftly ascends in the gemstone industry.

data.title: All My Days for You
data.intro: Violet Page's life changes after she is drugged and meets Zayne White. While others think she is using him, Zayne has been hoping for their relationship all along. As they grow closer, secrets are revealed, and Zayne supports Violet's dreams. Through ups and downs, their love deepens until marriage brings them both redemption.

data.title: Boomerang Love
data.intro: She decides to raise her son on her own, but he suffers from leukemia and therefore needs a bone marrow donation. Should she ask that man for help?

data.title: Into the Huntress' Web
data.intro: Growing up in Xonos, Yael Judd inherits her grandfather's entire fortune, only to be imprisoned by the Stone family and condemned to a life of misery behind a mask. Determined to escape and take her revenge, Yael sets her sights on Jim Holt, the wealthiest heir in Valia, and begins luring him into her trap, step by step.

data.title: Return of the Dragon Lord
data.intro: Ten years ago, Ian Thorn was forced to leave his family to live on his own due to a misunderstanding. Later, a severe accident nearly claimed his life, leaving him on the brink of death. In a stroke of fortune, Arya Shaw, a young woman, intervened, saving him from the precipice. Grateful for her actions, Ian commits to protecting her, and their bond deepens into love, resulting in marriage. However, their life together is fraught with stress and misunderstandings.

data.title: Love and Sorcery: A Mystical Adventure
data.intro: Kyle Young is not only the son of the richest man on earth, but also one who has a great secret that he himself is unaware of, while Chloe Carter is a girl who practices Spiritual Arts and is told to protect Kyle. As the villains try laying their hands on him,Chloe counteracts with her techniques and wit, occasionally fending the enemies off in Kyle’s house amid the fun times they spend together.Gradually,the bond between Kyle and Chloe thickens, and love surfaces in the air.

data.title: Power in Her Hands: She Commands, She Conquers
data.intro: At the dying request of war hero Paul Wade, Gwen Sinclair, leader of Empyrea, returns to Jaine as the fiancée of his son, Darcy Wade, to protect him and support his rise. Though their relationship begins on rocky ground, their bond strengthens amid battles with his scheming family and the traitors she once backed. Through every trial, Gwen and Darcy find themselves falling deeper in love.

data.title: That Makes Two of Us
data.intro: Four years ago, at the wedding arranged by their families, Max, the scion of the conglomerate, was absent, leaving the down-and-out socialite Alice as the nominal Mrs. Brown. Four years later, Alice has transformed into a well-known divorce case investigator, while Max returns home as the chairman of the Legend Group and entrusts her with handling his divorce case—neither recognizing the other.

data.title: Footprints of Fate: Tracing the Path Home (DUBBED)
data.intro: In a car accident, Kaleb Carter loses his memory due to injury. Thirteen years pass, and he is now working at Lacoy Group with his adopted daughter, Stella Carter. However, he offends William Lacoy and is bullied and humiliated. By coincidental circumstances, William discovers that Kaleb owns a lucky charm identical to the one his mother has. It turns out that Kaleb is the father William has been searching for, with 'Brandon Lacoy' being his real name.

data.title: The 19th Year
data.intro: When Melanie was young, she lost her mother. To get hands on the Wright family’s inheritance, Melanie’s stepmother deliberately indulged her, resulting in her frailty and incapability. Then, out of the blue, James reappears in Melanie's life and keeps pushing her to be strong and stand on her own feet. Though they share no blood ties, they have acted as siblings for 18 years. But things get more tangled in the 19th year.

data.title: Crown of the Reborn: Vengeance Awaits (DUBBED)
data.intro: On the day of Cade Bale’s wedding, Sue Shaw takes her last breath. Her downfall started when she invited him to go to school in the same Maybach as her out of kindness. Despite Cade being the son of the Shaws’ driver, Sue lent him her card, gifted him luxuries, and even handed over the company her father had left for her. Enjoying everything given by her, Cade got in a relationship, doting on his girlfriend while treating Sue as his maid.

data.title: The Forbidden Flame
data.intro: Despite the forbidden attraction between teacher Brody Shaw and student Eugene Sutton, Brody finds himself unable to resist Eugene's purity and warmth. Just as their bond deepens, Eugene suddenly loses contact with Brody, leaving him heartbroken and forever scarred. Ten years later, Brody reappears—not as the man Eugene once knew, but as the new husband of Eugene's father. What Eugene doesn’t know is that Brody’s marriage isn’t driven by love, but by revenge.

data.title: Revenge is My Name, Justice My Flame
data.intro: Burdened by vengeance, Penelope Morris is reborn as Molly, a humble maid in a landlord’s household. Outwitting her masters, defying bullies, escaping slavery, and helping those in need, she secretly plots to bring her enemies to justice and reshape her destiny. Determined to change not only her own fate but also the lives of her suffering friends, she leads them toward a future filled with hope and happiness.

data.title: Love's Valor
data.intro: As a devoted soldier, Joan White leaves her newborn daughter and heads out to fight for the country. However, when she returns with victory in her hands, the hospital her daughter is in has been burnt down. Despite the grief she feels, she dives back into the battlefield to contribute to her country. When Joan decides to retire twenty years later as peace is acquired, she gets informed that her daughter is, in fact, still alive.

data.title: Got Myself A Priceless Husband
data.intro: Beth Alison, after one fateful night with Norman Miles, runs into him again at a time of her need. Not remembering who he is, and not knowing the CEO identity that he has kept a secret from her, Beth goes on a journey of becoming a fashion designer and living a married life that eventually reveals a past and a man she thought she’s long left behind.

data.title: Picked Up a Chaebol on the Street
data.intro: A chaebol heir, Son Eun-seok, suffering from amnesia, is found by Ga-eul, who becomes part of a contract marriage love story.

data.title: Shadow of the Immortal
data.intro: The ruler covets the Xanthus Elder's life-extending medical skills and sends spies to infiltrate the Xanthus world and poison the Elder. The Xanthus Elder, poisoned and attacked by assassins, encounters Sam Jenkins, who looks just like him. After dealing with the assassins, the Xanthus Elder transfers his skills to Sam Jenkins, appointing him as the new Xanthus Elder temporarily, and tasks him with finding the mastermind behind the assassination.

data.title: Through Treachery, To Love
data.intro: Cassidy Marlowe uses her second chance at life to navigate the treacherous royal court. She outsmarts the princess royal, uncovers her husband's schemes, and thwarts the Lord Protector's rebellion. Amidst intrigue and upheaval, Cassidy not only reclaims her destiny but also discovers true love in the arms of Regent Julian Lockwood.

data.title: When the Spirit Lord Awakens
data.intro: The security guard, dealing with amnesia, faces rejection from his blind date. Shortly after, another strange woman comes and breaks off her engagement with him. Little do they know, he is actually the Supreme Spirit Lord, an undefeated force in this city.

data.title: The Love She Let Go
data.intro: In the fifth month of Nelly Wood’s pregnancy, her husband, Hugo Meyer, decorates their home with lilies to impress his first love, Sadie York—completely ignoring the fact that Nelly is severely allergic to them. Trapped in a room with no way to escape, Nelly suffers a violent allergic reaction, leading to a devastating miscarriage.

data.title: From Rags to Riches: The Lost Heiress' Reclaiming
data.intro: When Leo Shaw faced insurmountable career challenges and accrued a staggering debt, his creditors abducted his only daughter. Now, as the world's wealthiest man, he tirelessly searches for her. One fateful day at the entrance of Shaw Corp, he encounters a disheveled young woman. Unbeknownst to him, she is his long-lost daughter, adopted by an elderly man. Meanwhile, back home, the woman uncovers her husband's entanglement in an affair with another woman.

data.title: The Unrivaled Dragon King
data.intro: The unmatched Dragon King has returned! With overwhelming power and strength, his ironclad rule will have the world trembling in fear.

data.title: Rigged to Win: Jack of All Cons
data.intro: After witnessing his father’s tragic death due to gambling, Leo Cole vows to take down the industry from the inside. His journey begins by mastering the art of deception under the guidance of a seasoned swindler. With his skills sharpened, he convinces notorious gamblers Harry Lowe and Yves Clark to join him. Teaming up with a cunning thief, Doris Nott, they carefully select the perfect casino, forming an elite crew of con artists.

data.title: I Loved You, But Not Anymore
data.intro: In her final moments, Alison White discovers the heartbreaking truth—her husband, Sean Haller, has always loved her cousin, Vanessa Gray. But fate grants her a second chance. Reborn, she refuses to live under Sean’s shadow again. This time, she chooses Clive Haller, Sean’s younger uncle—superior to him in every way. What she doesn’t expect is that Sean will stop at nothing to win her back.

data.title: Let It Be Me
data.intro: Charlotte's parents passed away, and she was adopted by her uncle and aunt. As they grew older, her uncle arranged for Charlotte to marry Mike from the Davis family for the sake of a business partnership. In reality, Mike is a playboy and often has sexual relations with Ella. Upon discovering this, Charlotte angrily cancels her engagement with Mike and marries a homeless man named Jackson whom she found on the street.

data.title: Love's Fading Echoes
data.intro: Sierra Cox had never stopped loving Travis Foster for the past ten years. However, when he manipulates her into luring a psychotic murderer out in place of a girl he adores, it inevitably breaks Sierra’s heart. Tragically, she is brutally killed, and when Travis sees her body, he is overwhelmed with grief.

data.title: A Toast to Truth
data.intro: Cade Yale, the chairman of Soar Corp, finds himself mentioned repeatedly in his classmates' group chat, as they urge him to attend Sean Judd’s wedding. Initially, Cade plans to decline the invitation due to his demanding work schedule. However, everything changes when Sean shares a photo of his fiancée in the chat—revealing that the bride-to-be is actually Cade’s wife, Hana Soot.

data.title: Scripted Kisses, Dangerous Secrets
data.intro: On a job, Ariel Foster meets Alan Byrne, CEO of Byrne Corp, while pretending to be a wealthy heiress. Although she plans to leave after getting paid, she unexpectedly becomes involved in the Byrnes' dispute over the heir's position. What begins as a fake relationship with Alan soon turns into real love. However, something about his identity seems off.

data.title: Crown in My Hands, Blood on Yours
data.intro: Salma Windsor endures the unthinkable after witnessing Frida Sterling secretly swap her newborn son, Gregory Lancaster, with Elijah Lancaster, who becomes crown prince. Gregory takes his own life upon learning the truth. Grief-stricken and furious, Salma breaks her silence, exposing the emperor's darkest secret. With loyal guards and unyielding resolve, she seizes the palace, crushes Noelle Santor's schemes, and ascends the throne as empress regnant.

data.title: Stairway to Stardom
data.intro: After being betrayed by her boyfriend, Yannis Sand relives her dream of pursuing a music career. She auditions for a talent show, astonishing the audience with her exceptional talent. Yannis goes on to represent Clusia on "Global Best Vocal," ultimately conquering the music industry.

data.title: Last Breath, Last Love
data.intro: Whitney Lambert is bound to the Immortality System, which grants her eternal life with a cruel twist: every death consumes a vast amount of energy. Despite this, she is willing to sacrifice herself for Stephen Grant no matter when. However, Stephen grows indifferent to her repeated deaths, desensitized by her immortality. He even demands that she die in place of his first love, who has received a death threat. Heartbroken, Whitney agrees.

data.title: Love in the Spotlight
data.intro: When the Judds finally find their biological daughter, Mia Judd, they kick Jill Leed out of the house to make room for their long-lost family member. To make matters worse, Jill’s childhood sweetheart, Zac Ford, announces his engagement to Mia and accuses Jill of being the mistress between them. Devastated by the sudden turn of events, Jill drowns her sorrows in alcohol and spends a night with her good friend, Ian Lowe.

data.title: A Heart Only for You (DUBBED)
data.intro: Desperate to stay with the penniless Gemma Holt, wealthy heir Jerry Cobb cuts ties with his family, who disapprove of their marriage. But when she fails to secure the money for his heart transplant, Gemma lies—claiming she's just a gold-digger—to make him leave her. Years later, Jerry still resents her, unaware they share a child... and that Gemma's time is running out.

data.title: Reborn to Cure: A Miracle in the Making
data.intro: After developing a cancer cure, medical expert Mark Koch finds himself 50 years in the past, where his mother, once lost to cancer, is still alive. Motivated to save her, Mark accelerates his research and chooses to skip the SATs to administer the cure. However, his decision is met with skepticism from the medical community.As his mother's attending doctor, Jill Elmer recommends a check-up, and the results confirm the cure’s success.

data.title: Now You'll See Who I Am
data.intro: Quinn Smith had always devoted himself to his family—until the day they cast him out. Betrayed and furious, he vows to take back everything he once gave them. As the truth of Quinn’s sacrifices comes to light, the Smiths are left drowning in regret. Meanwhile, Quinn gets back with Riley Lopez, and together, they raise Bella Smith as a true family built on love, not obligation.

data.title: The Trials of Love
data.intro: Fifteen years ago, the Mirchoffs took everything from Alicia Stewart, including her grandfather’s life, forcing her to go abroad to build a career in the design industry. Over a decade has passed, and now, Alicia returns to Nathan Mirchoff's side as Alexia Faria, determined to reclaim everything she has lost and win his heart.

data.title: A Kiss a Day Keeps You My Way
data.intro: Food vlogger Naomi Lark falls for orthopedic doctor Hank Stone after watching his video online. When she discovers he's her neighbor, she boldly pursues him—until a bathroom accident leaves her injured, placing her directly in his care.

data.title: When Pride Becomes Poison
data.intro: After graduating, Stella Clark struggled to find a job. Moved by her determination, Cedric Tobin, the influential CEO of Flux Group, took her under his wing, offering her a job and nurturing her potential. Over three years, Stella rose to prominence, becoming the company's top sales performer. However, convinced that her success was entirely her own, she betrayed Cedric by resigning and launching a rival company.

data.title: Tied to a Love That Hated Me
data.intro: Sierra Gray marries Ethan York, unaware that his heart has always belonged to Lena Tobin—his brother's fiancée. After a tragic accident leaves Ethan's brother hospitalized, tensions rise. When Lena suffers a miscarriage after falling down the stairs, she blames Sierra, and Ethan, blinded by love and lies, turns against his wife, plunging her into misery.

data.title: Her Veiled Vengeance
data.intro: To exact her revenge, Jill Reed marries into the Baker family while pretending to be a naive and foolish girl. However, her secrets can’t stay hidden forever. Over time, Matt Baker discovers that she is not only the student of the master of medicine but also a skilled pianist, a covert investor, and a powerful hacker. Confounded and frustrated, he eventually can’t resist questioning her about what other secrets she might be hiding.

data.title: To Love and Be Destroyed
data.intro: Sarah Stone is forced to break up with Toby Gray and marry Zack Hanson to save her family from bankruptcy when her father is admitted to the hospital due to severe illness. However, what was meant to be redemption turns into a painful fall as her father takes his own life just so she can be set free upon learning that Zack is abusive and unfaithful.

data.title: Loving You to the Moon and Back
data.intro: Beth Aston loses her sight while saving an elderly woman, only to face her mother's insistence that she marry a frail, elderly man. Determined to escape, she flees—and is rescued by the old lady's grandson, Oscar Ford. As Beth and Oscar grow closer, their bond deepens, eventually leading to marriage. With his support, Beth resumes her studies and ultimately undergoes treatment to restore her sight.

data.title: Seconds Too Slow, Forever Too Long
data.intro: Three days before their wedding, Allen finds out that his fiancée, Xenia Smith, is pregnant with her best friend Liam Irwin's baby. Her betrayal shatters his trust and feelings for her. He eventually marries Nina Scott, a wealthy CEO who has loved him since their school days. Their story shows that sometimes, it takes time to find the right partner in life.

data.title: One Chip to Rule Them All
data.intro: Though he appears to be an ordinary worker, Theo Mason is secretly the underground ruler of the city, controlling its economic lifelines and sought after by top corporations. Five years ago, he joined Ford Corp as an employee to repay a favor. Now, to keep him, the chairman offers Theo his own position—but the chairman's daughter, Lena Ford, refuses to accept it.

data.title: Crown Me Never Again
data.intro: General Julia Wilson helps her beloved, Francis Burke, ascend the throne—only to be sentenced to death after discovering his affair with her sister. With her final breath, she vows revenge. Edmund Sinclair, the Marquis of Evermere and a man who secretly loved Julia, storms the Throne Hall and dies fighting Francis. But fate isn't finished with them yet: Julia and Edmund are granted a second chance at life.

data.title: Oops, My Heart Broke the Rules!
data.intro: Upon receiving a new mission, the protagonist is reborn as Yelena Quinn, an abandoned wife. This time, her task is not only to exact revenge on those who wronged her, but also to win the heart of the most elusive man—one with whom she unexpectedly shares a tangled history spanning three past lives.

data.title: Divorced? More Like Spoiled by Fortune
data.intro: On the day of her divorce, she's left with nothing—betrayed by her cheating husband, mistreated by her mother-in-law, and cast out. Just then, five powerful men step forward, each claiming to be her father: a real estate tycoon, a movie superstar, a legendary doctor, a genius scientist, and an overseas war hero. They all adore her, protect her, and give her the strength to rise again. From now on, her life is unstoppable!

data.title: The Heart Remembers
data.intro: Viola Sherwin, the eldest daughter of the prestigious Sherwin family in Highford City, was poisoned by her cousin Viola, leaving her mentally impaired. Taken in by the matriarch of the Quinn family, she assumed a new identity as Wendy and was married to the Quinn family’s heir, Winston Quinn.After the matriarch's passing, Viola, pregnant with twins, was sent away by Winston. A car accident on her journey triggered the return of her true memories and identity.

data.title: Love Beyond the Labels
data.intro: Sonia Wade, a luxury saleswoman, struggles under the constant pressure of her selfish and demanding family. One day, she's drugged during a delivery and rescued by Leo Lowe, leading to a night they unexpectedly spend together. However, Leo distances himself, mistaking her for a gold digger. Despite this rocky start, they gradually grow closer as Leo is captivated by Sonia's strength and independence.

data.title: Love Again: When Time Resets
data.intro: Reborn, Yara Smith stands before her own grave—while Tyler Levin digs it open, calling her name relentlessly. As family conspiracies, betrayal, and vengeance come to light, Yara captures Tyler's attention at a high-stakes gambling gala—and their story begins. This time, can she defy fate, protect her family, and claim the love she's always deserved?

data.title: Love Across Time
data.intro: A beauty content creator from 2024 traveled back to the 1990s and encountered the younger version of a future billionaire. The story unfolds as they navigate a romantic relationship.

data.title: Until We Meet Again
data.intro: Nina Clark grew up abandoned in an orphanage, clinging to a promise made with Tyler Winston, a boy who cared for her like a brother. They vowed to meet again in 15 years, marked by a jade necklace. Now, Tyler is the CEO of Winston Group, but when Nina finally finds him, an accident causes a twist of fate, and she finds her identity stolen by someone she thought was a friend.

data.title: Straight-A Boss: His Rise to the Top
data.intro: After being framed by his brother, Tommy York, and blamed by his family, Mike Smith—now transmigrated as Fabian York—leaves home and earns a place in college, standing up to the bullies. As Fabian becomes the target of their revenge, he is protected by his beautiful teacher, but his arrogance sparks further conflict when the bullies' parents place the blame on him instead.

data.title: Immortal? Been There, Done That
data.intro: Ben Zimmer, the most prominent figure in Riverton, has only a little time left before he takes his final breath. Yet, despite his frailty, he refuses to let go before seeing the person he longs for the most. His family is bewildered—until a striking young woman, Mia Young, arrives at their doorstep, demanding to see Ben. Suspecting she might be the daughter of the woman Ben once spoke of, the Zimmers watch in stunned silence.

data.title: Shadowed Thrones
data.intro: Felix Young, known as the Supreme, discreetly supports his wife, Madison Xavier, in her ascent to a higher position. However, the day she is appointed as the War God, Madison files for divorce. Disheartened, Felix is determined to reclaim everything he once granted her.

data.title: His by Decree: Ensnared in Royal Flame
data.intro: On the night of her engagement to her childhood sweetheart, Sabrina Yowell is plagued by a vivid dream—one where she finds herself trapped beneath the infamous tyrant, Edmund Sinclair. The next morning, news sweeps through the realm that the emperor has issued a decree to gather the most beautiful women. Sabrina dismisses it, convinced it has nothing to do with her.

data.title: Her Game Was His Heart
data.intro: Colin Scott spends three years pursuing Eva Ward, and when she finally agrees to be his girlfriend, he mistakes it for the long-awaited return of her love. But the truth cuts deep—Eva only said yes to avenge her childhood sweetheart, Sean Price, after Colin outshone him by taking first place at a medical forum. Heartbroken, Colin walks away. Only then does remorse consume Eva. She tries everything to win him back, but Colin’s heart has long since turned cold.

data.title: Treasure Seeker: The Eyes That See All
data.intro: After breaking up with his fiancée, Rue Leed, Finn Cole gains remarkable skills as an appraiser following an accident involving a vase. Using his newfound talent, he helps Mia Shaw, the boss of Treasure Trove, amass a fortune. Leveraging his abilities, Finn forms valuable connections by assisting notable figures like antique tycoon Ken Cork, Queen of the Underworld Phoebe Lowe, Leo Good, and Travis Gold. He then outmaneuvers Rue, Tom Judd, and Zach Walker in their schemes.

data.title: Princess Rowena Lance
data.intro: When the young Rowena Lance met Caspian Humpfrey, a captivating and unforgettable young man, she gave everything up and decided to follow him to the Great Avendell in the name of love. However, a tragic misunderstanding and a power struggle for the Great Avendell throne tore the two young lovebirds apart.

data.title: My Partner, the Devil
data.intro: Betrayed by her fiancé and his lover, a woman is given a second chance at life by a demon to seek revenge. As she unravels their plot against her, she finds herself drawn to the demon, who holds secrets from her past. In the end, their shared tragic history resurfaces, revealing a love lost in a previous life and a pact made to save her.

data.title: Am I the Villain?!
data.intro: Jung Mina is a novelist with a terrible reputation for leaving works unfinished. One day, she wakes up as a character in one of her stories, an irredeemable villain whom she named after herself. Not only is she stuck as such a terrible character, but she's also destined to meet a tragic fate! Can Mina escape her tragic fantasy life while also coming to terms with the struggles she has in her real life?

data.title: Broken Vows, Bow Before Me
data.intro: Promised the title of Lady of the County and the crown princess, Hilary Sharpe is left with a shattered heart when Crown Prince Austin Ruben replaces her with her half-sister. Realizing she has devoted herself to the wrong man, Hilary walks away from both him and her treacherous family, seeking an alliance with Prince Keanu instead. Fueled by anger and betrayal, she meticulously plots her revenge, vowing that everyone who has wronged her will regret it.

data.title: The Mistake They Made, The Reckoning They Deserved
data.intro: When Maya Ross, daughter of Aurelia's wealthiest man, Jacob Ross, returns from abroad, Jacob's secretary—and girlfriend—brings a priceless medical reagent to the airport as a welcome gift, hoping to leave her a good impression. But when the reagent breaks, she lashes out at the person responsible—unaware that the young woman she's tormenting is Maya herself.

data.title: My Heart, Your Weapon
data.intro: Ivy Shaw pretends to be insane so she can stay inside the Wynn residence—all to exact ruthless revenge using Lucas Doyle, the wealthiest heir in Goldridge, as her pawn. When her plan to bring the family to ruin succeeds, Lucas steps in, revealing he had seen through her schemes all along. Yet he chose to play along, willing to be her accomplice—and be used by her—for as long as it takes.

data.title: Sealed Legacy III: Immortal? Been There, Done That
data.intro: Mia Young once sealed the Demon Lord and entrusted the seal to her loyal servant, Noah Nord, unknowingly founding a family of demon subduers that endured for a millennium. Now, seeking to recover her lost memories, Mia returns to the Nords' residence to help them defeat the Demon Lord once again—only to discover that they plan to surrender and dismantle the Demon Seal the very next day.

data.title: My Ex-Husband is 18
data.intro: At 27, Yoon Ha-rin meets her end in the flames—betrayed and nearly murdered by her  husband, Kang Siwoo. But when she opens her eyes, she finds herself back in her  high school days. With the resentment and thirst for revenge from the brink of death still burning inside her, Ha-rin vows never to fall victim again in this life. Yet the Siwoo of the past still stands before her, and unexpected events—different from her previous life—begin to unfold one after another.

data.title: Rules Were Never Her Thing
data.intro: After ten years of suffering with the Lowe family, May Lowe finally glimpses hope when she meets Max Dow. Initially, she sees him only as a means to escape her family's virtual prison, but as time passes, she finds herself falling for him. His unwavering trust and devotion slowly break down her walls. Though their bond begins with deception, it ultimately leads them toward salvation and healing, their souls bound together on the path to recovery.

data.title: When the Sun Sets on Us
data.intro:
When Ethan Gray accidentally looks at the computer belonging to his girlfriend, Nancy Holt, he discovers countless photos of her posing intimately with her childhood sweetheart, Mark Hall. Ethan then decides to break up with her and accept his family’s arrangements for him to take over the family business abroad.

Initially, Nancy remains unaware that anything is wrong. She continues to shamelessly approach Mark in an overly intimate manner, even in Ethan’s presence.

data.title: Don't Tell My Boss I'm A Girl
data.intro: Due to a coincidence, Jessie is mistaken for a man by CEO Nathan and gets hired as his personal assistant. Little do they know, their love story began years ago...

data.title: I'm Nothing but a Mortal
data.intro: Ian Colt, a genius Jade Sect apprentice, ascends to the Sky Realm after just 20 years of cultivation. Believing there's nothing more to teach him, his mentor, Sean Judd, tricks Ian into leaving for the mortal realm.There, Ian encounters Jim Cole, whose life is on the line. Despite the efforts of three skilled doctors, none can save him, leaving his daughter, Sue Cole, desperate. Ian successfully saves Jim.

data.title: Unlawful Desires
data.intro: An accidental car crash kills Jacqueline, the Nichols' second daughter. Victor, their spokesperson, furious, blames Jensen family, leading to Allison's father and brother's death; her mother and herself are arrested. To vie for Wayne family's commercial land rights, Victor blackmails Allison's mother to have her replace Jacqueline, marrying Alec Wayne, Wayne's third-gen heir. As a Wayne wife, Allison forms an unexpected bond with Eric, fiancé's uncle-in-law....

data.title: Rewinding Life's Tape
data.intro: Ten years ago, Sean Leaf's gambling addiction led to the tragic loss of his daughter in a fire at Sky Tower. Devastated by their loss, his wife, Rue Bale, spiraled into despair during a fireworks show in 2012. Overwhelmed by hopelessness, Sean ends his life as well. When he opens his eyes again, he unexpectedly finds himself back in an arcade in 2002. To his surprise, Rue is also transported to the past.

data.title: General's Return: No Mercy, No Forgiveness
data.intro: After ten years of war, Liam Holt returns in triumph, welcomed by the crown prince—only to mistake an impostor for his daughter while his real daughter Aurora Holt has been forced into torment at a brothel by his four adopted sons. When the truth emerges, rage breaks Liam's peace to pieces, and he rushes to save Aurora before punishing his sons. Even in the face of the crown prince's rebellion, Liam never flinches, determined to bring his daughter justice.

data.title: Breaking Free From Their Thirst
data.intro: Alex Falkner is born to be nothing more than a blood donor for his brother, Shawn Falkner, enduring years of mistreatment under Shawn’s manipulation. Even the only person who ever shows him kindness, Faye Cole, agrees to get engaged to him solely because she fears he will stop donating blood to Shawn if he marries someone else.

data.title: Flashing My Moves, Accidentally Making Legends
data.intro: Caelis Valeheart transmigrates and becomes the lead disciple of the Ascension Sect, despite possessing no real power—only flashy, showy moves. Mistaken for a prodigy, he is put in charge of the disciples. Bound by the "Supreme Disciple System," Caelis is tasked with misleading his juniors at every turn. Forced to bluff nonstop, he casually spouts poems and song lyrics... and to his shock, his juniors begin achieving Transcendent ranks one by one, simply by listening to him!

data.title: When Love Expires
data.intro: To fund his grandmother’s treatment, Ian Judd signs a ten-year contract with Sue York’s mother to help Sue move on from heartbreak. For a decade, he stays by her side, but to her, he’s nothing more than Sean Shaw’s replacement.When the contract ends and Sean returns, Sue rushes back to him, unaware of Ian’s silent devotion. Only after Ian leaves, divorce papers in hand, does she realize his love—but by then, he’s already gone, stepping into a new life without her.

data.title: Route to Ruin: The Reckoning Awaits
data.intro: When Hannah Shaw boards a bus to her brother's wedding, she expects nothing more than a simple bus ride. Instead, she finds herself clashing with an entitled old woman who won't take no for an answer. A heated dispute spirals out of control, culminating in a reckless act that derails more than just the journey.

data.title: Drowning in Love
data.intro: Anna gave up her medical dream to work as a medic, all to stay close to Olympic champion Charles Turing. But for years, he took her love for granted, keeping her in the shadows. An unexpected pregnancy forced Anna to see the truth—she had fallen for a man incapable of love.

data.title: Photogenic Scandal
data.intro:
Habin, 27, an amateur photographer, secretly poses as famous photographer Miro for shoots with sexy models. What starts as a simple favor spirals into a whirlwind of temptation, jealousy, and complicated emotions.
"Would you rather kiss me or pay the penalty?"

data.title: Meet The Mafia Boyfriend
data.intro: A kind-hearted girl, Undine, rescues Tarak, a mafia boss who has lost his memory, in order to escape her debts. As they spend time together, they gradually develop feelings for each other. After Tarak regains his memory, however, he forgets Undine, and a fiancée named Vicky suddenly appears. The villainous younger brother Seren repeatedly plots against them, leading to misunderstandings and their separation.

data.title: My Wife is My Divorce Lawyer
data.intro: Four years ago, Richard fled the country on his wedding day, leaving his arranged bride, Nicole, behind. Now, he's back and seeks out a top divorce lawyer, Nicole, to handle his case, unaware that she is his wife. By a twist of fate, Nicole doesn’t recognize Richard as her runaway husband and eagerly takes on his case. What follows is a series of hilarious and heartwarming encounters as they navigate their unwitting reunion.

data.title: Trouble in Disguise
data.intro: When billionaire Stella Clark's mother plans to remarry, Stella panics and hires Marcus York, a struggling student, to sabotage the marriage. But her scheme backfires, resulting in her mother's tragic death and the loss of the family fortune. Angered and bitter, she sees Marcus as a scheming jerk—yet the truth is far more complicated: he is a wealthy man who repeatedly comes to her rescue, saving her from danger time and again.

data.title: Fury Awakened: The Mighty One Returns
data.intro: On his way back home by train after years of being away, Peter Lewis witnesses his wife, Mona White, and his son, Hank Lewis, being bullied by a rich woman named Yael Harris, who knocks their lunchbox over and demands compensation. Having been diagnosed with war injury sequelae, Peter tries looking for a peaceful resolution to prevent himself from losing control due to rage. However, Yael pushes them further and forces them to kneel before her.

data.title: Seven House Rules
data.intro: After marrying into the wealthy Gielgud family, Dickson Elba is bound by seven strict house rules. Breaking any of them could cost him his life. He gradually discovers that the master of the house controls the household through eerie blood vessels. The butler dies while trying to help him. In the final confrontation, Dickson realizes that it was all a hallucination following a car crash, reflecting his real-life despair.

data.title: My Husband Murdered Me
data.intro: A woman named Hyang-mi, who lost her family due to her husband's affair with his mistress, and Jae-ha, who seeks revenge for his father, work together to achieve revenge. However, they must face a brutal truth in their love story.

data.title: Through Shadows, She Reigns
data.intro: Aurora Pratt, a lost princess raised among commoners, is forced to break her engagement when her fiancé, Corvin Clay, passes the imperial exam and turns his sights on gaining power through a wealthy family. She then seizes the opportunity to expose the governor's schemes. With her brothers—Princes Leo and Marc Kingsley—coming to her aid, Aurora crushes Corvin's selfish ambitions and claims the nation’s devotion as the rightful royal princess.

data.title: Fatal Marriage
data.intro: Shirley Hodge, who has been in a deep sleep for years, wakes up to find her long-trusted medication causing issues. She discovers her perfect husband is having an affair with the maid she hired. Despite this distressing revelation, Shirley must navigate the situation without causing a stir.

data.title: The Awakened Eyes
data.intro: Summer Levin, an employee at an antique shop, is forced by her husband to get a divorce. Through a series of unexpected events, she gains the “Sage Eyes,” which grant her exceptional medical skills and the ability to discern the true value of antiques. With these newfound abilities, she excels in the antiques field, engages in stone gambling, and uses her resources to help others.

data.title: Duo of Duty: The Healers We Swore to Be
data.intro: Caden Gray begins his internship on the back of his exceptional suturing work, but is fired on day one by Jacob Stone after he performs emergency treatment on a mobster. He later proves his talent to Dr. Nash through his work at a clinic and at a crash scene. Jacob remains his rival, only to be gradually won over by Caden's quiet competence. He even helps clear Caden's father's wrongful conviction. Together, the two doctors continue their paths, staying true to their calling

data.title: Thawed by Love
data.intro: Though she is secretly one of the top doctors in the world, Natalie is forced into prison by his father. After being released, she is blackmailed by her father again. He forces her to marry the comatose Samuel Hunt to bring him good luck. However, she is devastated when she learns that her younger son has died. In the midst of her grief, Natalie makes a shocking discovery—Samuel’s son has the same birthmark as her late child…

data.title: From History to Glory: Legacy in Her Hands
data.intro: The Graham family is renowned for their work in artifact restoration, and Paige, the first female family head, vows to protect their honor. When she accidentally travels to the future, she stuns her descendants with her authority and mastery before revealing her identity as the legendary antique restorer and guarding the family's glory.

data.title: She’s the Apple of Their Eye（DUBBED)
data.intro: Emily, the daughter of the illustrious Porter family, had her world upended when she learned she wasn't her parents' biological daughter. When the true Porter family heiress returned to claim her birthright, Emily was kicked out of the family. After rejoining her biological family, she discovered she was the heiress of the nation's wealthiest dynasty. She had five exceptional brothers who showered her with affection, two adoring parents, and a wealthy CEO fiancé.

data.title: She Rests in Peace, They Rest in Grief
data.intro: Luna Lowe, an orphan, is welcomed into the Lowe family and adored by her three overprotective brothers. But the love and warmth vanish the moment their biological sister, Stella Lowe, returns home. Branded as nothing more than a stand-in, Luna slowly loses faith in the meaning of family.

data.title: Cheat on Me? Watch Me Wreck Your World
data.intro: Having started a business abroad, Will Lowe is crushed to discover his wife, Lina Mack, is having an affair with Harry Quinn back home. Upon his return, he witnesses their arrogance and greed—including the destruction of his mother's legacy. Fueled by rage, Will wrecks their marital home, strikes back, reclaims control of the company, and begins anew with Sue Litt.

data.title: Until Our Hearts Meet Again
data.intro: Seven years ago,Yelena Smith hides her illness and breaks up with Wesley Locke. She gives birth to their son, Noah Smith. They live a life of poverty and put up with her uncle's ridicule while living under his roof. Eight years later, Yelena is scraping by as a cleaner, while Wesley is now the richest man in the city. When they first meet, he resents her. After learning the truth, he pursues her once more.

data.title: Where Lost Hearts Meet Again
data.intro: Aurelia Shaw spends a night with wealthy Tobias Levin and later gives birth to Anna Levin. But abandoned by the other Levins, Anna only meets Aurelia again six years later when she has risen to be a renowned young violinist. Though protected by Tobias, they face obstacles reuniting as imposters and rivals target the family. But despite a kidnapping and many other challenges, they eventually manage to come together, starting a new chapter as a complete family of three.

data.title: A Dance Between Chains and Freedom
data.intro: In her past life, Sarah Garner was sent as a hostage and tortured to death. Reborn outside King Cyrus' camp, she chooses a new path—captivating Cyrus with her dance instead of becoming a miserable prostitute. Though kept under threat, Sarah pretends to obey while secretly plotting revenge. She manipulates the man who once abused her and spreads rumors about Cyrus, all while staying close enough to slowly win his heart.

data.title: Farming Love and Fortune
data.intro: Yara Irwin is forced to marry a countryman in place of her half-sister. Though she appears pitiful on the surface, beneath it all, Yara is clever, resilient—and secretly looking forward to the marriage. However, her expectations are upended when she discovers that the man rumored to be rough and indecent is, in fact, generous and strikingly handsome.

data.title: Heart Rebooted Without You
data.intro: Ethan Stewart has always loved his childhood sweetheart, Lucy Simpson—so much that he took the fall for her family. After three years in prison, he returns to find his place taken by her assistant, Felix Murray. Heartbroken, he walks away on their wedding day. When Lucy finally finds him, it's too late—he's already with someone else.

data.title: Don't Mess With Her
data.intro: Wendy Bell, the lost heiress of the Spencer family, supports her mom's medical bills by working at a club. Under a twist of fate, she accidentally rescues Henry Nelson, the CEO of Nelson Corporation. However, Rosy Hansley, discovering Wendy's heroic act, falsely claims credit for the rescue.Upon Wendy's return home, her step-parents force her to marry into the Nelson family in place of her stepsister.

data.title: A Deal With Time
data.intro: If you had the ability to buy and sell time, would you sell your time to someone else, or would you buy others' time to extend your own life? Blessed with such an extraordinary ability, Edwin Smith helps the poor by buying one year of their time for one million dollars each, as he does not possess enough time to do the opposite.

data.title: Contract Husband: He Is Already Yours
data.intro: Sophia Sterling was kicked out of her home by her father and had her assets frozen due to her excessive spending. With the help of her best friend Skye, she entered into a contractual marriage with Luke Carter. Initially, she only aimed to get money, but they gradually developed feelings for each other while jointly dealing with Vivian Thorne's provocation and the bankruptcy crisis of the Sterling Group.

data.title: The Compass of Destiny
data.intro: Derek Lang, a skilled geomancer, faces humiliation at the hands of his fiancée, Laura York, during his training. After foretelling that her family will face consequences for their actions, he is cast out of his home. He meets Daisy Frost, his new housemate, with whom he experiences a series of misunderstandings.

data.title: Love's Timeless Cure
data.intro: Emilia Shaw, a skilled modern-day doctor, is mysteriously transported to a rural village in a bygone era. Upon her arrival, she is sold to the Leigh family. Unwilling to accept her fate, Emilia refuses to bow down to her circumstances. Instead, she uses her medical expertise to heal the sick and assist the villagers, all while uncovering the dark secrets surrounding her disabled husband, Matthew Leigh.

data.title: The Day I Died, Their Hell Began
data.intro: Julia Smith can only watch as her parents and brother shower Emily Smith with love, always choosing her over Julia. Even her own fiancé sides with Emily. Pushed to the brink of despair, Julia sees no way out but to end it all—until fate takes an unexpected turn.

data.title: All That Was Promised
data.intro: For three long years, Emily Snow gave everything to help her husband, Jacob Gray, earn a noble title—only to be cast aside the moment he married another woman for his own promotion. What Jacob never knew was that Emily had already helped him secure the title he chased. But by the time the royal decree confirming their separation arrives—so does the truth. And his regret comes far too late.

data.title: The Lost Heiress: From Victim to Victor
data.intro: After twenty years of searching for his sister, David Jude finally discovers that she is now living in Giazo as "Sarah Tully," excelling in her studies at Irvin University. However, due to her relatively poor family background, she is often bullied by Jane Hunt. The bully's actions have caused her adoptive father, Warren Tully, to become a vegetable. Sarah herself almost suffered a lethal fall.

data.title: For Love and Nothing Less
data.intro: Seven years ago, Luna Sawyer was pregnant when she discovered that her boyfriend, Samuel Payne—who was battling cancer—was secretly the heir to Payne Corp in Reydon. Samuel was offered a deal: if he broke up with Luna, they would pay for his treatment. But deeply in love with her, he rejected the offer, unaware that Luna had overheard the conversation. Determined not to hold Samuel back, Luna silently chose to leave—only to be presumed dead in a car accident.

data.title: 9-to-5, Hearts in Overdrive
data.intro: Lilian Judd, the world's top crisis management specialist, secretly loves Tim Holt, head of the Holt Group, even giving up a promising job overseas to work for him. After an unexpected encounter, fate and love bring them to marriage—but unbeknownst to them, their relationship has long been part of a plan, leading them both to this moment.

data.title: Take My Bed
data.intro: Ten years of silent suffering—her husband's betrayal, her best friend's lies. Now, with life granted anew, it's time to settle the score.

data.title: This Time, No Turning Back
data.intro: A seven-year relationship shatters when Philip Page is caught cheating on Clara Bishop. Enraged, Clara ends things and begins rebuilding her life. However, Philip refuses to take her seriously and mistakenly believes there’s something romantic between her and Quinn Meyer. It’s only after facing repeated rejections that Philip finally understands Clara is truly gone, and that she will never return to him.

data.title: Not Yours, Not Today, Not Ever
data.intro: Moments before her death, Scarlett Kendall discovers that her husband, Connor Langley, sabotaged her chance at college by stealing her admission letter and giving it to her sister. Reborn, she wastes no time—claiming what should have been hers. Meanwhile, Connor heads to the college with her sister, holding the fake admission letter in hand.

data.title: Lust and Leverage
data.intro: Forced to quit her job to pay off her brother's debt, Maia Green plans a bold comeback by landing an interview with Aaron Moore—the aloof heir to Haybor's most powerful family. But as their paths cross in a web of schemes and challenges, an unexpected spark ignites between them.

data.title: Lost to You, Lost to Love
data.intro: On the surface, Ciara Wood and Vance Gerber seem like the perfect couple, but each harbors a secret: Vance is drawn to the student he's sponsoring, while Ciara still mourns a love lost five years ago. After their divorce, Vance struggles to discern whether his lingering feelings are mere obsession or true love, while Ciara finds unexpected happiness with someone new—someone determined to claim her heart.

data.title: Twisted Souls
data.intro: While confronting her boyfriend, Kyuwon, about his constant cheating, writer Sowon gets into a car accident with him. They wake up in the hospital to the shocking discovery that their souls have been swapped. Now in Kyuwon's body, Sowon decides to use this opportunity for revenge and begins to uncover the depths of his deceit.

data.title: Falling for the Secret Heir
data.intro: On her wedding night, Callie Jensen's husband elopes abroad with her best friend. Devastated and on the verge of giving up, she takes on a charming boy toy she meets at a bar and stays with him for three years—until her husband returns. Callie offers the boy toy a check and ends the relationship. However, they soon cross paths again, and she finally discovers that the seemingly immature boy she once knew is actually a powerful and influential billionaire.

data.title: Destined Clash: From Rivals to Romance
data.intro: After mistakenly interpreting a marriage agreement as a declaration of war, Thea Upton leaves home seeking revenge—only to find herself married to her sworn enemy, Tyler Aston. Her stepsister, Rose Upton, and the rest of her family are openly dissatisfied with her and cause constant turmoil.

data.title: Reborn CEO: Stitching a Legacy in the '80s
data.intro: Catapulted into the 1980s, Susan Smith is ensnared in a scandal by the manipulative Yvonne Williams, who frames her for an affair with Gary Collins. Susan endures Yvonne's venom and her husband Jackson Jones' anger while grappling with the destitution caused by the body's previous owner.With a talent for fashion unseen in this era, Susan takes matters into her own hands. Her skills turn heads, winning the approval of the community.

data.title: Shadows of Betrayal: Her Resolve to Vindicate
data.intro: Jasmine Mayall, the sole survivor of a devastating purge, witnesses the destruction of her loyal family at the hands of a paranoid king. Consumed by a thirst for truth and justice, she embarks on a perilous journey to clear her family's name. But the deeper she digs, the more horrifying the truth becomes—the mastermind behind the tragedy is the very king she swore allegiance to. Torn between blind loyalty and justice, Jasmine faces an agonizing choice.

data.title: Forget Me Not
data.intro: After a devastating fire robs Sue Leaf of her memory after she saves Andy Leed, the boy she grew up with, she ends up in the care of a farmer who renames her Mia Puck. Years later, Andy, determined to find Sue, plans to build the world’s largest funfair in his search for her. However, fate takes a twist when he discovers that the perfect location for his funfair belongs to Mia and her adoptive father, who are fiercely protective of their land.

data.title: You, My Angel in Disguise
data.intro: Eve Anson is only eighteen when she meets Julian Jett. Drowning in despair, she hands over every last penny with trembling hands, pleading for protection. What she doesn't realize is that he will become not only her guardian but her lover—for life.

data.title: All My Love, All for You
data.intro: To raise money for her tuition, Mona Leed works as a courier, where she meets Jim Judd and unexpectedly becomes pregnant. Her family, however, plans to marry her off to an older man in exchange for 500 thousand dollars. Determined to escape her family’s control, Mona decides to keep the baby and refuses the arranged marriage. Learning of her situation and recognizing Mona’s innocence, Jim steps in, bringing her home and caring for her.

data.title: The Stolen Life: Close yet Worlds Apart (DUBBED)
data.intro: When Amy Cecil brings her children, Ray and Roxy Lennon, to the hospital for their fevers, a mix-up occurs in the chaotic entrance, and she mistakenly takes home Lily Kirk instead of Roxy. Fortunately, Wade Graham, a local greengrocer, finds and rescues Roxy, who is subsequently raised as Ines Graham.Fifteen years later, Amy, now the head of Lennon Corp, is dedicated to finding Roxy with the help of her daughter Lily, now known as Paige Lennon, and her three sons.

data.title: A Mother's Last Gift
data.intro: Eight years after Mia Xavier donates a kidney to save her son, Walt, she suffers from a deadly illness caused by the donation and has only two months to live as she lacks the money for surgery. Therefore, she visits Walt in the city, never expecting that he would be so ungrateful as to disown her. Devastated, Mia is unaware that someone is looking for her–Tony Lane, chairman of Excel Group, and her husband, with whom she lost contact 25 years ago.

data.title: Replaced on My Wedding Day
data.intro: Ivy York has been with John Snow for six years, and their wedding day is finally set. But John betrays her in the worst way—he marries Stacy Stone to fulfill her mother’s wish, making Stacy the bride at Ivy’s own ceremony. Ivy’s dress is stolen, and she’s framed for hurting Stacy’s mother. Her life shatters, but William Grant, the powerful Lord of Jinton, steps in. He exposes Stacy and her mother’s deceit, helping Ivy see John’s true nature.

data.title: You're My Piece, My Whole
data.intro: Tina Lind and Noah Gould grew up side by side, so close that the Gould family eventually decided to adopt her. But before that dream could come true, Tina tragically fell off a cliff and vanished without a trace. Noah was devastated by the loss of his closest friend—and even twenty years later, now a powerful CEO, her absence still haunts him.

data.title: Marching Into Love
data.intro: After a sudden death, military doctor Sue Yale is reborn as the daughter of a military governor, married to General Tim Cole. But when he ignores her on their wedding night, favoring Wren Lowe instead, Sue doesn't hesitate—she walks away, determined never to accept disrespect or humiliation.

data.title: From Fired to the Power Seat
data.intro: It isn't until his mother falls into a coma from illness that Paul Judd realizes his girlfriend has been hiding her true nature all along. After securing a major deal for the company, he is swiftly betrayed and fired. In response, he switches sides, becoming the company's client, and begins plotting his revenge against those who wronged him, relishing the slow and satisfying process of payback.

data.title: Price Tag on a Heart
data.intro: Ethan Gray, a billionaire, returns to his hometown for a festive occasion to surprise his wife and her family, only to discover that his wife—whom he hasn’t seen in a year—is pregnant. It is only when his in-laws realize Ethan's immense status that they regret their actions. However, Ethan has already decided to cut ties, no longer harboring any feelings for them after such betrayal.

data.title: Fired, But Not Defeated
data.intro: Despite being the company’s top saleswoman, Wendy Gray is dismissed by Sophie Hall, the boss' daughter, who believes it's wiser to invest in Mandy Kurt, a high-performing newcomer, rather than retain a pregnant senior employee who seems less promising. Unbeknownst to Sophie, most of Mandy’s success is due to Wendy’s behind-the-scenes contributions. When Sophie later collaborates with Wendy and learns the truth, she is stunned.

data.title: Hush-Hush Marriage: My Boss, My Love
data.intro: Just one day after marrying, Yosef Brown steps into the workplace as the newly appointed CEO. When Sue Smith addresses him like how others do, she is taken aback when he warmly responds, "Hi, darling."

data.title: Heart Closed, Game Over
data.intro: After seven years of dating Cindy Turner, Julian Yale's mother falls ill. However, influenced by Cody Smith, Cindy refuses to lend him the money he desperately needs for his mother's treatment, believing it to be just a gold-digging scam for cash. Heartbroken over his mother's death, Julian leaves, and when he meets Cindy again, he has become someone out of her league—and a taken man.

data.title: Love Forsaken, Life Reclaimed
data.intro: Unaware of what lies ahead, Emily Reid forces her young uncle, Cedric Lowe, into marriage, only to spend her life in loneliness and misery. On her deathbed, Cedric’s first love, Della Smith, deceives her into believing that Cedric never loved her, leaving Emily to take her final breath filled with resentment. But death is not the end.

data.title: Love Knotted by Fate
data.intro: Five years ago, Naomi Olson was set up, which led to an unexpected night with Derek Wade, the heir of the Wades. That night changed everything, resulting in the birth of twins. However, Naomi was disowned by her family and forced to flee with her daughter, Thea Olson. Meanwhile, Naomi’s sister, Elena Olson, heartlessly lied, telling Naomi that her son, Henry Wade, had died—when in reality, Elena was using him as a tool to manipulate Derek.

data.title: Fate Twisted, Love Aligned
data.intro: Cyrus Griffin, the second young master of the powerful Griffin Corporation, and Daphne Ream, the eldest daughter of the Ream family, are victims of a sinister plot by Daphne’s stepmother. Drugged and manipulated, they unintentionally conceive twins—a boy and a girl. Cyrus’s ruthless grandmother forcibly takes the baby girl, leaving the boy with Daphne, who has no choice but to flee abroad.

data.title: Baby Deal: Bound to Mr. Infertile
data.intro: Ian Gray, struggling with infertility, is pushed into a contract marriage by his mother with Mia Shaw, whose exceptionally fertile physiology could be the cure. Believing—mistakenly—that Mia once bullied him in school, Ian mistreats her at work. But when he realizes his error, he must fight to win her heart.

data.title: The Little Mystic Who Saved the Day
data.intro: Lily May, a junior mystic born with otherworldly powers, embarks on a journey beyond the mountains to find her family and extend her life. Along the way, she crosses paths with Otto Ford, an old man on the brink of despair, ready to end his life after his greedy family strips him of his fortune. Once the wealthiest man in Coast City, Otto fell into ruin after hastily marrying his housekeeper, Jane Gill, following the death of his wife, Vera Rose, twenty years ago.

data.title: Hidden Thrones: Rising From the Shadows
data.intro: The chief of Tywood Group, Sam Hunt, hides in Soburg for seven years because he's being targeted by assassins. After being rejected by the fifth major family, he meets Sarah Hoover. Together, they seek out the mastermind behind the assassination attempts and realign the power of Tywood Group with those who deserve it, ultimately rising as leaders in Chansea.

data.title: Taking the Crown My Way
data.intro: In university, Lily Trent's brilliance in jewelry design shines—her solo exhibition earns the admiration of world-renowned designer Max Edward. Meanwhile, the Trent family drowns in regret as the truth unravels: her eldest brother discovers the storeroom she endures for three years, her second brother finds the medical books she studies to please him, and her parents break down as Gemma Trent's crimes surface.

data.title: Where Love Was the First Lie
data.intro: Gabrielle Elwood's world shatters on her wedding night when her husband, Lucien Hewitt, murders her family before her eyes. Trauma wipes her memory, giving Lucien the perfect cover. He poses as her savior and hides her as his maid, making her serve the man who destroyed her life. But when his obsessive admirer targets Gabrielle, jealousy ignites a chain of torment—and the buried truth begins to claw its way back.

data.title: Heir of the Hidden Flame
data.intro: Dylan Palmer, Emperor of Corria, has a unique constitution that forbids him from growing close to women. During a visit, Emma Weber—hoping to bear his child and become empress—drugs him, unintentionally involving Nina Greer in her scheme. Nina ends up spending the night with Dylan, but he dismisses the encounter as a mere dream—until six years later, when he meets a child bearing the unique royal birthmark.

data.title: Erase Me, Embrace Me
data.intro: Claire Sutton, a dedicated flight surgeon, finds herself unexpectedly pregnant after spending a night with pilot Calvin Gibb. Thrust into a rushed, unplanned marriage, the two endure heartbreak, divorce, and even memory loss—only to rediscover each other and write a tender, second-chance love story.

data.title: Velvet Vendetta: Her Rise, Their Ruin
data.intro: Reborn on the day she returns to the marquis' household, Freya Scott kills Rachel Tucker—the woman who once tried to murder her—accidentally saving the poisoned Crown Prince, Chris Foster. To conceal his health condition from the public, Chris follows Freya to Juset, where she works to purge the poison from his body and prevent the tragic fate she once endured.

data.title: My Word Is Law, My Love Is Final
data.intro: On her wedding night, Bella Reed finds herself with another man instead of her husband. Humiliated by her mother-in-law, neglected by her husband, and mocked by his mistress, she is ultimately cast out of the family home. Only later does fate lead her back to that same stranger—now revealed to be Aeryn's richest man. To her surprise, he becomes the one who cherishes her, stands by her side, and is willing to give her the world just to see her smile.

data.title: Our Journey Back to Love
data.intro: Despite being a billionaire CEO, Joe Grant grapples with erectile dysfunction until an encounter with a mysterious woman rekindles his virility, unbeknownst to him that she is his ex-wife. When they divorced five years ago, his ex-wife discovered that she was pregnant. However, the CEO had already brought his scheming lover home. Hence, the woman had no choice but to raise the child alone.

data.title: When Love Stumbled In
data.intro: As a token of gratitude, Amelia Bell offers herself to Joshua Ford, only to be rejected. Despite this, she marries him after a one-night stand arranged by his grandfather.

data.title: She Wore His Favor Like a Crown
data.intro: On his way to the border, Crown Prince Cyrus York rescues Cara Loeb and takes her in—along with her cousin and friend—as servants. He gives her a jade pendant and a letter as tokens. Mistaking his kindness for affection, Cara boldly claims to be the crown princess, stirring chaos within the manor and unknowingly setting the stage for her downfall as Cyrus makes his return.

data.title: Unexpectedly Married to a Billionaire
data.intro: The blind date Grandma introduced Arielle Talbot to is secretly one of the richest men in town, masquerading as a mere paper pusher making $5000 a month...

data.title: Silent Dominance: Listen, Rise, Rule
data.intro: In an accident, Theresa Webb unexpectedly escapes her miserable fate by time-traveling to the past, where she wakes up in the body of a notorious evil stepmother. Her new life comes with a paralyzed husband, two frail and impoverished stepchildren, and malicious in-laws. However, she discovers she now has an extraordinary ability to hear others' thoughts and a refined physique skilled in self-defense.

data.title: The Hired Husband
data.intro: Nate Leighton, 26 and CEO of RexCorp, had spent most of his life abroad. Back home, it was just his grandma and younger brother. His grandma kept trying to set him up with some heiress, but Nate wasn’t into it. Then there’s Celine Swift, a designer at RexCorp. Her family? A total trainwreck. Her mom and her useless younger brother, who did nothing but freeload. Celine had been hustling since she was a teenager, balancing school and work just to get by.

data.title: Echoes of the Heart
data.intro: Tracy Neil was an up-and-coming starlet who was still flying under the radar. One day, at a hotel banquet, she found herself caught up in a plot to frame her. Fortunately, she was rescued by Andy, a wealthy and influential man. As the two spent time together, sparks flew. She was a rising star, while he was a top-tier billionaire. What kind of chemistry would emerge between them? On one side, there’s family pressure; on the other, childhood friendship.

data.title: Love Starts Where You End
data.intro: In a five-year relationship, Bella Fisher realizes she's only a stand-in for Felix Smith's first love, Rose Lloyd. Torn between Felix's indecision and Rose's calculated provocations, Bella's patience finally breaks. Choosing to reclaim her own happiness, she leaves Felix behind and enters an arranged marriage—where she unexpectedly discovers true love.

data.title: Throne of Resolve
data.intro: In a brutal battle, a young woman loses her father and brothers—each married to one of three beautiful women. As grief settles over the land, Alex Larson, the sixth prince known for his perceived incapacity, boldly declares that he will take responsibility for the devastating losses. From that moment on, he proves his resolve, using his wit and cunning to battle the opposing forces. Along the way, an unexpected bond begins to grow between him and the three widows.

data.title: In Love, In Power, In Possession
data.intro: For five years, Jared Knight relentlessly pursued Emily York, only to be dismissed as a shameless suck-up. Heartbroken, he swore never to love again—until fate led him to rescue Giselle Morgan, a woman with a hidden identity as the heiress of a powerful underworld family. Just as Jared finally lets go of Emily, she suddenly starts chasing him instead.

data.title: Marry a Stranger
data.intro: When a covert operation backfires, young police intern Clare Brown finds herself inadvertently wed Ethan Clinton, a billionaire undercover. Forced to stay legally bound for six months, the mismatched duo battles external threats and their own preconceptions, discovering love may be the most unexpected twist of all.

data.title: Unexpected Knot: My Husband Is a Tycoon (DUBBED)
data.intro: Forced into marriage by her manager at the shoe store, Olivia Sullivan quickly weds a divorced father with two kids. While she expects an ordinary married life, she soon discovers that her husband is, in fact, the wealthiest man in the city!

data.title: Resurrecting Miracles: The Legend Returns
data.intro: Fabian Stewart, a renowned surgeon, loses his father and is betrayed by his student, leaving him heartbroken and hiding as an orderly in a small hospital. But when fate forces him back into the operating room for the richest man's daughter, he comes face-to-face with the traitor once more—igniting a battle between experts.

data.title: The Path of Immortal Reign
data.intro: After the Cole family—an ancient clan of warriors—is destroyed by a rival alliance over the coveted Aurum Annals, heir Sam Cole is left to wander the streets—alone and broken. He is taken in by a sorcerer from Drago Mountain, who trains him through countless trials. In time, Sam unlocks powerful skills and ascends to immortality. On the day he inherits his master’s mantle, Sam defeats a dragon threatening the mountain.

data.title: CEO’s Substitute Wife
data.intro: Framed and abandoned, Alice, the adopted daughter of the influential Dunn family, faced a relentless betrayal. Ariel, her long-lost twin, who walks in as Alice to seek vengeance. With the enigmatic Vincent by her side, Ariel navigates a treacherous path of deceit and danger. As their quest for retribution unfolds, dark secrets emerge, blurring the line between ally and enemy.

data.title: Marked by Betrayal, Made by Power
data.intro: Framed by his wife and accused of an affair with her mother, Mark Carter hits rock bottom—until a mysterious man claims him as grandson, awakening his legendary Auburn Eye and naming him heir to the Tylon Group. From then on, he rises through ruthless corporate wars and Skyfall League's deadly schemes, amassing a fortune in gemstone gambling. Now at the peak, his regretful ex-wife can only watch in despair.

data.title: Ex-husband Unmasked: A Man Like No Other
data.intro: Over the three years of their marriage, his wife's career has thrived. Then, one day, she suddenly hands him a divorce agreement. Little does she know that everything she possesses at this moment is because of him. As soon as his true identity is revealed, regret overwhelms his wife's soul. However, it's too late for her to undo the irreversible.

data.title: Crisis at 30,000 Feet: Engine on Fire, Kid in Command
data.intro: Emory Garza, the top female pilot and chief engineer, died in the line of duty—only to be reborn as a nine-year-old girl named Bella. During a perilous flight, an engine explodes, threatening everyone on board. But Bella steps up, performing a daring rescue that leaves the entire aviation world in shock. Yet behind the glory, danger still lurks. With skeptics and critics questioning her every move, can nine-year-old Bella rise again and prove that genius knows no age?

data.title: Never Too Late To Love You
data.intro: Ariel, a medical aesthetics sales rep, reunites with her college crush Evan during a clinic visit. As work forces them together, old feelings resurface, but romantic rivals and past misunderstandings stand in their way. When Ariel becomes the face of her company’s products, she rises to fame—until Evan’s fiancée, Sienna, frames her, turning public admiration into scandal. Can Ariel reclaim her love and reputation?

data.title: Kiss the Dead, Survive the Game
data.intro: I open my eyes in a twisted corridor reeking of rot and roses. Unfortunately, I've been thrown into a strange game with a 99% death rate. Worse still, my system forces me to romance inhuman beings! While others flee to survive, I recite love poems to ghosts and dance with skeletons. Fail, and I die. Succeed, and I live. When romance collides with terror, when truth and lies become indiscernible, how do I choose?

data.title: About to Die? Not When I Can Edit My Life
data.intro: Just as Finn Yale is about to become the next victim, he suddenly awakens the Background Editor System! Need a new identity? Just edit it. The king wants to kill me? Fine—I'll make myself the Crown Prince! The Hortus Sect misunderstands me? No problem—I'll become the Holy Maiden! Whatever schemes they throw at me, I have just as many identities.

data.title: Blood Feast: I Swallow Strength, I Shatter Foes
data.intro: In his past life, Mark Lowe suffered a miserable death. After being reborn, he awakens a powerful bloodline and personally slays his enemies to exact revenge. To protect his family, he continues devouring to grow stronger and fight off invaders. With his powers, he becomes humanity's last hope.

data.title: Beasts of War: One Man vs. a Hundred Horrors
data.intro: Ivan Ray transmigrates to an era where nations summon monsters to duel for the fate of their countries. Darshul struggles to keep up. Its forces falter as other nations unleash urban legends and monsters mercilessly. Ivan smiles calmly and asks, "Have you never heard of Darshul-style horror?"

data.title: Crown of the Reborn: Vengeance Awaits
data.intro: On the day of Cade Bale’s wedding, Sue Shaw takes her last breath. Her downfall started when she invited him to go to school in the same Maybach as her out of kindness. Despite Cade being the son of the Shaws’ driver, Sue lent him her card, gifted him luxuries, and even handed over the company her father had left for her. Enjoying everything given by her, Cade got in a relationship, doting on his girlfriend while treating Sue as his maid.

data.title: The Husband in the Mirror
data.intro: After a car crash leaves Coco Hahn with amnesia, a man claiming to be her husband, Ian Leed, keeps her in a suburban villa with a mute girl named Faye. Coco grows suspicious as Faye clearly fears him and tries to escape—but fails. Then Greg Thump, insisting he is her real husband, shows her a family photo. Ian counters with another, but Faye's subtle hint exposes the truth, igniting a fierce struggle between the two men.

data.title: Of Wings, Whiskers, and Thrones
data.intro: Blessed with the ability to speak with animals, Joan Wade is taken in by Prince Sean Judd as an animal tamer, helping him on his path to becoming crown prince. But after his rise to power, a bird warns her that he plans to hand her over to the crown princess as a servant. Feeling betrayed, Joan decisively leaves, embarking on a new life alongside Avery Shaw, a clever cat, and its owner, Will Gould.

data.title: Fading Facades: Love Beyond the Deal	(DUBBED)
data.intro: Qiana Cooper, born into a prestigious family, hides her identity to break free from her father's excessive indulgence. She travels to Green Land intending to marry John Collins, aspiring to lead an independent life. However, John becomes enamored with Cindy Smith, who portrays herself as an aristocrat. To ascend the social hierarchy, John divorces Qiana. Fueled by anger, Qiana enters into a marriage contract with Jack James, who happens to be in need of a partner.

data.title: My Ex Begs Me to Love Him Again
data.intro: "When Grace was a child, she was rescued by Nicholas, and from then on, she developed a deep and abiding affection for him. As she grew up, she was so determined to marry Nicholas that she cut off all ties with her family. However, Olivia constant instigation led Nicholas to be filled with misunderstandings about Grace. Olivia even orchestrated a scheme that made Grace fake her death.

data.title: Shadows of Betrayal, Light of Love
data.intro: Poisoned by her own husband and half-sister, Joanna Langford only realizes Nicholas Fletcher's feelings for her on her deathbed. Reborn and granted a second chance at life, she shocks everyone by marrying Nicholas. Though each harbors a deep secret, they brave the storm together and ultimately navigate their way back into the light.

data.title: Your Bride Is A Hunter, My Vampire Lord
data.intro: Vampire hunter Bianca's mission: pose as a vampire bride and assassinate a millennia-old vampire. To succeed, she must make Elijah fall in love to weaken his heart. However, she discovers he's not the evil creature she thought; his purity rivals humans. Unknowingly, Bianca falls for her target.

data.title: The Unconquerable Sovereign
data.intro: He was the Emperor of Constantine Hall, the man ranked first on the Global Martial Deity Ranking. Six years ago, he hid his true identity and married Meera to preserve Somerland’s prosperity. He was a delivery boy by day and a construction worker by night. The Markles mocked him for his lowly position in life, but he had a debt to pay. He silently endured the taunts because of this and for his young daughter's sake. Six years later, the world turned upside down.

data.title: The Blind Teacher: My Students are Legendary Beasts
data.intro: A blind young man teaches in a remote mountain village, unaware that his students are demons in disguise. The simple lessons he gives—basic language and morals—are regarded as supreme cultivation techniques. Three years later, inspectors arrive and witness the impossible: a turtle fishing, a bear farming, a boar cooking... all devoted to a single human teacher.

data.title: Twice Upon a Time
data.intro: Determined to protect her lover from her troubled family, Annie stages a devastating breakup with Ethan, only to find their paths intertwined years later when a surprise reunion forces them to confront their unresolved feelings and theirchild, whom she secretly bore.

data.title: From Blades to Bullets, My Vow Lives On
data.intro: Jasper Linton, top commander of the Imperial Guard, wakes up to find himself five hundred years in the future, in the body of a descendant who shares his name. While his old acquaintance has become a lonely immortal waiting for their reunion, Jasper promises to protect his three aunts from the most feared assassin guild—only to be surprised by how easily he can overpower them.

data.title: Grave of Lies: Secrets That Won't Stay Dead
data.intro: Richard Sawyer, the wealthiest man in Ravencrest, returns to repay his sister, Patricia, only to discover she has died and her coffin was ready to be buried. However, a witness reveals the shocking truth to Richard that she was murdered for catching Richard's wife, Monica Cole, in an affair with Dylan Parker. Meanwhile, strange noises begin to emerge from the buried coffin.

data.title: Kiss to Power Up: Taming an SSS-Class Monster Boss in the Apocalypse
data.intro: Apocalypse? Fret not! My manager-girlfriend is an SSS-rank monster!

data.title: Mistborn Grace II: Immortal? Been There, Done That
data.intro: Cheryl Linton once received guidance from Mia Young and rose to a reputable doctor. In her final moments, she wrote her final wish, hoping that Mia would one day visit her family as an honored guest. However, the Lintons, now the renowned family of medical experts of Riverton, show Mia no respect.

data.title: Granny Mode: Fight, Score, Survive
data.intro: 22-year-old MMA fighter, Cece Stone, is knocked out by an opponent—and wakes up in the body of a stingy, mean old woman. The system gives her a mission: win over three men who all hold grudges against the old lady. Determined to reclaim her life, Cece not only completes the task but also takes ruthless revenge on those who wronged her.

data.title: Where Love Defies Fate
data.intro: Lilith Quimby, a modern weapon designer, dreams her way into Nardor and wakes up as the weak, oppressed second daughter of General Quimby in an ancient era. Forced into a marriage with an old man for the sake of family interests, she refuses to accept such a fate. Determined to escape, she devises a plan—spend the night with Jasper Fleming, the notorious Duke of Warhaven, infamous for his debauchery, and ruin her prospects.

data.title: Forever Was a Lie (DUBBED)
data.intro: Nicole Quinn is taken in by her mother’s best friend after her family goes bankrupt, beginning a 20-year bond with Colin and Abel from the Smith family. The brothers dote on Nicole, but everything changes when the nanny’s daughter, Mandy Moore, enters the picture. Nicole becomes the target of Mandy’s schemes and humiliation, placing her in a difficult situation where the Smith brothers start distancing themselves and lose interest in her.

data.title: Once She's Mine, She Stays Mine
data.intro: Heartbroken by Caleb Grant, Aria Kane starts anew with his brother, Seth Aston—unaware that Seth has loved her in silence for years. As Seth's steady devotion melts her guarded heart, Aria finally finds the happiness she once dreamed of. Meanwhile, Caleb is left to face the wreckage of his own choices, watching the woman he lost find joy in his brother's arms.

data.title: The Legend of White Wolf
data.intro: Natalia is the daughter of Alpha,as the wolf in the prophecy, she is chased by many forces, to protect her, her father asked her to leave the pack and headed to New York so she could be safe there, two years later,the danger still existed, but her father thought it was time and he asked Natalia to come back and marry Blake Hunter, Alpha of another pack,he believed that Blake could protect Natalia after their marriage, their packs would be union.

data.title: Sovereign Above All
