data.intro: Wilson Smith leads a group to demolish a foster home, scaring the old residents away with just a yell. However, a man folding paper planes for his mute daughter remains unfazed, which enrages Wilson. After chasing them away, the man gives his wife a project worth hundreds of billions, only to receive divorce papers in return. Devastated, he finally decides to reveal his true identity.

data.title: Stop heartbreak: She's the one
data.intro: Richie and Lila were childhood sweethearts, but when they were kids, Lila was injured in a kidnapping case and lost in order to save Richie. When Richie grows up, he is forced to marry Sophia in order to find the missing Lila, but due to various misunderstandings, he fails to recognize Sophia as his childhood friend Lila. Sophia is bullied in Alex's home, including being set up by Daphne and misunderstood by Alex.

data.title: Out of the Asylum, Into Their Hell
data.intro: Once the family heiress, Tasha Blair is confined to a psychiatric hospital by her father, stepmother, and stepsister after her mother's death. For three long years, she endures torment and plots her escape—with only one goal in mind: vengeance.

data.title: Fake Married to My Baby's Daddy
data.intro: When strong-willed Caitlin receives a panicked call that her son Noah has gone missing in the hospital, she rushes to find him—only to cross paths with Jason, the independent-minded heir to a corporate empire. Noah, just six years old, tugs at Jason's hand and innocently asks, "Can you be my daddy?" Seizing the chance to escape their families' relentless pressure to marry, the two strike an unlikely deal: a fake marriage.

data.title: Lightning Marriage with a Tycoon Husband
data.intro: Professional Ginny was arranged by her grandmother to marry the man she first met, Kesten, who disappeared without a trace after the wedding. Ginny also forgot about getting married and worked hard to get into M Group. A year later, M Group President Allis Miller returned to the United States from Europe. Ginny always thought Allis looked familiar, but couldn't remember where she had seen him. At work, she chanced to discover that Miller and Kesten were the same person?

data.title: From Love to Light, From Heart to Life
data.intro: After enduring her husband's indifference and the schemes of his lover, Cheryl Fisk decisively ends the marriage and fights back through legal channels. When she crosses paths with business tycoon Lucian Holt, a relationship grounded in mutual respect and support brings new light to her life, helping her heal and embrace a brighter, happier future.

data.title: Not My Plan, 100% My Husband Material
data.intro: Photographer Celia Litt is set up on a blind date arranged by her best friend, only to accidentally spend the night with—and marry—her friend's eldest brother, Ryan Holt. As a busy CEO, Ryan hides his identity to protect their marriage, sparking a hilarious and heartwarming love story filled with white lies, misunderstandings, and growing affection.

data.title: For Her Pain, I Will Deliver Their Doom
data.intro: Dickson Kendal spends three years away from home building his fortune, leaving his mentally disabled sister, Linda Kendal, in the care of his wife, Gemma Jameson. But Gemma betrays him in the cruelest way—carrying on an affair with Brian Prowell while subjecting Linda to relentless abuse that nearly costs her life. Now, Dickson's return as a billionaire will change everything.

data.title: A Father's Wrath: Power Claims All
data.intro: Retired to be a street vendor for his son Evan Holt, former underworld kingpin Liam Holt is extorted by street thugs until his subordinate David Wood arrives for assistance. But Liam soon receives news of Evan being trapped and nearly killed in a sauna room after being cheated on by his fiancée—with the perpetrator Jason Wood. As Liam storms into his rescue, Jason pulls out a pistol, until his father David stops the showdown.

data.title: When Greed Meets No Mercy
data.intro: Xander Ziegler is forced into a nursing home by his daughter and son-in-law, only to discover it is a dead-end for the elderly, leaving him to face his final days in despair. But when fate unexpectedly gives him a second chance, he seizes the opportunity to turn the tables—casting them out and reclaiming everything he has lost.

data.title: Ultimate Dominance: All Hail to Me! (DUBBED)
data.intro: Skyler Larson, known as the Celestial Lord, shatters the barriers between realms and returns to Earth. With swift determination, he seizes control of Skyward, the prestigious academy in Southlin. Yet, his homecoming is marred by turmoil. His mother faces peril, while his wife and daughter endure torment. Driven by fury, Skyler confronts Skyward, showcasing his might by ringing the Mythic Bell before defeating Calista Lane and her brother, Felix Lane.

data.title: Her Breakthrough, His Breakdown
data.intro: Six years into her marriage, Eileen Marsh is devastated to discover that her husband, Danny Cohen, has been unfaithful. When her last shred of hope crumbles the day he fails to show up while their daughter lies gravely ill, she files for divorce. Rising from heartbreak, Eileen rebuilds her life and thrives as a world-renowned scientist, earning countless accolades. But just as she's ready to begin anew, Danny reappears—begging for a second chance.

data.title: Good Luck! Lee Soo-hee
data.intro: Abused at work and tormented by her trash husband and cruel mother-in-law, Lee Soo-hee endures a life of misery. After being diagnosed with terminal cancer, she plans to end it all—only to learn she has won the lottery. As her husband’s affair and her family’s betrayal are exposed, her life collapses. With the help of the perfect man Kim Seo-jun, she awakens her talent, rises through success, and begins her revenge—only to face an unexpected twist of fate.

data.title: 7 Days Locked With A Call Boy
data.intro: After betrayed by her ex-boyfriend, Ellie went to a bar and mistook a billionaire-Philip Wesley for a callboy. The two were hand cuffed together by mistake, so they were forced to live together for a week,and they gradually fall in love with each other.

data.title: My Billionaire Lover and Our Forgotten Love
data.intro: Charlotte, an amnesiac former ballet dancer, whose life is turned upside down when the domineering CEO Benjamin appears just as she is about to marry her boyfriend, William. Benjamin's aggressive pursuit and an inexplicable sense of familiarity disrupt Charlotte's peaceful life, triggering fragments of her lost memories.

data.title: Make Me Yours, Make Me New
data.intro: After a devastating betrayal shatters her world, Stella Ridge takes a desperate gamble and turns to business tycoon Xavier Grant to rebuild her life. Following an intense seven-day training, she's named the successor of his empire—only to find herself caught between Xavier's possessive dominance and Logan Reid's unwavering protection.

data.title: Action! Cut, Roll, and Fall for You
data.intro: Anna Grove and Josh Lark enter a sham marriage after Jack Moss's car accident, concealing their true feelings. As they work together on set, honesty begins to blend with affection. Eventually, secrets are uncovered, misunderstandings are healed, and they reach a heartfelt ending sealed by true love.

data.title: Runaway Bride: Looping Back to You
data.intro: Sara Judd, the neglected eldest daughter, is forced to marry in place of her stepsister to Jim Lowe, the feared heir of the Lowe family, rumored to be both violent and impotent. Refusing to accept her fate, she makes a daring escape on her wedding day—only to accidentally run straight into Jim’s car. Unaware that the man before her is the very groom she’s fleeing from, Sara pleads for his help to escape.

data.title: Level-Up Queen: From Nobody to Superstar
data.intro: Born with an unremarkable face, Averie Levin grows up an orphan until her grandmother takes her in. Her life changes when she gains the "Makeover System," which grants beauty as she earns fans, becoming a faceless singer. She falls for her devoted fan Josh online, but they part when she refuses to meet. Only after transforming into a breathtaking celebrity does Averie truly learn to love herself.

data.title: Forever Love, Against All Odds
data.intro: Upon learning that her severely injured boyfriend, Eugene Joyner, left his wealthy family for her, pregnant Tessa Sutton walks away—allowing him to receive treatment and have his debts settled. After Tessa is involved in a car accident, Eugene is set up to marry someone else, unaware that she survived and even gave birth to their child. When will they meet again, and will the truth finally be revealed?

data.title: Fortune in Disguise
data.intro: When Timothy Crawford endures cruel mockery at his class reunion over his son's humble career as a mechanic, he maintains his facade of mediocrity—all part of his masterful plan. As the world's wealthiest man operating from the shadows, Timothy has orchestrated the ultimate test of character: allowing his son Louis Crawford to forge his own path without the Crawford fortune. When Louis witnesses his father's humiliation, it ignites a fire within him to prove his worth.

data.title: Love's Trenches (DUBBED)
data.intro: Mia Bale, the daughter of the wealthiest family, works as an intern in her family's company. Unexpectedly, she encounters Ken Leed, the CEO of a collaborating company who is also her former boyfriend, having vanished without explanation three years ago. As Mia tries to reconcile with Ken, she faces obstacles from Lily Cork, who exacerbates misunderstandings between them.

data.title: Cloaked in Mystery
data.intro: Felix Turner gives his all to his wife, yet ends up being forced to sign a divorce agreement. However, his wife, Quinn Lloyd, is unaware that he is much more than just a live-in husband.

data.title: The Princess With a Tech Edge
data.intro: On a mission to find the Orb of Luck, special agent Cora Leed is struck by lightning, sending her back in time to an ancient era. When she awakens, she finds herself in the body of the foolish daughter of General Leed and the royal wife of the War King, Ian Shaw. Aware that her marriage is merely a ploy for the Crown Prince to humiliate Ian, and a scheme by Sue Lane to ridicule her, Cora vows to take revenge and make them pay while also repaying Ian for saving her life.

data.title: Jack of All Trades, Queen of Me
data.intro: Reborn as Nadia Joce, she's no longer a powerless ex-wife. After leaving her deceitful husband, she rises through her talents in medicine, business, and game development. With just a pulse reading, she diagnoses Jerome Eaton's ailment, earning his admiration. Together, they build careers, expose conspiracies, and navigate a thrilling story of ambition, brilliance, and mutual devotion.

data.title: The CEO's Surprise Daughter
data.intro: When Alvin Linton, CEO of Linton Corp, is severely injured, Hayley Linton saves him by donating blood. Grateful, Alvin offers to repay her—only for Hayley to call him her father in public. This sparks a journey to rescue her mother, Nina Sawyer, from an asylum. Though Alvin succeeds, Nina breaks down upon learning his true identity, accusing him of wasting eight years of their lives. Determined to make amends, Alvin helps Nina reclaim her family legacy from Alex Sawyer.

data.title: No Surrender, Only Desire
data.intro: For a decade, Elyse Mellor endured life as Zion Kayser's kept woman—concealing the love she dared never reveal. When she finally walks away, she leaves him unaware of the truth. Six years later, Zion's world shatters when he meets a child who looks exactly like him... and he believes Elyse has given birth to another man's child.

data.title: In His Obsession, She Belongs
data.intro: Fiona Joel has been engaged to her fiancé for four years. During that time, he has slept with dozens of women. Although Fiona pretends to be hurt by his infidelities, she secretly feels relieved, knowing she will marry into a wealthy family without having to fulfill the role of a devoted spouse to a man she doesn't even like. To even the score, she spends a night of passion with a stranger while waiting for the elevator, and the mysterious man accepts.

data.title: A Woman Scorned（DUBBED)
data.intro: Carynn Hughes was always the black sheep of her family. Her father did not like her, her stepmother was cruel, and her stepsister seduced her fiancee, Archiebald Murray. After a chance encounter with the powerful Jayden Lewis and his ill grandfather on the same day, she was given the opportunity to start a new life. Although her parents blamed her for Archiebald’s affair with her stepsister, Carynn manages to turn them into the town’s laughingstock during their engagement.

data.title: The Love I Hoped For Isn't Ours
data.intro: On the day Corey Meade's father undergoes heart surgery, his fiancée, Amber Neuman, hosts a welcome dinner for her close friend Eric Auden—and even admits she would reunite with him if she weren't engaged to Corey. Unfazed, Corey calmly proposes calling off the engagement. Expecting him to plead, Amber instead erupts in anger, only to realize too late that he no longer loves her.

data.title: Love Trap with My Dashing Knight
data.intro: The wealthy heiress Emily White marries Tim Carter, a man from humble beginnings, for love. She spares no effort in elevating him to the position of CEO, using her family's vast resources to secure his success. Yet, after ten years of marriage, Tim betrays her, secretly engaging in an affair with his secretary, Laura Green. Stripped of power, Emily is reduced to a housewife, trapped in a hollow, loveless marriage, suffering alone.

data.title: Reborn to Unravel the Deceit
data.intro: On her wedding night, Clare Calton got drunk and ended up in a room with Wade Walmer, not her groom, Karl Kinzey. A year later, after giving birth, Clare was devastated by a shocking revelation, and the entire ordeal had been Karl’s wicked scheme. She had always believed him to be kind, making his cruel betrayal a devastating blow. Anger, disappointment, and pain overwhelmed her. Just as despair threatened to consume her, Clare was mysteriously transported back in time.

data.title: Loved You, Lost You
data.intro: The moment Harold Rowe's beloved returns from abroad, his wife, Belle Wolfe, is branded a sinner—someone unworthy of his love. Consumed by anger and betrayal, Harold subjects her to relentless cruelty, dragging her through a living hell. But Belle is innocent. By the time the truth comes to light and she takes her final breath, it's too late. Harold is left drowning in the depths of regret, haunted by the pain he caused the one who never deserved it.

data.title: Rose's Thorn and Throne
data.intro: Ruth, the daughter of the richest family, is supposed to meet her family-arranged fiancé, Damien. But she arrives at the restaurant disguised as Rose, a cleaning lady, to finish the mission. It so happens that "Stephen", the security guard she crushed at first sight, is exactly Damien, who has also been hiding his identity to avoid the meeting. And a marvelous relationship unfolds between the two young people with their secret identities...

data.title: How to Snatch a Billionaire
data.intro: Tired of dull blind dates, Harley impulsively kisses a handsome stranger passing by. But he won't let go easily, sparking an unexpected romantic encounter.

data.title: Crash Landing Into Love
data.intro: After catching her unfaithful boyfriend with her stepsister, Bonnie Blair impulsively marries a stranger, only to discover he is Edward Hart, the wealthiest man in Syrena. Strangely, Bonnie, who has a rare allergy to physical contact with men, finds herself immune to Edward’s touch. Little does she know, their intertwined story began a decade ago in a car accident, and fate has inexorably linked their paths ever since.

data.title: After All Was Gone
data.intro: To support his wife Naomi Gale’s dream of becoming a musician, Joe Lynch gives up his education and entire future. When Naomi declares that Matthew Herman is her true soulmate, Joe is left with nothing but the heartbreak of a cold, one-sided divorce. Shattered, he finds strength in his mother’s dying wish, which is for him to pursue his own happiness. Letting go, Joe agrees to the separation and begins a new chapter.

data.title: Do Not Disturb Unless It's You
data.intro: On the eve of her engagement, Alexia Rowan runs from a cheating fiancé and a family eager to trade her for status—only to spend an unexpected night with Bruce Devlin, the heir of Erington. Determined to prove her own worth, she works at a seaside resort, unaware he's the new owner. As he draws closer, her walls begin to crack. By the end, she has won not just her place at the resort, but in his heart.

data.title: The Road Ends at Her Regret
data.intro: Adopted by the Jepson family, Evan Lutz marries their daughter, Carrie Jepson, and works tirelessly to grow their business. But in her eyes, he's nothing more than a useless husband. On her mother's birthday, a reckless decision leads to a tragic car accident. Carrie—an accomplished doctor—refuses to save her own parents. As they die in despair, Evan is determined to make her face the consequences of her cold betrayal.

data.title: Tears After 'I Do'
data.intro: Jesse was forced by his mother to marry Audrey and then fled abroad. After five years of success, Jesse returned to his country and accidentally met and fell in love with the designer Audrey while financing the HyperMode Designs, but he never knew that Audrey was his own wife. They developed a fondness for each other and sensed that the other might be the partner they had never met, but each time they were about to recognize each other, they found that it was not the case.

data.title: To Love a Mortal, To Defy Forever
data.intro: Luke Griffin, an immortal who has walked the earth for over two thousand years, is deceived by the Scotts' matriarch into signing a pact—one that compels him to protect the family three times. Believing his final act of saving Emma Scott will at last break the pact and grant him freedom, he discovers instead that a shattered pendant has bound their fates together once more.

data.title: Addicted to You: The CEO's Love
data.intro:
Leo, a top - tier male artist in the entertainment industry, is also the sole heir of the Martinez family in Los Angeles. Due to his complex family background, he has a wild and unrestrained personality, yet deep down, he is obsessed with uncovering the truth behind his mother's death.
Bridget, the daughter of Leo's family driver, is now the president of the entertainment company under the family's umbrella.

data.title: Missed Your Shot, Now She's Fire
data.intro: When divorce leaves Yara Snow broken and desperate, a supernatural twist changes everything. Her daughter becomes the vessel for an extraordinary spirit—the future's wealthiest woman who controls Magic Springwater. With that, Yara transforms from victim to victor as she discovers a newfound love with Joshua Walton and orchestrates the perfect revenge against her ex-husband.

data.title: The Twice-Crowned Heiress
data.intro: After twenty years, Amy discovers that the family she grew up with, the Bakers, are not her real family when their biological daughter, Bella, turns up. Harshly sent off to her supposedly destitute real family, the Lakes, Amy learns that they are not poor at all but are, in fact, the wealthiest! Overjoyed at being reunited with their long-lost daughter, Amy’s parents and five brothers lavish her with everything her heart desires.

data.title: His Obsession, Dangerously Sweet
data.intro: Winona Stewart, an heiress craving excitement, adopts a new identity and secretly marries her longtime nemesis, Micah Lane. By day, she's the perfect wife. By night? Street races and underground parties. When she flirts with her clueless husband at a club, sparks fly. Now he's falling hard—for the woman he doesn't realize is already his wife.

data.title: Drifting Toward You
data.intro: Having lost her parents at a young age, Mia Walker sells paintings for money to earn a living, only to stumble into the house of the wealthiest family and meet Hugo Young. After a night of passion, Mia flees only to find out about her pregnancy a month later, while Hugo is somewhere out there desperately searching for her.

data.title: From Flab to Fab: Her Miraculous Transformation
data.intro: Kenneth Hart discovers that the girl he is engaged to marry, Nicole Bishop, is overweight. She faces ridicule and is cruelly compared to a pig. Kenneth feels ashamed, but Nicole takes a stand for herself. Despite the humiliation, she allows the emcee to continue hosting the ceremony. During the vows, Kenneth reluctantly agrees out of obligation to his family. However, over time, he grows to resent Nicole and begins mistreating her.

data.title: The Telepathic Bride
data.intro: Evelyn Park grows up in an orphanage under the name "Eve," alongside her friend Jas. Her life takes a dramatic turn when her stepmother arranges for her to marry Jasper Perry, a wealthy but rumored to be ugly and old man, in exchange for 50 million dollars. As the wedding approaches, Evelyn discovers that Jasper is responsible for her mother’s death and plans to assassinate him during the ceremony. To her astonishment, she realizes she has the ability to read minds.

data.title: His Tempestuous Return
data.intro: The moment Noah Pike heals the ailing Ellen Eldon with half the Unity Pendant, a century-old secret is brought to light. Seeing through the Eldons' greed for wealth and power, he reveals that Ellen was long poisoned and exposes the culprit, then takes Ellen's granddaughter Clara Eldon with him on his new journey.

data.title: Reset for Revenge
data.intro: Due to poor management, Dylan Reed’s company is on the brink of collapse, accumulating a debt of twenty million dollars. However, luck is on Dylan’s side when he wins the lottery, earning one hundred million dollars. To avoid splitting the fortune with his wife and paying off his debts, he fakes his death and goes into hiding. Meanwhile, his wife, Claire Foster, is determined to reclaim everything she unknowingly lost in her past life.

data.title: Love Was the Cruelest Excuse
data.intro: Mona Cole suffers humiliation to save the "ill" Joe Bale, only to discover it was all a cruel test disguised as love. Shattered, she finds unexpected support from his older brother, Ian Bale. When Joe's deceit leads to her grandmother's death, Mona vows revenge. With Ian's help, she rises from the ashes, returning to expose Joe's betrayal. In the end, she finds her true family—and a lasting love with Ian.

data.title: The Sweetest Payback
data.intro: Zoe Yale, the rightful daughter of the Yales, is forced into marriage with Jim Shaw—a man she barely knows—simply because her parents want to secure a future for their adopted daughter. Betrayed and cast aside, Zoe severs ties with her family and agrees to Jim's proposal for a contract marriage. What she expects to be a cold, transactional union takes an unexpected turn when Jim showers her with genuine tenderness.

data.title: The Holy Joy King
data.intro: An evil scheme brought tragedy upon all eighteen members of the Hoffman family ten years ago. Noah Hoffman had fallen off a cliff then, before being rescued by a grandmaster who taught him all that he knew. He yields the courage to enter the North army, starting from the lowest of ranks and eventually rising up to become a legendaryconqueror of the battlefield named the Holy Joy King! Ten years later, he returns to the city under a new alias Liam Holland, out for payback in w

data.title: Life Switched: Fate in Her Hands
data.intro: In her past life, Cara Lane is forced to marry the playboy Isaac Rowe, while Katy Lane weds the brilliant doctor Steve Tobin—only to lose him in a tragic accident. Consumed by jealousy, Katy attempts to murder Cara but ends up losing her own life. Upon rebirth, she sets her sights on Isaac, unaware that Cara has already rewritten Steve's destiny. Thus begins a ruthless game of love, identity, and revenge.

data.title: Silent Love, Hidden Truths
data.intro: A mute mother had swapped her daughter with the heiress of a wealthy tycoon. Eighteen years later, after being robbed of a life of luxury, the true heiress was then pressured by her biological mother, Mrs. Smith, to donate a kidney. On the day of the surgery, as Mrs. Smith anxiously waited outside the operating room, she finally discovered the truth. However, it was too late to undo the damage. What will happen next? How will Mrs. Smith find her biological daughter?

data.title: Blessed with Twins: Mysterious Daddy Spoils Big Time
data.intro: Cute kids helped their genius doctor mom with her job, and a cool, domineering president showed up to beg for a place to stay.

data.title: The Reborn Heiress Strikes Back
data.intro: As Jennie Baker is delivering her baby, Wendy York sets the place on fire, hoping to burn Harold Bill, her plotting husband, and Jennie to death as revenge on Harold. Fortunately, Jim Baker arrives just in time with his men to save them. However, amidst the chaos, a falling beam hits Jim on the head while he is escaping with his granddaughter in his arms. The last thing he sees before everything goes black is the birthmark on the baby’s neck.

data.title: Unexpected Bliss: Marrying Into Fortune
data.intro: Chandler's newlywed wife Celeste stunned him when she spat milk all over him. To his surprise, she only responded by laughing maniacally and gesturing wildly while calling him a meanie after he ordered her to clean up! It turned out that she was born into a wealthy family. However, she became mentally impaired after suffering a high fever in her childhood. This made her into a bumbling fool who laughed madly all the time.

data.title: The Unconquerable
data.intro: Having endured three years of imprisonment and humiliation, Max Yates emerges as the ruler whom no one can defy. With an invincible demeanor, he proudly laughs in the face of the world.

data.title: Masked Vengeance: In My Sister's Name
data.intro: Leah Ernst, an orphan, has a twin sister named Lenny Ernst, who suffers from a heart disease. When presented with the opportunity to be adopted by a wealthy family, Leah sacrifices it for Lenny, setting their lives on divergent paths. Years later, Lenny, now the heiress of Scott Group, dedicates herself to finding her sister. Meanwhile, Leah endures constant torture and deceit from her husband and his family, culminating in a fall from a high building.

data.title: Office Secrets: Love Undercover
data.intro: Sam Judd, a wealthy and shrewd investor, is married to Nina Wade, a fiery designer with a love for money. Once bitter rivals in their school days, their marriage does little to quell their competitive spirit, as they bring their relentless battles into the workplace—neither willing to back down.

data.title: The Late-Blooming Romance
data.intro: "I can't believe I married a man I've known for less than an hour!" Jane Austen muses as she exits City Hall, the marriage certificate in hand.Her new husband, Hugo West, suggests they establish rules and agreements for their married life, acknowledging their connection lacks true love and affection.

data.title: Baited by Betrayal
data.intro: Having just arrived in the city, Bella Hill takes a job as a housekeeper for Daniel Leigh, unaware that her employment is part of a scheme orchestrated by his estranged wife, Faye Smith. Faye, unhappy in her marriage, deliberately selects Bella to provoke mistakes during Daniel's daily interactions, manipulating her into believing that sacrifices are necessary to establish a stable life in the city.

data.title: The Unveiled Heiress: Return of the Queen
data.intro: Jane Reed, the daughter of a wealthy family, hid her identity and married Terry Horton, CEO of Horton Corp. She became Amber Carter's blood donor and was constantly humiliated. Heartbroken, Jane divorced Terry and returned to her wealthy family. When Terry found out the truth, he began a difficult journey to win her back.

data.title: She Who Claims the Throne
data.intro: Claudia Faber, the daughter of The God Father of Zayle, is saved by a poor man named Sean Holt after she is betrayed by one of her own and severely injured. As a token of gratitude, she keeps her true identity hidden and marries him, giving birth to their child, Nora Holt, and working hard to support the family while assisting Sean with his career using her power as the ruler of Cyrus Hall.

data.title: All Hail the Princess
data.intro: Upon traveling through time, a genius named Victoria Griffin finds herself as the Princess Royal of Valdoria, a figure known for being ridiculed by the nation. As she looks around, she realizes she is in her room, having just humiliated the Primus. At that moment, the prince, who seeks to consolidate the High Court’s power for himself, rushes in with the emperor to accuse her of bringing bad luck to the country.

data.title: Sleep With Sister's Fiance
data.intro:
To earn money for her mother's treatment, Celestine pretends to be her twin sister, Leina, and sleeps with her boyfriend, Arnold. At first
sight, she falls in love.After their one-night stand, Celestine runs into Arnold. She tries to hide but he chases her, believing she's more like the girl he slept with than the real Leina. He decides to investigate, only to be told by her father that she is defiant promiscuous woman.

data.title: My Guy Friend is a Chaebol
data.intro: A woman discovers her boyfriend's affair and is forced to take on his enormous debt. She turns to her old friend for help, who unexpectedly reveals himself as the heir to a major conglomerate. As they work together, a secret romance unfolds between them.

data.title: Marry, Multiply, Max Out
data.intro: At 80, Brock Yale unexpectedly binds with the Lineage System after six decades trapped in the cultivation world. The rules are simple: each child born to his spouses grants him bonus years and stacking bloodline buffs. Building his harem across the realm, Brock farms lifespan extensions while power-leveling the Yale family from zero to legendary status.

data.title: By Right and Heart, She Belongs to Me
data.intro: To save her mother, Cora Bolton takes a job at Velvet Parlor—until she's forced to spend a night with Prince Regent Jasper Page. Now pregnant with twins, she endures her family's scorn and Jasper's misunderstandings. Only when the truth comes to light does he step in to protect her—but her father's schemes keep her in constant peril. With danger closing in from every side, can Cora and Jasper defy the odds to claim their happily ever after?

data.title: Together We Stand, Together We Love
data.intro: After giving birth, Jane Kirk leaves Chad Lynd, unable to endure his mother's false accusations. Harassed by the Lynds, she meets disabled veteran Noah Zell, who supports her. Together, they navigate challenges—Jane establishing a clothing factory while Noah rebuilds his own strength. From scorned wife to self-made woman, Jane rises alongside Noah, forging a future of resilience, independence, and shared triumph.

data.title: Rising Beyond the Tempest
data.intro: After an accident miraculously restores Irene Gray's vision, she eagerly prepares to share the good news with her husband, only to catch him in the act with their nanny. Shocked and heartbroken, Irene conceals her newfound sight and silently plots her revenge against her unfaithful husband and deceitful nanny. Playing the part of the blind wife, she skillfully manipulates them, exposing their betrayal and causing them to turn against each other.

data.title: Legacy Rewritten: She Turns the Tide
data.intro: Reborn as a nine-year-old heir of her own bloodline, Iris Logan is dismayed by the family's descendant. Armed with the wisdom of her past life, she leverages the resources she left behind for her descendants to restore the family, guiding them back to their former glory.

data.title: Beyond Medicine: The Healer in Rags
data.intro: Andy Quinn is a legend—the founder of Overlord Corp and the revered "Sage of Medicine." Yet, he roams the streets as a beggar, helping those in need. In Xanor, billionaire Max Gray offers a fortune to anyone who can cure his ailing daughter, Tina, but no doctor succeeds. One day, his second daughter, Sophie, donates to Andy, who offers to grant her a wish. She brings him home, and to everyone’s shock, he cures Tina with ease.

data.title: From Plus-Size to Power: I Put My Son on the Throne
data.intro: Sara Lowe awakens in Lorva, scorned for her plus-sized body and fated to die alongside her son. Refusing to accept her destiny, she transforms herself, outwits the cunning Julia Lopez, and rescues the royals from ruin. As she wins the nation's heart and secures her son's path to the throne, she faces one final challenge: rejecting the emperor's declaration of love.

data.title: Death in My Sight, Fortune in My Hands
data.intro: After being knocked over by Wendy Flint, CEO of Flint Corp, deliveryman Caleb Sack gains the uncanny ability to see everyone's remaining lifespan. Foreseeing Wendy's imminent death, he saves her just in time. Using his newfound insight in treasure appraisal and stone gambling, Caleb amasses a fortune and ascends to unprecedented heights.

data.title: The Second-Chance Mother
data.intro: Yvonne Wyatt is a ruthless woman whose flawed parenting leads her family to the brink of destruction. She forces her eldest son, Norman Walter, to shoulder the burden of supporting the family alone, causing him to lose his beloved wife under the immense pressure. Her second son, Travis, a brilliant scholar, is given free rein to live recklessly after marrying the chancellor’s daughter, while her youngest son, Keith, falls under bad influence, squandering his promising future.

data.title: The Legendary Healer
data.intro: Spencer Leeds leaves his little town for the big city to work, hoping to climb out of poverty. He soon meets Donna, the daughter of the Darcies, and angers the young heir of the Slades. As Spencer is slowly revealed as the Slades' long-lost son, a story of love and revenge begins. He eventually inherits billions from his family and defeats the Slades to avenge his mother’s tragic fate.

data.title: Wrapped in Poison, Healed by Love
data.intro: After enduring a decade of daily torment as a poison tester, Anne Cole is finally found by her stepmother—only to be forced into an arranged marriage as a substitute bride for General Sam Holt. Unexpectedly, Ann turns out to be the only cure for the general’s affliction. From that moment on, she is enveloped in love and protection at Holt Manor, rising to become a matriarch no one dares to cross again.

data.title: Her Final Say: Ascending After Betrayal
data.intro: To face her ordeal, Grandmaster Lynette Zahn descends from the mountain and unexpectedly falls in love with Tommy Ward at first sight. Over the next five years, she dedicates herself to helping his family achieve success, only to be falsely suspected of harming the child they had longed for. As misunderstandings and threats mount, Lynette's heart fills with disappointment, prompting her to reclaim everything she had given and walk away.

data.title: Rise and Reign: His Vengeful Reckoning
data.intro: To repay his three sisters for taking him in, Kevin Shaw uses the power of Drakonis to help them achieve the pinnacle of success. However, their biological brother, Horace Shaw, wants to be the heir and orchestrates a betrayal. On the day of their success, they drug Kevin, stab him three times, and throw him from a tall building, creating a bloody scene witnessed by Kevin's fiancée, Gina Zimmer.

data.title: The Lies You Tried to Mute
data.intro: After losing his hearing saving Nora Jensen, Ethan Quinn falls deeply in love and builds a family with her, their child completing their home. When Ethan regains his hearing through treatment, he rushes to tell Nora—only to discover her affair. Disillusioned, he reveals his true identity as the world's wealthiest man. As expected of someone selfish, Nora regrets her betrayal, but there's no way back to the man who once loved her above all else.

data.title: Meet the Man You Called Weak
data.intro: Leonard Carter, heir to Seaville's richest family, hides his identity to protect his girlfriend, Tessa Xavier. He works as a hotel waiter and gives her a soda-can ring, only to be scorned by her family. Hurt and angry, Tessa goes abroad for five years with Frank Smith. When she returns, flaunting her engagement and humiliating Leonard, she doesn't realize he has built Tessard Pharmaceuticals—curing diseases and astonishing the world, while she can only watch in regret.

data.title: The One Who Dominates All
data.intro: On the day the five greatest warriors return, none of the six major families will be spared—such is the fury of Dexter Herrick when the love of his life lies wounded.

data.title: Vampire's Remedy
data.intro: The handsome and powerful vampire Count Victor, gravely wounded, rescues a young girl named Elena by chance—one whose blood holds remarkable properties. Upon discovering that her blood can heal him, Victor brings Elena back to his home. But unbeknownst to Victor, the source of Elena's unique blood is entangled in a massive conspiracy, and her approach to him is far from accidental—it is a calculated move for revenge.

data.title: Cross My Path, Face the Wrath
data.intro: Forged by the cruelty of her father and stepmother, Dawn Stone fights back with unmatched skill in combat and medicine. Amid her entanglement with Harry Pelton, she rescues her brother, uncovers long-buried truths, and seizes control of her destiny, rising stronger than ever.

data.title: Viral Revenge: The Architect Queen Strikes Back
data.intro: Silvia Walker uncovers a shocking betrayal through her smart speaker. Her husband, Yale Carter, is having an affair with Tanya Marsh and stealing her designs. She exposes their schemes but faces public backlash. With her best friend's help, Silvia reveals that Yale has been embezzling the company's funds and transferring the assets, eventually putting them behind bars. Later, Silvia rises and becomes the youngest judge in the history of the Pritzker Prize.

data.title: Family Love Takes Me Home（DUBBED）
data.intro: Eighteen years ago, Evelyn Lynn ordered the extraction of all of Zoe Lynn’s RH-negative blood to save her grandson, Ben Lynn's life. Abandoned in the middle of nowhere by the butler, Zoe was left to await her death. However, she was discovered by Mark Dunn, a janitor with the same blood type, who found her and gave her a new name, Grace Dunn. Fast forward to the present day, Helen Reed emerges as the new leader of Lynn Group.

data.title: Beyond Betrayal: Her New Dawn
data.intro: While concealing her identity as the world's top artist and the daughter of Jaxon's wealthiest family, Kate Snow embarks on a three-year relationship with Cedric Muhl. However, their bond shatters when Joan Larson, a manipulative woman, frames Kate to win Cedric for herself. Choosing to align with Joan for the sake of his family's future, Cedric humiliates Kate and even resorts to physical violence against her.

data.title: Fate Turned: My CEO Husband Shields Me
data.intro: Genius scientist Emma and her sister Samantha became estranged due to a hospital mix-up at birth. After Emma’s successful time machine experiment, she is retaliated against by Samantha, and the two accidentally travel back ten years. Samantha vies for Emma's identity as the Carter family's real daughter and her engagement, while Emma meets Matthew, who hides his identity as a chairman.

data.title: Daddy's Got Girls and Guns
data.intro: The mysterious secret agent Peter Rogers was awarded the National Medal of Honor by the President and had retired from the military. While dining out with his daughter Leslie, Peter was mistaken for a blind date by the beautiful CEO Sydney Greenfield, and the two unexpectedly got married. When his classmate and ex-girlfriend, who were unaware of Peter's true identity, encountered him again, they subjected him to various insults and ridicule.

data.title: The Legend in Mortal Flesh
data.intro: Silas Diaz is the strongest cultivator on Earth, burdened by a troubling condition—he loses all memories and is reborn every era. His disciple, the Empress, founds Toria and conquers countless lands, while Silas is mistaken for a mere mortal upon each rebirth. One day, Silas saves Ella Nell, the Holy Maiden, and becomes entangled in the bitter feud between Toria and Xyra.

data.title: Redeeming the Past: A Journey to 1980
data.intro: Despite being the richest man on earth, Ian Leed carries nothing but guilt in his heart ever since he caused the death of his sister's best friend, Sue Todd. Determined to atone for his sins with his own life, he unexpectedly time-travels to the year 1980, where he resolves to make amends and ensure Sue becomes the happiest woman on earth.

data.title: Of His Day and Night
data.intro: Andrologist Tessa Tilden marries Jordan Slate to save her mother—only to be ensnared in a web of family intrigue. On their wedding night, she encounters Simon Slate, discovering later that he is Jordan's alternate persona, born from a childhood trauma seventeen years ago. As Tessa unravels the kidnapping plot behind it all, she and Jordan join forces to expose his uncle Marcel Slate and restore both love and peace to the Slate family.

data.title: Timeless Love
data.intro: Chole was the ancient Queen and a time travel brought her to 2024. In this modern world, the General she loved becomes her contract husband and she accidentally got a chance to audition. Now a Hollywood movie star is about to shine.

data.title: Luckbound Heiress: Fortune at Her Fingertips
data.intro: Lucky charm Joan Scully is mistaken for the Scullys' adopted child and drained of her fortune to save the family, only to be cast out after. Reborn, she returns to the wealthy Bennett family and helps those who protect her to find success. Only when misfortune takes everything they own do the Scullys regret their actions, but forgiveness is only for the grateful.

data.title: Shackled by You, Soaring With Love
data.intro: Five years into marriage, Justin Clarke goes missing suddenly, leaving the blind Sophie Whitman in a panic as she rushes to the police—only to find out that Yvette Lawson has replaced her identity and won Justin over. After Sophie unexpectedly regains her sight, she leaves him for good and never returns, even when he collapses in regret. Rising anew, she shines before the world, and he can only watch her find happiness with someone else.

data.title: The Jade Ring of Love
data.intro: Ja-young, a woman who quit her career for 30 years, uses a magical ring inherited from her mother to take revenge on her husband and mother-in-law in this comedy fantasy.

data.title: Marry to Top Star at 40s
data.intro: The female lead divorces her husband after enduring his domestic abuse, alcoholism, and infidelity. She quits her job as a high school teacher and becomes an obscure, little-known talent manager. During this time, her ex-husband continues to tear her down, while the relentless demands of her work leave her overwhelmed and exhausted.

data.title: Masked Overlord: From Ruin to Reign
data.intro: Remington Yueh's fiancée cheated on him and even asked for a million of bride price before agreeing to marry him, along with all sorts of unreasonable and unacceptable demands. When he was tired of the whole nonsense, the heiress of Sullivan Enterprise, Ingrid Sullivan, comes to his rescue and turned the events around.

data.title: Sweetheart, I Don't Lose Twice
data.intro: In her past life, Cheryl York married the wrong man—Sean Asher—and lost everything. Given a second chance, she wakes up on the day of their engagement, only to cross paths with Conner Asher, Sean's brother. Driven by Conner's unexpected affection and the bitter history between the brothers, Cheryl joins forces with him to expose Sean's true colors—and ensure he pays for everything.

data.title: Go Ahead, Impress Me
data.intro: Troy Quinn possesses an extraordinary talent for martial arts. His father, the Supreme Lord, believes that their Dragon Force technique cannot advance beyond the second level. However, Troy has unknowingly reached the ninth level—granting him power equal to that of a Supreme Lord.

data.title: Sometimes, Calm is Deadly
data.intro: After his girlfriend Aurora Golde's tragic death, Noah Stark loses his sanity. He feigns recovery upon release from the hospital, carefully setting a web of revenge and turning Jerry Fox and Jade White against each other. When the truth comes to light, he faces justice—the cost he willingly pays for the love of his life.

data.title: Out of Prison, Out of Love
data.intro: After being taken home from the orphanage by her wealthy biological parents, Jane Leed believes she is finally going to have a happy life—until she returns home to find her parents have a pampered adopted daughter, Wren Leed. Fearing that Jane might take everything from her, Wren pushes her fiancé’s sister down the stairs and frames Jane for the act.

data.title: Happily Ever After: Spoiled by My Billionaire Husband
data.intro: Abby Yates is devastated when she discovers her sister and fiancé's affair. Driven by impulse, she hastily marries Levi Lawson, a billionaire she barely knows, and their lives plunge into a whirlwind of dramatic twists and turns. With newfound determination, Abby fights back against those who have taken advantage of her, reclaiming what rightfully belongs to her. Levi stands by her side, offering unwavering support as she faces bullying and oppression from her own family.

data.title: The One That Got Away
data.intro: After eight years by Theo Aster’s side, Esme Blume is attacked by his first love, Gina Fox, and shoved into the water in a deliberate attempt on her life. But the real betrayal comes when Theo, instead of defending her, coldly demands that she apologize to Gina. Heartbroken, Esme calls off their wedding and walks away—but Theo, blind to her pain, dismisses it as nothing more than a tantrum.

data.title: Pampered by My Ex-husband's Billionaire Friend
data.intro: After a divorce with the CEO of Paul Corp, Edith Cohen leaves with a fortune in her hands and offers a handsome pay to whoever she deems fit to father her child. Her assistant introduces her to a male model who seems perfect in every aspect—except that he is her ex-husband’s friend, the powerful and ruthless CEO, Roman Kent! Rumor has it that he rarely involves himself with women, so why did he agree to the offer? Meanwhile, her ex-husband unexpectedly proposes remarriage.

data.title: A World Within: Defying Her Fate
data.intro: Upon transmigrating into a novel, Lena Dale finds herself inhabiting the body of a minor character. This character’s husband, Nathan Morgan, is exiled with his family the day after their wedding. When the Emperor summons Nathan to the palace, Lena uses her supernatural storage space to prepare an antidote for him in advance and secretly stocks up on valuable resources from the national treasury, her family home, and Northhold Manor.

data.title: My Sweet Husband Is a Secret Tycoon
data.intro: To reclaim her mother's company, Nina Beaumont hires a male escort named Ernest to help her produce an heir. Unbeknownst to her, Ernest is Elijah Griffin, a tycoon who has lost his memories in a car accident. As time passes, Elijah, who had harbored a secret crush on Nina before the accident, gradually regains his memory. He quietly works behind the scenes to help her regain company control.

data.title: Caught Red-Lensed: Dangerous Exposure
data.intro: Julia Mason, the city's most notorious paparazzo, lives for elite scandals. On a stakeout, she catches heir Caleb Tate meeting a starlet—and brands him "impotent." The story explodes, making him a public joke for the first time. Enraged, he hunts her down to ruin her. But once her "mask" slips, vengeance turns to obsession. He thinks he's in control, unaware he's already ensnared in her web, falling deeper with every step.

data.title: When Love Ends, Power Begins
data.intro: In just three years, Sue Judd rises to success as a CEO with a net worth of three hundred million dollars, while her husband, Finn Knot, still earns a modest monthly salary of only five thousand dollars. As Will Lowe stirs up discord, Sue grows increasingly disdainful of Finn's perceived incapacity, leading her to ultimately decide on a divorce.

data.title: When Love Forgot My Name
data.intro: When Tracy Scott's family faces bankruptcy, her boyfriend, Felix Lynch, decisively sells the company he built from scratch to save her. However, after discovering that he has cancer, Felix chooses to break up with her and keep his condition a secret to protect her from heartbreak. Over the next three years, Tracy pulls through the crisis but cannot seem to get over the breakup.

data.title: Married My CEO Ex In My 40s
data.intro: Mary Larson, a hardworking housekeeper in her 40s, attends her high school reunion, where she reconnects with James Hastings, her wealthy first love who has never stopped regretting their separation. As old feelings resurface, Mary struggles with self-doubt, the weight of her past, and the secret that her son might be James's child.

data.title: Flip the Day: The Bouquet of Revenge
data.intro: In her previous life, Tasha Shelby lost her fiancé, her brother, and the priceless emerald bouquet her grandfather had crafted and left behind—all because she was too soft to stand up to Vera Snow. Reborn after a tragic and miserable death, she finds herself back on her wedding day—and this time, she will never let go of what is rightfully hers.

data.title: Chasing the Light That Is You
data.intro: Shy and soft-spoken Yelena Shaw has mapped out her entire future around one goal—following her longtime crush, Shane Smith, to college. But her dream shatters when she learns the truth: Shane, the school's golden boy, is a heartbreaker who tosses girls aside without a second thought. Just when Yelena is ready to let go—watching the campus queen pour her heart out to him—Shane stuns everyone. He turns perfection down... and walks straight toward Yelena.

data.title: Eclipsed Power: The Legend's Awakening
data.intro: Although Ian Cole has remained in the beginner stage for a century, he has built a team of elites, each reigning over their own territory. Just as he prepares for a millennial slumber, the immortals launch a devastating attack, leaving him gravely wounded and stripped of his former power, reduced to the mortal heir of the Cole family.

data.title: My Billionaire Ex Wants Me Back
data.intro: Alison Johnson has been secretly in love with Dylan Garcia for ten years. After being drugged by Kara Davis, she has a one-night stand with Dylan. Since then, Alison willingly remains by Dylan's side as his booty call. Two years later, when Kara returns, Dylan immediately abandons Alison. Alison intends to leave Dylon for good,bbefore realizing she is pregnant with Dylan's child.

data.title: Across Worlds, I Claim the Crown
data.intro: Hector Novak, a top scientist and CEO of Novak Group in 2077, is betrayed and killed by his best friend, Melvin Shaw. He awakens in the Duflana Empire as Cedric Novak, the exiled, foolish third son of the disgraced Novak family. Branded as traitors, the patriarch is executed, and Cedric is banished with his seven sisters-in-law. Feigning madness, he secretly safeguards them and captures corrupt officials with his aether technology.

data.title: Love Beyond the Veil of Time
data.intro: After an accidental time travel, Dr. Aurora Yandell finds herself in an ancient era, assuming the identity of the abandoned consort of Prince Hugh Yancey—a man with grudges against her newfound persona. Thrust into a time of the past, Aurora finds herself having to treat a patient with a severe illness while navigating the treacherous intrigues of the royal court. Wrongfully accused of a crime, she narrowly escapes imprisonment.

data.title: Once Bitten, Never Again
data.intro: It only takes one day to undo eight years of effort. Jude Holt, heir to Holt Group, spent nearly a decade pursuing Susie Grant, giving everything he had in hopes of winning her heart. But when he is betrayed by both Susie and his own brother, Wilson Holt, years of devotion are shattered. Betrayed and heartbroken, Jude is left with nothing but resentment and emptiness, ultimately facing death after being framed by them. However, fate offers him a second chance—a rebirth.

data.title: The Double Life of Mr. Yearwood
data.intro: With an alias of “Mr. Kent”, Evan Yearwood secretly helps his wife on her path to success. However, she falls in love with another Mr. Kent instead and decides to divorce Evan.

data.title: I Wish You Knew
data.intro: Rachel Summers thought her high school years would be defined by regrets, until her final year brought an unexpected twist—a rebellious bad boy, Christopher Grant, who turned her world upside down. From the strict "Four Don'ts" rules set by Christopher to him breaking them one by one himself, his relentless charm brought meaning to her youth.

data.title: The World Beckoned in My Call
data.intro: After retiring as the legendary hero Commander Asura, Jack Lang reluctantly agrees to his mother’s insistence on going on a blind date. On his way, he saves Will Olson, the wealthiest man in Calton. In gratitude, Will offers his granddaughter Cara's hand in marriage, but Cara refuses. Defiantly, she marries a stranger she meets on her own blind date—unaware that her new husband is actually Jack.

data.title: He Who Wields Time
data.intro: Tyler Quinton lives with his sister, Rhonda, and works as a food delivery man. One day, she falls seriously ill. Their aunt and cousin trick her into agreeing to sell her organs to save the rich Mr. Zander's life. Rhonda agreed to sacrifice herself so she would no longer burden Tyler, who she assumes is broke. Tyler indeed borrowed money from a loan shark to treat Rhonda's illness, but soon, a saving grace comes.

data.title: Step Aside, The Heiress Is Here
data.intro: Mia Lowe keeps her identity a secret when she marries Sean Shaw, working as a delivery woman to support herself. Meanwhile, her brother Hans Lowe invests in Sean’s company. However, Sean soon drives Mia out of his house, believing that the illegitimate daughter of the Lowes is the one aiding his career. With the help of her four brothers, Mia takes revenge on Sean, stripping him of everything and making him regret his actions.

data.title: Reign of Dark Abyss
data.intro: After Tim Yale, the Lord of Dark Abyss, serves a five-year prison sentence for his brother-in-law, he returns home to his wife in hopes to go back to how things were. However, his wife forces him to comply with a divorce because she thinks that she is way out of his league. Having his hopes torn apart, Tim decides to disclose his true identity and make his status-conscious wife regret her choices.

data.title: Resurgence: The Lord's Glorious Return
data.intro: Ben Mill, the God of War, brings an eternal end to the chaos wrought by the son of the Soutia King. Though he performs a noble deed, Amy Knot, the Guard of Valia, misunderstands his actions when she witnesses the incident. Deeming him a villain, Amy resolves to arrest him, but Ben pays her no mind and opts to return home for an arranged marriage.

data.title: Regret Served in Seven Portions
data.intro: Middle-aged Zeke Gibson's estranged wife, Eileen Xander, suddenly returns with a pair of twins—a boy and a girl. With no heirs of his own, she plans for her illegitimate children to inherit his fortune. Outraged by her betrayal, Zeke publicly releases his DNA information, tracking down his seven children conceived from his sperm donations. Eileen's world crumbles when all seven show up before her, and regret finally sets in.

data.title: The Sweetness That Kills
data.intro: Rescued by her brother from Julian Spencer's schemes to harvest her heart for Quinn Lind, Cindy Lawson plots her revenge as his seemingly dutiful secretary, secretly orchestrating his downfall. She manipulates his assistant into marriage and carefully drives a wedge between Julian and Quinn, leaving him isolated and defeated, step by ruthless step.

data.title: Thorns Beneath the Veil
data.intro: Rosalie Walker, the disowned daughter of the Marquis' family, is treated as a substitute bride for her elder sister upon her long-awaited return home. Unbeknownst to others, she has returned with vengeance burning in her heart, determined to seek justice for her mother, whose tragic and undeserved death haunts her.

data.title: Once Upon a Fateful Night
data.intro: On the eve of her engagement, Sasha Lovell escapes from her cheating boyfriend and the family that plans to trade her for money. In the process, she spends a night with Cedric Fleming, the wealthiest man in Harfush. Pregnant with Cedric's child, Sasha finds herself unable to cut ties with him. Determined to prove her self-worth through hard work at a restaurant, she refuses to rely on him—only for Cedric to acquire the restaurant and dote on her in every way possible.

data.title: Love, Lies, and Second Chances
data.intro: At her boyfriend’s granduncle’s birthday party, Joyce Levine is stunned to learn that the guest of honor is none other than Hector Sinclair, her ex-boyfriend. Two years have passed since their breakup, but Hector still seems unable to leave her behind. Relentless in his pursuit, he even flirts with her in front of her current boyfriend.

data.title: Bridezilla, Never Provoke The Billionaire Mother
data.intro: Youthful-looking Amelia arrives at her son Wilson's wedding. But over one drunken and debauched night, her new daughter-in-law, Robyn and her evil bridesmaids mistake Amelia for Wilson's mistress and torture her. Will Robyn finally find out Amelia is not a mistress, and can Amelia successfully break the couple apart before it’s too late?

data.title: Second Chance to Love You
data.intro: Phoebe Rivers was suddenly kidnapped. Edmund Sullivan gave his life trying to save her, but in the end, they both perished. Fate, however, had other plans, and Phoebe was given a second chance at life. In that new life, she swore to protect Edmund, reclaim her family's fortune, and make those who wronged them pay dearly. What Phoebe did not know was that Edmund had also been reborn after his death.

data.title: The Janitor and Her Mogul Sons
data.intro: Sophia Adams is a cleaner whose three children belong to society’s upper class. Others may view her as insignificant and target her with bullying and trouble, but her sons will teach them a lesson for bullying their mother.

data.title: No Longer Yours to Command
data.intro: Rescued from a car accident by Howard Grentham, Joseph Vellman signs a contract and promises to make Brilliaz Group the top automotive company in Draconia within three years. At the end of the contract, he stands up against Olivia Grentham's bullying and joins Visiona Group, helping the chairperson, Caroline Wexley, secure a hundred-billion-dollar deal and fending off Olivia of her revenge.

data.title: The World Stops at My Hands
data.intro: In the Cole family courtyard, Paula Lowe grips a broom and hurls her usual complaints into the air—until a stone comes out of nowhere and smacks her right in the head. At the gate stands Jane Cole, unbothered, casually sucking on a lollipop. Paula doesn't hesitate to cast blame, launching into a furious tirade—utterly clueless about the storm Jane's return is about to unleash.

data.title: Chains Can't Hide Her Crown
data.intro: Yael Shaw was always the cherished daughter of the Shaw family—until her 18th birthday, when Sue Lowe appeared, claiming to be the true heiress and accusing Yael of being merely the housekeeper’s daughter. In a single day, Sue steals everything from Yael and traps her in a fake pregnancy with a stranger. Even after five years in prison, Yael’s suffering continues.

data.title: Forever Starts Tonight
data.intro: Stella Page, a 19-year-old student at Joyner University, finds herself in an unexpected situation after a night of passion with Jerry Gray, the CEO of Gray Corp, who is believed to be unable to have children. To her surprise, she later discovers she is pregnant with sextuplets. However, due to a misunderstanding, she and Jerry lose contact, leaving him unaware of her pregnancy.

data.title: Signed, Sealed, Secretly Married
data.intro: With the help of his grandfather, Dave Quinn marries Tessa Gray, a girl he does not know much about. After marriage, Tessa works in Quinn Corp as a cleaner and makes Dave promise to keep their relationship a secret from their colleagues. However, some of her colleagues show disdain towards her, especially Dave’s childhood sweetheart, Lana Harris, who has a crush on him. Out of jealousy, Lana sets Tessa up in an attempt to get rid of her, hoping to ruin her marriage with Dave.

data.title: A New Dawn for Love
data.intro: The day Sam Hart loses his daughter in a tragic accident, his family is torn apart, leaving him with nothing but twenty-five years of remorse and self-blame. As his wife nears her breaking point from the overwhelming grief, Sam is miraculously transported back in time. Armed with vivid memories of the future, he is determined to rewrite their fate. With unwavering resolve, Sam saves his daughter’s life and shields his family from the crises that once shattered it.

data.title: Tech Clash: The Glory Reclaimed
data.intro: Alex Gray is a technician working for Sky Corp. In hopes of bringing glory to the country, he dedicates himself to developing AI software. After three years of hard work, he finally establishes SkyAI, bringing local AI technology to the pinnacle of global innovation. However, Lisa Olson betrays him and fires him, igniting a flame of vengeance in Alex’s heart. Seeking justice, he exposes her true colors at the launch event of SkyAI and reclaims everything that belongs to him.

data.title: Spoon of Destiny: A Borrowed Life
data.intro: Harry Lewis is one of the many poor students in Sommerset High, and his life is full of hardships. He’s bullied by the rich students in school, and he has to work as a delivery boy after school while also working the night shift in a convenience store. Despite this being his life, Harry still dreams of getting into North University and becoming rich. However, his pride and desire change after his only friend dies.

data.title: When the Heiress Reclaims Her Crown
data.intro: For three years, Lily Reed has been married to Sam Page as a token of gratitude, hiding her true identity as the daughter of the richest man, Joe Reid. However, on their third anniversary, she discovers his affair with Mary Reid, a gold-digger posing as a young lady of the Reid family. After being mistreated by her mother-in-law and sister-in-law, Lily is kicked out of the house, and they continue to harass her even after her divorce from Sam.

data.title: Stepping Into Power: His Turnaround
data.intro: Blake Gordon has always been mocked because of his humble origins in a shabby village. Even his fiancée's family looks down upon him. On their wedding day, they demand more money as the bride price, leading to Blake storming out of the venue in a fit of rage. On the brink of a breakdown, Blake discovers that his family is actually the wealthiest in the nation and had intended for him to work his way up from the bottom before taking over the family business.

data.title: The Inimitable Grand Duke
data.intro: He is the supreme Grand Duke, a powerful leader with the world at his command. With his return to the South Valley, he has taken up the mantle of bodyguard to the gorgeous company President. Watch as he conjures miraculous wealth while stomping through all the nobodies that dare stand in his way. There's a new sheriff in town — let's see who gets the last laugh!

data.title: Hi, Mr. Capricious（DUBBED)
data.intro: On the day of Aiden Steele's engagement to Isabella Rosewood, Emma Blake was forced into abortion by Aiden’s mother. As the mistress, she was deemed unworthy to bear children for the Steele family.

data.title: Sweet Surrender
data.intro: Throughout their three-year marriage, Joe Leed consistently neglects Amy Hale. Unable to endure it any longer, Amy finally makes the difficult decision to seek a divorce on their third anniversary. However, Joe's response is devoid of concern; instead, he views Amy's request as a ploy to extract money from him. At that moment, Amy feels an overwhelming sense of disappointment.

data.title: Grace in the Abyss
data.intro: Betrayed and mercilessly murdered, Winona Reed is reborn as the young wife of Xavier Cole—her former bodyguard, now secretly the ruler of the underworld. Cloaked in the guise of an untouchable beauty, Winona steps into the spotlight, while Xavier watches from the shadows as her silent protector. Together, they waltz through danger and deception, every step bringing her closer to her ultimate goal.

data.title: How I Became a Billionaire Heiress
data.intro:
How does a small-town girl become a billionaire heiress?
Charlotte Smith never had it easy, but when a twist of fate throws her into the ruthless world of the ultra-wealthy, she has two choices: sink or dominate. Between boardroom betrayals, power struggles, and a slow-burn romance with a man who isn’t what he seems, Charlotte must outsmart everyone who doubts her.
Scandals.  Power.  Love.
Watch as she rises from nothing to claim an empire!

data.title: The Empress and Her Time-Traveling Fiancé
data.intro: Evan Holt time-travels to the world of Sora and finds himself as the son of Duke Holt in Cloudin. Bound by a marriage pact with the Empress, he is unwilling to go through with it. To avoid the marriage, he pretends to be a useless brat for three years, all the while secretly developing powerful weapons. Eventually, the Empress, fed up with his charade, calls off the engagement.

data.title: Until You Say Yes
data.intro: Jamie Holt is deeply in love with Esme Carson and relentlessly pursues her, but his efforts only push her further away. On graduation day, she breaks down, begging him to let her go, and flees abroad to continue her studies. A decade passes, but fate isn't finished with them. When their paths cross again, Jamie is determined to leave Esme with no choice but to marry him.

data.title: The Heiress Nobody Saw Coming
data.intro: The billionaire heiress Natalie Lawson refused to accept an arranged marriage planned by her father. She resumed a false identity and married a poor man, Mark Chancer.However, after the wedding, Mark grew fickle and set his sights on an impostor, Jennifer Lawson, in hopes of climbing the social ladder. Disappointed, Natalie boldly divorced him and reclaimed her identity as a wealthy heiress.She exposed Mark’s true colors and uncovered Jennifer's scheme as a fake heiress.

data.title: Loving Him to Ruin
data.intro: Since he was young, Luke Zeller's mother, Fiona White, has been permissive, allowing him to do whatever he wants without consequences. She never punishes him, even when he sprays water on others, damages a luxury car, or breaks a million-dollar figurine belonging to a relative. As Fiona turns a blind eye, Luke's behavior worsens, until one day, he takes someone's life and is sentenced to death. Only at his execution does Fiona realize her mistakes.

data.title: Kim Is Mission Impossible
data.intro: Kimberly and Darren, never having met even once, had been married for three years. Few people knew of their marriage. One night, she accidentally entered the wrong room and had a wild night with a man she thought was a stranger. The next day, she left behind ten dollars for the man and ran away, not knowing that he was actually her husband. Upon returning to her work, Kimberly was surprised that the new CEO was the man from her wild night...

data.title: Our Fantasy of Forever
data.intro: While trying to replace her damaged marriage certificate, Nora Snow uncovers a shocking truth: her marriage to Ethan Shaw is fake, and he is actually married to her stand-in, Gina Quinn. Determined to leave, she is forced to stay until her fake ID is processed, enduring two excruciating weeks with him. By the time Ethan begins to regret losing her, Nora has already moved on with someone else.

data.title: Love, Unexpected
data.intro: It wasn’t until Ava Laud heard that her painting, which took only 3 minutes to finish, had sold for 200 million that she rushed to pinch her cheek, nearly losing her life over it. Little did she know, her poor husband, who couldn’t even take out two cents from his pocket, had just come home and was already offering her a gift.

data.title: His Highness Is Mine, And So Is the Chaos
data.intro: After an unexpected leap through time, engineering professor Chloe Jaffe awakens in the body of a persecuted woman from an ancient era. Determined to escape her cruel fate, she rescues a gravely injured child—only to be met with his cold arrogance. But months later, he reappears, no longer the helpless boy she saved, but a formidable man. Worse yet, he is none other than the infamous Prince Regent, a man feared for his ruthless reputation.

data.title: Trust No Shadow
data.intro: A misdialed call in the dead of night sparks an unexpected obsession in Leo Shaw, a wealthy and enigmatic man, for Mia Leed, a struggling college student. When his fiancée, Molly Quimby, returns to find him captivated by someone else, her jealousy twists into a dark determination to drive Mia away. Meanwhile, the charming and seemingly refined Ben Judd hides his own hidden motives.

data.title: A Burnt Past, A Blazing Future
data.intro: Reborn, Sharon Hunt returns home to reclaim her identity, only to face abuse from her stepfather, an imposter, and her biological brother. Unbeknownst to the imposter, the true leader of the Hunt family—Daphne Baird—is already on her way to support Sharon and help her reclaim her rightful place.

data.title: Twice We Meet
data.intro: Seven years after Sophie Adams was drugged and spent a night with a stranger, she crosses paths with Michael Claude at City Hall while trying to resolve her daughter's registration issue. They agree to a marriage of convenience—Michael helps her overcome workplace troubles, and she shields him from his family's disputes. After weathering countless storms together, the three of them set out on a new chapter as a united family.

data.title: Doting on Me Like It's His Job
data.intro: Years after Jenny Gray saves Luke Grant's life, he sets out to find her and repay the debt. Disguising himself as a humble intern, he conceals his identity as the powerful CEO of a major company, remembering how she once expressed a liking for someone more modest. With persistence and genuine care, he slowly wins her heart, eventually making her the woman he will love and cherish forever.

data.title: Xander's Golden Era
data.intro: After he was tragically murdered, Xander Lewis, a top entrepreneur, was sent back in time to the beginning of the millennium! Dusting himself off and getting back on his feet, he welcomes his very own golden era!

data.title: Not Your Puppet, Not Your Pawn
data.intro: Winnie Reed wakes up in the body of Wendy, a lowly maid doomed to die after endless torment from the Crown Prince's wife. Refusing to accept that fate, Winnie seduces the Crown Prince behind his wife's back—and makes sure his wife catches them in the act. When the Crown Prince's wife plots a savage punishment, he arrives just in time. Shocked to discover his wife's true viciousness, he finally sees through her pure facade. Now, Winnie has her chance to claim a new destiny.

data.title: Love in Absence (DUBBED)
data.intro: Despite being diagnosed with terminal cancer, Diana Aston faces mockery and ridicule from her own family. She suspects her husband, Mason Payne, of infidelity and feels estranged from their daughter. Diana decides to pursue a divorce, especially after realizing that Mason's family had only pretended to be kind to her during her temporary stay at Noah Bishop’s house. Although Mason hasn't been unfaithful, he prioritizes his dignity over attempts at reconciliation.

data.title: Ordinary No More: His Path to the Throne
data.intro: Justin Lind, an unambitious orphan, has opted for an ordinary life. Despite ridicule from those around him, he remains steadfast in his choice, refusing to take action. However, everything changes when his beloved wife, Roxy Young, ejects him from their home and files for divorce. In the three years since, Justin has embarked on a completely new journey.

data.title: Throne Tempest: Her Path to Power
data.intro: Freya Scott, cherished daughter of the Scott family, was engaged to the kind Michael Lind until Charles Wilde disrupted everything by coercing her family to his side and marrying her against her will. Believing Freya betrayed him, Michael teams up with the Shaw and Jensen families to expose Charles' treason. When Michael becomes king, he keeps Freya as his personal maid, subjecting her to daily mistreatment, unaware that the proof against Charles was provided by the Scotts.

data.title: Arise, O' Mighty One
data.intro: Once a revered hero, Peter Harvey, the leader of Iredale Fort, awakens in Arkzona with no memory. He finds himself living as a mentally challenged live-in son-in-law, a far cry from his past glory. Everyone bullies him except his wife, Grace Clarke, whose unwavering kindness and protection become his solace. However, Grace's captivating beauty attracts unwanted attention in Arkzona, a land rife with wickedness. No amount of kindness and tolerance offers them respite.

data.title: Towers of Greed: Fortune or Ruin
data.intro: Sheryl Property’s chairman, Sam Zayne, spares no effort in recruiting Hugo Howe, a civil engineering prodigy, to help grow his business. For years, Hugo dedicates himself to Sheryl Property, only to become a target when Sam’s children return from abroad to take over the company. Fearing Hugo’s influence just as the company is about to go public, they attempt to eliminate him. That’s when Mandy and Laura Slater from Youngers Property step in as his unexpected saviors.

data.title: He Was the Wild, She Was the Way
data.intro: Kyle Finch, a young hunter from Nasvale, grew up rugged and straightforward. All he wants is a simple life and a family of his own, but exaggerated rumors that paint him as a violent barbarian have made him unapproachable. No one dares come near him—or think of marrying him—except for Aurelia Jarvis, a time-traveller.

data.title: The Young Divine: Physician of Miracles
data.intro: Medical Saint Tristan Hall, shattered by his daughter's murder, seals his meridians and is reborn as frail child Mike Cohen. With past-life mastery and the Soulbinding Needle, Mike protects his sister, Yara Cohen, counters family feuds and his enemies' schemes, and revives his family's clinic. After exposing the dark secrets behind medicine, he rises as a new legendary healer while protecting his loved ones.

data.title: Back From the Brink: His Mighty Ascension
data.intro: After being framed by his girlfriend and best friend, Jonas Smith ends up in jail. Fortunately, he encounters Lord Dustorn, who grants him the power to seek revenge after his release from prison. Fulfilling expectations, Jonas punishes the bullies and leads a happy life with his true loved ones.

data.title: Supreme God of Army
data.intro: The useless and wretched son-in-law suddenly became powerful and truculent. Turned out, all his obedience was just a foreshadowing of revenge.

data.title: Crowned Supreme: The Absolute Returns
data.intro: Born for greatness, Steven Langley is forced to trade the battlefield for books. He takes his fiancée and her family under his wing, only to be betrayed and scorned for choosing scholarship over the battlefield, unlike the mighty Leopold Marlowe. Turning away from humiliation, he returns to war, rises to rule the land, and proves he is far more than a general—and far beyond her reach.

data.title: From Commoner to Noble: Reborn in Ancient Times
data.intro: After an accident, Juan Lawson finds himself reincarnated as a nobleman in ancient times. Opting for a humble existence, he seeks to lead a quiet life farming alongside his wife. Yet, his fate takes an unexpected turn as the king expresses a desire to visit him, the general vies to become his protector, and the prime minister wishes to retire in his village. Even princesses and beauties from distant lands vie for his attention.

data.title: Back to the 80s
data.intro: Julie Stein wakes up from her sleep, expecting just another ordinary day. However, to her surprise, she finds herself in the 80s, a totally different era from where she belongs. Not only is she a disowned daughter of a wealthy family to whom she has no blood connection, but she is also supposed to marry an old man with two children, in place of the family’s biological daughter.

data.title: Absolute Dominance: I Stand Above Heaven, Forever Supreme
data.intro: Adam Steele, a cultivator of Skyveil Sect, has been in the Refining Stage for 100,000 years. Standing beside the vivacious and spirited Ann York, he faces threats from dark sects and forces. Fighting side by side, they protect their sect in the tumultuous cultivation world. Adam keeps a low profile while achieving legendary feats that are hard to believe.

data.title: What Exactly Lies in the Dance Studio
data.intro: When 16-year-old Ayla investigates the secret behind her aunt Esme’s mysterious dance studio, she reunites with Jared—a childhood love she was made to forget. Their rekindled romance becomes entangled in a dangerous supernatural mystery as they discover Esme is guarding a secret portal… and is desperate to uncover the truth about it. This fantasy mystery forces them to unravel a legacy of betrayal, testing their love against a past that threatens to destroy them.

data.title: Cloaked in Power: His Secret Identity
data.intro: Dante Wood is no ordinary man, but he wishes to live an ordinary life as a driver. However, after meeting the love of his life, he swears to protect her against everyone who tries to lay a finger on her no matter what.

data.title: Mama Rules: Fortunes in Her Grip
data.intro: Top agent Jenna Leed is killed, only to awaken in ancient times as a mother drowning in debt and ready to sell her daughters. Faced with such misery, Jenna seizes control of her new life—defying bullies, winning back her daughters' trust, and rebuilding their broken home. Step by step, she reunites her family and forges a future of lasting wealth and happiness.

data.title: Dismissed, Underrated, Unmatched
data.intro: Derek Smith, a world-class tech genius, remains at Levy Corp out of gratitude to Kate Levy. He turns down top offers to develop the Vertexa AI system for Levy Corp at minimal pay. But when a dispute with a manager escalates, Kate sides with the manager and fires him. Backed by an investor, Derek starts his own company, which quickly overtakes Levy Corp. Kate regrets letting him go—but time cannot be rewound.

data.title: Underlying Dawn: The Rising Ruler
data.intro: There are rumors that if one can gain the favor of Lord Cloud, he will be a man of honor.
