On this ordinary day, Lars Baxter barges into the conference room of Royal Corp, intending to settle matters quickly and move on to the next delivery. At this time, a meeting about the company crisis is taking place. To everyone’s surprise, Lars suggests the best solution to the problem as if it is nothing to be worried about.

data.title: The Scheming Maid（DUBBED)
data.intro: 20 years ago, Emma Harrison, the privileged daughter of a wealthy family, enjoyed a life that many envied. However, their world crumbled due to the meddling of a private tutor, Therese Parish. Emma's father became entangled in an affair, her younger brother tragically passed away, and her mother suffered a severe breakdown, shattering their once-happy family.Emma swore to herself that she would definitely make Therese pay back for all the suffering she inflicted on her.

data.title: A Love That Shouldn't Be
data.intro: A woman falls in love with the brother of her husband's mistress, even though their love is filled with reasons they shouldn't be together.

data.title: Her Vengeful Rebirth Before the Tempests
data.intro: Louisa Ford is the neglected eldest daughter of the Ford family of Danesia who is given over to a farming family because her grandmother deems her as a sign of bad luck. Raised and doted on by her adoptive family, at the age of five, Louisa meets Paul Hale, a skilled doctor, on a mountain and becomes Paul’s disciple, learning peak medical techniques with all her effort.

data.title: Of Forever, and the Lies Beneath
data.intro: When Sylvia Levin sacrifices her right arm to save Henry Nash, she clings to his vow of love as her only solace. But hope shatters into bitter fragments when Henry reappears three days later, not with a ring, but with another woman, Gloria Reed, on his arm. Scorned and devastated, Sylvia cuts all ties, accepting the cold hand of imperial decree. Yet, fate is a cruel mistress.

data.title: Veiled Secrets: A Love Unraveled
data.intro: Sandra Steele, the illegitimate daughter of the prime minister, accidentally spends a night with the abstinent regent, Duke Joshua. She then finds out that she is pregnant with twins a month later. Facing the tragic death of her mother and the pressure from her father to become someone else's concubine, Sandra has no choice but to reveal her pregnancy, yet she is brutally beaten for it.

data.title: Legally Bound To Love
data.intro: The story follows Leilani, whose adoptive father has been framed  by her ex-boyfriend. Desperate for help, she turns to the one man she trusts the least—Diego Marlowe, a ruthless, undefeated attorney who also happens to be her enemy's future brother-in-law. What begins as a dangerous deal and a fake relationship soon spirals into a high-stakes game of power, secrets, and irresistible attraction.

data.title: The Queen's Revenge
data.intro: Once known as the legendary leader of the covert organization Ladies Bond—a woman feared and worshipped as The Queen—Nam Ji-young buries her past, choosing anonymity for the sake of her daughter's peace. But the day she discovers her only child has been abused by her husband and mother-in-law, the mask shatters. The Queen awakens. And this time, she rises not to rule the shadows—but to burn her enemies to ash.

data.title: Doomsday Whisper: I Can Talk to Everything
data.intro: At his lowest point after being dumped by his girlfriend, Finley Leigh is surprised by his sudden ability to hear the voices of all things. They tell him the apocalypse will arrive in three days. Armed with this power, Finley navigates the coming disaster with ease, thriving in a world on the brink of collapse.

data.title: No More Claim Upon My Heart
data.intro: Years into a relationship with Yannick Shane, Clara Jenner is blindsided by betrayal when she discovers he sent her to Bill Thawne just to sabotage his secret crush Ivy Stone's marriage. Realizing she was nothing more than a pawn in his scheme, Clara's disappointment turns into determination. She sets out to win Bill's heart—and make Yannick feel the sting of betrayal in return.

data.title: Love's Detour to Destiny
data.intro: Mia Cole has been married to Joe Holt for three years when she catches him in bed with Sue Cole on the day of their third wedding anniversary. After seeking a divorce, Mia reclaims her title as the founder of MY Corp and overcomes Sue, resolving the misunderstandings between herself and Joe. Having gone through thick and thin together, they finally end up as a happy couple.

data.title: The Infidelity Queen
data.intro: A protagonist who seduces the husbands of her clients and causes families to fall apart begins a dangerous love story and an intricate revenge plot.

data.title: Love's Redemption: Winning Her Heart Back
data.intro: Born into a wealthy family, Belle Smith has been showered with affection her whole life. She later marries Ezra Ford and assumes the role of a housewife. However, she finds herself despised and bullied by her mother-in-law. Each time she feels wronged, all she can do is cry alone in a corner.Meanwhile, her husband shows no concern for her, even after learning about the mistreatment she endures.

data.title: The Underdog's Triumph
data.intro: How does it feel to end up at the wrong table during a blind date? David mistakenly marries a gorgeous CEO, and from then on, his life is completely transformed!

data.title: The Immortal Guardian: She Who Walked 3,000 Years
data.intro: To suppress her death miasma and reach the mystical realm, Rhea Hale agrees to help Bill Reed survive a mortal calamity. Bill treats Rhea with the utmost respect. However, his wife, Linda Cork, and their children grow jealous of her, seeing her as a threat. When Bill falls unconscious, Linda seizes the opportunity to slander Rhea, accusing her of killing him.

data.title: Glory on the Line: The Taste of Triumph
data.intro: Born and raised in isolation, Fiona Smith carries more than just her grandfather's extraordinary culinary techniques—she harbors a burning desire to escape the mountain that has been her silent prison. When a twist of fate brings her into the orbit of Ethan Parker, the cutthroat restaurateur of River Dine, she sees an opportunity for more than just a job—she sees a chance at redemption.

data.title: The Masked Heiress
data.intro: The wealthy heiress Yasmine Lambert plans to get engaged to her lover, Jasper Lynn. However, because she has concealed her true identity from his family, she faces disdain from them, as they despise poverty and admire wealth. At their engagement banquet, Lara Lambert pretends to be the wealthy heiress, taking credit for Yasmine's accomplishments and winning the favor and approval of the entire Lynn family.

data.title: Strings of Betrayal: The Shattered Puppet
data.intro: Goddess Mona Todd fulfills a thousand-year promise by using a puppet to endure the suffering inflicted by her reincarnated lover, Noah Stork. When the puppet finally shatters, Noah begins to seek the truth—but it is already too late. Mona has met Julian Bennett, and the three are drawn into a tangled love triangle. After surviving trials of life and death, Mona releases the past and chooses to begin anew, only to discover that Julian's devotion has endured across lifetimes.

data.title: Mess with Me, Meet Your Misery
data.intro: After leaving the psychiatric hospital, Nora Dugan appears perfectly obedient. At home, however, she discovers her adoptive sister is even better at playing the part. Her eldest and second brothers dote on her more and despise Nora—but Nora only smiles, unfazed. Outwardly sweet and innocent, she is actually sharp, cunning, and far more dangerous than anyone realizes.

data.title: The Last Gambling God
data.intro: Legendary gambler Henry Smith is framed by his nemesis and fellow gambler, Lip Orville, and forced into hiding after Lip kills his brother, David. On the run and out of options, he's saved by Sophia and assumes a new identity—Carl, a janitor at an underground casino (a speakeasy officially) in Chicago. But when Lip returns, now allied with the mafia, and the infamous mob boss, Don Bazzini, Carl is dragged back into the dangerous world of gambling.

data.title: Three Strikes to My Heart
data.intro: As his assistant, Eve Wilde has been deeply in love with Hugh Grimm for years. After Hugh gets her pregnant while drunk one day, they enter into a secret marriage. However, what Eve mistakenly believes is the start of a happy romantic life is, in fact, the beginning of a nightmare—all Hugh cares about is his first crush, and he even hurts Eve and their child mercilessly if it benefits his beloved.

data.title: Tables Turned, Empire Revealed
data.intro: On Thanksgiving, Zane York puts his heart into preparing a meal for his in-laws, only to face utter humiliation. His brother-in-law ridicules him for being incompetent, while his parents-in-law unfairly discriminate against him and his daughter when it comes to Thanksgiving gifts. Worst of all, they forbid him from even sitting at the table with them.Fed up with the blatant disrespect, Zane flips the table and walks out without looking back.

data.title: She Who Rules, He Who Obeys
data.intro: Once a famed courtesan of ancient times, Nancy White transmigrates into the body of Tim Lock's wife. With Tim absent for two long years, she single-handedly holds the Lock family together under constant scorn and scrutiny—only for him to return with Sammy Blain, allowing her to boss Nancy around. Enraged, Nancy strikes back without mercy, exposing Sammy's true intentions and forcing Tim to realize two things: he can never afford to cross her, and he can never leave her.

data.title: Seeds of Love, Sunlit Days
data.intro: Village girl Tina Lynch is forced by her stepmother to spend a night with a wealthy man for the family farm. By accident, she ends up with Gabe Nelson, who proposes marriage as compensation. Disguised as a poor laborer, Gabe secretly supports Tina, who loves him for who she thinks he is. When her jealous sister causes trouble, he reveals his true identity, and together they set things right.

data.title: A Dance of Steel and Blood
data.intro: After a devastating assault on the Koch family, young Blake Koch inherits the ancient Octa Dragon Arts from his dying father, Grandmaster Jason Koch, with a final command: never fight until the arts are perfected. Taken in by the compassionate Lucinda Hudson, head of the Hudson family, Blake trains in isolation and masters the arts by the age of 18.

data.title: Paws Speak Louder Than Words
data.intro: Elena Marsh initially plans to give up her college opportunity for her boyfriend, who needs to retake a course. But she soon discovers that he treats her like a walking ATM and deliberately failed just to be with someone else. Betrayal comes to light in the most unexpected way—from a cat. Furious, Elena teams up with her landlord to teach him a lesson, before setting off on a bold new journey of her own.

data.title: Call to Arms, Call to Love
data.intro: Beth Nelson, a brilliant pharmacology graduate, saves Captain Zander Dunn on a train—unaware he's the boy she once rescued. Zander recognizes her and forces her into marriage, making her leave her fiancé, Miles Hall. Though she resents him, she slowly sees the love behind his obsession—but misunderstandings shatter her trust once more.

data.title: Maybe Love, Maybe Not
data.intro: After Dickson Tennant marries her sister, Eileen Sinden, Linda Sinden buries her love for him deep in her heart. But when Eileen falls gravely ill, she arranges for Linda and Dickson to be together, hoping her children will be left in capable hands. Yet just as Linda begins to believe she can love him openly, Dickson misreads her intentions as scheming and repays her with nothing but misery.

data.title: Sinful Triangle With Alpha's Twin Mates
data.intro: Twin sisters Azelia and Sylvia were born under the same moon in the mystical forest. Azelia, with her kind heart, saves the injured Alpha wolf king, Gavin. He falls for her at first sight, seeking to make her his Luna. Sylvia, consumed by jealousy, resorts to murdering Amelia and takes her place right before the wedding night. Unbeknownst to Sylvia, Azelia survives, vowing to reclaim her rightful place.

data.title: Born of Flames: The Reckoning Begins
data.intro: When Sean Leed was young, his father was killed by Ben Leed, together with Alex Ford and Eve Todd of the Sky Sect. Determined to avenge his father, Sean secretly trains in martial arts. During this time, his sister is forced into marriage. Just as things are about to spiral out of control, Sean rescues her and avenges his father, making Ben, Alex, and Eve pay the price.

data.title: Points for Survival, Love as a Bonus
data.intro: At just 20, Renee Turner's body finally gives out from overwork. She wakes tethered to System Luminos and thrust into a war-torn Cael Era as the "guardian" of General Gabriel Rowe. As she fights to protect his family from ruin and outsmart enemies across time, Renee must navigate a world filled with danger and shifting loyalties. Amid the chaos, something unexpected begins to grow between them.

data.title: One Step Away from Goodbye
data.intro: Five years have passed since Diana Reid married Ethan Gray, but on her birthday this year, he’s nowhere to be found. As the hours tick by and the diner they reserved for her special day closes, Diana is left alone, forgotten. Ethan, instead of celebrating with his wife, welcomes his mistress—who has just returned from abroad. The moment Diana discovers that he has brought his lover back to their home, something inside her breaks.

data.title: Case Dismissed, Love Remains
data.intro: For five years, Jim Nash waited outside the prison gates—only to learn that Sara Gould had long been freed. Now, years later, Sara returns to the country with her child, only to find every law firm's door closed to her because of her past. Though their vows lie in ruins, Jim's heart still refuses to let go. When fate brings them together again, love collides with pride, and between them rises a storm of vengeance and redemption.

data.title: Almost Forever, Almost Ours
data.intro: After being diagnosed with terminal liver cancer, Felix Craig is devastated when his wife, Ruby Lowe, decides to take their daughter, Ally Craig, abroad to live with her close friend Harry Wood—and even plans to marry him. Consumed by despair, Felix unexpectedly finds himself reborn in the past, granted a second chance at life. This time, he resolves not to sacrifice himself for his family.

data.title: One Night to Forever
data.intro: After a one-night stand with Layla Reed, Miles Zeller takes her snowflake necklace and instructs his men to treat her as his future wife. However, his subordinate mistakenly identifies Lana Reed as Layla, sparking a competition between the real Layla and the impostor for the title of Mrs. Zeller.

data.title: Fragments of Us
data.intro: On their wedding anniversary, Hugo Zahn returns home to a devastating betrayal—his wife, Wendy Judd, in the arms of another man. Shattered by her disdain for his humble life, Hugo agrees to Wendy’s demand for a divorce, while she disappears from his life. Seven years later, he’s risen to become a wealthy CEO. Fate brings Wendy back into his life, this time with her young son, Derek, by her side. But beneath the surface lies a web of secrets: Why did Wendy abruptly walk away?

data.title: Predator in Disguise
data.intro: On the surface, Shawn Lane seems like an ordinary delivery man, but in reality, he is the legendary Silver Fox. When a leak of classified information threatens the organization, Shawn’s superior urgently calls on him and his senior to uncover the traitor within their ranks in Cloude City. Answering the call of duty, Shawn infiltrates the city, keeping his true identity hidden. It is here that he meets a dejected young woman, who is meant to lead a life of luxury.

data.title: The Hidden Half of Love
data.intro: Believing Terrence Zerkle to be her savior, Wanda Waller signs a three-year marriage contract, only to endure his coldness and deceit. When she finally walks away, her true rescuer, Ramon Zerkle, comes into her life. As the truth comes to light, Ramon breaks down every barrier, wins her family's trust, and offers Wanda not just love, but the life of happiness she was once denied.

data.title: Breaking Up Was the Glow-Up
data.intro: Upon finding out about her fiancé George Adler's affair, Anna Snow works with his nemesis, Nathan Vance, to crash her own wedding. George tries to win her back, yet to no avail, and even kills his grandmother by accident in an attempt to end himself, leading to being stuck in a wheelchair for the rest of his life. With Nathan, Anna discovers his long-hidden love, and their bond deepens—but new dangers await in the dark.

data.title: Echoes From Below
data.intro: Joe Cole takes over his grandfather’s store and becomes the ninth head of the Cole family. He helps the Lones solve problems according to his grandfather’s last wish, and in the process, involves himself in a series of uncanny events.

data.title: When Our Paths Crossed Again
data.intro: At the critical moment before Max Mack falls into a deadly trap set by his enemies, Jill Wade saves him—at the cost of a severe and permanent arm injury. Five years later, they cross paths again, unaware of their past connection. But when Jill’s injury is exposed during a fight, doubt sparks in Max’s mind. Suspecting she might be the one who saved him, he orders an investigation into her past.

data.title: Sweet, Silent, and Deadly
data.intro: When Cindy Eaton's stepmother brings her back from the countryside to take her half-sister's place in marrying the sickly Elvis Loeb, Cindy runs away—and bumps into Elvis. To protect herself, she pins him with a needle and takes his jade pendant, only to find out that his grandmother was her missing mother's last visitor. And so begins a game of pretending and following orders, all for her mother's sake.

data.title: The Alpha’s Breeder
data.intro: Father and Stepmother: "In a few days, we will have all the money we need, and she will no longer be a problem for us. If Alpha Ethan buys her, our financial troubles will be over."I'm Rosalie, and I couldn't decide if this was the best or worst day of my life. I was finally escaping from my father and stepmother, but only so they could sell me to the Alpha of Drogomor.

data.title: The Beast on Her Leash
data.intro: To find evidence of Vincent's crimes—the murderer of her parents—Eliza accepts an invitation from Vincent's father to become the president of Evertech AI. Unexpectedly, the father imposes an additional condition: she must educate his youngest son, Ryder, who is as ferocious as a wild beast, into a civilized man. After agreeing, Eliza finds Ryder an extremely difficult man to handle, and the two often clash with intense tension.

data.title: Breaking Out of the Pages
data.intro: Transmigrated into a novel, Shane Klein finds himself cast as the female lead's cousin, while Evan Hudson becomes the vicious side character who constantly curries favor with the second female lead. Unbeknownst to anyone, they begin earning money to climb to the top—but just as success is within their grasp, the male lead returns. At that moment, escaping back to reality seems like the perfect solution... until they encounter the girls waiting there.

data.title: Through His Divine Sight
data.intro: Because of a burial plot, Micah Yantz goes to jail after being set up by his fiancée right before his wedding day. Upon his release, his Divine Sight awakens. He uses it to teach the arrogant man a lesson, exact revenge on his fiancée, and reach the pinnacle of his life.

data.title: Royal Pains, Meet My Prescription
data.intro: Claudia Everett, a brilliant andrologist, wakes up in an ancient palace as a consort accused of causing the emperor's illness. She gambles everything on a promise to heal him. But rising as his favored consort comes at a price: survival now means outwitting the palace's ruthless schemes.

data.title: What Broke Wasn't Just the Vow
data.intro: Alicia Blair spends years trying to be the perfect wife to Jasper Kane—only to discover their "perfect" marriage is nothing but a lie. Just as she gathers the strength to leave and files for divorce, Jasper realizes too late that he's truly fallen for her.

data.title: Never See You Again
data.intro: Born into the prestigious Green family, Judy Green sacrifices her dignity to marry Todd Payne, despite his well-known love for Tasha Jones. Enduring Todd's scorn and relentless humiliation, Judy's life ends tragically on an operating table, her value exploited for his gain. Given a second chance to rewrite her fate, she chooses herself this time—focusing on her career, forging new connections, and embracing her independence.

data.title: Puppets Of Passion
data.intro: In high school, Sunny juggled work and school while caring for her sick grandmother. Bad boy Drake teased her to get her attention, unaware she saw him as a nightmare. She agreed to date him only if he changed, secretly planning to transfer. Unbeknownst to her, Drake was her admired hero. Ten years later, now a billionaire, Drake reappears before Sunny's wedding, determined to win her heart. With love, sacrifice, and truth at stake—who will she choose?

data.title: Rescue Me With Love
data.intro: When Casey Trent, a college student, spends a night with CEO Ralph Colton, neither of them expects it to kickstart a slow-burn love story. As Ralph’s affection for her deepens, he helps pull her out of the misery caused by her family and protects her when she faces humiliation at the hands of a lecherous man during a blind date she is forced to attend. Their bond strengthens, and Casey begins to recognize his feelings for her, along with his sense of responsibility.

data.title: A Heart Set Free
data.intro: On the day Cora Irwin is set to marry Gavin Royce, her heart shatters when Gavin chooses Leila Black over her. Devastated, Cora ends their relationship and severs all ties with him. By the time Gavin realizes his mistake and regrets his decision, it is already too late.

data.title: Fate's Call: The Road to Power
data.intro: Betrayal was just the beginning. Sean Cole thought his cheating girlfriend had delivered the worst surprises of his life—until a mysterious woman showed up to annul a marriage pact he never knew existed. With no reason to refuse, he returns the contract, only to stumble upon an even bigger shock—a long-hidden inheritance from his grandfather, catapulting him into a position of power.

data.title: The World Shall Tremble Before Hades
data.intro: He is Hades, master of Hades's Hall, the organization that ruled over the world. He had the millions of people worshipping the ground he walked! When he learned that his wife was being humiliated, he marched back to his home country while burning with fury. Those who stepped on his tail must die!

data.title: Showtime, Ladies!
data.intro: Genius director Julia receives a call from the police one day after work, learning that her best friend, Emma, has died by suicide. Emma's final words reveal that her husband, the treacherous Benjamin, was the true cause of her death. Devastated but determined, Julia vows to take down Benjamin and exact revenge in the most dramatic way possible.

data.title: Under Fire, Under Your Spell
data.intro: During a mission with Sean Jett, Lydia Grant saves Wade Carver from an assassination attempt. Drawn to her courage and strength, Wade discovers love for the first time, while Lydia finds herself falling for him as well. Hunted by both the Carver family and the organization, they stand united—fearless in the face of death and determined to protect each other at all costs.

data.title: In the Wake of Betrayal
data.intro: On her way to a crucial negotiation, Ayla Young unsuspectingly accepts a drugged bottle of water from her best friend, Karen Lund. Rendered unconscious, Ayla is driven by her husband, Ryan Zell, to a treacherous mountainside, where he and Karen abandon her in a car, leaving her to be buried alive in a devastating mudslide. With no regard for her life, they scheme to take over her company, stooping as low as harming her parents to secure their goals.

data.title: Survival Guide for the Hated Stepmom
data.intro: After waking up as a notorious stepmother accused of selling her stepdaughter and squandering the money on gigolos, Jolene Culver turns the tide. She brings fortune to her family, cures ailing courtesans, and unravels a chilling mystery. In doing so, she not only clears her name but also earns royal favor—and carves out her own path in both business and love.

data.title: Revenge of the Time-Traveling Princess
data.intro: After the fall of her noble family, a princess from a past era mysteriously found herself in the present day. To her shock, her husband, a powerful CEO, was none other than the arch-enemy from her previous life. She gradually rose in the modern world as she took down scumbags and dealt with one manipulative schemer after another.

data.title: When Love Fails to Keep Its Word
data.intro: Nina Shelton has loved James Quinn for fifteen years. However, her world takes an unexpected and heart-wrenching turn when she finds herself being sent to prison by James himself. Amidst her heartache, she witnesses his affectionate relationship with another woman, seemingly forgetting the promise they made to each other in their childhood. And all of this unfolds from a misunderstanding where he mistakes the girl from fifteen years ago for that woman.

data.title: He Kissed Me Back to Life
data.intro: Isabel Gray is reborn after betrayal, her heart consumed by rage whenever she faces the man who wronged her, Oscar Gray. Driven by revenge, she finds herself unexpectedly swept into love. Caught between vengeance and passion, Isabel embraces a life without regrets—one that is sweet, triumphant, and deeply fulfilling.

data.title: Replaying the Color of Our Days
data.intro: Years after Sean Lowe rejected her in high school, Nadia Sutton unexpectedly crossed paths with him again. When he lost his parents in an earthquake, she stayed by his side through the grief. In 2008, she discovered her talent for shooting and became an athlete, while he went abroad. For ten long years, they lost touch—until he heard her old confession and set out to find her once more.

data.title: Veil of Fate and Crown
data.intro: Nella Romero, engaged to Harrison Tillman, discovers his infidelity the moment he betrays her with her sister Moana Romero at Lynnix Hall just so they can get married instead. Amid confusion and weak consciousness, Nella spends the night with Neo Tillman, the heirless emperor who happens to have left the palace in ordinary clothes.

data.title: The Lovers' Saga
data.intro:
When Carmelia Sanders stepped in for Maeve Turner at the After Hours Club, a twist of fate led her into a night with Asher Lowery. However, Maeve took credit for Carmelia's encounter with Asher.  
Asher woke up and found the pendant that Carmelia had left behind, becoming convinced that Maeve was the daughter of his savior. He deeply adored Maeve and even promised to make her his bride.

data.title: Rise of the Reborn Consort
data.intro: Elena Hale is the daughter of the Chancellor’s second wife. She has a pretty face that is almost identical to her elder sister, Tiffany Hale. When Tiffany is chosen to enter the palace, she discovers that she is infertile. To secure the wealth and power the Emperor offers, Tiffany threatens Elena with their mother’s life and demands that Elena become pregnant with the Emperor's child in her place.

data.title: Secretly Married to the CEO
data.intro: An intern accidentally walks into the wrong room and ends up having a one-night stand with a stranger. The next day, she's shocked to discover that the man is actually her boss. Even more unexpected, he proposes to marry her. Thereafter she enters into this complicated contract marriage that is filled with ambiguous entanglements. As Emily dives deeper, it's unbeknownst to her that all of this was meticulously orchestrated by Mason, the boss…

data.title: Mr. Moore's Secret Wife
data.intro: Sapphire Wyatt's family was framed and tortured by Logan Moore. Her life became even miserable when she was eventually forced to marry her tormentor. Logan’s exact words were, "Sapphire Wyatt, even in death, you would be subjected to my approval!"

data.title: 100 Days to Say Yes to Love
data.intro: After saving the gravely wounded Kevin Palmer, Julia Green enters the Palmer family through her grandfather's arrangement, agreeing to a 100-day marriage. Unaware that she is the very woman who saved him, Kevin struggles to keep his feelings in check while searching for his mysterious rescuer. As the truth gradually comes to light, the secrets behind Julia’s identity are revealed—leaving Kevin utterly stunned.

data.title: Luminary Love
data.intro: After eighteen years in the countryside, Emily Hale returns home, only to be immediately pressured by her stepmother and stepsister into marrying Leo Braun, the son of the wealthy Brauns. Little do they know, it has always been Emily’s wish to marry Leo, as he had saved her five years prior. This time, Emily returns to marry Leo, who is now blind, as a way to repay his kindness.

data.title: The Legend I Didn't Mean to Be
data.intro: After three years of training under the wise Master Sage on Mt. Solomon, Lucas Gray has unknowingly acquired extraordinary powers. Despite his newfound strength, he remains unaware of his abilities and is dismissed as a mere country bumpkin due to his humble appearance. His fiancée, Elise Wood, breaks off their arranged engagement, seeing no value in him. In a twist of fate, Lucas becomes engaged to Ivy, the heiress of the influential Kurt family.

data.title: Captain of Her Own Sky
data.intro: Summer Eaton has been in a secret relationship with Captain Matt Newman for five years. She puts her own dreams on hold, turning down the chance to become a captain just to stay by his side as his co-pilot. But when she finds out he's still tangled up with his ex, something in her breaks. Without hesitation, she walks away from the relationship.

data.title: Destined Acquaintance With a Billionaire
data.intro: Sue Hale, an entertainment reporter, faces relentless bullying from her superior, Amy Leed. Despite the adversity, Sue remains dedicated to her job to support her grandmother in a nursing home. One day, while rushing to handle a work emergency, Sue's bike collides with Ron Wade, leading to an unexpected turn of events. Ron insists on compensation for his medical bills and ends up moving into Sue's home, much to her dismay.

data.title: Dear Mr. Ex, I've Moved On
data.intro: When their son falls ill, Ivy Judd begs her husband to call the family doctor—but he refuses, choosing instead to care for his best friend's child. The result is devastating: their son dies. Crushed by grief and betrayal, Ivy's world collapses—until fate grants her a chance to rewrite the past.

data.title: Love After Rebirth: Marrying My Ex's Uncle
data.intro: Chloe Park, driven by misguided love for her ex-boyfriend Simon Gray, resorts to stealing confidential information from Gray Group. However, immediately after handing the information to him, he betrays her, along with her sister, Wendy Park. Abandoned in a fire, Chloe faces her final moments. Right then, Lucas Gray rushes in to save her, but tragically, they both perish in the ferocious blaze.

data.title: Ties That Bind	 (DUBBED)
data.intro: Myla Abner, whose real name is Bella Stone, is the daughter of a wealthy family in Valia known as the Stones. She was abandoned in a fire during a family trip in the mountains when they chose to save her brother instead of her. Surviving against the odds, Myla is later taken in by Sarah Abner, who raises her under the assumption that she has lost her memory. Fourteen years later, Myla goes to work and coincidentally has her long-lost brother, Ben Stone, as her superior.

data.title: I Rewind, I Rise, I Take Everything
data.intro: Mike Cohen wins millions, only to have his girlfriend, Megan Topp, take most of it. Reborn unexpectedly, he returns to the day he first claimed the prize. This time, he keeps every cent, severs ties with her greedy family, and falls for Zoe Grant. From exposing banking conspiracies to dazzling at the gem expo, Mike climbs the trading world and becomes the nation's richest man—with Zoe by his side.

data.title: Supremacy Unveiled: The World At His Feet
data.intro: For the past three years as a live-in son-in-law, he has endured mockery, ridicule, and being labeled a pathetic loser. However, unbeknownst to them, when he finally seizes the power he rightfully owns, everyone will bow before him.

data.title: Bridging Time: Love, Betrayal, and Revenge
data.intro: Blessed with a love that transcends time, Nina Lowe and Liam Cabell fall deeply for each other after Nina saves him from a severe injury. They build a family and welcome a wonderful son. With Nina’s support and resources, Liam rises to fame as a victorious general. However, their hopeful future takes a devastating turn—Nina is sentenced to execution by her own husband. Heartbroken by betrayal, Nina is reborn and vows to take a different path.

data.title: Love Is a Game of Moves
data.intro: Jacob Gray and Wanda Carter have secretly loved each other for 13 years, yet each believes the other has never noticed them. Their lives only truly intersect when Jacob finds himself in danger and unexpectedly ends up near Wanda's home. From that moment, he vows never to let the woman of his dreams slip away. After persistent effort, he wins her heart and makes her his wife—only for Wanda to seize the chance to register their marriage while Jacob battles amnesia.

data.title: Unveiling Ms. Lynch's Secret Identities
data.intro: After her father's passing, Yancy Lynch, a girl from the countryside, is brought to the city by the affluent Watson family, who had arranged her marriage. Mr. Watson allows her to choose from his three sons, and the selected one receives a twenty percent stake in Watson Corporation. The city is abuzz with talk, and online users claim she's not worthy.

data.title: She, the Snare
data.intro: Once a noble daughter from ancient times, Raine Carter wakes in the modern world—abandoned, framed, and left overseas. Two years later, she returns as a renowned embroidery artist, ready to reclaim her dignity. Forced into a marriage alliance, she plots revenge—but Julian Fuller, the man she meant to use, slowly melts her guarded heart. She came back for justice... not expecting to find love.

data.title: Off to Better Love
data.intro: Dreaming of lifelong happiness, Belle Judd runs away from home to be with Ethan Lane—only to be mistreated when his childhood sweetheart, Ivy Hill, returns, even being stood up at their wedding three times. Heartbroken, Belle agrees to a family-arranged marriage and leaves. But Ethan soon regrets it and risks everything to win her back.

data.title: Heir of the Hidden Flame (DUBBED)
data.intro: Dylan Palmer, Emperor of Corria, has a unique constitution that forbids him from growing close to women. During a visit, Emma Weber—hoping to bear his child and become empress—drugs him, unintentionally involving Nina Greer in her scheme. Nina ends up spending the night with Dylan, but he dismisses the encounter as a mere dream—until six years later, when he meets a child bearing the unique royal birthmark.

data.title: Dominion: The One Who Rules
data.intro: Felix Quinn is not only the ruler of the world, known as the "Dragon Lord," and the owner of Dragon Palace—a symbol of unmatched power—but also a legendary divine doctor with the most advanced medical techniques on earth. To repay Chloe Greer for her kindness years ago, he decides to return to her side and become her lifelong guardian.

data.title: Out of His Possession
data.intro: In the name of "love," Carly Morse is sent by her husband to serve as his boss Liam Scott's assistant. By day, she obeys him at work; by night, she surrenders to him in bed. Using his power as a chain, he bound her, but in countless nights she stirred his heart, and he sank ever deeper into obsession. But when Carly sees through the cage of control and false affection, she resolves to break free—and reclaim the woman she once was.

data.title: Family Love Takes Me Home
data.intro: Eighteen years ago, Evelyn Lynn ordered the extraction of all of Zoe Lynn’s RH-negative blood to save her grandson, Ben Lynn's life. Abandoned in the middle of nowhere by the butler, Zoe was left to await her death. However, she was discovered by Mark Dunn, a janitor with the same blood type, who found her and gave her a new name, Grace Dunn. Fast forward to the present day, Helen Reed emerges as the new leader of Lynn Group.

data.title: Unexpected Knot: My Husband Is a Tycoon
data.intro: Forced into marriage by her manager at the shoe store, Olivia Sullivan quickly weds a divorced father with two kids. While she expects an ordinary married life, she soon discovers that her husband is, in fact, the wealthiest man in the city!

data.title: The Time-Bending Magistrate
data.intro: Deceived by his two-timing girlfriend, Finn Leed spends his savings to make ten tons of porridge for an order that turns out to be fake. Left in financial ruin and desperate for money to treat his ailing sister, Finn finds himself—and his porridge-laden truck—mysteriously transported back to the Dyer Dynasty. In Peace County, on the brink of rebellion due to starvation and poverty, Finn is mistaken for the new magistrate.

data.title: Unfading Flame: Rising to Greatness
data.intro: Great fortune comes after a disaster. The Skye Supreme Skill awakens in Ray Vale’s body only after his Supreme Bone is forcibly taken, granting him the power to exact revenge on those who harmed him and ascend to the pinnacle of the power hierarchy.

data.title: Death Answers to Me
data.intro: Nina Bale is an immortal who controls life and death. A year ago, the head of the Ford family accidentally severed a geomantic vein, cursing his bloodline. To protect them, he traded his life for Nina's help—for just one year. Now, the Fords, tired of her presence, are ready to cast her out. But just as they do, the powerful Cork family arrives, falling to their knees. Only Nina can save their dying patriarch—and time is running out.

data.title: High School, Take Two
data.intro: In his previous life, Stan Shaw was hopelessly in love with Sarah Clarke, the most popular girl in class, but that infatuation ultimately led him to bankruptcy. On his way to borrow money, he was involved in a car accident, and when he awoke, he found himself in the year 2008—before he had confessed to Sarah. Having learned his lesson, Stan decides instead to give the bouquet to Yvonne Chase, the campus belle known as the "Ice Queen" for her cold indifference toward others.

data.title: Survive. Ascend. Conquer.
data.intro: All could wait—his own mentor included—until Noah Quinn completed his Heavenly Tribulation.

data.title: The Invincible Legend
data.intro: As the heir to Nagar Palace, Tyler Ellis stays by Kaia Clarke’s side as an ordinary man to repay the favor of saving his life in the past. He helps and supports the Clarke family, but after Kaia rises to a higher status, she seeks to divorce him. Little does she know that the husband she despises wields influence over powerful figures.

data.title: Once Betrayed, Now Unstoppable
data.intro: Upon being murdered by his family's adopted son, Jay Creed is reborn into the past with a chance to rewrite his fate. Determined to break free from their humiliation, he cuts ties with his family and carves out a path to success. As events unfold, Jay rises to prominence and ultimately exposes the true colors of his murderer. Faced with the truth, the Creeds are consumed by regret and plead for Jay to return, but this time, the decision is his.

data.title: Stepmom's Guide to Winning Big
data.intro: Medical genius Winda Sade transmigrates into the body of an idle village woman with the same name in ancient times. Rebuilding her life alongside the skilled hunter Carver Lawson and their two children, she uses her healing talents to cure the sick and amass wealth. As she supports Carver in achieving victory and defending their country, Winda's admiration deepens into love.

data.title: Wake Up and Watch Your World Burn
data.intro: Betrayed by the childhood friends whose success he built—only to have them crush his dignity for someone else—Chase Jagger dies in rage and regret. Reborn, he rewrites his fate and severs all ties. His former friends assume they still have his unconditional support, until they slowly realize the truth: Chase is no longer a man they can control, use, or deceive ever again.

data.title: Tiny Blessing: Danger Detected, Family Protected
data.intro: Reunited with her family after years of separation, Mia awakens with the ability to glimpse the future—a gift bestowed by the family's all-knowing guardian. Though she appears to be an innocent little girl, her visions foretell looming crises and hidden dangers, allowing her to protect her loved ones and rewrite the destiny of the entire family.

data.title: Love Survives the Lie (DUBBED)
data.intro: After a passionate night between Shea Lacy and Ian Jurd, Shea's sister, Gigi Lacy, impersonates her as Ian's one-night stand partner. Six years later, Shea becomes Ian's legal counsel, and over time, they fall in love. Fearing that Shea might take her place as Ian's lover, Gigi frequently attempts to sabotage their relationship. However, Ian always intervenes just in time, preventing Shea from suffering any harm or misunderstanding.

data.title: The Vampire Count's Modern Lover
data.intro: Modern girl Emily accidentally summons the 700-year-old vampire Count Alexander and finds herself bound by fate to fall in love with him within 15 days to break his power's seal. While facing the growing threat of the vampire antagonist Voss and the conspiracies of both the fashion world and the vampire realm, how will they break the ancient seal with true love within the urgent deadline?

data.title: My Plot, My Husband, My Way
data.intro: Vera Rose transmigrates into a novel as the infamous ex-wife of Howard Bach, who left her after she aborted their child while he was away in the countryside. Determined to take control of her destiny, Vera navigates the story on her own terms, rewriting fate to keep her dashing husband and forge a brand-new kind of married life.

data.title: Threads of Fate, a Hundred Times Over
data.intro: In her 100th life, witch doctor Avril Lind awakens as an heiress—and is unexpectedly saved by Diego Lowe, the young boss of the Blackguards, breaking her doomed fate. Facing threats from Havan and her family's power struggles, they fight side by side without fear. This time, Avril vows to protect him—but can she truly succeed?

data.title: How the Tables Turned
data.intro: Ever since Horace Zabel married into the Steele family as a live-in husband, he has been hardworking and devoted to his wife, Xaviera Steele. In recognition of his dedication, Xaviera steps back and entrusts him with Titan Group to help him gain experience and advance his career—only to later discover his betrayal. Behind her back, Horace has secretly started a family with his mistress, Yulissa Cohen.

data.title: Shining Again: The Dance of Revenge
data.intro: May Hood, a renowned dancer celebrated for her iconic performance, "Moon Goddess," abandons her flourishing career in the name of love. However, her world shatters when her partner betrays her for another woman, and their treachery causes her to suffer a devastating miscarriage. Heartbroken and filled with burning rage, May rises from the ashes of despair, returning to the stage to deliver a breathtaking and vengeful dance that leaves the world in awe.

data.title: Breaking the Narrative: I Own My Fate
data.intro: Upon waking, Elena realizes she's the female lead of a novel—and that she can hear people's thoughts. She quickly sees that others are only kind to her to curry favor with the male lead, Dylan Logan. Refusing to be manipulated like a puppet, she allies with the stand-in heroine and the villainess to fight back. In the end, they prove that each of them is the protagonist of her own life.

data.title: The Most Painful Kiss in the World
data.intro: The protagonist, who has the ability to absorb the wounds and illnesses of others through physical touch, regains true love and destiny after being abandoned by her unfaithful husband.

data.title: Obey Me, Mr. President's Son
data.intro:
The promiscuous playgirl, Liz (25), known for having countless lovers, unexpectedly decides to "care" for her longtime rival, Lucius (28), after learning of his bankruptcy, making him her plaything and exerting complete control over him in bed. As time passes, Liz
 finds herself increasingly drawn to the irresistible charm Lucius exudes, slowly reining in her wild ways.

data.title: Missed Me, Lost Me
data.intro: Connor Devlin, heir to the powerful Devlin Group, grew up surrounded by seven girlfriends carefully chosen by his father. But his world shatters when he discovers they were never his—they were all in love with Micah Murphy, using him as a stepping stone to secure Micah's place in the Devlin fortune. Broken by betrayal, Connor takes an unexpected turn. He marries Yara Nesbitt, defying everything planned for him.

data.title: When Law Fails, She Rises
data.intro: When her daughter is framed for murder and sentenced to death after an act of self-defense, Cora Judd commits a crime just to enter the same prison. Seven days before the execution, Cora and her daughter begin a daring escape. Facing high walls, strict patrols, a powerful abuser, and danger at every turn, they race against time. Can a mother's love defy the impossible?

data.title: Gourmet Prodigy: God-Tier Chef at Eight
data.intro: What can an eight-year-old do? Become a State Banquet Chef, of course! Shane Jepsen bonds with the Gourmet Prodigy System and whips up dishes so delicious they leave his classmates drooling. His talent spreads like wildfire, stunning the nation—and the world!

data.title: Our Love, Buried in Regret (DUBBED)
data.intro: After Cliff Meyer’s death, his mother orders Liam to father a child with Cliff’s wife, Isla. Liam’s wife, Kate, feels betrayed when told he has already slept with Isla and even her son turns against her. Heartbroken, she leaves with the Empress’s permission to divorce and guards the border, where she meets Prince Steve Lester. Realizing his mistake, Liam cuts ties with his family and begs for Kate’s forgiveness, but she rejects him.

data.title: Training the Emperor, Collecting Rewards
data.intro: After transmigrating and becoming the emperor's grandson, Ryan Garcia awakens a cultivation system. He drags his grandfather, Emperor Charles Garcia, into cultivation to earn rewards. Once Charles reaches a high cultivation stage, they storm the battlefield together, overwhelming all their enemies!

data.title: Heiress Rules: Back to Her Throne
data.intro: After spending years in an orphanage, Rose Linden is retrieved by her parents and goes undercover within the Ford family to uncover the truth behind her childhood abduction. When her identity is exposed, the initially arrogant Fords become her protectors. As Rose unravels the mystery of her past, she also finds the man who promises to love her forever.

data.title: Recrowned: The Heiress' Reckoning
data.intro: Three years ago, Colin Siega saved Lyla Jahn, the daughter of the wealthiest family. In return, she kept her identity under wraps and helped him secretly, only to find herself drowning in the sufferings inflicted by his family. She endured it all for years, but now she decides to let everyone know who she is. Packing her things, Lyla steps out the door and heads home to reclaim her title and power.

data.title: Love's Bumpy Ride to Bliss
data.intro: When Elle Hall, the biological daughter of the Fame family, returned to the Fames' residence, she unknowingly fell into a trap set by the family's adopted daughter, resulting in a night with Kai Filan. As her reputation crumbled, she was promptly cast out of the Fame family. In the midst of this turmoil, she discovered she was carrying Kai's children. Five years later, Elle, now a single mother, enters into a marriage of convenience with Kai, who is also a single father.

data.title: Blissfully His: Second Life, Perfect Love
data.intro: In her past life, Yael Mason sacrificed everything to build her husband's empire, only to be abandoned for her stepsister. Upon rebirth, she resolves not to repeat the same mistake. This time, she marries Zack Judd, a man posing as a beggar, and soon discovers he is the perfect husband—skilled in both medicine and combat, gentle at home, and merciless to his enemies. As his true identity comes to light, the couple embarks on a blissfully sweet married life that leaves everyon

data.title: Matriarch Reborn: Respect the Bloodline
data.intro: Evelyn Roff, a physicist from the nation's early founding, wakes up 70 years later to find her once eight-year-old son now a grumpy old man with two troublesome grandchildren—a clueless CEO manipulated by a scheming beauty and a lazy underachiever. Unable to tolerate such an eyesore, Evelyn, now an 18-year-old great-grandma, steps in for a fate-writing family lesson.

data.title: Prism of Betrayal
data.intro: Wren Sutton entrusts her family company and home to her fiancé, Nicholas Lynch—only to discover him unfaithful, cheating with Ruthie Quigley on their wedding day. She loses both him and her home to Ruthie, and one thing becomes crystal clear: he is a despicable hypocrite, unworthy of respect. Determined to take control of the game, Wren strikes back, ensuring they both learn exactly what crossing her costs.

data.title: Moving On Was a Lie
data.intro: Five years ago, a food safety scandal shattered Abigail Jensen's world—her father took his own life, her mother lost her sanity, and their family name was ruined. To spare her boyfriend from the fallout, she staged their breakup, breaking both their hearts. Now, when fate brings them together again, resentment turns to regret as he learns the truth and fights to win her back.

data.title: Perfect Score, Perfect Payback
data.intro: After being brought back to the wealthy Litt family, Elsa Litt endures constant disdain and bullying from her parents and three brothers—all for the sake of their beloved adopted daughter, Stacy Litt. On the eve of her SATs, Elsa is falsely accused and thrown into juvie for a hit-and-run crime actually committed by Stacy. When the SAT results are released, Elsa walks out of juvie due to lack of evidence—only to be met with her brothers' scorn and ridicule.

data.title: Embers of Lies, Sparks of Love
data.intro: When Ian Logan's betrayal becomes unbearable, Jean Anson orchestrates the perfect revenge: a ruthless counterattack followed by her own staged death. While Ian unravels, consumed by his frantic search for the woman he wronged, Jean disappears into a new life with Scott Gray—the man who has always loved her. Together, they use their medical expertise to save lives and become the unsung heroes protecting their community.

data.title: When Betrayal Steals Life
data.intro: Jack Langston is out shopping with his mother-in-law, Nora Delaney, when she is suddenly hit by a car, which puts her in critical condition and urgently needs surgery that only his wife, Emma Caldwell, can execute. Anxious and desperate, Jack rushes to find Emma, only to discover that she is shopping for home renovation designs with her male best friend, Dylan Everett.

data.title: The Stepmom General: Conquering Love & Family
data.intro: Elise Sweet, daughter of a renowned general, awakens in a new life as Simon Floyd's wife and the stepmother of their rebellious son, Eric, who would rather fight than study. Armed with her past-life wisdom, she repeatedly saves them, winning their hearts and uncovering Simon's hidden past—unaware that a cunning scheme is waiting.

data.title: Hearts That Shine, Dreams That Soar
data.intro: Felix Turner bets his friends that he can win over poor student Jocelyn Stanton in just one week. But Jocelyn, seeing through his scheme, reveals that one of his friends already tipped her off. When Felix demands the traitor's name, she calmly tells him not to ruin a friendship over a woman and walks away. Suspicion spreads among Felix and his buddies—but this is only the first small move in a much larger game orchestrated by Jocelyn.

data.title: A Legacy Forged in Love
data.intro: Leon Price, a witty and fearless young man, rises to fame through his extraordinary combat skills and unyielding determination. Championing the weak, he defeats the arrogant heir of the Ulmer family and stands resolute against the overbearing Lane relatives, embodying the true spirit of heroism. When his loved one faces danger, he steps in without hesitation, safeguarding her life and demonstrating his unwavering devotion.

data.title: If Only Life Had a Reset
data.intro: To save her comatose father, Clara Doyle is forced into a secret affair with Ronan Brown. But when she discovers she's merely a stand-in and becomes a target of Susie Evans, she walks away. Assuming a new identity, she rescues Calvin Howe and exposes the truth with his help. In the end, Ronan sacrifices his life to save her, and Clara, letting go of her past, begins a new life with Calvin.

data.title: Behind the Blueprint: Dad's Secret Identity
data.intro: Wesley York, a top engineer at Sherton, has devoted many years to the aerospace industry. However, his neglect of his family leads his son, Hubert York, to mistake him for an ordinary technician working in a car workshop. To make amends, Wesley introduces Hubert to potential partners, secures bids, and provides valuable connections and resources. Despite his efforts, others perceive his actions as mere attempts to appear useful, subjecting Hubert to even more ridicule.

data.title: The Love He Missed, The Heart He Broke
data.intro: Zeke Larson marries Sylvie Charon, seeing her only as a stand-in for his first love. He disregards her devotion, even sending her to prison after she is publicly humiliated. Crushed, Sylvie walks away and reclaims her true identity as a powerful heiress. Only then does Zeke realize she is the very girl he has spent years searching for—yet by the time the truth surfaces, her heart is already shattered beyond his reach.

data.title: The Scarlet Rose
data.intro: Three years ago, Sophie Lane uncovered a cruel truth: her adoptive parents took her in not out of love, but to shield their biological daughter, Ruby Lane, from bad luck. Fueled by jealousy over Sophie’s beauty, Ruby persuaded their father to send Sophie to an old man as a bed companion. In a desperate act of self-defense, Sophie fought back, injuring the man, which gave her family the perfect reason to lock her away in Cray Asylum—a place as nightmarish as hell itself.

data.title: Top Agent's Mission: To My Father's Rescue
data.intro: Under the organization’s arrangement, Dave Leed, a special agent, is sent to jail because of illegal fights. In the dark, he is actually taking control over Sky Corp and making it a stronger company. After five years, he is released from jail and returns home, only to find out that his father has been framed as a pervert by two influencers just for their entertainment. What surprises him the most is that they are the candidates for his secretary!

data.title: Awakening to Life's New Dawn
data.intro: There are too many regrets in his life, but things can never go back to how they were before. Even in his final moments, all Bruno Logan can do is pray for a chance to set things right. Surprisingly, his wish is granted.Opening his eyes once again, Bruno cries tears of joy. Futures trading, real estate investment, financial mergers and acquisitions, and international trading are all simple tricks up his sleeve, helping him to stand out and succeed.

data.title: Forbidden, Yet Forever Mine
data.intro: Linda Young and Miguel Baker secretly liked each other in high school, but when their parents marry, they're forced to live under the same roof as step-siblings. What starts as awkward coexistence soon turns into a tangled mix of love, resentment, and longing, pushing this forbidden bond to the edge.

data.title: Blind to Love, Lost in Regret
data.intro: Erik Barton has loved Celeste Mercer since childhood. When she loses her sight saving Adrian Greene and is cast out of her home, he cares for her. But after Celeste regains her sight and power, she marries Adrian to stop him from marrying someone else, breaking Erik's heart. Soon, she realizes too late what she has lost.

data.title: When the Immortal Walks Among Us
data.intro: A divine being walks among mortals—yet he has no idea. After wiping his own memories to ascend to the Elder Celestial, Felix Lawson, the most powerful Sage in existence, finds himself reduced to selling street food and navigating a bitter divorce. But even as a humble vendor, his godlike powers begin to resurface at the most unexpected moments.

data.title: The Stranger I Once Loved
data.intro: Tobias Yowell, the long-lost heir of the wealthy Yowell family, lives as a live-in son-in-law with the Ingrams—all for his deep love for Natalie Ingram. However, as Marcus Zabel returns from abroad, Natalie grows increasingly distant from Tobias, even refusing to donate blood to him when he is severely injured in a car accident.

data.title: Love Me, Kill Me, Crown Me
data.intro: In a single night, Sarah Jensen becomes the lone survivor of a merciless massacre that wipes out her entire family. Barely escaping with her life, she seeks refuge in the arms of her fiancé—only to be betrayed and killed the moment he takes her military token. But death isn't the end. Granted a second chance, she awakens to a twisted fate: her former fiancé is now her son—giving her the perfect opportunity to exact her revenge.

data.title: No Tears Left for You
data.intro: Sue York, heiress to the York fortune, elopes with Max Dunn, only to face mistreatment from her mother-in-law and sister-in-law, who turn her daughter, Hannah, against her. What was meant to be a celebration spirals into mockery, and Sue seeks a divorce. The Dunns destroy the pendant symbolizing her love with Max, while Hannah stands by without offering support.

data.title: Return of the Unrivaled
data.intro: Adam Green, a man of unparalleled strength who had already reached the pinnacle of his abilities, descended from the mountain only to unexpectedly become a fool after rescuing Tracy Jones. He devoted himself to her, marrying into the Jones and silently protecting them. Three years later, as the villain, Henry Taylor intended to use Adam as a sacrifice, Adam miraculously regains his brilliance and unrivaled mastery.

data.title: He Was My Weapon, Then My Heart
data.intro: Fifteen years after her unfaithful father, Elijah Watson, sent her to the countryside, Mandy Watson is summoned back—only to be handed over to the governor, a feared man rumored to have driven two of his wives to their deaths. Tasked with flattering him in exchange for power, Mandy instead uses his influence to forge her own path of vengeance for her mother.

data.title: Til Lies Do Us Part
data.intro: For three years, Theo Ridge thought he had a loyal wife in Lindsay Atkins—until he discovers her affair with Henry Skye. Determined to make them pay, Theo joins forces with Henry’s wife, Aria Keys, to plot the ultimate revenge. Unrepentant, Lindsay leaves Theo and even her family and reputation behind, confident in Henry’s wealth and promises. The pair plan to take over Aria’s company and secure their future.

data.title: The Game Ends with Goodbye
data.intro: When the truth comes to light, Heather Smith realizes that Jeremy Moore never loved her—she was just a pawn in a twisted game meant to amuse his first love. For ninety-nine cruel games, he toyed with her heart. But after witnessing his final betrayal with her own eyes, Heather doesn’t break—she awakens. She plays along with his ninety-ninth game, but this time, the rules have changed. She's done being the victim. Now, she's the one pulling the strings.

data.title: Reborn to Let Go
data.intro: The day her husband Owen Whitman's parents are kidnapped, Kaitlyn McGee stops him from going on a camping trip with his mistress and demands that he save them instead, which unfortunately results in the death of his mistress in spite of successfully saving his parents.

data.title: When Forever Passed Us By
data.intro: Phil Lowe devotes five years to Shaw Corp, climbing his way to power. But after he is hospitalized, his wife hands his office and tailored suits to a mere intern. Crushed by betrayal and realizing she will never return to his side, Phil transfers all his assets overseas—leaving her with nothing—and walks away with heartbreaking disappointment.

data.title: My Stunning Boss Lady
data.intro: Elena Graywood couldn't understand why her grandfather insisted on her marrying a man from a mountain village. Until, this man revealed to her that he was actually a divine physician with unparalleled medical skills.

data.title: Fur-tunate: Born Full of Luck
data.intro: When lightning splits the sky on the night of her birth, baby Dana Foyer arrives as more than just the youngest daughter of a struggling family—she's their miracle. Blessed with supernatural luck and the extraordinary gift to speak with animals, Dana holds secrets that could either save her family from poverty or attract dangerous attention from those who would exploit her powers.

data.title: Married at First Sight
data.intro: After being abandoned by a deceitful man, Kate Steel marries Evan Lake, a man she barely knows, and her life undergoes a dramatic transformation. As a genuine bond begins to develop between them, Kate uncovers a startling truth: she is the long-lost daughter of the Wood family and should have been living in luxury, not poverty.

data.title: The Hidden Fortune: A Dad's Lie
data.intro: Terry Ford's father is the world's wealthiest man, who kept his wealth a secret from his son out of fear that women would manipulate Terry into giving them money. It's not until Terry reaches the age of 28 that he learns the truth. For the past few years, he's been living as a poor salaryman, juggling an office job and a part-time job to make ends meet.

data.title: The Mute Serenade of Our Love
data.intro: After losing her parents, Quinn Ward meets Mike Aston, a man left deaf and mute after a tragic car accident. To pull him back from the brink of despair, Quinn pretends to share his condition, giving him a sense of understanding and companionship. For five years, they stand by each other through every hardship—until Mike miraculously recovers. As he re-enters high society, the love they once shared is tested.

data.title: Love's Out of Stock
data.intro: On their silver wedding anniversary, Louisa Goodall discovers that her husband, Jason Bennett, has been cheating on her for years. While she is desperate to save their marriage, Jason boldly demands a divorce simply because he believes he will soon be promoted to dean. Worse yet, their son and daughter-in-law side with him, leaving Louisa alone in the battle and forcing her to walk away without a single penny.

data.title: Wrath Unbound: The Unstoppable Healer
data.intro: Charles Lane was set up and imprisoned three years ago, but he unexpectedly inherited Meds Pavilion. Three years later, he made a powerful comeback. He was a doctor and a night watchman who could go anywhere he wanted. He could bring the dead back to life and even perform miracles. He vowed to make those who had hurt him suffer miserably!

data.title: Dark Web of Desire
data.intro: Sold out by someone in dark web, Chloe Morgan bumps into mafia lord, Shaun Luther in the riches’ hunting game. Once an aristocracy, Chloe is now dragged into inferno by Shaun, lost in sweetness and tortures. She finally makes up her mind to leave, but Shaun confines her no matter how many times she tries. It’s out of love, or of hatred? Overwhelmed by love and forbidden desire, the two hurt each other but simultaneously save each other.

data.title: Perfect Score, Zero Mercy
data.intro: Zach Lowe is taken back in by his wealthy parents, who openly favor their adoptive son, Ryan Lowe. He endures neglect and disdain from them and his sisters—who even send him to a detention center after he saves Lauren Hall, a victim of Ryan's car crash. Frustrated and disillusioned, Zach severs ties with his family, leaving them stunned when he achieves perfect SAT scores at the Top Scorer Banquet.

data.title: Crave Me, Command Me
data.intro: Madison Ansell, Nevahn's most beautiful woman, is betrayed by Noel Barron, heir to the city's most powerful family. Determined to take her revenge, she joins forces with his twin brother, Levi Barron. When the brothers' identities are swapped, Madison plays along, pretending to cooperate—but the moment her goal is achieved, she tries to walk away, only to discover that Levi is deadly serious about their relationship.

data.title: Love Me Loud, Love Me Bold
data.intro: A year ago, Cindy Walker swapped lives with her twin sister, stepping into a business marriage with Nathan Gibson to cover their father’s mounting medical bills. For the past year, she’s carefully played the part—trying to win her husband’s favor and keep the household running smoothly, all while hiding her true identity.

data.title: Signing Out of Your Life
data.intro: After discovering her husband Sam Shaw's affair, Amy Yale is pushed to her limit when Sam's mistress, Jill Leed, sends her a taunting photo of them in bed. Disillusioned with the ideal love life she once believed in, Amy erases her identity, leaves behind a divorce agreement, and disappears without a word. It takes time before Sam begins to regret his actions and turns on Jill, then starts searching for Amy.

data.title: Married to Mr. Mysterious
data.intro: Forced into a blind date, Nora Moore unexpectedly finds herself in a flash marriage with Trent Ford—unaware that he's actually the heir to the powerful Ford family. Believing he's just an ordinary man struggling to make ends meet, Nora settles into what she assumes will be a quiet, simple married life. Meanwhile, Trent scrambles to hide his true identity, terrified that revealing his immense wealth and status will shatter their fragile bond.

data.title: The Oath I Break, The Justice I Take
data.intro: Hallie Jaegar, once the marquis' childless wife, was brutally poisoned by the very children she had raised—only to be reborn. Fueled by vengeance, she strikes back with ruthless precision, starting by stripping the girl destined to be the heiress of her title and status.

data.title: A Trade of Hearts
data.intro: Billionaire Orson accidentally discovers that kissing Rebecca cures his deadly heart disease. Desperate to survive, he forces her to marry him, knowing that each kiss slowly kills her. What starts as a scheme to save himself turns into real bonding with Rebecca. While all their contact threatens Rebecca's life, Orson must decide which one of them shall live... himself or the true love of his life?

data.title: One Punch Sovereign
data.intro: Betrayed by his senior, Yvaris Thorne, Falrik Lorien—the Supreme Vaelith of the Ethereal Realm—falls into the Mortal Realm, stripped of his power and identity. Awakening in the body of a young man who shares his name, he must carve his path back to the realm he once ruled. As he rises from the depths of exile, Falrik forges a legend of vengeance, power, and the unification of a fractured world.

data.title: From 'I Do' to 'I'm Done'
data.intro: Logan Shaw spent years working tirelessly to win Alison Stone's heart, and they finally came together. He loved her deeply—but under the influence of his friends, his devotion began to waver. Things took a devastating turn when his mistress confronted Alison, challenging their relationship and pushing Alison to immigrate and leave him for good. By the time Logan realized the gravity of his mistake, it was too late to make amends.

data.title: Reborn and Renewed
data.intro: After being betrayed by her husband-to-be, Claudia returned to her wedding day, which was the time she was killed, and began her path for revenge.

data.title: Labyrinth of Love
data.intro: Erin Sharp and Jayden Carver were once an admired and envied couple who grew up together until Erin's father used her mother to threaten her, coercing her into marrying someone else. However, Jayden mistakenly interpreted the breakup as Erin abandoning him, prompting him to embark on a journey of self-improvement and career advancement, eventually rising as an aristocrat in Jesa.Erin believes she has lost any chance of rekindling her relationship with Jayden.

data.title: The Masked Heiress (DUBBED)
data.intro: The wealthy heiress Yasmine Lambert plans to get engaged to her lover, Jasper Lynn. However, because she has concealed her true identity from his family, she faces disdain from them, as they despise poverty and admire wealth. At their engagement banquet, Lara Lambert pretends to be the wealthy heiress, taking credit for Yasmine's accomplishments and winning the favor and approval of the entire Lynn family.

data.title: Waking to Love's Embrace
data.intro: After a tragic accident leaves Emma Hale in a vegetative state, she never gets the chance to return Adam Cosby’s unspoken love. But when she’s reborn, she seizes her second chance—fearlessly pursuing Adam while pretending to be naive to outsmart her cruel stepmother and scheming stepsister. In the end, she finds not just revenge, but true happiness.

data.title: She Speaks in Spears
data.intro: Murdered by her unfaithful husband and his mistress, Eliza Thorne is reborn as Theresa Elmore, a member of a military household who betrayed her fiancé. Disguised as a man, she infiltrates the army base camp and regains her strength by polishing her combat skills so that she can return to Juset for revenge. As the Marquess of Lumora, Eliza protects her homeland and forges a new legacy for her nation, bringing glory to her once-tainted name.

data.title: Sweetheart Rewind: Triplets in Tow
data.intro: After being betrayed by her boyfriend, Maeve Sinclair spends a lustful night with Tyler Sloane and later gives birth to triplets abroad. Six years later, she returns with her children and joins Sloane Corp, crossing paths with Tyler again. However, after searching for her all those years, Tyler mistakenly believes that she is married, so he becomes her silent guardian—until he finally approaches her and finds out her children are his.

data.title: Not All Wounds Want Healing
data.intro: Desperate to save her mother, Nancy Moore agrees to a contract marriage with Tim Murray. But by a twist of fate, she learns that Tim sees the world through her late brother's eyes—the very eyes he received in a corneal transplant five years ago. As suspicion grows and trust begins to fracture, a web of misunderstandings and hidden conflicts slowly unravels.

data.title: Here's to One Night and a Lifetime
data.intro: After spending a night with tycoon Aiden Barrett, Everly Gould never expected to see him again—until he appears at the hospital, posing as her doctor just to stay close. What she thought was fleeting becomes a dangerous entanglement as Aiden shields her from harm, crushes those who wrong her, and, upon learning she's single, begins an obsessive pursuit that blurs the line between protection and possession.

data.title: Reborn As My Foe's Brother
data.intro: Dan Morris is an average man, striving to make ends meet in life. However, his world is shattered when he discovers his fiancée in the arms of Scott Bowen, the younger son of the wealthy family behind Vanda Corp. Furious, Dan confronts Scott, only to end up dead in the pool after being humiliated by them.But death doesn't mark the end for Dan. He awakens in the body of Rufus Bowen, Scott's elder brother, and seizes the opportunity for vengeance.

data.title: No One Writes My Ending But Me
data.intro: In her past life, Zoe Snow was a beloved college student, cherished by her parents and brother. But everything shattered when her fiancé betrayed her—stealing her offer letter and giving it to Sophie Kurt, his late best friend's wife. Trapped in a loveless marriage and forced into motherhood, Zoe's life was no longer her own. Now reborn, Zoe is determined to rewrite her fate.

data.title: Mr. Singer’s Lasting Love（DUBBED)
data.intro: Three years ago, Sam Singer knelt and proposed to Kat Lane, vowing to make her the happiest wife on earth. However, a year later, she suffered a miscarriage, and he underwent a kidney transplant after a car accident. Since then, nothing has been the same.Having grown tired of all that, Kat wants a divorce. However, Sam refuses and even locks her up in the house. He says, “Don’t even think about getting a divorce! You will spend the rest of your life paying for your sins!”

data.title: Cloaked in Shadows: The Hidden Power Unveiled
data.intro: Tristan Simmons was originally the lord of Saint Dragon Hall. He stayed as the son-in-law of the Xavier family for three years and quietly used his resources to help the Xavier family. However, after the company of his wife Sandra Xavier, flourished, she became annoyed about Tristan's domediocrity and became involved with a rich heir. Once Tristan found out about it, Sandra asked for a divorce.

data.title: The Hidden Fang
data.intro: Zoe Soot, a skilled doctor with a distinguished medical background, earns the emperor's praise as the top physician in the palace. However, consumed by jealousy, a vengeful consort orchestrates Zoe's brutal execution and orders the annihilation of the entire Soot family. As the sole survivor, Zoe’s sister, Yael Soot, refuses to flee. Instead, she adopts the identity of "Luna Yale" and enters the palace as the consort’s servant.

data.title: Hit-and-Run Romance
data.intro: After a passionate night with a stranger, Kimmy Lark runs away, planning to raise the baby alone. Yet she is unexpectedly dragged into the Warners' battle for power. They're not just fighting over company shares, but also over the status of the true heir. Just as she's ready to flee again, Theo Warner pulls her right back into the heart of the war.

data.title: Snatch an Emperor to Be My Husband
data.intro: Betrayed by her partner, Diana Locke marries David Jepson to honor her grandmother’s dying wish, only to learn that he is the heir to a vast fortune. However, David’s odd behavior and inability to fit in lead Diana to suspect he might have a mental impairment. In truth, David is a king from ancient times who has traveled to the modern era. Grateful to Diana for saving his life, David vows to protect her, and together they vanquish their enemies.

data.title: Verses of Ascension
data.intro: Blood stains the earth as evil rises in the world of mortals. Peace is restored only when the Sage steps forward, wielding the power of the heavens to eradicate darkness. As mortals rebuild their empire and establish academies to cultivate new talent, the Sage takes his final breath, marking the decline of Virtue’s Way for the next 10,000 years.

data.title: Breathing You In, Once More
data.intro: Right before her wedding, Hayley Crane discovers she's been cheated on. Heartbroken, she spends the night with her personal bodyguard, Spencer Monroe, who has been secretly in love with her for ten years. Spencer supports her through the messy breakup, and just as their love deepens, a tragedy tears them apart. Five years later, they cross paths again, both at the peak of their lives, and the love they once shared ignites once more.

data.title: Exed Out of My Story
data.intro: Evelyn Scott, once the heiress of the Scotts, had her place stolen by her half-sister, Lydia. She spent three years chasing Jonas Ford, unaware he was heir to the powerful Ford family—and only approached her because of Lydia. After sacrificing everything and enduring endless betrayal, Evelyn finally lets go of her feelings for Jonas... just when he starts to want her for real.

data.title: Resurrected Mom vs. The Doomed Fate
data.intro: After dying in a car crash, Rayna Salton discovers she's just a character in a novel—the antagonist's late wife whose four children are doomed to suffer, while Lyra Salton, the fake heiress, is the heroine. Furious, Rayna is unexpectedly brought back to life ten years after her death. Her inner voice reaches her family, guiding them to defy their tragic fate and rewrite the story.

data.title: When Forever Turns to Never (DUBBED)
data.intro: Can you imagine being humiliated by your future stepmother at your father’s wedding, only to be mistaken for his mistress? In this story, Luna Ward seizes the moment of this misunderstanding and turns it into an opportunity to expose her stepmother. As the scandal stirs the crowd, Luna defends her dignity and protects her family. With Julian Ward’s unwavering support, they unleash their fury, putting an end to the disgrace once and for all.

data.title: When Love Comes Knocking
data.intro: The night Susan Jenkins was pursued by Bertram Lewis and had all her family assets seized, an adorable girl fell from the heavens and called for the most fearsome man in Chesterville, Elias Stewart, to save Susan. The adorable girl called Susan and Elias her parents, utterly confusing Susan as she stared at the strange man before her. Urged by the adorable girl, Susan moved into the Stewarts’ mansion, unaware that a plot was looming.

data.title: Glitz, Glamour, and Vengeance
data.intro: Skylar Trent, a rising pop sensation, loses everything when a cruel plot orchestrated by her boyfriend and stepsister comes to light. In her final moments, the truth shatters her—Yves Craig, the very man she once saw as an enemy, has been secretly devoted to her, protecting her from the shadows. Given a second chance at life, Skylar seizes the opportunity to rekindle her connection with Yves and take vengeance on those who ruined her.

data.title: I Break Rules and Hearts
data.intro: Three years ago, Zoe Walker became Shane Reed's lover to save her father, only to be cast aside when he agreed to an arranged marriage. Upon discovering Zoe's existence, Shane's fiancée, Yara Aston, plotted to murder both her and her father. Rescued by another wealthy heir, Zoe survived—and now she's back for revenge. But the painful truth Shane holds may bring them back together.

data.title: Not Your Crown to Take
data.intro: Rightfully the Levin heiress, Nancy was switched at birth with Zoey and grew up as a Smith. To honor a long-standing family promise, she marries Colin Zahn—in her cousin's place—the very man Zoey loves, and whom everyone believes to be a mere country bumpkin. What follows is a fierce battle for love, with decades of buried secrets rising to the surface.

data.title: Billionaire in Disguise: Daddy Edition
data.intro: Clara Monroe, a single mother of two, is reluctantly dragged by her son to a blind date—only to unexpectedly run into Ryan Pierce, the father of her children and one of the wealthiest men in the world. In a surprising twist, they soon find themselves married.
